saman_suttam_verses.prakrit_devanagari: जो परसदि अप्पाणं, समभावे संठवित्तु परिणामं । आलोयणमिदि जाणह परमजिणंदस्स उवएसे
saman_suttam_verses.transliteration: Jo passadi appānam, samabhāve samthavittu pari

saman_suttam_verses.prakrit_devanagari: अब्भुट्ठाणं अंजलिकरण, तहेवासणदायणं । गुरुभत्तिभावसुस्सूसा, विणओ एस वियाहिओ
saman_suttam_verses.transliteration: am amjalikaranam, tahevāsanadāyan

saman_suttam_verses.prakrit_devanagari: ओवचारिओ विणओ। पंचविहो खलु विणओ, पंचमगइणाइगो भणिओ
saman_suttam_verses.transliteration: ao, carittatava-ovacārio vinao. Pamcaviho khalu vi

saman_suttam_verses.prakrit_devanagari: एकम्मि हीलियम्मि हीलिया हुति ते सब्वे । एकम्मि पूइयम्मि, पूइया हुति सब्वे
saman_suttam_verses.english: Ekammi hiliyammi, hiliya humti te savve. Ekammi p

saman_suttam_verses.prakrit_devanagari: विणओ सासणे मूलं, विणीओ संजओ भवे । विणयाओ विप्पमुकस्स, कओ धम्मो कओ तवो
saman_suttam_verses.transliteration: ao sāsane mūlam, vi
saman_suttam_verses.english: o vippamukkassa, kao dhammo kao tavo ?

saman_suttam_verses.prakrit_devanagari: विणओ मोक्खदारं, विणयादो संजमो तवो णाणं । विणएणाराहिज्जदि, आइरिओ सबसंघो य
saman_suttam_verses.transliteration: ayādo samjamo tavo nānam. Vi
saman_suttam_verses.english: irio savvasamgho ya. PATII OF LIBERATION

saman_suttam_verses.prakrit_devanagari: विणयाहीया विज्जा, देंति फल इह परे य लोगम्मि । न फलंति विणयहीणा, सस्साणि व तोयहीणाई
saman_suttam_verses.transliteration: Vinayāhiyā vijjā, demti phalam iha pare ya logammi. Na phalamti vi

saman_suttam_verses.prakrit_devanagari: तम्हा सबपयत्ते, विणीयत्तं मा कदाइ छडेज्जा । अप्पसुदो वि य पुरिसो, खवेदि कम्माणि विणएण
saman_suttam_verses.transliteration: iyattam mā kadai chamdejjā. Appasudo vi ya puriso, khavedi kammāni vi

saman_suttam_verses.prakrit_devanagari: सेजोगासणिसेजो, तहोबहिपडिलेहणाहि उवरगहिदे । आहारोंसहवायण विकिचणं वंदणादीहिं
saman_suttam_verses.transliteration: yana-vikimcanam vamdanādihim.

saman_suttam_verses.prakrit_devanagari: रायणदीरोधणासिवे ओमे । वेज्जावच्चं उत्तं, संगहसारक्खणोवेदं
saman_suttam_verses.transliteration: Addhānatenasāvada-rayanadirodhanāsive ome. Vejjavaccam uttam, samgahasārakkhanovedam.

saman_suttam_verses.prakrit_devanagari: परियट्टणा य वायणा पडिच्छणाणुवेहणाय धम्मकहा । थुदिमंगलसंजुत्तो, पंचविहो होइ सजझाओ
saman_suttam_verses.transliteration: ā, padicchanānuvehanā ya dhammakahā. Thudimamgalasamjutto, pamcaviho hoi sajjh

saman_suttam_verses.prakrit_devanagari: सत्थं जो पढेइ भत्तीए । कम्ममल सोहणट्ठ, सुयलाहो सुहयरो तस्स
saman_suttam_verses.transliteration: iravekkho, jina-sattham jo padhei bhattie. Kammamala-sohanattham, suyalāho suhayaro tassa. PATIIOF LIBERATION
saman_suttam_verses.english: ) Learning acquired with humility proves fruitful in this world and in the other world; just as a plant cannot grow without water, learning will not be fruitful without humility. (

saman_suttam_verses.prakrit_devanagari: सज्झायं जाणंतो, पचिंदियसंवुडो तिगुत्तो य । होइ य एकग्गमणो, विणएण समाहिओ साहू
saman_suttam_verses.english: amto, pamcimdiyasamvudo tigutto ya. Hoi ya ekaggama

saman_suttam_verses.prakrit_devanagari: णाणेण ज्झाणसिजझी, झाणादो सवकम्मणिजरणं । णिज्जरणफलं मोक्ख, णाणब्भास तदो कुज्जा
saman_suttam_verses.transliteration: nasijjhi, jhānādo savvakammanijjaranam. Nijjaranaphalam mokkham,

saman_suttam_verses.prakrit_devanagari: बारसविहम्मि वि तवे, अब्भितरबाहिरे कुसलदिट्ठे । न वि अत्थि न वि य होही, सज्झायसमं तवोकम्मं
saman_suttam_verses.transliteration: yasamam tavokammam.
saman_suttam_verses.english: Barasavihammi vi tave, abbhimtarab

saman_suttam_verses.prakrit_devanagari: सयणासणठाणे वा, जे उ भिक्खू न वावरे । कायस्स विउससग्गो, छठो सो परिकितिओ
saman_suttam_verses.transliteration: Sayanāsanathāne vā, je u bhikkhū na v

saman_suttam_verses.prakrit_devanagari: देहमइजड्डसुद्धी, सुहदुक्खतितिक्खया अणुप्पेहा । झायइ य सुह झाणं, एगग्गो काउसरगम्मि
saman_suttam_verses.transliteration: Dehamaijaddasuddhi, suhadukkhatitikkhaya anuppehā. Jh

saman_suttam_verses.prakrit_devanagari: तेसिं तु तवो ण सुद्धो, निक्वंता जे महाकुला । जं नेवन्ने वियाणंति, न सिलोगं पवेज्जइ
saman_suttam_verses.transliteration: Tesim tu tavo na suddho, nikkhamtā je mahākulā. Jam nevanne viyā
saman_suttam_verses.english: amti, na silogam pavejjai. PATIIOF LIBERATION

saman_suttam_verses.prakrit_devanagari: नाणमयवायसहिओ, सीलुज्जलिओ तवो मओ अग्गी। संसारकरणबीयं, दहइ दवग्गी व तणरासिं
saman_suttam_verses.transliteration: yasahio, silujjalio tavo mao aggi. Samsārakaranabiyam, dahai davaggi va tanarāsim.

saman_suttam_verses.prakrit_devanagari: सीसं जहा सरीरस्स, जहा मूलं दुमस्स य । सव्वस्स साधुधम्मस्स, तहा झाणं विधीयते
saman_suttam_verses.transliteration: Sisam jahā sarirassa, jahā mūlam dumassa ya. Savvassa s

saman_suttam_verses.prakrit_devanagari: जं थिरमज्झवसाणं, तं झाणं जं चलतयं चितं । तं होज्ज भावणा वा, अणुपेहा वा अहब चिंता
saman_suttam_verses.transliteration: Jam thiramajjhavasā

saman_suttam_verses.prakrit_devanagari: लवण व्व सलिलजोए, झाणे चित्तं बिलीयए जस्स । तस्स सुहासुहडहणो, अप्पाअणलो पयासेइ
saman_suttam_verses.transliteration: Lavana vva salilajoe, jhā

saman_suttam_verses.prakrit_devanagari: जस्स न विज्जदि रागो, दोसो मोहो व जोगपरिकम्मो। तस्स सुहासुहडहणो, झाणमओ जायए अग्गी
saman_suttam_verses.transliteration: go, doso moho va jogaparikammo. Tassa suhāsuhadaha
saman_suttam_verses.english: ) The fire of penance which is set ablaze by righteous character when combined with the wind of Right knowledge, will burn the seed of karma which is the cause of mundane existence, like a forest-fire which burns heap of grass.

saman_suttam_verses.prakrit_devanagari: समायारो। झाया समाहिजुत्तो, सुहासणत्थो सुइसरीरो
saman_suttam_verses.transliteration: Puvvābhimuho uttaramuho va, houna sui-samāyaro. Jh

saman_suttam_verses.prakrit_devanagari: वयणकायवावारो । नासग्गनिमियनयणो, मंदीकयसासनीसासो
saman_suttam_verses.transliteration: Paliyamkam bamdhewn, nisidhamana-vayanakayavāvāro. Nāsagganimiyanayano, mamdikayasāsanisāso.

saman_suttam_verses.prakrit_devanagari: गरहियनियदुवरिओ, खामियसत्तो नियत्तियपमाओ । निच्चलचित्तो ता झाहि जाव पुरओब्ब पडिहाइ
saman_suttam_verses.transliteration: Garahiyaniyaduccario, khāmiyasatto niyattiyapam

saman_suttam_verses.prakrit_devanagari: थिरकयजोगाणं पुण, मुणीण झाणे सुनिच्चलमणाणं । गामम्मि जणाइण्णे, सुण्णे रण्णे व ण विसेसो
saman_suttam_verses.transliteration: ānam. Gāmammi ja

saman_suttam_verses.prakrit_devanagari: जे इंदियाणं विसया मणुण्णा, न तेसु भावं निसिरे कयाइ। न याऽमगुण्णेसु मणं पि कुज्जा, समाहिकामे समणे तवस्सी
saman_suttam_verses.transliteration: vam nisire kayāi. Na ya manunnesu ma

saman_suttam_verses.prakrit_devanagari: सुविदियजगस्सभावो, निस्संगो निब्भओ निरासो य । वेरग्गभावियमणो, झाणंमि सुनिच्चलो होइ
saman_suttam_verses.transliteration: Suvidiyajagassabh
saman_suttam_verses.english: ) A person who being pure in thought and body, concentrates his mind sitting in a comfortable posture, facing the East or the North, becomes absorbed in perfect meditation. (

saman_suttam_verses.prakrit_devanagari: पुरीसायारो अप्पा, जोई वरणाणदंसणसमग्गो । जो झायदि सो जोई पावहरो हवदि णि दो
saman_suttam_verses.transliteration: yadi so joi, pāvaharo havadi niddamdo.

saman_suttam_verses.prakrit_devanagari: देहविवित्तं पेच्छइ, अप्पाणं तह य सब्वसंजोगे । देहोवहिवोसग्गं, निस्संगो सब्वहा कुणइ
saman_suttam_verses.transliteration: Dehavivittam pecchai, appānam taha ya savvasamjoge. Dehovahivosaggam nissamgo savvaha ku

saman_suttam_verses.prakrit_devanagari: णाहं होमि परेसि, ण मे परे संति णाणमहमेक्को । इदि जो झायदि झाणे, सो अप्पाणं हवदि झादा
saman_suttam_verses.transliteration: ham homi parcsim, na me pare samti nānamahamekko. Idi jo jhāyadi jh

saman_suttam_verses.prakrit_devanagari: झाणद्विओ हु जोई जइणो संवेय णिययअप्पाणं । तो ण लहइ तं सुद्ध भग्गविहीणो जहा रयणं
saman_suttam_verses.transliteration: o samveya niyayaappanam. To na lahai tam suddham bhaggavihino jahā rayan

saman_suttam_verses.prakrit_devanagari: केवलित्तं, सिद्धत्तं चेव तस्सत्थो
saman_suttam_verses.english: vejja avatthatiyam, pimdattha-payattha-r

saman_suttam_verses.prakrit_devanagari: अवि झाइ से महावीरे, आसणत्थे अकुक्कुए झाणं । उड्ढमहे तिरियं च, पेहमाणे समाहिमपडिष्णे
saman_suttam_verses.transliteration: sanatthe akukkue jhānam. Uddhamahe tiriyam ca, pehamāne samāhimapadinne. PATIIOF LIBERATION
saman_suttam_verses.english: ) A yogin (monk) who meditates upon the soul in human form equipped with supreme knowledge and faith, is a (real) yogi; he puts an end to all his sins and becomes free from conflicting feelings of pain and pleasure (

saman_suttam_verses.prakrit_devanagari: णातीतम ण य आगमिस्सं, अठं नियच्छंति तहागया उ । विधूतकप्पे एयाणुपस्सी, णिज्झोसइत्ता खवगे महेसी
saman_suttam_verses.transliteration: Nātitamatiham na ya
saman_suttam_verses.english: gamissam, atham niyacchamti tah

saman_suttam_verses.prakrit_devanagari: मा चिट्ठह मा जंपह, मा चिन्तह कि वि जेण होइ थिरो । अप्पा अप्पम्मि रओ, इणमेव परं हवे झाणं
saman_suttam_verses.transliteration: thaha mā jampaha, mā cintaha kim vi je

saman_suttam_verses.prakrit_devanagari: इएहिं, झाणोवगयचित्तो
saman_suttam_verses.transliteration: Na kasāyasamutthehi ya, vahijjai m

saman_suttam_verses.prakrit_devanagari: चालिज्जइ बीभेइ य, धीरो न परीसहोवसग्गेहिं । सुहमेसु न संमुच्छइ, भावेसु न देवमायासु
saman_suttam_verses.transliteration: Cālijjai bibhei ya, dhiro na parīsahovasaggehim. Suhumesu na sammucchai, bhāvesu na devamāyāsu.

saman_suttam_verses.prakrit_devanagari: जह चिरसंचियमिंधणमनलो पवणसहिओ दुयं दहइ। तह कम् धणममियं, खणेण झाणानलो डहइ
saman_suttam_verses.transliteration: Jaha cirasamciyamimdhanamanalo pavanasahio duyam dahai Taha kammemdhanamamiyam, khanena jhā
saman_suttam_verses.english: ) The blessed personages give no consideration to what existed in the past nor to what will exist in the future. Certainly, the great sage, free from all indulgence in imagination and concentrating his thought on what existed in the present, first dries down and then annihilates (all his karmas). (

saman_suttam_verses.prakrit_devanagari: झाणोवरमेऽवि मुणी, णिच्वमणिच्वाइभावणापरमो । होइ सुभावियचित्तो, धम्मज्झाणेण जो पुविं
saman_suttam_verses.transliteration: ibhavanāparamo. Hoi subh

saman_suttam_verses.prakrit_devanagari: अद्युवमसरणमेगत्तमन्नत्तसंसारलोयमगुइत्तं । आसवसंवरणिज्जर, धम्मं बोधि च चिंतिज्ज
saman_suttam_verses.transliteration: Addhuvamasaranamegattamannattasamsāraloyamasuittam.
saman_suttam_verses.english: savasamvaranijjara, dhammam bodhim ca cimtijja.

saman_suttam_verses.prakrit_devanagari: सहिया, इय सब्वं भंगुर मुणह
saman_suttam_verses.transliteration: am jarāsahiyam. Lacchi vi

saman_suttam_verses.prakrit_devanagari: चइऊण महामोहं, विसए मुणिऊण भंगुरे सब्बे । णिव्विसयं कुणह मणं, जेण सुहं उत्तमं लहह
saman_suttam_verses.transliteration: a mahāmoham, visae mu
saman_suttam_verses.english: a bhamgure savve. Nivvisayam ku

saman_suttam_verses.prakrit_devanagari: वित्तं पसवो य णाइओ, तं बाले सरणं ति मण्णइ । एए मम तेसि वा अहं, णो ताणं सरणं ण विज्जई
saman_suttam_verses.transliteration: le saranam ti mannai. Ee mama tesim vā aham, no tanam sara
saman_suttam_verses.english: ) (A monk) should reflect upon transitoriness, helplessness, loneliness, distinctness (of body and soul), mundane existence, the terrestrial world, impurity, influx of Karmas, stoppage of Karmic influx, release from Karmas, religion and enlightenment. (

saman_suttam_verses.prakrit_devanagari: संग परिजाणामि, सल्लं पि य उद्धरामि तिविहेणं । गुत्तीओ समिईओ, मज्यं ताणं च सरणं च
saman_suttam_verses.transliteration: āmi, sallam pi ya uddharāmi tivihenam. Guttio samūo, majjham tānam ca saranam ca.

saman_suttam_verses.prakrit_devanagari: धी संसारो जहियं, जुवाणओ परमरूवगव्वियओ । मरिऊण जायइ किमी तत्येव कलेवरे नियए
saman_suttam_verses.transliteration: Dhi samsāro jahiyam, juvān

saman_suttam_verses.prakrit_devanagari: सो नत्थि इहोगासो, लोए वालग्गकोडिमित्तोऽवि । जम्मणमरणाबाहा, अणेगसो जत्थ न य पत्ता
saman_suttam_verses.transliteration: abāhā, anegaso jattha na ya pattā.

saman_suttam_verses.prakrit_devanagari: बाहिजरमरणमयरो, निरंतरुप्पत्तिनीरनिकुरुंबो । परिणामदारणदुहो, अहो दुरंतो भवसमुद्दो
saman_suttam_verses.transliteration: Bāhijaramaranamayaro, niramtaruppattiniranikurumbo. Parināmadārunaduho, aho duramto bhavasamuddo.

saman_suttam_verses.prakrit_devanagari: संजुत्तो, जीवो वि हवेइ उत्तमं तित्थं । संसारं तरइ जदो, रयणत्तय
saman_suttam_verses.transliteration: Rayanattaya-samjutto, jivo vi havei uttamam tittham. Samsāram tarai jado, rayanattaya-divva-n

saman_suttam_verses.prakrit_devanagari: पत्तेयं पत्तेयं नियगं, कम्मफलमणुहवंताणं । को करस जए सयणो को कस्स व परजणो भणिओ
saman_suttam_verses.transliteration: Patteyam patteyam niyagam, kammaphalamanuhavamtānam. Ko kassa jae sayano; ko kassa va parajano bhanio? PATIIOF LIBERATION
saman_suttam_verses.english: ) I know that they are all (the forms of) attachments; I shall remove those defects known as śalya from my mind, speech and body; the guptis and the samitis are my protectors and shelters. (

saman_suttam_verses.prakrit_devanagari: एगो मे सासओ अप्पा, नाणदंसणसंजुओ । सेसा मे बाहिरा भावा, सब्वे संजोगलक्खणा
saman_suttam_verses.transliteration: Ego me sāsao appā, nānadamsanasamjuo. Sesā me bāhirā bhāvā, savve samjogalakkhanā.

saman_suttam_verses.prakrit_devanagari: संजोगमूला जीवेणं, पत्ता दुक्खपरंपरा । तम्हा संजोगसंबंध, सबभावेण वोसिरे
saman_suttam_verses.transliteration: Samjogamūlā jīve

saman_suttam_verses.prakrit_devanagari: अणुसोअइ अनजणं, अन्नभवंतरगयं तु बालजणो। नवि सोयइ अप्पाणं, किलिस्समाणं भवसमुद्दे
saman_suttam_verses.transliteration: Anusoai annajanam, annabhavamtaragayam tu bālaja

saman_suttam_verses.prakrit_devanagari: जो जाणिऊण देह, जीवसरूवाद् तज्वदो भिनं । अप्पाणं पि य सेवदि, कज्जकर तस्स अणत्तं
saman_suttam_verses.transliteration: a deham, jivasarūvādu taccado bhinna

saman_suttam_verses.prakrit_devanagari: मंसडियसंघाए, मुत्तपुरीसभरिए नवच्छिरे । असुई परिस्सवंते, सुहं सरीरम्मि कि अत्थि
saman_suttam_verses.transliteration: e, muttapurīsabharie navacchidde. Asuim parissavamte, suham sarirammi kim atthi ?

saman_suttam_verses.prakrit_devanagari: भावा, जो परिवज्जेइ उवसमे लीणो । हेयं ति मन्नमाणो, आसवअणुवेहणं तस्स
saman_suttam_verses.transliteration: Ede mohaya-bhāvā, jo parivajjei uvasame li
saman_suttam_verses.english: ) My soul endowed with knowledge and faith is alone permanently mine; all others are alien to me and are in the nature of external adjuncts. (

saman_suttam_verses.prakrit_devanagari: दियस्स समिदीस अप्पमतरस । आसवदारणिरोहे, णवकम्मरयासवो ण हवे
saman_suttam_verses.transliteration: avayanakāyaguttim-diyassa samidisu appamattassa.

saman_suttam_verses.prakrit_devanagari: णाऊण लोगसारं, णिस्सारं दीहगमणसंसारं । लोयग्गसिहरवासं, झाहि पयत्तेण सुहवासं
saman_suttam_verses.transliteration: Nāūna logasāram, nissāram dihagamanasamsāram. Loyaggasiharavāsam, jhāhi payattena suhavāsam.

saman_suttam_verses.prakrit_devanagari: बंधप्पदेस गगलणं णिज्जरण इदि जिणे हि पणत्तं । जेण हवे संवरणं, तेण दु णिज्जरणमिदि जाण
saman_suttam_verses.english: Bamdhappadesa-ggalanam nijjaranam idi ji

saman_suttam_verses.prakrit_devanagari: जरामरणवेगेणं, बुज्ममाणाण पाणिणं । धम्मो दीवो पइट्ठा य गई सरणमुत्तमं
saman_suttam_verses.transliteration: Jarāmaranavegenam, vujjhamānāna pāni

saman_suttam_verses.prakrit_devanagari: माणुस्सं विग्गहं लधुँ, सुई धम्मस्स दुल्लहा । जं सोच्चा पडिवज्जति, तवं खंतिमहिंसयं
saman_suttam_verses.transliteration: ussam viggaham laddhum, sui dhammassa dullahā. Jam soccā padivajjamti, tavam khamtimahimsayam.

saman_suttam_verses.prakrit_devanagari: आहच्चव संवणं लदुं, सद्धा परमदुल्लहा । सोच्चा नेआउयं मग्गं, बहवे परिभस्सई
saman_suttam_verses.transliteration: hacca savanam laddhum, saddhā paramadullaha. Soccā neauyam maggam, bahave paribhassai. PATIIOF LIBERATION
saman_suttam_verses.english: ) A monk who controls his senses through restraints of his mind, speech and body, and is aware of the observance of samiti i. e. the five types of vigilance, prevents influx of karmas and will not attract the dust of new karmas. (

saman_suttam_verses.prakrit_devanagari: सुई च ल सद्धं च, वीरियं पुण दुल्लहं । बहवे रोयमाणा वि नो एणं पडिवज्जए
saman_suttam_verses.transliteration: . Bahave royamānā vi, no enam padivajjae.
saman_suttam_verses.english: Suim ca laddhum saddham ca, viriyam puna dullaha

saman_suttam_verses.prakrit_devanagari: सुद्धप्पा, जले णावा व आहिया । नावा व तीरसंपण्णा, सवदुक्खा तिउट्टइ
saman_suttam_verses.transliteration: ājoga-suddhappā, jale nāvā va

saman_suttam_verses.prakrit_devanagari: बारस अणुवेक्खाओ, पच्चक्खाणं तहेव पडिक्कमणं । आलोयणं समाही, तम्हा भावेज्ज अणुवेक्खं
saman_suttam_verses.transliteration: loyanam samāhi, tamhā bhāvejja anuvekkham.

saman_suttam_verses.prakrit_devanagari: मंदाइभेयाओ
saman_suttam_verses.transliteration: o. Dhammajjhānovagayassa, tivva-mamdāibhey

saman_suttam_verses.prakrit_devanagari: जोगपउत्ती लेस्सा, कसायउदयाणुरंजिया होई। तत्तो दोण्हं कज्ज, बंधचउक्कं समुद्दिट्ठ
saman_suttam_verses.transliteration: Jogapauti lessā, kas
saman_suttam_verses.english: ) Even after listening to the sacred lore and acquiring firm faith in it, it is again difficult to undertake the endeavour needed, for certainly there are many people who even having a firm faith in religion, do not practise it. (

saman_suttam_verses.prakrit_devanagari: किण्हा णीला काऊ, तेऊ पम्मा य सुक्कलेस्सा य । लेस्साणं णिहेसा, छच्चेव हवंति णियमेण
saman_suttam_verses.transliteration: hā nīlā kāu, teu pammā ya sukkalessā ya. Lessānam niddesā, chacceva havanti niyamena.

saman_suttam_verses.prakrit_devanagari: किण्हा नीला काऊ तिण्णि वि एयाओ अहम्मलेसाओ । एयाहि तिहि वि जीवो, दुग्गई उववजई बहुसो
saman_suttam_verses.transliteration: Kinhā nīlā kāu, tin

saman_suttam_verses.prakrit_devanagari: तेऊ पम्हा सुक्का, तिण्णि वि एयाओ धम्मलेसाओ । एयाहि तिहि वि जीवो, सुग्गई उववज्जई बहुसो
saman_suttam_verses.transliteration: o. Eyāhi tihi vi jivo, suggaim uvavajjai bahuso.

saman_suttam_verses.prakrit_devanagari: तिब्वतमा तिब्बतरा, तिव्वा असुहा सुहा तहा मंदा । मंदतरा मंदतमा, छट्ठाणगया हु पत्तेयं
saman_suttam_verses.transliteration: Tivvatamā tivvatarā, tivvā asuhā suh

saman_suttam_verses.prakrit_devanagari: वसाहं छित्तुं चिणित्त पडिदाई । खाउं फलाई इदि जं मणेण वयणं हवे कम्मं
saman_suttam_verses.transliteration: Pahiyāje cha ppurisā, paribhattharannamajjhadesamhi. Phalabhariyarukkhamegam, pekkhittā te vicimtamti. Nimm

saman_suttam_verses.prakrit_devanagari: चंडो ण मुंचइ वेर, भंडणसीलो य धम्मदयरहिओ । दुद्धो ण य एदि वसं, लक्खणमेयं तु किण्हस्स
saman_suttam_verses.transliteration: Camdo na mumcai veram, bhamdanasilo ya dhammadayarahio. Duttho na ya edi vasam, lakkhanameyam tu kinhassa.

saman_suttam_verses.prakrit_devanagari: मंदो बुद्धिविहीणो, णिविणाणी य विसयलोलो य । लक्खणमेयं भणियं, समासदो णीललेस्सरस
saman_suttam_verses.transliteration: ī ya visayalolo ya. Lakkhanameyam bha

saman_suttam_verses.prakrit_devanagari: रूसइ जिंदइ अन्ने, दूसइ बहुसो य सोयभयबहुलो । ण गणइ कज्जाकज्जं, लक्खणमेयं तु काउस्स
saman_suttam_verses.transliteration: Rūsai nimdai anne, dūsai bahuso ya soyabhayabahulo. Na ganai kajjākajjam, lakkhanameyam tu k

saman_suttam_verses.prakrit_devanagari: जाणइ कज्जाकज्ज, सेयमसेयं च सवसमपासी । दयदाणरदो य मिदू, लक्खणमेयं तु तेउस्स
saman_suttam_verses.transliteration: Jānai kajjākajjam, seyamaseyam ca savvasamapāsi. Dayadānarado ya mid

saman_suttam_verses.prakrit_devanagari: चागी भहो चोक्खो, अज्जवकम्मो य खमदि बहुगं पि । साहुगुरुपूजणरदो, लक्खणमेयं तु पम्मस्स
saman_suttam_verses.transliteration: hugurupūjanarado, lakkhanameyam tu pammassa.
saman_suttam_verses.english: gi bhaddo cokkho, ajjavakammo ya khamadi bahugam pi. S

saman_suttam_verses.prakrit_devanagari: ण य कुणइ पक्खवायं, ण वि य णिदाणं समो य सब्वेसिं । णत्थि य रायहोसा, णेहो वि य सुक्कलेस्सरस
saman_suttam_verses.transliteration: Na ya kunai pakkhavāyam, na vi ya nid
saman_suttam_verses.english: ) The (mental) characteristes ofa person of black Leśya are: he is violent; he does not give up enmity; he is quarrelsome, he is devoid of goodness and compassion; he is wicked and he cannot be influenced. (

saman_suttam_verses.prakrit_devanagari: लेस्सासोधी अज्झवसाणविसोधीए होइ जीवस्स । अज्झनवसाणविसोधि, मंदकसायस्स णायव्वा
saman_suttam_verses.transliteration: avisodhie hoi jivassa. Ajjhavasā

saman_suttam_verses.prakrit_devanagari: जेहिं दु लक्खिज्जेते, उदयादिसु संभवेहिं भावेहिं । जीवा ते गुणसण्णा, णिहिट्ठा सव्बदरिसीहिं
saman_suttam_verses.transliteration: disu sambhavehim bhāvehim. Jīvā te gu

saman_suttam_verses.prakrit_devanagari: विरदो पमत्त इयरो, अपुन्व अणिय िसुहमो य ॥२॥ उवसंत खीणमोहो, सजोगिकेवलिजिणो अजोगी य । चोद्दस गुणट्ठाणाणि य, कमेण सिद्धा य णायब्वा
saman_suttam_verses.transliteration: o ajogi ya. Coddasa gunatthānā
saman_suttam_verses.english: a misso, aviradasammo ya desavirado ya. Virado pamatta iyaro, apuvva a

saman_suttam_verses.prakrit_devanagari: तं मिच्छत्तं जमसदहणं, तच्चाण होदि अत्थाणं । संसइदमभिग्गहियं, अणभिग्गहियं तु तं तिविहं
saman_suttam_verses.transliteration: Tam micchattam jamasaddahanam, taccā

saman_suttam_verses.prakrit_devanagari: सिहरादो मिच्छभावसमभिमुहो । णासियसम्मत्तो सो, सासणणामो मुणेयबो
saman_suttam_verses.transliteration: Sammattarayanapavvaya-siharādo micchabh
saman_suttam_verses.english: ) On the attainment of mental purification there will be purity in the Leśyas; it should be understood that the subsidence of passions leads to attainment of mental purification.

saman_suttam_verses.prakrit_devanagari: दहिगुडमिव वामिस्सं, पिहुभाव णेव कारिदुं सक्कं । एवं मिस्सयभावो, सम्मामिच्छो त्ति णायव्बो
saman_suttam_verses.transliteration: Dahigudamiva vāmissam, pihubhāvam neva kāridum sakkam. Evam missayabhāvo, sammāmiccho tti nāyavvo.

saman_suttam_verses.prakrit_devanagari: णो इंदिएसु विरदो, णो जीवे थावरे तसे चावि । जो सदहइ जिणत्तुं, सम्माइट्ठी अविरदो सो
saman_suttam_verses.transliteration: vare tase cavi. Jo saddahai jinattum, sammāitihi avirado so.

saman_suttam_verses.prakrit_devanagari: थावरवहाओ । पडिसमयं सो जीवो विरयाविरओ जिणेक्कमई
saman_suttam_verses.transliteration: Jo tasavahāuvirado, no virao ettha-thavaravah

saman_suttam_verses.prakrit_devanagari: वत्तावत्तपमाए, जो वसइ पमत्तसंजओ होइ । सयलगुणसीलकलिओ, महव्वई चित्तलायरणो
saman_suttam_verses.transliteration: e, jo vasai pamattasamjao hoi. Sayalagunasilakalio, mahavai cittalāyarano.

saman_suttam_verses.prakrit_devanagari: णट्ठासेसपमाओ, वयगुणसीलोलिमंडिओ णाणी । अणुवसमओ अखवओ झाणणिलीणो हु अपमत्तो सो
saman_suttam_verses.transliteration: o, vayagunasilolimamdio nā

saman_suttam_verses.prakrit_devanagari: एयम्मि गुणट्ठाणे, विसरिससमयद्विएहिं जीवेहिं । पुबमपत्ता जम्हा, होति अपुवा हु परिणामा
saman_suttam_verses.transliteration: thiehim jīvehim. Puvvamapattā jamha, homti apuvvā hu pari
saman_suttam_verses.english: Eyammi gunathane, visarisasamaya

saman_suttam_verses.prakrit_devanagari: तारिसपरिणामद्वियजीवा, हु जिणेहिं गलियतिमिरेहिं । मोहस्सऽपुब्वकरणा, खवणुवसमणुज्जया भणिया
saman_suttam_verses.transliteration: Tārisaparināmatthiyajīvā, hu ji
saman_suttam_verses.english: ehim galiyatimirehim. Mohassa puvvakara

saman_suttam_verses.prakrit_devanagari: सिहाहिं णिइढकम्मवणा
saman_suttam_verses.transliteration: āmā. Vimalayarajh
saman_suttam_verses.english: ino te, padisamayam jesimekkapari

saman_suttam_verses.prakrit_devanagari: कोसुंभो जिह राओ, अब्तरदो य सुहुमरत्तो य। एवं सुहुमसराओ, सुहुमकसाओ त्ति णायव्बो
saman_suttam_verses.english: o, abbhamtarado ya suhumaratto ya. Evam suhumasar

saman_suttam_verses.prakrit_devanagari: सकदकफलजलं वा सरए सरवाणिय व णिम्मलयं। सयलोवसंतमोहो, उवसंतकसायओ होदि
saman_suttam_verses.transliteration: Sakadakaphalajalam vā, sarae saravā

saman_suttam_verses.prakrit_devanagari: समचित्तो । खीणकसाओ भण्णइ, णिग्गंथो वीयराएहिं
saman_suttam_verses.transliteration: ) The souls, experiencing such mental states (of bliss), get ready either to subside or to annihilate their delusive karmas, are given the designation 'apurvakara
saman_suttam_verses.english: Nissesakhinamoho, phalihamalabh

saman_suttam_verses.prakrit_devanagari: सहिओ वि हु केवली हु जोएण । जुत्तो त्ति सजोइजिणो, अणाइणिहणारिसे वृत्तो
saman_suttam_verses.transliteration: adivāyara-kiranakalāvappanāsiannāno. Navakevalaladdhuggama-p

saman_suttam_verses.prakrit_devanagari: आसओ जीवो । कम्मरयविप्पमुक्को, गयजोगो केवली होइ
saman_suttam_verses.transliteration: Selesim sampatto, niruddhanissesa-āsao jivo. Kammarayavippamukko, gayajogo kevali hoi.

saman_suttam_verses.prakrit_devanagari: सो तम्मि चेव समये, लोयग्गे उड्ढगमणसब्भाओ । संचिट्ठइ असरीरो, पवरट्ठ गुणप्पओ णिच्वं
saman_suttam_verses.english: So tammi ceva samaye, loyagge uddhagama

saman_suttam_verses.prakrit_devanagari: अदुविहकम्मवियडा, सीदीभूदा णिरंजणा णिच्चा । अदुगुणा कयकिच्चा, लोयग्गणिवासिणो सिद्धा
saman_suttam_verses.transliteration: Atthavihakammaviyadā, sidībhūdā niramja

saman_suttam_verses.prakrit_devanagari: सरीरमाहु नाव ति जीवो बुच्चइ नाविओ । संसारो अण्णवो वुत्तो, जं तरंति महेसिणो
saman_suttam_verses.transliteration: Sarīramāhu nāva tti, jivo vuccai nāvio. Samsāro an
saman_suttam_verses.english: ) The moment, the pure soul reaches this stage, it goes upward straight to the top of the universe according to its natural attribute, remains there forever in a disembodied form and endowed with the eight supreme attributes. (

saman_suttam_verses.prakrit_devanagari: ढमादाय, नावकंखे कयाइ वि । पुवकम्मक्खयट्ठाए, इमं देह समुद्धरे
saman_suttam_verses.transliteration: Bahiyā uddhamādāya, nāvukamkhe kayai vi. Puvvakammakkhayath

saman_suttam_verses.prakrit_devanagari: धीरेण वि मरियब्वं, काउरिसेण वि अवस्समरियवं। तम्हा अवस्समरणे, वरं खु धीरतणे मरिउं
saman_suttam_verses.transliteration: a vi mariyavvam, kāurisena vi avassamariyavvam. Tamhā avassamarane, varam khu dhirattane marium.

saman_suttam_verses.prakrit_devanagari: इक्कं पंडियमरण, छिंदइ जाईसयाणि बहुयाणि । तं मरणं मरियब्वं, जेण मओ सुम्मओ होइ
saman_suttam_verses.transliteration: Ikkam pamdiyamaranam, chimdai jāisayāni bahuyāni. Tam maranam mariyavvam, jena mao summao hoi.

saman_suttam_verses.prakrit_devanagari: इक्कं पंडियमरणं, पडिवज्जइ सुपुरिसो असंभतो । खिप्पं सो मरणाणं, काहिइ अंतं अणताणं
saman_suttam_verses.transliteration: ānam, kāhie amtam anamtānam.
saman_suttam_verses.english: am, padivajjai supuriso asambhamto. Khippam so mara

saman_suttam_verses.prakrit_devanagari: चरे पयाई परिसंकमाणो, जं किंचि पासं इह मनमाणो । लाभंतरे जीविय वहइत्ता, पच्चा परिण्णाय मलावधंसी
saman_suttam_verses.transliteration: Care payaim parisamkamā

saman_suttam_verses.prakrit_devanagari: तस्सण कप्पदि भत्त पइण्णं अणुवद्विदे भये पुरदो । सो मरणं पत्थितो, होदि हु सामण्णणिविष्णो
saman_suttam_verses.transliteration: Tassa na kappadi bhatta-painnam anuvathide bhaye purado. So maranam pathito, hodi hu sāma
saman_suttam_verses.english: ) He who has an eye on his upward journey (liberation) should not think of the external objects (i. e., worldly pleasures): he should protect his body for annihilating the past Karmas. (

saman_suttam_verses.prakrit_devanagari: संलेहणा य दुविहा, अब्भितरिया य बाहिरा चेव । अब्भितरिया कसाए बाहिरिया होइ य सरीरे
saman_suttam_verses.transliteration: Samlehanaā ya duviha, abbhimtariya ya bāhirā ceva. Abbhimtariyā kasāe, bāhiriy

saman_suttam_verses.prakrit_devanagari: कसाए पयणूएं किच्चा, अप्पाहारे तितिक्खए । अह भिक्खू गिलाएज्जा, आहारस्सेव अन्तियं
saman_suttam_verses.transliteration: em kiccā, appāhāre titikkhae. Aha bhikkhū gil

saman_suttam_verses.prakrit_devanagari: न वि कारणं तणमओ संथारो, न वि य फासुया भूमी। अप्पा खलु संथारो, होइ विसुद्धो मणो जस्स
saman_suttam_verses.transliteration: mi. Appā khalu samthāro, hoi visuddho mano jassa.

saman_suttam_verses.prakrit_devanagari: न वि तं सत्यं च विसं च, दुष्पउतु व्व कुणइ वेयालो । जंतं व दुप्पउतं, सप्यु ब्व पमाइणो कुद्धो ॥११॥ जं कुणइ भावसल्लं, अणुद्धियं उत्तमटुकालम्मि । दुल्लहबोहीयत्तं, अणंतसंसारियत्तं च
saman_suttam_verses.transliteration: ai veyālo. Jamtam va duppauttam, sappu vva pamāi
saman_suttam_verses.english: Na vi tam sattham ca visam ca, duppautu vva ku

saman_suttam_verses.prakrit_devanagari: तो उद्धरति गारवरहिया, मूलं पुणब्भवलयाणं । मिच्छादंसणसल्लं, मायासल्लं नियाणं च
saman_suttam_verses.transliteration: To uddharamti gāravarahiyā, mūlam punabbhavalayan
saman_suttam_verses.english: sallam niyanam ca. PATH OF LIBERATION

saman_suttam_verses.prakrit_devanagari: मिच्छ सणरत्ता, सनियाणा कण्हलेसमोगाढा । इय जे मरंति जीवा, तेसिं दुलहा भवे बोही
saman_suttam_verses.transliteration: Micchaddamsanarattā, saniyānā kanhalesamogādhā. Iya je maramti jivā, tesim dulah

saman_suttam_verses.prakrit_devanagari: सम्महंसणरत्ता, अनियाणा सुक्कलेसमोगाढा । इय जे मरंति जीवा, तेसि सुलहा भवे बोही
saman_suttam_verses.transliteration: arattā, aniyānā sukkalesamogādhā. Iya je maramti jivā, tesim sulah

saman_suttam_verses.prakrit_devanagari: तो जिदकरणो जुद्धे,कम्मसमत्थो भविस्सदि हि ॥१७॥ इय सामण्णं साधूवि, कुणदि णिच्चमवि जोगपरियम्मं । तो जिदकरणो मरणे, झाणसमत्थो भविस्सति
saman_suttam_verses.transliteration: Jaha rāyakulapasūo, joggam niccamavi kunai parikammam. To jidakara
saman_suttam_verses.english: adi niccamavi jogapariyammam To jidakara

saman_suttam_verses.prakrit_devanagari: मोक्खपहे अप्पाणं, ठवेहि तं चेव झाहि तं चेव । तत्येव विहर णिच्च, मा विहरसु अन्नदवेसु
saman_suttam_verses.transliteration: nam, thavehi tam ceva jhāhi tam ceva. Tattheva vihara niccam, mā viharasu annadavvesu. PATIIOF LIBERATION
saman_suttam_verses.english: ) Hence those persons who die as attached to wrong faith, as full of desire for sensuous enjoyment in return for the good acts performed, as subject to kr

saman_suttam_verses.prakrit_devanagari: प्पओग, तह जीयमरणभोगेसु । वज्जिज्जा भाविज्ज य, असुहं संसारपरिणामं
saman_suttam_verses.transliteration: Ihaparalogāsamsa-ppaoga, taha jiyamaranabhogesu. Vajjijjā bh

saman_suttam_verses.prakrit_devanagari: परदब्बादो दुग्गइ, सहव्वादो हु सुग्गई होई। इय णाऊ सदब्वे, कुणह रई विरई इयरम्मि
saman_suttam_verses.transliteration: ) One gets birth in a miserable state by being devoted to other substances i. e. worldly things and birth in a good state by being devoted to contemplation of one's own soul; knowing this one should be absorbed in meditation of one's soul and desist from thinking of other substances. SAMANA SUTTAM Part -
saman_suttam_verses.english: aha rai virai iyarammi. PATIIOF LIBERATION

saman_suttam_verses.prakrit_devanagari: जावन्तऽविज्जापुरिसा, सब्वे ते दुक्खसंभवा । लुप्पन्ति बहुसो मूढा, संसारम्मि अणन्तए
saman_suttam_verses.transliteration: Jāvanta vijjāpurisā, savve te dukkhasambhavā. Luppanti bahuso mūdh

saman_suttam_verses.prakrit_devanagari: समिक्ख पंडिए तम्हा, पासजाइपहे बहू । अप्पणा सचमेसेज्जा, मेति भूएसु कप्पए
saman_suttam_verses.transliteration: Samikkha pamdie tamha, pāsajāipahe bah

saman_suttam_verses.prakrit_devanagari: ट्ठा हुति अभिहाणा
saman_suttam_verses.transliteration: vam taheva paramaparawn Dheyam suddham paramam, eyathā humti abhihā

saman_suttam_verses.prakrit_devanagari: जीवाऽजीवा य बन्धो य, पुण्णं पावाऽऽसवो तहा । संबरो निज्जरा मोक्खो, संतेए तहिया नव
saman_suttam_verses.transliteration: . Samvaro nijjarā mokkho, samtee tahiyā nava.

saman_suttam_verses.prakrit_devanagari: निहणमत्थतरं सरीराओ । जीवमरूविं कारिं, भोयं च सयस्स कम्मस्स
saman_suttam_verses.transliteration: Uvaogalakkhanamanāi-nihanamatthamtaram sarir
saman_suttam_verses.english: . PRECEPTS ON FUNDAMENTAL TRUTHS (

saman_suttam_verses.prakrit_devanagari: सुहदुक्खजाणणा वा, हिदपरियम्मं च अहिदभीरुत्तं । जस्स ण विज्जदि णिच्वं, तं समणा विति अज्जीवं
saman_suttam_verses.transliteration: Suhadukkhajānanā vā, hidapariyammam ca ahidabhiruttam. Jassa na vijjadi niccam, tam sama

saman_suttam_verses.prakrit_devanagari: अज्जीवो पुण णेओ, पुगगल धम्मो अधम्म आयास । कालो पुग्गल मुत्तो, रूवादिगुणो अमुत्ति सेसा दु
saman_suttam_verses.transliteration: a neo, puggala dhammo adhamma āyāsam. Kālo puggala mutto, rūvādiguno amutti sesā du.

saman_suttam_verses.prakrit_devanagari: नो इन्दियरगेज्झ अमुत्तभावा, अमुत्तभावा वि य होइ निच्चो । अज्झत्थहेउं निययऽस्स बन्धो, संसारहेउं च वयन्ति बन्धं
saman_suttam_verses.transliteration: No imdiyaggejjha amuttabh

saman_suttam_verses.prakrit_devanagari: रत्तो बंधदि कम्मं, मुच्चदि कम्मेहिं रागरहिदप्पा। एसो बंधसमासो, जीवाणं जाण णिच्छयदो
saman_suttam_verses.transliteration: garahidappā. Eso bamdhasamāso, jīvānam jāna nicchayado.

saman_suttam_verses.prakrit_devanagari: तम्हा णिव्युदिकामो, रागं सव्वत्थ कुणदि मा किचि । सो तेण वीदरागो, भवियो भवसायरं तरदि
saman_suttam_verses.transliteration: ivvudikāmo, rāgam savvattha ku

saman_suttam_verses.prakrit_devanagari: कम्म पुण्णं पावं, हेऊ तेसि च होति सच्छिदरा । मंदकसाया सच्छा, तिव्वकसाया असच्छा हु
saman_suttam_verses.transliteration: Kammam punnam pāvam, heu tesim ca homti sacchidarā. Mamdakas
saman_suttam_verses.english: ) The Jinas call that an ajiva (i.e.. non-soul) which invariably does not have any knowledge of pleasure or pain, does not know what is beneficial and does not have any fear of what is detrimental. (

saman_suttam_verses.prakrit_devanagari: सीलत्तं । वेरधरणं च सुइरं, तिब्वकसायाण लिंगाणि
saman_suttam_verses.transliteration: am ca suiram, tivvakasāyāna limgani.
saman_suttam_verses.english: Appapasamsana-karanam, pujjesu vi dosagahana-silattam. Veradhara

saman_suttam_verses.prakrit_devanagari: गुहेहिं तिविहेण करणेणं
saman_suttam_verses.transliteration: Rāgaddosapamatto, imdiyavasao karei kammāim.

saman_suttam_verses.prakrit_devanagari: आसवदारेहि सया, हिंसाईएहि कम्ममासवइ । जह नावाइ विणासो, छिदेहि जलं उयहिमज्झे
saman_suttam_verses.transliteration: , himsāiehim kammamāsavai. Jaha Nāv

saman_suttam_verses.prakrit_devanagari: प्पणिओगो, जोगो त्ति जिणेहिं णिहिठो
saman_suttam_verses.transliteration: yā kāyena, kā vi juttassa viriyapari

saman_suttam_verses.prakrit_devanagari: जहा जहा अप्पतरो से जोगो, तहा तहा अप्पतरो से बंधो । निरुद्धजोगिस्स व से ण होति अछिदपोतरस व अंगुणाथे
saman_suttam_verses.transliteration: Jahā jahā appataro sejogo, tahā tah
saman_suttam_verses.english: ) Always speak words which are dear (to others), even those wicked men who use harsh words ought to be forgiven; one must take the best from all people - these are illustrative of persons possessed of subdued passions. (

saman_suttam_verses.prakrit_devanagari: विराय दंसण जोगाभावो य संवरओ
saman_suttam_verses.transliteration: Micchattāviradi vi ya, kasaya jogā ya

saman_suttam_verses.prakrit_devanagari: संधियछिदसहस्से, जलजाणे जह जलं तु णासवदि । मिच्छत्ताइअभावे, तह जीवे संवरो होइ
saman_suttam_verses.transliteration: Rumdhiyachiddasahasse, jalajā

saman_suttam_verses.prakrit_devanagari: सवभूयऽप्पभूयस्स, सम्म भूयाई पासओ । पिहियासवस्स दंतस्स, पावं कम्मं न बंधई
saman_suttam_verses.transliteration: Savvabhūya'ppabhūyassa, sammam bhūyāim pāsao. Pihiy

saman_suttam_verses.prakrit_devanagari: मिच्छत्तासवदारं, संभइ सम्मत्तदिढकवाडेण । हिंसादिदुवाराणि वि, दिढवयफलिहहिं रुभति
saman_suttam_verses.transliteration: Micchattasavadāram, rumbhai sammattadidhakavādena. Himsādiduvārāni vi, didhavayaphalihahim rumbhati.

saman_suttam_verses.prakrit_devanagari: उस्सिंचणाए तवणाए, कमेण सोसणा भवे ॥२२॥ एवं तु संजयस्सावि, पावकम्मनिरासवे । भवकोडीसंचियं कम्मं, तवसा निज्जरिज्जइ
saman_suttam_verses.transliteration: ā bhave. Evam tu samjayassāvi, pāvakammanirāsave. Bhavakodisamciyam kammam, tavasā nijjarijjai.
saman_suttam_verses.english: ) Wrong faith, non-refrainment, passion and Yoga-are the causes of Karmic influx. Self-restraint, detachment, rightfaith and the absence of Yoga are the causes of cessation. (

saman_suttam_verses.prakrit_devanagari: तवसा चेव ण मोक्खो, संवरहीणस्स होइ जिणवयणे । णहु सोत्ते पविसंते, किसिणं परिसुस्सदि तलायं
saman_suttam_verses.transliteration: Tavasā ceva na mokkho, samvarahi

saman_suttam_verses.prakrit_devanagari: ज अनाणी कम्म, खवेइ बहुआहि बासकोडीहिं । तं नाणी तिहिं गुत्तो, खवेइ ऊसासमित्तेणं
saman_suttam_verses.transliteration: i kammam, khavci bahuāhim basakodihim. Tam nā

saman_suttam_verses.prakrit_devanagari: सेणावइम्मि णिहए जहा सेणा पणस्सई । एवं कम्माणि णस्संति, मोहणिज्जे खयं गए
saman_suttam_verses.transliteration: āvaimmi nihae, jahā se
saman_suttam_verses.english: i nassamti, mohanijje khayam gae.

saman_suttam_verses.prakrit_devanagari: कम्ममलविप्पमुक्को, उड्ढं लोगस्स अंतमधिगंता । सो सव्वणाणदरिसी, लहदि सुहमणिंदियमणंत
saman_suttam_verses.transliteration: Kammamalavippamukko, uddham logassa amtamadhigamtā. So savva

saman_suttam_verses.prakrit_devanagari: चक्किकुरुफणिसुरेंदेसु, अहमिदे जं सुहं तिकालभवं । तत्तो अ तगुणिदं, सिद्धाणं खणसुहं होदि
saman_suttam_verses.transliteration: Cakkikurufanisuremdesu, ahamimde jam suham tikālabhavam. Tatto anamtagunidam, siddhānam khanasuhcm hodi.

saman_suttam_verses.prakrit_devanagari: सव्वे सरा नियट्टति, तक्का जत्थ न विजजइ । मई तत्थ न गाहिया ओए अप्पइठ्ठाणस्स खेयने
saman_suttam_verses.transliteration: tamti, takkā jattha na vijjai. Mai tattha na gāhiya, oe appai
saman_suttam_verses.english: ) It has been asserted by the Jinas that one who has not controlled the influx of the Karmas, does not achieve liberation by practising austerities only; just as the water of a pond does not dry completely, if the sources of the inlet of water are kept open. (

saman_suttam_verses.prakrit_devanagari: ण वि दुक्खं ण वि सुक्खं, ण वि पीडा णेव विजदे बाहा । ण वि मरणं ण वि जणणं, तत्थेव य होइ णिव्वाणं
saman_suttam_verses.transliteration: Na vi dukkham na vi sukkham, na vi pīdā neva vijjade bāh

saman_suttam_verses.prakrit_devanagari: ण वि इंदिय उवसग्ग, ण वि मोहो विम्हयो ण णिहा य । णय तिण्हा णेव छुहा, तत्येव य होइ णिव्वाणं
saman_suttam_verses.transliteration: Na vi imdiya uvasaggā, na vi moho vimhayo na niddā ya. Na ya tinh

saman_suttam_verses.prakrit_devanagari: ण वि कम्मं णोकम्मं, ण वि चिंता णेव अहरुदाणि । ण वि धम्मसुक्कझाणे, तत्थेव य होइ णिव्वाणं
saman_suttam_verses.transliteration: i. Na vi dhammasukkajhāne, tattheva ya hoi nivvāna

saman_suttam_verses.prakrit_devanagari: विज्जदि केवलणाणं, केवलसोक्खं च केवलं विरयं । केवलदिट्टि अमुत्तं, अत्थित्तं सप्पदेसत्तं
saman_suttam_verses.transliteration: Vijjadi kevalanānam, kevalasokkham ca kevalam virayam. Kevaladiųhi amuttam, atthittam sappadesattam.

saman_suttam_verses.prakrit_devanagari: निव्वाणं ति अवाहंति, सिद्धी लोगग्गमेव य । खेमं सिवं अणाबाहं, जं चरंति महेसिणो
saman_suttam_verses.transliteration: Nivvānam ti avāhamti, siddhi logaggameva ya. Khemam sivam anābāham, jam caramti mahesino.

saman_suttam_verses.prakrit_devanagari: लाउअ एरण्डफले, अग्गीधमे उसू धणुविमुक्के । गइ पुवपओगेणं, एवं सिद्धाण वि गती तु
saman_suttam_verses.transliteration: Lāua crandaphale, aggidhume usū dhanuvimukke. Gui puvvapaogenam, evam siddhā
saman_suttam_verses.english: ) Where there is neither pain nor pleasure, neither suffering nor obstacle, neither birth nor death, there is emancipation. (

saman_suttam_verses.prakrit_devanagari: मणोवमं पुण्णपावणिम्मुक्कं । पुणरागमणविरहियं, णिच्वं अचलं अणालंबं
saman_suttam_verses.transliteration: Avvābāhamanimdiya-manovamam punnapāvanimmukkam, Punarāgamanavirahiyam, niccam acalam anālambam.

saman_suttam_verses.prakrit_devanagari: धम्मो अहम्मो आगासं, कालो पुग्गल जन्तवो । एस लोगो ति पण्णतो, जिणेहिं वरदंसिहिं
saman_suttam_verses.transliteration: gāsam, kālo puggala jantavo. Esa logo tti pannatto, jinehim varadamsihim.

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: gamaṇayapamāṇagahirā sahiayahiayahiayaṁgamarahassā | jayaï jiṇindāṇa asēsabhāsapariṇāmiṇī vāṇī || 1 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
samagraśabdānāmanuśāsanē cikīrṣitē saṁskr̥tādibhāṣāṇāṁ ṣaṇṇāṁ śabdānuśāsanē siddhahēmacandranāmni siddhirūpanibaddhā |
            idānīṁ lōpāgamavarṇavikārādinā kramēṇa pūrvairasādhitapūrvā dēśyāḥ śabdā avaśiṣyantē |
            tatsaṁgrahārthamayamārambhaḥ |
            tatrādau śiṣṭasamayaity adhikr̥tadēvatā namaskriyatē | gamāstātparyabhēdinaḥ sadr̥śapāṭhāḥ |
            nayā vastvēkadēśagrāhiṇaḥ syādvādāvirōdhinō 'bhiprāyaviśēṣāḥ |
            naigamasaṁgrahavyavahārarjūsūtraśabdasamabhirūḍhaivaṁbhūtābhidhānāḥ |
            sapta pramāṇāni syādvādagōcarāṇi pratyakṣādīni |
            tairgaṁbhīrā mandabuddhīnāmastāghāḥ |
            atha ca sahr̥dayaṁ sacētanaṁ hr̥dayaṁ yēṣāṁ tēṣāṁ hr̥dayaṁgamarahasyā |
            ata ēva jayati niḥśēṣatīrthikabhāṣōtkarṣēṇa vartatē |
            jayantarthēna ca namaskāra ākṣipyatē |
            ayamapara utkarṣō yadaśēṣabhāṣārūpatvēna pariṇamatē |
            yad āha | saivaṁbhūtā jinēndrāṇāmarhatāṁ vāṇī jayatīti saṁbandhaḥ || [1]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: ṇīsēsadēsiparimalapallaviakuūhalāulattēṇa | viraïjjaï dēsīsaddasaṁgahō vaṇṇakamasuhaō || 2 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
vyutpitsupravr̥ttayē ’bhidhēyaprayōjanē āha | dēśīśabdēna dēśīśāstrāṇyucyantē |
            niḥśēṣadēśīśāstrāṇāṁ parimalēna pariśīlanēna pallavitaṁ prādurbhūtaṁ kvacidarthāsamarpakatvēna kvacidvarṇānupūrvīniścayābhāvēna kvacitpūrvadēśīvisaṁvādēna kvacidgatānugatikatānibaddhaśabdārthatayā yatkutūhalaṁ tēna yadākulatvamāḥ kathamayamapabhraṣṭaśabdapaṅkamagrō janaḥ samuddharaṇīya iti parōpacikīrṣārabhasastēna hatēunā dēśīrūpāṇāṁ śabdānāṁ saṁgrahō viracyatē |
            asmābhiriti śēṣaḥ |
            pādaliptācāryādiviracitadēśīśāstrēṣu satsvapyasyārambhē prayōjanaṁ viśēṣaṇadvārēṇāha vaṇṇēti |
            varṇā akārādayō hakārāvasānāḥ prākr̥taprayōgayōgyāḥ |
            tēṣāṁ padādibhūtānāṁ sukhagrahaṇadhāraṇanimittaṁ kramaḥ paripāṭiḥ |
            tēna varṇakramēṇa dvyakṣaratryakṣaracaturakṣarādipadakramēṇa ca sukhadaḥ subhagō vā |
            varṇakramēṇa hi nirdiṣṭāḥ śabdā arthaviśēṣasaṁśayē sati sukhēnaiva smaryantē 'vadhāryantē ca |
            varṇakramātikramēṇa ca nirdiśyamānā na sukhēnāvadhārayituṁ śakyantaity arthavān varṇakramanirdēśaḥ || [2]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: jē lakkhaṇē ṇa siddhā ṇa pasiddhā sakkayāhihāṇēsu | ṇa ya gaüṇalakkhaṇāsattisaṁbhavā tē iha ṇibaddhā || 3 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
punaritaradēśībhyō vailakṣaṇyamāha | lakṣaṇē śabdaśāstrē siddhahēmacandranāmni yē na siddhāḥ prakr̥tipratyayādivibhāgēna na niṣpannāstē 'tra nibaddhāḥ |
            yē tu bajjara-pajjara-upphāla-pisuṇa-saṁgha-bōlla-cava-jaṁpa-sīsa-sāhādayaḥ kathyādīnāmādēśatvēna sādhitas [siddhahēmacandram, 4, 2] tē 'nyairdēśīṣu parigr̥hītā apyasmābhirna nibaddhāḥ |
            yē ca satyāmapi prakr̥tipratyayādivibhāgēna siddhau saṁskr̥tābhidhānakōśēṣu na prasiddhāstē’py atra nibaddhāḥ |
            yathā |
            amr̥tanirgama-cchinnōdbhavā-prahānaṭādayaścandra-dūrvā-harādiṣvarthēṣu |
            yē ca saṁskr̥tābhidhānakōśēṣvaprasiddhā api gauṇyā lakṣaṇayā vālaṅkāracūḍāmaṇipratipāditayā śaktyā saṁbhavanti |
            yathā |
            mūrkhē baïllō |
            gaṅgātaṭē gaṅgāśabdasta iha dēśīśabdasaṁgrahē na nibaddhāḥ || [3]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: dēsavisēsapasiddhīi bhaṇṇamāṇā aṇantayā hunti | tamhā aṇāipāiapayaṭṭabhāsāvisēsaō dēsī || 4 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
idānīṁ nānādēśaprasiddhabhāṣāsvativyāptiparihārārthaṁ dēśīlakṣaṇam āha | dēśaviśēṣā mahārāṣṭravidarbhābhīrādayastēṣu prasiddhā |
            magā paścāt |
            nikkūilā jitaḥ |
            ukkhuruhuṁciō utkṣiptaḥ |
            prēyaṁḍō dhūrtaḥ |
            hiṁgō jāraḥ |
            viḍḍō prapañcaḥ |
            vaḍhamūḍhō mūrkha ēkagrāhī |
            ityēvamādayaḥ śabdā yady ucyēraṁs tadā dēśaviśēṣāṇām anantatvāt puruṣāyuṣēṇāpi na sarvasaṁgrahaḥ syāt |
            tasmādanādipravr̥ttaprākr̥tabhāṣāviśēṣa ēvāyaṁ dēśīśabdēnōcyata iti nātivyāptiḥ |
            yad āha |

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: ajjō jiṇammi allaṁ diahammi aṇū a sālibhēammi | aṁkō ṇiaḍē allā avvā ammā ya ambāē || 5 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
atra akārādayō dvyakṣarāḥ śabdāḥ saṁgr̥hyantē | ajjō jinō ’rhan buddhaś ca |
            yad āhuḥ |
            arhantaṁ prati dēvajjō ||
            yadi tu svāmi-paryāya-arya-śabda-samudbhavō ’yaṁ tadā maṅgalārthamasyōpādānam |
            ajjā gaurīti kēcitsaṁgr̥hṇanti |
            tadayuktam |
            tasya saṁskr̥ta-āryā-śabdādēva siddhēḥ |
            yadāha |
            āryāmbikā mr̥ḍānīti || [halāyudhaḥ 1, 15] allaṁ dinam |
            aṇū śālibhēdaḥ |
            aṁkō nikaṭam |
            allā avvā ammā ca ambā |
            jananītyarthaḥ ||
	    yathā |
prakrit_examples: vīrajjaravī allaṁ virayantō bhiṇṇamōhatimirōhō | aṇugōvigijjamāṇō giriaṁkē jayaï viharantō || 1 ||
jagaavvaambiāē pāē daṁsēsi jaï ṇa ujjintē | tō tuha ahaṁ ṇa dhūā allē ammā tumaṁ pi ṇa hu majjhā || 2 ||

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: akkō dūē akkā bahiṇī appō piā ahaṁ dukkhē | aṁguṭṭhī avaguṇṭhaṇamagayaayakkāyagā daṇuē || 6 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
akkō dūtaḥ |
            akkā bhaginī |
            ambārthas tu saṁskr̥tasamaḥ |
            yatkālāpāḥ |
            hē akka || [kātantram 2, 1, 40] appō pitā |
            ahaṁ duḥkham || aṁguṭṭhī avaguṇṭhanam |
            śirō 'vaguṇṭhanamiti yāvat |
            tryakṣaraprastāvāttvaṁguṭṭhītyanuvādyam |
            avaguṇṭhanaṁ tvarthanirdēśa iti sāmānādhikaraṇyē ’pi na vidhyanuvādasaṁdēhaḥ |
            agaō ayakkō ayagō iti trayō dānavārthāḥ ||
            yathā | atra ca |
            aha asau |
            aṇaṁ r̥ṇam |
            aḍō kūpaḥ |
            aṇa nañarthē |
            aï saṁbhāvanē |
            ētē śabdānuśāsana ēvāsmābhiḥ sādhitāity atraiva nōpāttāḥ || [7]
prakrit_examples: kayaaṁguṭṭhī akkē ayagaayakkāriappamahaharaṇaṁ | jamaakkasamē kamaḍhāgaē vi karuṇāparaṁ ṇama supāsaṁ || 3 ||

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: aṁkēllī a asōē ajjhēllī duhiadujjhadhēṇūē | aṁbēṭṭī muṭṭhijjūē aṇṇāṇaṁ vivāhavahudāṇē || 7 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
aṁkēllī aśōkataruḥ |
            ajjhēllī dugdhadōhyā dhēnuḥ |
            yā punaḥpunarduhyatē |
            abēṭṭī muṣṭidyūtam |
            aṇṇāṇaṁ vivāhavadhūdānam |
            vivāhakālē vadhvai yaddīyatē |
            yadvā vivāhārthaṁ vadhvā ēva varāya yaddānam |
            maurkhyavācakastvaṇṇāṇaśabdō 'jñānaśabdabhava ēva ||
            yathā |
prakrit_examples: aṁkēllitalāsīṇō mā rama aṁbēṭṭiāi putta tumaṁ | ajja taē dāyavva ajjhēllī bahiṇiaṇṇāṇē || 4 || [7]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: addhaṁtō pēraṁtē aruṇaṁ kamalē akāsi pajjattē | agghāḍō avamaggē avēsi aṁbēsi gharaphalahē || 8 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
addhaṁtō paryantaḥ aruṇaṁ kamalam |
            akāsi paryāptam |
            kr̥tamalamiti yāvat |
            agghāḍō apāmārgaḥ |
            avēsi tathā aṁbēsī gr̥hadvāraphalahakaḥ |
            avēsi aṁbēsīti luptavibhaktyantau samāhārō vā ||
            yathā |
prakrit_examples: aṁbēsipaēsaṭhiā agghāḍaavēsilaggavatthamisā | ṇayaṇāruṇaaddhaṁtēṇa ṇiasi jaṁ taṁ akāsi lajjāē || 5 || [8]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: aṁkārō atthārō sāhijjē atthuḍaṁ lahuē | akkaṁtaṁ ca pavuḍḍhē aṁbōccī pupphalāvīē || 9 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
aṁkārō tathā atthārō sāhāyyam |
            atthuḍaṁ laghu |
            akkaṁtaṁ pravr̥ddham |
            aṁbōccī puṣpalāvī |
            yadāmrapuṣpāṇyēvōccinōti tadā na dēśī ||
            yathā |
prakrit_examples: kusumāuhaaṁkāraṁ aṁbōccīṇaṁ ca kuṇaï atthāraṁ | malayasamīrō aïatthuḍō vi kāhī kimakkaṁtō || 6 || [9]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: dhaṇavantammi ahillō aviaṁ bhaṇiē gayammi aṭṭaṭṭō | ajjhatthō āgayaē aïṇaṁ giriaḍamaṇattamōmālē || 10 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
ahillō īśvaraḥ |
            aviaṁ uktam |
            aṭṭaṭṭō yātaḥ |
            ajjhatthō āgataḥ |
            yadyapyētē trayō ’pi kriyāvācinastathāpi tyādiṣu prayōgādarśanāddhātvādēśēṣvasmābhirna paṭhitāity atra nibaddhāḥ |
            ēvamanyatrāpyūhyam |
            aïṇaṁ giritaṭam |
            aṇattaṁ nirmālyam ||
            yathā |
prakrit_examples: ajjhatthō aṭṭaṭṭō sa kiṁ ahillō vi ia maē aviaṁ | aïṇē vi jassa raṇṇō sirē aṇattaṁ va vubbhaï ṇa āṇā || 7 || [10]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: ālē alaggamaliṇō viṁcuaē aṁbusū sarahē | akkuṭṭhaṁ ajjhāsiamaṁkiaavaruṁḍiā ya parirambhē || 11 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
alaggaṁ kalaṅkārōpaḥ |
            aliṇō vr̥ścikaḥ |
            aṁbusū śarabhaḥ |
            akkuṭṭhaṁ adhyāsitam |
            aṁkiaṁ tathā avaruṁḍiaṁ parirambhaḥ |
            avaruṁḍiaśabdasya pañcākṣarasyāpyarthānurōdhāt tryakṣarēṣu pāṭhaḥ |
            anyathā dvirarthakīrtanaṁ syāt |
            ayaṁ ca yadyapi kriyāśabdaḥ |
            avaruṁḍaï |
            avaruṁḍijjaï |
            avaruṁḍiūṇa |
            ityādi prayōgayōgyaśca tathāpi pūrvācāryairdhātvādēśēṣu na paṭhitaity asmābhirapi tadanurōdhāttatrāpaṭhitvēha nibaddhaḥ ||
            yathā |
prakrit_examples: akkuṭṭhakōvaaṁbusualiṇāṇa bhayammi kēvalamalaggaṁ | mahilāvaruṁḍiāō bīhanti vivēaaṁkiā muṇiṇō || 8 || [11]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: khaggammi aṇappō allaō pariciē pasummi akkōḍō | kayalīi asārā āvaṇē avārō avārī a || 12 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
aṇappō khaṅgaḥ |
            allaō paricitaḥ |
            akkōḍō chāgaḥ |
            asārā kadalī |
            avārō tathā avārī āpaṇaḥ ||
            yathā |
prakrit_examples: ṇiva mā akkōḍaasāraallayaṁ kuṇa aṇappamimiṇā hi | bhariā arikarimuttāhi disi avārā vidisi avārīō || 9 || [12]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: mōrē allallō kukkuḍē alaṁpō ayāli duddiṇaē | ṇiṇṇēhammi aaṁkhō ajjhassaṁ saviamakkhaē aṇahaṁ || 13 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
allallō mayūraḥ |
            alaṁpō kukkuṭaḥ |
            ayālī durdinam |
            ayālīti ikārāntō luptavibhaktyantō nirdēśaḥ |
            aaṁkhō niḥsnēhaḥ |
            ajjhassaṁ ākruṣṭam |
            ayaṁ dhātyādēśaḥ |
            ajjhassaï |
            ajjhassiaṁ |
            ityādiprayōgadarśanāt |
            pūrvācāryānurōdhāttviha nibaddhaḥ |
            aṇahaṁ akṣatam ||
            yathā |
prakrit_examples: aṇahō ayālimattāllallēsu vi taṁ aaṁkha piapāsaṁ | gantumasahō alaṁpō vva appamajjhassaï tti pahiajaṇō || 10 || [13]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: aṁjasamujjū addāō mukurē aṁchiaṁ ca kaḍḍhiaē | asiaṁ dattē savasē appajjhō 'ṇavasarammi atthakkaṁ || 15
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
aṁjasaṁ r̥ju |
            addāō darpaṇaḥ |
            aṁchiaṁ ākr̥ṣṭam |
            asiaṁ dātram |
            appajjhō ātmavaśaḥ |
            atthakkaṁ anavasaraḥ ||
            yathā ||
prakrit_examples: addāyakarāi tumaṁ aṁjasamaï asiavaṁkabhumayāē | aṁchiahiaō tammasi kiṁ atthakkē aṇappajjhō || 11 || [14]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: akkaṁdō ārakkhē ambakaḍakkhēsu aṁbiraavaṁgā | candē amayāmayaṇiggamā ya addaṇṇaaddaṇā vihurē || 15 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
akkaṁdō paritrātā |
            aṁbiraṁ āmram |
            avaṁgō kaṭākṣaḥ |
            amaō tathā amayaṇiggamō candraḥ |
            amayaṇiggamaśabdasyāmr̥tānnirgamō yasyēti vyutpattau satyāmapi saṁskr̥tēṣvaprasiddhērdēśītvam |
            addaṇṇō tathā addaṇō ākulaḥ ||
            yathā |
prakrit_examples: aṁbiraakkaṁdāē mayaṇaddaṇa amayaṇiggamamuhīē | amaüggamammi khēllasu taralaavaṁgacchaḍāi addaṇṇa || 12 || [15]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: macchammi aṁḍaō aïrō āuttammi aṁbaḍō kaḍhiṇē | alayaṁ viddumamaḍaṇī maggē alitthayāriā ya sahī || 16 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
aṁḍaō matsyaḥ |
            aïrō āyuktaḥ |
            āmēśādiḥ |
            aṁbaḍō kaṭhinaḥ |
            alayaṁ vidrumaḥ |
            kuṭalakēśavācakastvalakaśabdabhava ēva |
            aḍaṇī mārgaḥ |
            aliā tathā atthayāriā sakhī ||
            yathā |
prakrit_examples: kuṇa aṁḍayacchi bhaṇiāi atthayārīṇa aṁbaḍā kimasi | kāmāirā kimaliē kiṁ aḍaṇīē sa tumha alaüṭṭhi || 13 || [16]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: aharō akhamē ajuō sattacchaē ajjhaō saïjjhammi | avagaṇaṇāē agilā avaṇṇaaṇṇattiaggahaṇā || 17 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
aharō asamarthaḥ |
            ajuō saptacchadaḥ |
            ayamayukśabdabhava iti na vācyam |
            saṁskr̥tē hyukparṇa iti dr̥ṣṭama |
            yadi ca padaikadēśēna prayōgastadā sahr̥dayāḥ pramāṇam |
            ajjhaō prātivēśmikaḥ |
            avagaṇanā avajñā |
            tasyāmagilā avaṇṇaṁ aṇṇattī aggahaṇaṁ iti catcāri padāni ||
            yathā |
prakrit_examples: ajuakusumē vva kamalē agilā tīē viōaaharāē | ajjhaya ṇhāṇē  'vaṇṇaṁ asaṇē  'ṇṇattī sahīsu aggahaṇaṁ || 14 || [17]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: ayaḍōṁ 'dhaṁdhū kūvē aṇaḍaaṇāḍāviṇayavarā jārē | aviṇayavaīi aḍayā tahā ahavvā aḍayaṇā ya || 18 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
ayaḍō tathā aṁdhaṁdhū kūpaḥ |
            andhaścāsāvandhuścēti vigrahē śabdabhavō aṁdhaṁdhuśabdaḥ |
            kēvalaṁ sō  'ndhakūpavācī |
            ayaṁ tu kūpamātravācītīha nibaddhaḥ |
            ya tvauṇādikamaṁdhaṁdhuśabdamicchanti tairapi saṁskr̥tē prayōgādarśanādayaṁ saṁgrāhya ēva |
            aṇaḍō aṇāḍō aviṇayavarō trayō ’py amī jārārthāḥ |
            aviṇayavaī iti drōṇaḥ |
            avinayavaraity asya vyutpattau satyāmapi saṁskr̥tēṣvaprasiddhardēśītvam |
            ēvaṁ vakṣyamāṇē agujjhahara-acirajuvaï-ityādāvapi vācyam |
            ayaṁ ca ṣaḍakṣarō ’py arthānurōdhāttryakṣarēṣūpāttaḥ |
            ēvamaḍayaṇā-aṇṇaïa-akkasāla-aṇudavi-aṇōlaya-aṇuallādiṣvapi vācyam |
            aḍayā ahavvā aḍayaṇā trayō ’py ētē asatīvācakāḥ ||
            yathā |
prakrit_examples: aḍaē suṇāhi ayaḍē aṇāḍaaḍayaṇapiē sarasi kālē | aṁdhaṁdhumaviṇayavarāhavvāṭhāṇaṁ tamittha aṇaḍō kiṁ || 15 || [18]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: agghāṇō aṇṇaïō tittammi haḍhē aḍāḍaaṇuvā ya | gōsammi aṇillaṁ taha aṇōlayāṇudaviaṇuallā || 19
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
agghāṇa-aṇṇaïa-śabdau tr̥ptārthau |
            aṇṇaïō darśanādāvapi tr̥pta ucyatē |
            tēnānnacita iti vyutpattirnānuyōktavyā |
            aḍāḍō tathā aṇuvō balātkāraḥ |
            aṇillaṁ aṇōlayaṁ aṇudavi aṇuallaṁ ētē catvāraḥ prabhātavācakāḥ ||
            yathā |
prakrit_examples: maṇamaṇuvēṇa harantō aṇudaviphullāravindamayarandaṁ | parimalapāṇagghāṇō vva aṇillasamīraṇō khivaï || 16 ||
raviṇō aḍāḍakhaṇḍiatamariuṇō daṁsaṇamayaṇṇaïā | aliṇāēhi kamaliṇī gāi vva aṇōlaēsu aṇuallaṁ || 17 || [19]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: apphuṇṇaṁ ahisāyaṁ āpuṇṇē avaḍaō a tiṇapurisē | avagūḍhaṁ viliē khaṇarahiē avarikkaaṇarikkā || 20 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
apphuṇṇaṁ tathā ahisāyaṁ pūrṇam |
            ākrāntavācakastvapphuṇṇaśabdaḥ ktēnāpphuṇṇādaya [siddhahē. 4,285] iti siddhaḥ |
            atra ca tryakṣaraprakaraṇē  ’nyair anyē ’pi śabdā upāttāḥ |
            tē cāsmābhiḥ śabdānuśāsana ēva sādhitā iti nēha saṁgr̥hītāḥ |
            tathā hi |
            acchalaṁ anaparādha iti saṁskr̥tasamaḥ |
            alasī kṣumētyatasīśabdabhavaḥ |
            alāhi nivāraṇē |
            iti nipātēṣūktaḥ |
            tathā |
            agghaï rājatē |
            aṇhaï bhuṅktē |
            ahēsi asīt |
            aṭṭaï kvathati |
            aīi gacchati |
            aṁcaï karṣatītyādayō dhātvādēśēṣūktāḥ || atha ahisāyaśabdādārabhya caturakṣarāḥ || avaḍaō tr̥ṇapuruṣaḥ |
            avagūḍhaṁ vyalīkam |
            aparādhaity arthaḥ |
            avarikkō tathā aṇarikkō kṣaṇarahitaḥ |
            niravasara iti yāvat ||
            yathā |
prakrit_examples: dhaṇaapphuṇṇō kalaahisāu avaḍaü vva sāvagūḍhō sō | tā tassa kahasu maṁ sahi aṇarikkaṁ aṇavarikkaṁ pi || 18 || [20]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: aṇhēaō a bhantē khiṇṇammi avaḍiamaṇuiō caṇaē | aṁtōhuttamahōmuhamahihāṇaṁ vaṇṇaṇāē a || 21 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
aṇhēaō bhrāntaḥ |
            avaḍiaṁ khinnam |
            aṇuiō caṇakaḥ |
            aṁtōhuttaṁ adhōmukham |
            ahihāṇaṁ varṇanā |
            yadyapyabhidhānaśabdaḥ saṁskr̥tē ’pi dr̥śyatē tathāpi saṁskr̥tānabhijñaprākr̥tajñaṁmanyadurvidagdhajanāvarjanārtha saṁgr̥hītaḥ |
            ēvamanyatrāpi saṁskr̥tabhavaśabdasaṁgrahē nyāyō ’bhyūhyaḥ ||
            yathā |
prakrit_examples: aṁtōhuttō cintasi ahihāṇaṁ tīi vaṇiaütta sayā | aṇuiavikkayaṇē avaḍiō a aṇhēaō taō tumayaṁ || 19 || [21]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: avahēaṁ aṇukampē avattharā pāyaghāyammi | avaliamasaccamarihaï ṇūṇaṁ ammāiā ya aṇugāē || 22 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
avahēaṁ anukampyam |
            avattharā pādaghātaḥ |
            avahattharāity anyē |
            avaliaṁ asatyam |
            arihaï nūnam ity arthē |
            ammāiā anumārgagāminī ||
            yathā |
prakrit_examples: ammāiāi diṇṇāvahēa tuha rē avattharārihaï | ṇāvaliaṁ jaṁ jāva ya rasēṇa taṁ kisaliō asōu vva || 20 || [22]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: atthuvaḍaṁ bhallāē chīrē aliāramavalayaṁ gēhē | avahaṭṭhō gavviaē aṇusūā ṇiaḍapasavāē || 23 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
atthuvaḍaṁ bhallātakam |
            aliāraṁ dugdham |
            avalayaṁ gr̥ham |
            avahaṭṭhō garvitaḥ |
	    aṇusūā āsannaprasavā ||
            yathā |
prakrit_examples: jaï aliāraṁ vañchasi tā avalaē rakkha dhēṇumaṇusūaṁ | avahaṭṭha aṇṇahā sā marihī atthuvaḍasaṁkulē raṇṇē || 21 || [23]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: ariallī saddūlē kaḍḍhaṇarajjummi avayāṇaṁ | siracittapaṭṭiāē aṇarāhō aïṇiaṁ ca āṇīē || 24 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
ariallī vyāghraḥ |
            avayāṇaṁ ākarṣaṇarajjuḥ |
            aṇarāhō śirasi citrapaṭṭikā |
	    aïṇiaṁ ānītam ||
            yathā |
prakrit_examples: cālukka tamavagaṇṇaï disaaṇarāhia jasāṇurāyaṁ jō | ṇaraarialli sakaṇṭhē avayāṇaṁ aïṇiaṁ tēṇa || 22 || [24]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: ahiviṇṇā kayasāvattā duddantōsahē alamalō a | aṇusuttī aṇukūlē ahōraṇaṁ uttarijjammi ||25||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
ahiviṇṇā kr̥tasāpatnyā |
            alamalō durdāntavr̥ṣabhaḥ |
            alamalavasahō iti saptākṣaraṁ nāmēti gōpālaḥ |
            aṇusuttī anukūlaḥ |
            ahōraṇaṁ uttarīyam |
            avarillaśabdas tūttarīyavācakaḥ śabdānuśāsanē sādhita itīha nōkta ||
            yathā ||
prakrit_examples: alamalasama aṇusuttī kahaṁ tumaṁ muñca majjha avarillaṁ | mūḍha taē parihiamahivisāi ahōraṇaṁ imaṁ tīē || 23 || [25]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: avaḍuaavaaṇṇā ukkhalaē cīrīi aralāyā | aïrimpō kahabandhē kacchāvatthammi avaacchaṁ || 26 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
avaḍuō tathā avaaṇṇō udūkhalam |
            avaaṇṇaṁity atra tr̥tīyākṣaraṁ hakāraṁ kēcitpaṭhanti |
            aralāyā cīrī |
            aïrimpa iti makārapakārasaṁyōgāntaḥ kathābandhārthaḥ |
	    lipidōṣāpabhraṣṭās tu pakāradvayasaṁyōgaṁ kēcit paṭhanti |
            avaacchaṁ kakṣāvastram |
            kakṣētyanyē ||
            yathā |
prakrit_examples: avaaṇṇaghaḍaṇamavaḍuakaṇḍaṇamavaacchamittaparihāṇaṁ | aralāyaguñjiraṇiuñjavasaṇabhia tuha riūṇa aïrimpō || 24 || [26]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: akkhaliaṁ paḍiphaliē alīsaō sāgarukkhammi | ahirīō vicchāē aggakkhaṁdhō raṇaggadhurā || 27 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
akkhaliaṁ pratiphalitam |
            alīsaō śākavr̥kṣaḥ |
            ahirīō vicchāyaḥ |
	    aggakkhaṁdhō raṇamukham ||
            yathā |
prakrit_examples: aggakkhaṁdhapalāyaṇaahirīā kumaravāla tuha riuṇō | ōbīhanti alīsayaṇiuñjaakkhaliaappasaddē vi || 25 || [27]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: aṇṇamayaṁ puṇaruttē aṁgāliamucchusayalammi | avarōhō avarāhō a kaḍīi avāluā sikkē ||28||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
aṇṇamayaṁ punaruktam |
            aṁgāliaṁ ikṣukhaṇḍam |
            avarōhō tathā avarāhō kaṭī |
	    avāluā sr̥kva |
            ōṣṭhaparyantaḥ ||
            yathā |
prakrit_examples: aṇṇamayaṁ aṁgāliarasaṇēṇa avāluā phuḍaṁ phuḍaï | ia avarāhiṇi aharaṁ avarōhaṭhiā tuha piāmō || 26 || [28]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: pūrammi aggavēō ahiārō lōgajattāē | cōrē adaṁsaṇō kavikacchūē appaguttā ya || 29 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
aggavēō nadīpūraḥ |
            ahiārō lōkayātrā |
            adaṁsaṇō cauraḥ |
            appaguttā kapikacchūḥ ||
            yathā |
prakrit_examples: sariāṇa aggavēō adaṁsaṇā taha ya appaguttā ya | dūmanti jhatti lōaṁ ahiāravirōhiṇō hi khalā || 27 || [29]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: avagadamurummi diṭṭhē ajjhasiaṁ cañcalē aṇēkajjhō | gahabhayaruṇṇē ahisiamavaddusaṁ ukkhalāimmi || 30 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
avagadaṁ vistīrṇam |
            ajjhasiaṁ dr̥ṣṭam |
            aṇēkajjhō cañcalaḥ |
            ahisiaṁ grahaśaṅkāruditam |
            avaddusaṁ udūkhalādi śūrpaprāyam upakaraṇajātam ||
            yathā |
prakrit_examples: caïa avaddusakammaṁ kāmaggahaahisiaṁ kuṇantīē | ajjhasiamaṇēkajjhaṁ avagadaṇayaṇāi saṁbharimō || 28 || [30]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: abbhāyattō paccāgayammi abbhakkhaṇaṁ ajasē | kāvāliē agahaṇō aṁgutthalamaṅgulīammi || 31 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
abbhāyattō pratyāgataḥ |
            abbhāyatthō paścādgata iti tu gōpālaḥ |
            abbhakkhaṇaṁ akīrtiḥ |
            agahaṇō kāpālikaḥ |
            aṁgutthalaṁ aṅgulīyam ||
            yathā ||
prakrit_examples: abbhakkhaṇamagaṇantā vimukkaaṁgutthalāiāharaṇa | agahaṇavēsā raṇaō abbhāyattā bhamanti tuha riuṇō || 29 || [31]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: ucchuadantavaṇacchaṇē avayārō avahaḍaṁ musalē | aṁguliṇī phaliṇīē ahisaṁdhī puṇapuṇakkaraṇē || 32 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
avayārō māghyām utsavaviśēṣō yasminn ikṣudantadhāvanādyācāraḥ kriyatē |
            avahaḍaṁ musalam |
            aṁguliṇī priyaṅguḥ |
            ahisaṁdhī paunaḥpunyam ||
            yathā |
prakrit_examples: aṁguliṇisāmalēhiṁ avahaḍadasaṇēhi kuñjarindēhiṁ | ahisaṁdhiucchuasaṇē kō avayārē vi kuṇaï paḍisiddhiṁ || 30 || [32]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: ahivaṇṇaṁ piñjaraē pāyattāṇammi addhajaṁghā ya | aṅkābharaṇē mōttiarayaṇā ajjhōlliā ṇāma || 33 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
ahivaṇṇaṁ pītaraktam |
            addhajaṁghā mōcakākhyaṁ pādatrāṇam |
            ajjhōlliā krōḍābharaṇē mauktikaracanā ||
            yathā |
prakrit_examples: ghusiṇāhivaṇṇiāō ajjhōlliabhūsiāu jāu purā | tuha riuvahūu tāō bhamanti caïaddhajaṁghiāu vaṇē || 31 || [33]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: aïhārā vijjū saṇṇiamaddhakkhiamasaṁgayaṁ vatthē | addhakkhaṇaṁ paḍikkhaṇamavattayaṁ taha visaṁṭhulayaṁ ||34||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
aïhārā vidyut |
            aïrāhā iti tvacirābhāśabdabhavaḥ |
            addhakkhiaṁ saṁjñākaraṇam |
            asaṁgayaṁ vastram |
            addhakkhaṇaṁ pratīkṣaṇam |
            parīkṣaṇamiti kēcit |
            avattayaṁ visaṁsthulam ||
            yathā |
prakrit_examples: aïhārujjōē ṇaṁ kassa vi addhakkhiēṇa caliā si | sahi kuṇa addhakkhaṇayaṁ avattayamasaṁgayaṁ ca saṁṭhavasu || 32 || [34]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: kañcīi aṁtarijjaṁ ahikkhaṇaṁ taha uvālambhē | aṁtīharī a dūīi disāē akkhavāyā vi || 35 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
aṁtarijjaṁ kaṭīsūtram |
            ahikkhaṇaṁ upālambhaḥ |
            abhīkṣṇam ity anyē |
            aṁtīharī dūtī |
            akkhavāyā dik ||
            yathā |
prakrit_examples: āli galiaṁtarijjē ahikkhaṇaṁ tassa mē kahantīi | uvagariaṁ aṁtīhari kimakkhavāyā pulōēsi || 33 || [35]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: avarijjō aduijjē kōvē ahialamavaluā ya | avaṭhaṁbhō tambōlē virahē avahāyaavayariā || 36 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
avarijjō advitīyaḥ |
            ahialaṁ avaluā ca kōpaḥ |
            avaṭhaṁbhō tāmbūlam |
	    avahāō tathā avayariō virahaḥ |
            ayaṁ ca pañcākṣarō ’py arthānurōdhāc caturakṣarēṣu nibaddhaḥ |
            ēvam uttaratrāpi ||
            yathā |
prakrit_examples: avaṭhaṁbhē ’hialō kamalē ’valuā tīi havaï avahāē | suhayāvarijja tuha puṇa avayariē hōi kiṁ ti ṇa hu muṇimō || 34 || [36]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: aṁjaṇiāṁjaṇaīsaṁ aṁjaṇaïsiā ya tāvicchē | aṁbasamī avasamiā timmiapariusiakaṇikāē || 37 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
aṁjaṇiā aṁjaṇaīsaṁ aṁjaṇaïsiā ca tāpiccham |
            aṁbasamī tathā avasamiā stīmitaparyuṣitakaṇikā |
            aṁbasamīty atra sakāramakārayōr vyatyayē aṁbamasīti kēcit paṭhanti |
            tatra kēṣāṁcid bhramō ’bhramō vēti bahudr̥śvāna ēva pramāṇam ||
            yathā | atra kēcit |
            acchōḍaṇaṁ mr̥gayā |
            aliṁjaraṁ kuṇḍam |
            amilāyaṁ kuraṇṭakakusumam |
            acchabhallō r̥kṣaḥ |
            ityapi saṁgr̥hṇanti |
            tatsaṁskr̥tabhavatvādasmābhirnōktam |
            yattu |
            acchabhallō yakṣaity āha tad bahubhir anuktatvād asmābhir upēkṣitam |
	    tathā |
            ahacchaï akkusaï gacchati |
            avakkhaï paśyati |
            appāhaï saṁdiśati |
	    akkhōḍaï asiṁ kōśātkarṣati |
            abbhiḍaï saṁgacchatē |
            agghāḍaï agghavaï aṁgumaï pūrayati |
            aḍḍakkhaï kṣipati |
            avahēi racayati |
            avukkaï vijñapayati |
            aṇacchaï ayaṁchaï karṣati |
            allatthaï utkṣipati |
            ētē dhātvādēśēṣu śabdānuśāsanē  ’smābhir uktā iti nēhōpāttāḥ |
            na ca dhātvādēśānāṁ dēśīṣu saṁgrahō yuktaḥ |
            siddhārthaśabdānuvādaparā hi dēśī sādhyārthaparāś ca dhātvādēśāḥ |
            tē ca tyādi-tum-tavyādi-pratyayair bahurūpāḥ saṁgrahītum aśakyā iti |
            tathā avajjhāō upādhyāya iti upādhyāyaśabdasya prākr̥tam apabhraṣṭam iva rūpam iti nēhōpāttam || [37] || atha avasamiāśabdādārabhya pañcākṣarāḥ ||
prakrit_examples: aṁjaṇiaruiṁ kaṇhaṁ aṁjaṇaïsiālayāharē daṭṭhuṁ | muccaï gōvavahūē aṁbasamī addhapakkā vi || 35 ||
vialantabāhakajjalakalusiaavasamiapiṇḍayaṁ païṇō | aṁjaṇaīsasavasaṁ pāhijjaṁ kijjaï vahūē || 36 ||

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: avakīriaṁ virahiē aṁkusaïamaṅkusāyārē | avalāvammi avallāvaō a aṇahāraō khallē || 38 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
avakīriaṁ virahitam |
            aṁkusaïaṁ aṅkuśākāram |
            avallāvaō kapratyayābhāvē avallāvō apalāpaḥ |
            aṇahāraō khallam |
            nimmamadhyam ity arthaḥ |
            yathā |
prakrit_examples: kiṁ kuṇasi avallāvaṁ bhālē aṁkusaïā ṇahā tujjha | aṇahāragaṇḍajīē taṁ mā avakīriaṁ kuṇa khaṇaṁ pi || 37 || [38]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: avapusiō saṁghaḍiē avacchuraṇaṁ kōhabhaṅgibhaṇiammi | acchivaḍaṇaṁ ṇimīlaṇamaṇṇōsariaṁ aïkkantē || 39 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
avapusiō saṁghaṭitaḥ |
            avacchuraṇaṁ krōdhē sati bhaṅgayā bhaṇitam |
            acchivaḍaṇaṁ nimīlanam |
            yady apy akṣipatanaśabdasyēdaṁ rūpaṁ saṁbhavati tathāpi saṁskr̥tē tad aprasiddham itīha nibaddham |
            aṇṇōsariaṁ atikrāntam ||
            yathā ||
prakrit_examples: pasia sahi kimiha juttaṁ ciraavapusiē piammi avacchuraṇaṁ | kāyavvamacchivaḍaṇaṁ aṇṇōsariāvarāhassa || 38 || [39]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: avaakkhiamavaacchiamajjhavasiamavi ṇivāiamuhammi | asarāsaō kharahiē agaṁḍigēhō a jōvvaṇummattē || 40 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
avaakkhiaṁ tathā avaacchiaṁ tathā ajjhavasiaṁ nivāpitaṁ mukham |
            asarāsaō kharahr̥dayaḥ |
	    agaṁḍigēhō yauvanōnmattaḥ |
            yathā |
prakrit_examples: tamagaṁḍigēhamasarāsayaṁ ca avaakkhiēṇa hiṇḍantaṁ | ajjhavasiēṇa kiṁ sahi bharēsi avaacchiēṇa pukkarimō || 39 || [40]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: acchiharullō vēsē acchiviacchī parōpparāyaḍḍhī | paḍijāgariē aḍakhammiaṁ ca aṇuvajjiaṁ taha ya || 41 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
acchiharullō dvēṣyō vēṣō vā vēsaśabdasyōbhayārthatvāt |
            kēcit hasthānē ghaṁ paṭhanti |
	    acchigharullō |
            kēcid rēpham ikārāntaṁ paṭhanti |
            acchiharillō |
            tadēvaṁ granthakr̥dvipratipattau bahujñāḥ pramāṇam |
            acchiviacchī parasparamākarṣaṇam |
            aḍakhammiaṁ tathā aṇuvajjiaṁ pratijāgaritam |
            aṇuvajjiaṁ gatam iti tu gamidhātvādēśasiddham ||
            yathā |
prakrit_examples: acchiviacchīduhiā acchiharullā taē kayapahārā | piaaṇuvajjaṇarahiā aḍakhammijjanti savariāhi vaṇē || 40 || [41]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: abbhapisāō rāhū abbuddhasirī acintaphalapattī | purisāiamaḍaüjjhiamaṁgavalijjaṁ ca taṇuvalaṇaṁ || 42 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
abbhapisāō rāhuḥ |
            abbuddhasirī manōrathādhikaphalaprāptiḥ |
            aḍaüjjhiaṁ puruṣāyitam |
            viparītaratam iti yāvat |
            aṁgavalijjaṁ aṅgavalanam ||
            yathā |
prakrit_examples: aḍaüjjhiamaṁgavalijjaṁ dūrē a iha vattaṇaṁ pi kira | abbhapisāyavahūṇaṁ abbuddhasirī sirīṇāha || 41 || [42]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: addhaviāraṁ maṇḍaṇamapāramaggō a vīsāmō | apaḍicchirō jaḍamaī rahassabhēī agujjhaharō || 43 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
addhaviāraṁ maṇḍanam |
            kaścidaddhaviāraṁ maṇḍalakamityāha |
            apāramaggō viśrāmaḥ |
            apaḍicchirō jaḍamatiḥ |
            agujjhaharō rahasyabhēdī |
            asyāguhyadharaśabdabhavatvē yuktiruktā ||
            yathā |
prakrit_examples: mā kuṇa addhaviāraṁ akivē apaḍicchirē agujjhaharē | jaṁ sō taï ṇāṇuṇiō apāramaggō mahacchīṇa || 42 || [43]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: avaaṇiō aṇamiliē rittammi puḍē abhiṇṇapuḍō | hikkāē aṇubaṁdhiamaṇacchiāraṁ ca acchiṇṇē || 44 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
avaaṇiō asaṁghaṭitaḥ |
            abhiṇṇapuḍō riktapuṭaḥ |
            śiśubhiḥ krīḍayā janapralōbhanārthaṁ vipaṇimārgē riktā puṭikā yā kṣipyatē saivamucyatē |
            aṇubaṁdhiaṁ hikkā | aṇacchiāraṁ acchinnam ||
            yathā |
prakrit_examples: avaaṇiavallahāṇaṁ vērōṇamabhiṇṇapuḍayasuṇṇāṇaṁ | tuha jhatti ṇāmakittaṇamaṇacchiārāṇubaṁdhiaṁ haraï || 43 || [44]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: avarattayājarāuraaraviṁdaramaṇusaüṇhadīhammi | aṇarāmayamaraī aḍḍhaakkalī taha ya kaḍihatthē || 45 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
avarattaō paścāttāpaḥ |
            avarattēaṁ iti gōpālaḥ |
            yad āha |
            avarattēaṁ paścāttāpē  ’pi prōcyatē tajjñaiḥ || ajarāuraṁ uṣṇam |
            araviṁdaraṁ dīrgham |
            ubhayatra samāhāradvandvaḥ |
            aṇarāmaō aratiḥ |
            aḍḍhaakkalī kadyāṁ hastanivēśaḥ ||
            yathā |
prakrit_examples: araviṁdarājarāuraṇīsāsantaṁ kayaḍḍhaakkalia | agaṇantō avarattayaaṇarāmayadutthiō havasi taṁ pi || 44 || [45]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: sīhummi avakkarasō avayaḍḍhiamājihariammi | avayāsiṇī a ṇāsārajjū alamaṁjulō alasē || 46 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
avakkarasō sarakaḥ |
            avayaḍḍhiaṁ raṇahr̥tam |
            avayāsiṇī nāsārajjuḥ |
            alamaṁjulō ālasyavān |
            kēcidalamaṁjulayamalasamācakṣatē |
            tadayuktam |
            kapratyayasyātantratvāt |
            kavayō hi chandaḥ pūraṇārtha kādācitkaṁ kapratyayaṁ prayuñjatē |
            ata ēvāsmābhirayaṁ pañcākṣarēṣu nibaddhaḥ ||
            yathā |
prakrit_examples: avayaḍḍhiā bhaḍēhiṁ ghallia avayāsiṇiṁ ṇaḍijjantā | bhuamayaavakkarasaphalamariṇō alamaṁjulā tuha lahanti || 45 || [46]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: avaḍāhiamukkuṭṭhē pavāyaṇihaē ’vaḍakkiō taha ya | rōgammi aṁgavaḍḍhaṇamayataṁciamuvaciē cēa ||47||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
avaḍāhiaṁ utkruṣṭam |
            prapātaḥ kūpādiḥ |
            tatra nihatō avaḍakkiō |
            anyē tu avaḍāhiaṁ avaḍakkiaṁity anyōnyaparyāyaśabdāvuttkā gajanimīlikayā gatāḥ | asmābhistu sāradēśīnirīkṣaṇēna vivēkaḥ kr̥taḥ |
            aṁgavaḍḍhaṇaṁ rōgaḥ |
            ayataṁciaṁ upacitam |
            māṁsalamityarthaḥ |
            avaacciaṁ iti kēcitpaṭhanti |
            tatra kēṣāṁ lipibhramaḥ kēṣāṁ nēti na vidmō niyāmakābhāvāt |
            varṇānupūrvīvijñānaṁ tu prakr̥tyādivibhāgamantarēṇāśakyakriyam |
            bahutarapustakaprāmāṇyācca niyatē vartmani pravr̥ttāḥ smaity alaṁ bahubhāṣitayā ||
            yathā |
prakrit_examples: avaḍāhēmi durāsaya pariṇia pavasantaēṇa jaṁ tumaē | ayataṁciavisamasaraṁgavaḍḍhaṇā sāvaḍakkiā bālā ||46|| [47]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: aṇuvahuāirajuvaī aṇahappaṇayaṁ aṇaṭṭhammi | ajualavaṇṇāmbiliā allaṭṭapalaṭṭamaṅgaparivattē ||48||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
aṇuvahuā navavadhūḥ |
            sāmānādhikaraṇyanirdēśō ’nyōnyaṁ vidhyanuvādārthaḥ | tēna aïrajuvaī aṇuvahuāity apyarthaḥ saṁgr̥hītaḥ |
            atra |
            avajjasaï gacchati | avaakkhaï avaajjhaï paśyati |
            ahirēmaï pūrayati |
            ahiūlaï dahati |
            avahēḍaï muñcati |
            avahāvēi kr̥pāṁ karōti |
            ahilaṁkhaï ahilaṁghaï kāṅkṣati |
            ityādayō dhātvādēśēṣvasmābhiḥ sādhitā iti na saṁgr̥hītāḥ || atha aïrajuvaïśabdādārabhya ṣaḍakṣarāḥ || aṇahappaṇayaṁ anaṣṭam |
            ajualavaṇṇā amlikāvr̥kṣaḥ |
            ajualavaṇṇō saptacchada iti tvayugalaparṇaśabdabhavaḥ |
            allaṭṭapalaṭṭaṁ pārśvaparivartanam ||
            yathā |
prakrit_examples: aṇahappaṇayacchāē ajualavaṇṇāyalammi pahiassa | aṇuvahusaṁbharaṇēṇaṁ allaṭṭapalaṭṭayaṁ pēccha || 47 ||[48]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: aṇugamaṇē ’mmaṇuaṁciamahipaccuiaṁ ca ṇāyavvaṁ | aïsayaduēsu acchaṁ tayaādaraṇijjacchaḍḍiēsu aaṁ || 49 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
ammaṇuaṁciaṁ tathā ahipaccuiaṁ anugamanam |
            yathā | acchaṁ atyarthaṁ śīghraṁ ca |
            aaṁ vistāritamādaraṇīyaṁ tyaktaṁ cēti tryartham || ihānēkārthēṣu śabdēṣu vaiṣamyācchiṣyamativyāmōhō mā bhūdityudāharaṇāni nōpadarśayiṣyantē |
            [49]
prakrit_examples: dūiṁ ammaṇuaṁcasi jassa kaē bahiṇi candabimbamuhi | taṁ kiṁ ṇa ṇiasi muddhē daïaṁ aṇṇāhipaccuiaṁ || 48 ||

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: asaïsuhāṇavavahuātaruṇīsu imāi taha ajjhā | kisagurusugasuhadhaṭṭhālasēsu saddē asaccaē aṭṭaṁ ||50||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
ajjhāśabdō asatī śrubhā navavadhūstaruṇī ēṣā tēti pañcārthaḥ |
            ēṣēti sarvanāmavācyā yā kācitpratyakṣanirdēśyā |
            ajjhō ēṣa iti drōśaḥ |
            aṭṭaṁity aṣṭāsvarthēṣu |
            kr̥śō durbalaḥ |
            gururmahān |
            śrukaḥ pakṣī |
            sukhaṁ saukhyam |
            dhr̥ṣṭō viyātaḥ | alasaḥ śītakaḥ |
            śabdō dhvaniḥ |
            asatyamanr̥tam || [50]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: aṇṇī a dēarāṇī païbahiṇipiucchiāsuṁ ca | māipiucchāsāsūsahīsu attā ṇihē muhē aṇihaṁ || 51 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
aṇṇī tryarthā |
            kapratyayē aṇṇiāśabdaśca |
            dēvarāṇī dēvarabhāryā |
            patibhaginī nanāndā |
            piucchiā pitr̥ṣvasā |
            attā caturarthā |
            mātā jananī |
            piucchā pitr̥ṣvasā |
            śvaśrūḥ śvaśrurabhāryā |
            sakhī vayasyā |
            avvōśabdaḥ sūcanādiṣvēkādaśasvarthēṣu śabdānuśāsanē paṭhita itīha nōpāttaḥ |
            aṇihaṁ sadr̥śaṁ mukhaṁ ca || [51]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: cīrimasaēsu aralaṁ alasaṁ sitthayakusumbharattēsu | pasukaḍhiṇēsuṁ avilō aṇuō āyāradhaṇṇabhēēsu || 52 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
aralaṁ cīrī maśakaśca |
            alasaṁ sikthakaṁ kusumbharaktaṁ cēti dvyartham |
            avilō paśruḥ kaṭhinaśca |
            aṇuō ākr̥tirdhānyaviśēṣaścēti dvyarthaḥ |
            aṇuā yaṣṭirityanyē || [ 52 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: gharaüttapacchimaṅgaṇaṇiṭṭhuravirasēsu acalaṁ ca | avaḍō kūvārāmēsu aggiō indagōvamandēsu || 53 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
acalaśabdaḥ pañcārthaḥ |
            gharaṁ gr̥ham |
            uttaṁ uktam |
            pacchimaṅgaṇaṁ gr̥hapaścimapradēśaḥ |
            ṇiṭṭurō niṣṭhuraḥ |
            virasō nīrasaḥ |
            avaḍō kūpa ārāmaśca |
            kapratyayē avaḍaōity api |
            aggiō indragōpakīṭō mandaścēti dvyarthaḥ ||

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: atthagghaṁ atthāhaṁ agāhaāyāmaṭhāṇēsu | surasagurēḍēsuṁ ajjaō jaladdaṅgadēsu allatthaṁ ||54||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
atthagghaṁ atthāhaṁ iti ca pratyēkamagādhādiṣu triṣu |
            ajjaō surasagurēṭakayōstr̥ṇabhēdayōḥ allatthaṁ jalārdrā kēyūraṁ ca || [54]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: avaṇō vahagharaphalahēsu aṇṇaō taruṇadhuttadiarēsu | aṁtēllī majjhōaralaharīsu asaṁgiō hayacalēsu || 55 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
avaṇō parīvāhō gr̥haphalahakaścēti dvyarthaḥ |
            aṇṇaō taruṇō dhūrtō dēvaraścēti tryarthaḥ | aṁtēllī madhyaṁ jaṭharaṁ taraṅgaścēti tryarthā |
            asaṁgiō aśvō ’navasthitaśca || [ 55 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: gayabhāvivāsarēsuṁ divasārambhē a avarajjō | kaḍikaḍhiṇēsu avajjhasamaliallī miamaē a vagghē a || 56 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
avarajjō atikrāntaṁ bhaviṣyacca dinaṁ dinamukhaṁ cēti tryarthaḥ |
            avajjhasaṁ kaṭī kaṭhinaṁ ca vastu |
            aliallī kastūrikā vyāghraśra || [ 56 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: dēularapphēsuṁ ahiharamahiliamabhibhavē a kōvē a | addhāṇapacchabhāgē samāgaē aïgayaṁ paviṭṭhē a ||57||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
ahiharaṁ dēvakulaṁ valmīkaśca |
            ahiliaṁ abhibhavaḥ kōpaśca |
            aïgayaṁ mārgapaścādbhāgaḥ samāgataṁ praviṣṭaṁ cēti tryartham || [ 57 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: aïrāṇī indāṇīi tavvayāsēviṇīē a | chaṇaṇiamēsu avasahaṁ haḍhēsimattāsu akkasālā vi || 58 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
aïrāṇī indrāṇī saubhānyārthamindrāṇīvratāsēvinī ca strī |
            avasahaṁ utsavō niyamaśca |
            akkasālā balātkāra īṣanmattā ca strīti dvyarthā || atra ca |
            abbhuttaï snāti pradīpyatē ca |
            alliaï ālīyata upasarpati ca |
            ētau dvāvapi dvyarthau dhātvādēśēṣvasmābhiruktāviti nōcyētē || [ 58]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: avirayahikkāsuṁ aṇusaṁdhiamavihāviaṁ ca dīṇammi | aṇaālavaṇē taṁ cia akkhaṇavēlaṁ rayappaōsēsu ||59||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
aṇusaṁdhiaṁ avirataṁ hikkā ca |
            avihāviaṁ dīnamanālapanē ’pi tadēvēti dvyartham |
            akkhaṇavēlaṁ surataṁ pradōṣaśca || atra ca |
            avaacchaï hlādatē hlādayati paśyati ca |
            avaāsaï paśyati śliṣyati ca |
            avasēhaï gacchati naśyati ca | ēvam avaharaï |
            ityādayō dhātvādēśēṣvasmābhiruktā iti nōpāttāḥ || [ 59 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: bhaṇiō akaṁḍatalimō ṇiṇṇēhākayavivāhēsu | avakittīi asaccē dāṇammi a avarihaḍḍhapusaṇaṁ ti ||60||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
akaṁḍatalimō niḥsnēhō ’kr̥tavivāhaśca |
            atra ca |
            ahipaccuaï guhṇāti āgacchati cēti dhātvādēśēṣūkta iti nōktaḥ |
            avarihaḍḍhapusaṇaṁ akīrtirasatyaṁ dānaṁ cēti tryartham || [ 60 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: āhū ghūē āū salilē taha viṁcuammi ālāsō | āṇikkaṁ taṁsaraē āallī jhāḍabhēammi ||61||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
āhuity ukārānta ulūkavācī |
            āū salilam |
            ālāsō vr̥ścikaḥ | āṇikkaṁ tiryaksuratam |
            āallī jhāṭabhēdaḥ ||
            yathā |
prakrit_examples: āalliāhuālāsasaṁkulaṁ āurahiagirisariaṁ | āṇikkajāṇi tuha kāraṇē aḍavimaḍaï sō suṇṇō ||49|| [ 69 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: āhaccaṁ accatthē muhamāṇuamāulaṁ raṇṇē | āvaṁgō avamaggē juḍē āmōḍaāmēlā ||62||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
āhaccaṁ atyartham |
            āṇuaṁ mukham |
            ākāraity anyē |
            āulaṁ araṇyam | āvaṁgō apāmārgaḥ |
            āmōḍō tathā āmēlō jūṭaḥ |
            śēkharavācakastu āmēlō āpīḍaśabdabhavaḥ ||
            yathā ||
prakrit_examples: lhasiāmōḍamilāṇāṇuāṇa tuha riuvahūṇa āmēlō | āhaccamāulamahīluḍhiāṇāvaṁgamañjarī liaï || 50 || [ 62 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: ārillō ārā ārōhō a thaṇammi āpharō jūē | āgattī kūvatulā āsaṁghēcchāi khittamāviddhaṁ ||63||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
ārillō arvāk |
            arvākkālōtpannaity arthaḥ |
            ārōhō stanaḥ |
            nitasbavācī tvārōhaśabdaḥ saṁskr̥tasamaḥ |
            āpharō dyūtam |
            āgattī kūpatulā |
            āsaṁghā icchā | āsthētyanyē |
            āviddhaṁ prēritam ||
            yathā |
prakrit_examples: ārillamayaṇa āgattīdaḍhabhua muñca āpharaṁ suhaya | maraï tuhāsaṁghāē kāmāviddhā varārōhā || 51 || [ 63 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: āṇāī saülī āṇūvō savacē haḍhammi āḍāḍā | āyaḍḍhīāmōālaṁbā vitthāraharisabhūchattā || 64 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
āṇāī śakunikākhyaḥ pakṣī |
            āṇūvō śvapacaḥ |
            āḍāḍā balātkāraḥ | āyaḍḍhī vistāraḥ |
            āmōō harṣaḥ |
            parimalavācakastvāmōdaśabdabhavaḥ |
            ālaṁbaṁ bhūmicchatram |
            yadvarṣāsu prarōhati ||
            yathā ||
prakrit_examples: haṇiūṇa paütthajaṇaṁ āṇāikulaṁ va raïaāḍāḍō | ālaṁbāyaḍḍhimisā āmōā hasaï pāusāṇūvō || 52 || [ 64 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: ālatthō mōrē āsayamāsaṇṇē balammi āyāmō | ālīlaṁ ṇiaḍabhaē āuramājimmi āusaṁ kuccē || 65 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
ālatthō mayūraḥ |
            āsayaṁ nikaṭam |
            āyāmō balam |
            dīrghaity anyē |
            ālīlaṁ nikaṭaṁ bhayam |
            āuraṁ saṁgrāmaḥ |
            āusaṁ kūrcam ||
            yathā |
prakrit_examples: sāyāmāsayasēṇṇaṁ tuha pēcchia jāyaāurālīlā | ālatthapicchacchattē chaḍḍia riuṇō aṇāusā janti || 53 || [ 65 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: āsaṁgō āsavaṇaṁ ālayaṇaṁ vāsagēhammi | āmōraō visēsaṇṇuammi āhuṁdurō vālē || 66 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
āsaṁgādayastrayō vāsagr̥hārthāḥ |
            atra ca |
            āliddhaśabda āśliṣṭaśabdabhavaḥ | āhaï kāṅkṣatīti dhātvādēśēṣūkta iti nōpāttaḥ |
            āmōraō viśēṣajñaḥ |
            āhuṁdurō vālaḥ |
            āhuṁdurū vālaity anyē ||
            yathā |
prakrit_examples: āmōraya siriāsaṁga taē āhuṁdurā kariharīṇa | mittāsavaṇaamittālayaṇaduvārēsu saṁghaḍiā || 54 || [ 66 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: kamalammi āraṇālaṁ āsiaō lōhaghaḍiammi | āsakkhaō sirivaē āmalayaṁ ṇēuragharammi || 67 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
āraṇālaṁ kamalam |
            kāñcikē āraṇālaṁ saṁskr̥tabhavam |
            āsiaō lōhamayaḥ | kēcidayasā nirvr̥tta āyasikastadapabhraṁśa āsiaōity āhuḥ |
            āsakkhaō śrīriti vadatīti śrīvadaḥ praśastaḥ pakṣiviśēṣaḥ |
            āmalayaṁ nūpuragr̥ham ||
            yathā |
prakrit_examples: līlāraṇālaāmalayakēliāsakkhaē imē tīē | jaṁ virahammi ṇiantaṁ hiaa ṇa phuṭṭēsi taṁ si āsiaaṁ || 55 || [ 67 ]
