desinamaala.prakrit_verse: āaḍḍiaṁ paravvasacaliē āūḍiaṁ ca jūapaṇē | ālaṁkiaṁ ca khañjīkayammi āmaṁḍaṇaṁ bhaṇḍē || 68 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
āaḍḍiaṁ paravaśacalitam |
            yastu vyāprērāaḍḍaity ādēśō ’smābhiruktaḥ sa vyāpāramātrārthaḥ |
            āūḍiaṁ dyūtapaṇaḥ |
            ālaṁkiaṁ khañjīkr̥tam |
            āmaṁḍaṇaṁ bhāṇḍam ||
            yathā |
prakrit_examples: rayaṇāmaṁḍaṇamavaṇiṁ jō sahi āūḍiaṁ khaṇē kuṇaï | sō āaḍḍiaālaṁkiēhi kaha ahisarēavvō || 56 || [ 68 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: ārōggiaāsīvayaāhuḍiā bhuttasuiapaḍiēsu | mīsattamāḍuālī āsariō saṁmuhāāē || 69 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
ārōggiaṁ bhuktam |
            āsīvaō sūcījīvakaḥ |
            āhuḍiaṁ nipatitam |
            āḍuālī miśrībhāvaḥ |
            āsariō saṁmukhāgataḥ ||
            yathā | iha ca āaḍḍa-āuḍa-ārōgga-āḍuāla-āhuḍaprabhr̥tīni dhātvādēśapratirūpakāṇi nāmāni |
            tēṣāṁ karōtyarthē ṇici nāmadhātutvamapi |
            tēna |
            āaḍḍaï | āūḍaï |
            ārōggaï |
            āḍuālaï |
            āhuḍaï |
            ityādyapi siddham |
            ēvaṁ sarvatra kriyāvāciṣu yōjanīyam |
            [ 69 ]
prakrit_examples: ārōggiāḍuālīsattūṇaṁ tuha ṇarinda sattūṇaṁ | āhuḍiāṇamaraṇṇē pattapuḍāsīvaattamāsariaṁ || 57 ||

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: āyāvalō a bālāyavammi āvālayaṁ ca jalaṇiaḍē | āḍōviaṁ ca ārōsiammi ārāiaṁ gahiē || 70 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
āyāvalō bālātapaḥ |
            āvālayaṁ jalanikaṭam |
            kapratyayābhāvē āvālaṁity api | āḍōviaṁ ārōṣitam |
            ārāiaṁ gr̥hītam |
            āsāditamityanyē ||
            yathā |
prakrit_examples: āyāvalē pasariē kiṁ āḍōvasi rahaṅga ṇiadaïaṁ | ārāiabisakandō āvālaṭhiaṁ pasāēsu || 58 || [ 70 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: mālāyārē āraṁbhiō a āisaṇamujjhiaē | ālīvaṇaṁ palittē kariāē āvarēiā cēa || 71 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
āraṁbhiō mālākāraḥ |
            āisaṇaṁ ujjhitam |
            ālīvaṇaṁ pradīptam |
            pradīpanakamityarthaḥ |
            atra ca |
            āhammiaṁ āgatamityāṅpūrvasya hammēḥ siddham |
            āigghaï ājighrati |
            āhōḍaï tāḍayati |
            āsaṁghaï saṁbhāvayati |
            āaḍḍaï vyāpriyatē | āuḍḍaï majjati |
            ārōlaï puñjayati |
            āyaṁbaï āyajjhaï vēpatē |
            āḍhavaï ārabhatē |
            ālihaï spr̥śati |
            āiṁchaï karṣati |
            ārōaï ullasati |
            āḍhappaï ārabhyatē |
            ityādayō dhātvādēśēṣūktā iti nōcyantē |
            ārāliō sūpakāraity ārālikaśabdabhavatvānnōktaḥ |
            āvarēiā karikā |
            madyaparivēṣaṇabhāṇḍam ||
            yathā |
prakrit_examples: kassa va viōaālīvaṇammi āraṁbhiē tumaṁ paḍiā | jaṁ maïrāvimuhīē āisaṇaṁ āvarēiāi kayaṁ || 59 || [ 71 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: āyāsalavō ṇīḍē āyāsatalaṁ ca hammapuṭṭhammi | āṇaṁdavaḍō paḍhamē vahūi ruhirāruṇē vatthē || 72 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
āyāsalavō pakṣigr̥ham |
            āyāsatalaṁ harmyapr̥ṣṭham |
            āṇaṁdavaḍō prathamaṁ vadhvā rudhirāruṇitaṁ vastram |
            prathamapariṇayē bhartrā kaumārē gr̥hītē yattatparimalarudhirarañjitaṁ vastram |
            bāndhavānānandayati tat āṇaṁdavaḍākhyam |
            yathā | atra ca |
            āviluṁpiaṁ abhilaṣitamiti yadanyairuktaṁ tatkāṅkṣērādēśaḥ |
            āsēaṇayaśabdaścāvitr̥ptadarśanārtha āsēcanakaśabdabhava iti nōktau || [ 72 ]
prakrit_examples: āyāsatalōvari vallahassa cariaṁ vayaṁsi ṇiṇhavasu | āṇaṁdavaḍō āyāsalavaṭṭiasāriā ya taṁ kahaï || 60 ||

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: pasavaduhaṇiccadiṭṭhēsu āvi ālaṁ vahōlamaüēsu | accatthadīhavisamēsu lōhamusalēsu taha āaṁ || 73 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
āviśabdaḥ prasavaduḥkhē nityē dr̥ṣṭē cēti tryarthaḥ |
            ālaṁ alpasrōtō mr̥du ca | āaṁ atyartha dīrgha viṣamaṁ lōhaṁ musalaṁ cēti pañcārtham || [ 73 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: āṇiamāḍhiamiṭṭhē gaṇaṇijjē appamattagāḍhēsu | sikkārē paṇiē āhuḍamāaramukkhalē kuccē || 74 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
āṇiaṁ āḍhiaṁ ca iṣṭaṁ gaṇanīyamapramattaṁ gāḍhaṁ cēti pratyēkaṁ dvāvapi caturarthau | āhuḍaṁ sītkāraḥ paṇitaṁ ca |
            āaraṁ udūkhalaṁ kūrcaṁ ca || [ 74 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: āallō rōgacalēsu vilaviē cittiē a ārāḍī | āraddhaṁ ca pavuḍḍhē sayaṇhagēhāgaēsuṁ ca || 75 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
āallō rōgaścañcalaśca |
            ārāḍī vilapitaṁ citrayutaṁ ca |
            āraḍiaṁity anyē | yadāha |
            cittaliaṁ vilaviaṁ ca āraḍiaṁ || āraddhaṁ pravr̥ddhaṁ satr̥ṣṇaṁ gr̥ha āgataṁ cēti tryartham || [ 75 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: āraṇamaharapharēsuṁ āviamindōvamahiapōēsu | āūramaïsaüṇhēsu caliakuviāulēsu āhitthō || 76 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
āraṇaṁ adharaḥ phalakaśca |
            āviaṁ indragōpō mathitaṁ prōtaṁ cēti tryartham | āūraṁ atiśayamuṣṇaṁ ca |
            āhitthō calitaḥ kupita ākulaścēti tryarthaḥ || [ 76 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: ārēiaṁ maüliē mukkē bhantē sarōmañcē | ṇavavahuparatantāsuṁ āvaṭṭiaāviajjhāō || 77 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
ārēiaṁ mukulitaṁ muktaṁ bhrāntaṁ sarōmāñcaṁ cēti caturartham |
            āvaṭṭiā tathā āviajjhā navavadhūḥ paratantrā cēti pratyēkaṁ dvyarthē || [ 77 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: āippaṇaṁ ca piṭṭhē chaṇagharamaṇḍaṇacchuhāchaḍāē a | avivittasaṁkaḍē āraṁdaramāvaḍiamabbhiḍiasārē || 78 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
āippaṇaṁ piṣṭamutsavē gr̥hamaṇḍanārtha sudhāchaṭā ca |
            tandulapiṣṭakṣīraṁ gr̥hamaṇḍanamāippaṇaṁity anyē |
            āraṁdaraṁ anēkāntaṁ saṁkaṭaṁ ca |
            avivittasaṁkaḍē iti samāhāraḥ | āvaḍiaṁ saṁgataṁ sāraṁ ca |
            abbhiḍiaṁ saṁgataṁ samā abbhiḍaity ādēśāt |
            atrāpi samāhāraḥ |
            atra āluṁkhaï dahati spr̥śati cēti dhātvādēśēṣūkta iti nōktaḥ || [ 78 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: iggō bhīē ibbhō vaṇiē ucchusayalammi iṁgālī | ikkusamuppalamiriṇaṁ kaṇayaṁ indindirammi iddaṁḍō || 79 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
iggō bhītaḥ |
            ibbhō vaṇik || iṇaṁ iṇamō ētat |
            irṇhi idānīm |
            ira kilārthē |
            ētē śabdānuśāsana ēvōktā itīha nōcyantē || iṁgālī ikṣukhaṇḍam | ikkusaṁ sāmānyābhidhānē ’pi nīlōtpalam |
            iriṇaṁ kanakam |
            iddaṁḍō bhramaraḥ | kaiścidindindiraśabdō ’pi dēśya uktaḥ |
            asmābhistu saṁskr̥tē ’pi darśanādanayā bhaṅgayā nibaddhaḥ ||
            yathā |
prakrit_examples: ibbhāṇamiriṇamikkusamiddaṁḍāṇaṁ gayāṇa iṁgālī | iggāṇa ya mābhēsīsaddō harisaṁ samuvvahaï || 61 || [ 79 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: ikkaṇaïrāvaïgghiaïriā cōrakaribhacchiakuḍīsu | ōsiṁghiammi iṁghiamiṁdaggīṁdaggidhūmamavi tuhiṇē || 80 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
ikkaṇō cōraḥ |
            irāvō gajaḥ |
            igghiaṁ bhartsitam |
            iriā kuṭī |
            iṁghiaṁ ghrātam |
            iṁdaggī tathā iṁdaggidhūmaṁ tuhinam ||
            yathā |
prakrit_examples: maṇaïkkaṇa balaïgghiaïrāva paṇṇaïriāṭhiā muṇiṇō | iṁdaggiṇagē iṁdaggidhūmadhavalaṁ jasaṁ tuhēṁghinti || 62 || [ 80 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: kōmārē iṁdamahō iṁdōvattō a indōvē | kīḍēsu iṁdagāī juēsu iramaṁdirō karahē || 81 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
iṁdamahō kaumāraḥ |
            kumāryā bhava iti vyutpattēḥ |
            iṁdamahaṁ kaumāramityavantisundarī |
            yadudāharati sma | iṁdōvattō indragōpakaḥ |
            iṁdagāī yutāḥ kīṭāḥ |
            yē kīṭāḥ saṁlagnā bhramanti | iramaṁdirō karabhaḥ ||
            yathā |
prakrit_examples: uvahasaē ērāṇiṁ indō indīvaracchi ēttāhē | iṁdamahapēcchiē tuha muhassa sōhaṁ ṇiacchantō || 63 ||
iramaṁdirēṁdagāīiṁdōvattāijantuṇō vi varaṁ | iṁdamahō puṇa ṇūṇaṁ lajjaṁ hāsaṁ ca jaṇaï jaṇē || 64 || [ 81 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: induṭṭhavaṇē iṁdaḍḍhalaō iṁdamahakāmuō sāṇē | illō dariddakōmalapaḍihāralavittakasiṇēsu || 82 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
iṁdaḍḍhalaō indrōtthāpanam |
            iṁdamahakāmuō śvā ||
            yathā | illō daridraḥ kōmalaḥ pratīhārō lavitraṁ kr̥ṣṇavarṇaścēti pañcārthaḥ || [ 82 ]
prakrit_examples: iṁdaḍḍhalaō saraē payāṇacaliēbhagajjiēhi taē | raïō riūhi raṇṇē sahaaraïṁdamahakāmuaravēhiṁ || 65 ||

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: saddūlasīhavuṭṭhīṇivāraṇēsuṁ tahā illī | bisivuṭṭhirakkhaṇēsuṁ gēhaduvārē a illīraṁ || 83 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
illī śārdūlaḥ siṁhō varṣatrāṇaṁ cēti tryarthaḥ |
            illīraṁ br̥sī vr̥ṣṭivāraṇaṁ gr̥hadvāraṁ cēti tryartham || [ 83 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: īsaṁ kīlē rōjjhammi īsaō īsarō mayaṇē | savarasirapaṇṇapuḍayammi īsiaṁ taha vasāiaē || 84 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
īsaṁ kīlakaḥ |
            īsaō rōjjhākhyō mr̥gaḥ |
            īsarō manmathaḥ ||
            yathā | īsiaṁ śabaraśiraḥ patrapuṭaṁ vaśāyitaṁ cēti dvyartham || [ 84 ]
prakrit_examples: mukkēsarēhi ṇiccaṁ bhamirēhiṁ īsaēhi va culukka | dalabhōaṇēhi īsīkayā tuhārīhi raṇṇadumā || 66 ||

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: uṁḍaṁ gahirē ucchū vāē ukkaṁ. ca pāḍavaṇē | ucchō antāvaraṇē uḍḍō kūvāikhaṇayammi || 85 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
uṁḍaṁ gambhīram |
            ucchū vātaḥ |
            ikṣuvācakastu saṁskr̥tabhava ēva |
            ukkaṁ pādapatanam |
            ucchō antāvaraṇam |
            ōjjharīti prasiddhaḥ |
            uḍḍō kr̥pādikhanakaḥ ||
            yathā |
prakrit_examples: ucchū uṇhō khaṇiā uḍḍēhiṁ kūvayā ya aïuṁḍā | ucchaṁ dahaï a taṇhā ukkamiṇaṁ tujjha maruthaliē || 67 || [ 85 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: uramārambhē uccaṁ ṇāhitalē banghaṇē uṁvā | tiṇaparivāraṇayamuḍū uṁbī uṇa pikkagōhūmē || 86 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
uraṁ ārambhaḥ |
            uccaṁ nāmitalam |
            uṁbā bandhanam |
            uḍū tr̥ṇaparivāraṇam | tr̥ṇāvacchādanamityarthaḥ |
            uṁbī pakkagōdhūmaḥ ||
            yathā | atra ca |
            ubbhaṁ ūrdhyam |
            ubbhē yūyam |
            ua paśya |
            ētē śabdānuśāsanē sādhitā iti nōktāḥ |
            ussāśabdastu dhēnuparyāya usrāśabdabhavaḥ || [ 86 ]
prakrit_examples: kuntalaüḍucchaṇṇēṇaṁ jaṇaṇayaṇamigāṇa uṁbakhāyaṁ va | mayaṇēṇa urē raïaṁ tuha uccaṁ uṁbigōraṅgi || 68 ||

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: ukkā ukkaṁdī kūvatulā cullīi ulliuddāṇā | uvvāuvvaraüvvāhā ukkōlō a ghammammi || 87 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
ukkā tathā ukkaṁdī kūpatulā |
            ukkaṁtī kūpatulētyanyē |
            ullī tathā uddāṇā cullī | uvvā- uvvara- uvvāha - ukkōlāścatvārō ’pi gharmārthāḥ ||
            yathā |
prakrit_examples: jaliaggiulliuvvāsaṁtattā uṇhayālaükkōlē | kāsayadhūā vaccaï ō ukkākaḍḍhiṁajalammi || 69 ||
uddāṇaṁ va samuddaṁ laṅghaï baḍavāṇaluvvaraṁ jiṇaï | kassuvvāhaṁ ṇa jaṇāi ukkaṁdibhuō paī majjha || 70 || [ 87 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: urarī pasummi kisarāi uṇhiā aṇṇamō samuṇṇayaē | uliaṁ ṇikūṇiacchē uaaṁ ujjummi ukkhalī piḍharē || 88 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
urarī paśruḥ |
            aṇhiā kr̥sarā |
            uṇṇamō samunnataḥ |
            uliaṁ nikūṇitākṣam | uaaṁ r̥ju |
            ukkhalī piṭharam ||
            yathā |
prakrit_examples: uaüṇṇamadēhalimullaṅghia bāhimuliaṁ ṇiacchantī | ukkhaliuṇihaamurarī ua rōragharammi ullihaï || 71 || [ 88 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: ulluṭṭaṁ micchāē uviaṁ sigghammi dūsaṇē usuō | dhattūrē ummattō ulittamuccaṭṭhiē kūvē || 89 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
ulluṭṭaṁ mithyā |
            uviaṁ śīghram |
            usuō dūṣaṇam |
            ummattō dhattūrakaḥ |
            ēraṇḍaity anyē |
            ulittaṁ uccasthitaḥ kūpaḥ ||
            yathā |
prakrit_examples: ulluṭṭaṁ jaṁ kaṇayaṁ pēcchasi ummattaüsuavihurō si | tā rē payapāṇakaē vaja uviamulittakaṇṭhaghōsammi || 72 || [ 89 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: ugghaṭṭiuālīō avayaṁsē phāliē urattaṁ ca | bahuammi uṁbaraṁ ucchuramaviṇaṁsirē khalammi upphālō || 90 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
ugghaṭṭī tathā uālī avataṁsaḥ |
            urattaṁ sphāṭitam |
            uṁbaraṁ bahu |
            yastu dēhalyartha uṁbaraśabdaḥ sa udumbaraśabdabhavaḥ |
            ucchuraṁ avinaśvaram |
            upphālō durjanaḥ || yathā |
prakrit_examples: rē upphāla urattē pēmmē suravahuuālijōggēhiṁ | kiṁ ṇāma uṁbarucchuraṇavakusumēhiṁ pi ugghaṭṭī || 73 || [ 90 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: uḍḍhallaüḍḍhalā ullāsē taha ummalaṁ thīṇē | ukkuṁḍō mattē uggamammi uḍḍāaüpphōā || 91 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
uḍḍhallō tathā uḍḍhalō ullāsaḥ |
            ummalaṁ styānam |
            ukkuṁḍō mattaḥ |
            uḍḍāō tathā upphōō udgamaḥ ||
            yathā |
prakrit_examples: tiṇaüpphōukkuṁḍavasahuḍḍhalukkhāyaümmaluppaṅkē | saraē tuha vērīhiṁ mukkā uḍḍāyaüḍḍhalā || 74 || [ 91 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: ukkōḍā ukkaṁḍā lañcāē tuṭṭayammi ullukkaṁ | upphuṇṇaṁ āuṇṇē ucchāhō suttatantummi || 92 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
ukkōḍā tathā ukkaṁḍā lañcā |
            ullukkaṁ truṭitam |
            upphuṇṇaṁ āpūrṇam |
            ucchāhō sūtratantuḥ ||
            yathā |
prakrit_examples: virahōpphuṇṇē ukkōḍaaṇiuṇē dēsu tassa ukkaṁḍaṁ | ucchāhēhi ṇa muddhē saṁdhijjaï pēmmamullukkaṁ || 75 || [ 92 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: saṁmaddē utthagghō hēṭṭhāmuhayammi ummatthaṁ | parivattaṇammi utthallā uvadēhīi uddēhī || 93 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
utthagvō saṁmardaḥ |
            ummatthaṁ adhōmukham |
            viparītamiti yāvat |
            utthallā parivartanam |
            uddēhī upadēhikā ||
            yathā |
prakrit_examples: jaṇaütthagghē utthalliūṇa mā pēccha vāri ummattha | uddēhitikkhatuṇḍaṁ kiṁ aṇuintiṁ ṇa pēkkhasē mahilaṁ || 76 || [ 93 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: ukkōḍī paḍisaddē bisē usīraṁ ḍarammi upphēsō | ummallā taṇhāē ataḍē kūvammi uttūhō || 94 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
ukkōḍī pratiśabdaḥ |
            usīraṁ bisam |
            upphēsō trāsaḥ |
            apavādārthē ’ pyayaṁ lakṣyēṣu dr̥śyatē |
            yathā | ummallā tr̥ṣṇā |
            uttūhō ataṭaḥ kūpaḥ ||
            yathā |
prakrit_examples: asarisajaṇaüpphēsayā ṇa hu sahiavvā kulē pasūēṇa || 77 ||
tuha hayahēsōkkōḍīupphēsā vēriṇō gayā raṇṇē | ummallāi usīraṁ asanti pavisanti uttūhaṁ || 78 || [ 94 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: ujjamaguṇṭhiachiddēsu ujjhasubbhaggaücchillā | ucchuaümmaraübbhaṁtā bhayacōriayadēhaligilāṇā || 95 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
ujjhasaprabhr̥tayastrayō yathāsaṁkhyamudyamādyarthāḥ |
            ujjhasō udyamaḥ |
            ubbhaggō guṇṭhitaḥ |
            ucchillaṁ chidram |
            iha chillaśabdaśrchidrārthō vakṣyatē |
            tasya utpūrvakasyēdaṁ rūpamiti na śaṅkanīyaṁ chillaücchillaśabdayōḥ svatantratvāt |
            na hi dēśīśabdānāmupasargasaṁbandhō bhavati |
            ēvaṁ phēsaüpphēsādiṣvapi vācyam |
            ucchuādayō ’pi trayō yathāsaṁkhyaṁ bhayacauryādyarthāḥ |
            ucchuaṁ bhayacauryam |
            ummarō gr̥hadēhalī |
            ubbhaṁtō glānaḥ ||
            yathā |
prakrit_examples: timirōbbhaggaṇisāē ummaraücchillakhalaṇaübbhaṁtā | ucchuarayaüjjhasaō ua asaī visaï khaṇḍadēvaülaṁ || 79 || [ 95 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: suṇṇē ujjaḍamukkērō a balī uḍḍasō a makkuṇaē | santammi a ubbhāō uddhatthō vippaladdhē a || 96 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
ujjaḍaṁ udvasam |
            ukkērō upahāraḥ |
            samūhavācakastu ukkēraśabda utkaraśabdabhava ēva |
            uḍḍasō matkuṇaḥ |
            ubbhāō śāntaḥ |
            uddhatthō vipralabdhaḥ ||
            yathā |
prakrit_examples: vōlanti tujjha riuṇō sōḍḍasasayaṇē ṇisaṁ pi uddhatthā | ubbhāyā diahaṁ kayaüjjaḍadēvaüladēvaükvērā || 80 || [ 96 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: ujjallā ummaḍḍā haḍhammi vimalammi uccārō | viulē uccāḍō payaḍē uccēvō daḍhammi uccatthō || 97 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
ujjallā tathā ummaḍḍā balātkāraḥ |
            uccārō vimalaḥ |
            uccāḍō vipulaḥ | uccēvō prakaṭaḥ |
            uccatthō dr̥ḍhaḥ ||
            yathā |
prakrit_examples: uccārē uccēvē uccāḍakarē sasimmi jaṁ kāmō | ujjallōccatthabalō tā ummaḍḍāi ramasu imaṁ || 81 || [ 97 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: uaha tti pēcchahatthē uḍidō māsammi sāiṇī uarī | ullōcō a viāṇē chimpayakārummi uṁchaō hōi || 98 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
uaha paśyata |
            uḍidō māṣadhānyam |
            uarī śākinī |
            ullōcō vitānam | uṁchaō chimpakākhyaḥ kāruviśēṣaḥ ||
            yathā |
prakrit_examples: uṁchayavāḍē majjārirūvayāō bhamanti uarīō | uahōḍidasāmāō tamissaüllōciē gayaṇē || 82 || [ 98 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: uḍḍāsō tāvē ugghuṭṭhaṁ puṁsiamarimmi ullōlō | dariē uttuṇaümmuhaüccuṁcucchucchuutturiddhīō || 99 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
uḍḍāsō saṁtāpaḥ |
            ugghuṭṭhaṁ puṁsitam |
            ugghuṭṭaśabdasya uddhuṣṭa iti vyutpattau satyāṁ viśēṣārtharūḍhēriha pāṭhaḥ |
            ullōlō śatruḥ |
            uttuṇō ummuhō uccuṁcō ucchucchū utturiddhī ētē pañca śabdā dr̥ptārthāḥ |
            utturiddhī garvaity anyē ||
            yathā |
prakrit_examples: vijjōcchucchukulummuhavayaüccuṁcasiriutturiddhīṇaṁ | ugghuṭṭhamuttuṇattaṁ ullōlāṇaṁ taē kaüḍḍāsaṁ || 83 || [ 99 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: ārūḍhē ullūḍhō uccappōccuppiā taha ya | uvvīḍhaṁ uddariaṁ ummariaṁ cēa ukkhāē || 100 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
ullūḍhō uccappō uccuppiō trayō ’ pyēta ārūḍhārthāḥ |
            ullūḍhō aṅkuritaity anyē | uvvīḍhaṁ uddariaṁ ummariaṁ cēti trayō ’py ēta utkhātārthāḥ ||
            yathā |
prakrit_examples: uvvīḍhakhaggaümmariasattuṇivahō guṇēsu ullūḍhō | uddariuccappakhalō uccuppaï tihuaṇaṁ pi cālukkō || 84 || [ 100 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: ucchaṭṭō uḍḍahaṇō cōrē duacōriāi ucchaṁṭō | uttālōvvēttālā acchiṇṇārāvarūṇṇammi || 101 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
ucchaṭṭō |
            ōtsaṁyōgē [ siddhahē° 1,116 ] hatyuta ōti |
            ōcchaṭṭō |
            tathā uḍḍahaṇō dvāvapyētau cōrārthau |
            ucchaṁṭō drutadhauryam |
            uttālaṁ uvvēttālaṁ dvāvapyētau nirantarasvararuditē |
            uddhatārthavācī tūttālaśabdaḥ samasaṁskr̥ta ēva ||
            yathā |
prakrit_examples: guṇigaṇahiaücchaṭṭaya uḍḍahaṇucchaṁṭabhīsiā raṇṇē | payaḍiajhāḍuttālaṁ uvvēttālanti tujjha riuvahuā || 85 || [ 101 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: khiṇṇē uvvāuttaṁpiā ya hāsammi ullēvō | ubbhuggōpphaṁdōlā calammi mūḍhammi ummaïaṁ || 102 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
uvvāō tathā uttaṁpiō khinnaḥ |
            uttammiaṁ khinnamityanyē |
            ullēvō hāsaḥ | svārthē kē ullēvaōity api |
            ubbhuggō upphaṁdōlō dvāvapyētau calārthau |
            ummaïaṁ mūḍham ||
            yathā | atra ca |
            utthārō utsāhaḥ |
            ucchuṇṇaṁ vimarditamityutsāhaütkṣuṇṇaśabdaprabhavau | unduraüccayaśabdāvākhunīvīvācakau saṁskr̥tasamau |
            uṁghaï nidrāti |
            uggaï udghāṭayati |
            ētau dhātvādēśēṣūktāvityētē ’ nyairuktā api nōktāḥ |
            [ 102 ]
prakrit_examples: uvvāyamaṇā ubbhuggalōaṇā caïacāruullēvā | upphaṁdōlōttaṁpaï tujjha kaē sā viōaümmaïā || 86 ||

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: ubbhālaṇamuppaṇaṇē palāyaṇatthammi ujjhamaṇaṁ | ucchaviaṁ sayaṇīē uiṁtaṇaṁ uttarijjammi || 103 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
ubbhālaṇaṁ śrūrpādinōtpavanam |
            ubbhālaṇaṁ apūrvamiti kēcit |
            uta ōti ōbbhālaṇaṁity api |
            ujjhamaṇaṁ palāyaṇam |
            uta ōti ōjjhamaṇaṁity api | ucchaviaṁ śayanīyan |
            uiṁtaṇaṁ uttarīyam ||
            yathā |
prakrit_examples: vialiaüiṁtaṇāē suṇṇaṁ ubbhālaṇaṁ kuṇantīē | taha pulaïamucchaviaṁ jaha kāuṁ sakkimō ṇa ujjhamaṇaṁ || 87 ||

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: ullaliaṁ siḍhilaṭhiimmi ṇiuṇagahiammi uggahiaṁ | ullēhaḍō a lōlē raïjōggē taha ya uvasēraṁ || 104 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
ullaliaṁ śithilasthiti |
            uggahiaṁ nipuṇagr̥hītam |
            uggahiaṁ racitamiti tu racidhātvādēśasiddham |
            ullēhaḍō lampaṭaḥ |
            uvasēraṁ ratiyōgyam ||
            yathā |
prakrit_examples: ullaliadōsatusa taha uggahiā kumaravāla taï lacchī | ullēhaḍā vi jaha sā ṇa maṇṇaē aṇṇamuvasēraṁ || 88 || [ 104 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: ulluruhō lahusaṅkhē tattōcchaliammi ubbhuāṇaṁ tu | uṁduraō dīhāhē ukkhōḍiaammi uttuhiaṁ || 105 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
ulluruhō laghuśaṅkhaḥ |
            ubbhuāṇaṁ yadagnyādinā taptaṁ dugdhādi bhājanāducchalati | uṁduraō dīrghamahaḥ |
            uttuhiaṁ utkhōṭitam |
            takārasaṁyōgasthānē ḍakārasaṁvōgaṁ kēcitpaṭhanti |
            sa ca lipibhrama ēvētyanēkadēśīpariśīlanēna niścitamasmābhiḥ ||
            yathā |
prakrit_examples: uttuhiajīviāsāi ulluruhakaṇṭha tīi tuha virahē | aïubbhuāiaraī uṁdurayā hunti sisirē vi || 89 || [ 105 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: uddharaṇaṁ ucchiṭṭhē uvadīvaṁ aṇṇadīvammi | uddhavaüccaḍḍiaüttāhiaüvvāhiā ya ukkhittē || 106 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
uddharaṇaṁ ucchiṣṭam |
            uvadīvaṁ anyadvīpam |
            uddhavaō uccaḍḍiō uttāhiō uvvāhiōity ētē catvāra utkṣiptārthāḥ ||
            yathā |
prakrit_examples: uvvāhiabhua uccaḍḍiāsi uttāhiōvadīvēsa | hariṇō vva lihanti vigā uddhavayakarā ṇivā tuhuddharaṇṇaṁ || 90 || [ 106 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: uddhaviamagghiē uvaluaṁ salajjē gharammi utthaliaṁ | ulukhaṁḍō a alāē uakkiucchaṁgiā purōṭhaviē || 107 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
uddhaviaṁ arghitam |
            uvaluaṁ salajjam |
            utthaliaṁ gr̥ham |
            utthaliaṁ unmukhagatamityanyē |
            ulukhaṁḍō ulmukam |
            uakkiaṁ ucchaṁgiaṁ dvāvapyētau puraskr̥tārthau ||
            yathā |
prakrit_examples: utthaliavaī ucchaṁgiaviṇaō tā uakka sahi viṇayaṁ | alamulukhaṁḍapahārēhi uvaluā havia appamuddhavasu || 91 || [ 107 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: urumillaṁ urusōllaṁ ca pēriē avagaē a uacittō | uvaüjjō uvayārē dōhaṇahārīi uahārī || 108 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
urumillaṁ urusōllaṁ ca dvāvapyētau prēritārthau |
            uacittō apagataḥ |
            uvaüjjō upakāraḥ |
            uahārī dōgdhrī ||
            yathā |
prakrit_examples: uacittāṇaṁ uahārīṇaṁ maggōrumillaṇayaṇāṇaṁ | urusōllaūruvasaṇō pavaṇō taruṇāṇa kuṇaï uvaüjjaṁ || 92 || [ 108 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: saṁcuṇṇiammi ulluṁṭiaṁ ca kāgammi uluhaṁtō | ṇēmīē uṁcahiā uppēkkhiayammi uddisiaṁ || 109 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
ullaṁṭiaṁ saṁcūrṇitam |
            uluhaṁtō kākaḥ |
            uṁcahiā cakradhārā |
            uddisiaṁ utprēkṣitam ||
            yathā |
prakrit_examples: asurēhiṁ uvari paribbhamantaüluhaṁtavirasarōlēhiṁ | haricakkaüṁcahiaülluṁṭiamuddisiamappabalaṁ || 93|| [ 109 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: ubbhāsuaṁ visōhē garuāvēsammi uvvahaṇaṁ | ullarayaṁ ca kavaḍḍāharaṇē rāsimmi ukkuruḍī || 110 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
ubbhāsuaṁ gataśōbham |
            uvvahaṇaṁ mahānāvēśaḥ |
            ullarayaṁ kapardābharaṇam | ukkuruḍī avakararāṇiḥ ukkuruḍō ratnādīnāmapi rāśiḥ ||
            yathā |
prakrit_examples: ubbhāsua sā mēllaï uvvahaṇaṁ tā khu aggaō tīē | ullarayabhūsaṇō jaï rē ṇaccasi caḍia ukuruḍiṁ || 94 || [ 110 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: ucchalliamukkhōḍiatajammi ubbiṁbalaṁ jalē kalusē | uddhacchiaṁ ṇisiddhē vaṁkabhuammi ujjaṇiaṁ ||111||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
uddhacchiaṁ chinnatvak |
            ubbiṁbalaṁ kaluṣajalam |
            uddhacchiaṁ niṣirddham | ujjaṇiaṁ vakrībhūtam ||
            yathā |
prakrit_examples: ubbiṁbalā ṇaīō taruṇō ucchalliā ya dantīhiṁ | ujjaṇiacāvaüddhacchiārimaṇḍala kahanti tuha siviraṁ || 95 || [ 111 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: ṇibbhacchiammi ujjīriaṁ ca ujjūriaṁ jhīṇē | ukkhaṁḍiamakkantē cōriavatthummi ucchaḍiaṁ ||112||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
ujjīriaṁ nirbhartsitam |
            ujjūriaṁ kṣīṇam |
            śruṣkamityanyē |
            ukkhaṁḍiaṁ ākrāntam |
            uta ōti ōkkhaṁḍiaṁity api |
            ucchaḍiaṁ cōritaṁ vastu ||
            yathā |
prakrit_examples: tuha guṇaücchaḍiamaṇā virahōjjūriataṇū a taṇuaṅgī | ujjīrēi sahīō kusumasarōkkhaṁḍiā kaē tujjha || 96 || [ 112 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: ṇīcīkayammi ujjāṇiamuvasaggō a mandammi | upphuṁḍiamatthuriē ujjaggujjaṁ akalusammi || 113 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
ujjāṇiaṁ nimnīkr̥tam |
            uvasaggō mandaḥ |
            upphuṁḍiaṁ āstr̥tam |
            ujjaggujjaṁ svaccham ||
            yathā |
prakrit_examples: aṇaüvasaggapayāvayaüjjāṇiariu kumāravāla ṇiva | upphuṁḍiā tihuaṇē ujjaggujjā ramēu tuha kittī || 97 || [ 113 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: uddhacchavī visaṁvāiammi upphuṁkiā ya rajakīē | taha uṭṭhiammi ukkāsiaṁ ca uccāriaṁ gahiē || 114 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
uddhacchavī visaṁvāditaḥ |
            upphuṁkiā rajakī |
            ukkāsiaṁ utthitam |
            uccāriaṁ gr̥hītam ||
            yathā |
prakrit_examples: ukkāsaï upphuṁkiagharammi vatthāṇa ghallaṇamisēṇa | uccāriaaṇaüddhacchavisaṁkēaṁ vahū sariuṁ || 98 || [ 114 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: kaṇḍiaē ukkhaṇiaṁ saṁchaṇṇē ucchuāraṁ ca | ujjōmiā ya rassīē ullasiaṁ ca ulukasiaṁ || 115 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
ukkhaṇiaṁ kaṇḍitam |
            ucchuāraṁ saṁchamnam |
            ucchuāriaṁ chāditamiti tvanēnaiva ṇijantēna siddham |
            ujjōmiā raśmiḥ |
            ullasiaṁ ulukasiaṁ dvāvapyētau pulakitārthāvanyōnyaparyāyatvēna nibaddhau |
            uddhasiaśabdastu uddhuṣitaśabdabhavaḥ ||
            yathā |
prakrit_examples: ujjōmīi vi baddhaṁ ṇisi ullasiaṁ piaṁ sahi sarantī | ukkhaṇaṇavāvaḍā vi hu ulukasiattaṁ kahōcchuārēmi || 99 || [ 115 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: ucchēvaṇaṁ ghaē uccaṁpiamuvajaṁgalaṁ ca dīhammi | uppēhaḍaülhasiā ummacchaviaṁ ca ubbhaḍaē || 116 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
ucchēvaṇaṁ ghr̥tam |
            uccaṁpiaṁ uvajaṁgalaṁ dvāvapyētau dīrghārthau |
            uppēhaḍaṁ ulhasiaṁ ummacchaviaṁ trayō ’py ēta udbhaṭārthāḥ ||
            yathā |
prakrit_examples: uccaṁpiaüppēhaḍabhuajuṇa uvajaṁgalaccha ulhasiā | ummacchaviapayāvāṇalammi ucchēvaṇaṁ va tuha riuṇō || 100 || [ 116 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: ujjaggiramōṇṇiddē ucchuraṇucchuaraṇāi ucchuvaṇē | umhāviaüvalalayā suraē tittirahiammi uluhaliō || 117 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
ujjaggiraṁ aunnidyam |
            ucchuraṇaṁ ucchuaraṇaṁ ca ikṣuvāṭaḥ |
            ucchuraṇaṁ ikṣuriti kēcit |
            umhāviaṁ uvalalayaṁ ca suratam |
            ubbhāviaṁ suratamiti tu ramērubbhāvādēśasiddham |
            atra ca |
            upphālaï kathayati |
            ulluṁḍaï virēcayati |
            ullālaï uppēlaï unnamayati |
            uvvēllaï prasarati |
            ummacchaï vañcati |
            ugghusaï mārṣṭi |
            ullūraï tuḍati |
            ubbhuttaï utkṣipati |
            utthāraï ākrāmati |
            ukkusaï gacchati |
            ummatthaï abhyāgacchati |
            uddhumāi pūryatē |
            ityādayō dhātvādēśēṣvasmābhiruktā iti nōcyantē | uluhaliō tuptirahitaḥ |
            yaḥ kadāpi tuptiṁ na jānāti ||
            yathā |
prakrit_examples: umhāviaüluhaliaya vayaṁsa māmēsu tattha gantūṇa | ucchuraṇēsōjjaggiraōcchuaraṇagōviāi uvalalayaṁ || 101 || [117]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: hiaarasōcchalaṇē ugguluṁchiā ya uvaēiā kariā | musalimmi usaṇasēṇō taha uppiṁgāliā karucchaṁgē || 118 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
ugguluṁchiā hr̥dayarasōcchalanam |
            uvaēiā madyaparivēṣaṇabhāṇḍam |
            usaṇasēṇō balabhadraḥ |
            uppiṁgāliā karōtsaṅgaḥ ||
            yathā |
prakrit_examples: jaṁ jassa rōaē kira ṇa hu tassa tamugguluṁchiaṁ kuṇaï | ua uppiṁgāliaṭhiamuvaēiamusaṇasēṇassa || 102 || [ 118 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: uta/?/ sajjiamuttalahaō viḍavē | ululaṁḍiaṁ paluṭṭē uṁbaraüpphaṁ ahūaabbhudaē || 119 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
uvakayaüddhacchaviaṁ iti samāhāradvandvaḥ |
            uvakayayaṁ |
            kapratyayābhāvē uvakayaṁ tathā uddhacchaviaṁ sajjitam |
            yastu uvahatthiaśabdaḥ sajjitārthaḥ sa samāracayatē rādēśa itīha nōktaḥ |
            uttalahaō viṭapaḥ |
            uta ōti ōttalahaōity api uluuṁḍiaṁ praluṭhitam |
            virōcitamiti yāvat |
            uṁbaraüpphaṁ abhūtābhyudayaḥ ||
            yathā
prakrit_examples: uddhacchaviuttalahayatalammi uluuṁḍiōrupēmmāṇaṁ | raïuvakayāṇa mihuṇāṇōṁbaraüpphaṁ va saṁgamō bhāi || 103 || [ 119 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: valaēsu uvalabhattā uvalayabhaggā ya ṇāyavvā | aliēraṇḍēsūṇhōdayabhaṁḍōttāṇapattayā cēa || 120 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
uvalabhattā tathā uvalayabhaggā valayāni |
            alyēraṇḍayōryathāsaṁkhyēna dvau śabdau uṇhōdayabhaṁḍō bhramaraḥ |
            yastu uṇhōdayabhaṁḍaśabdaḥ piṭharavācī kaiścinnibaddhaḥ sō ’smābhiḥ saṁskr̥tabhavatvādupēkṣitaḥ |
            uttāṇapattayaṁ airaṇḍam |
            ēraṇḍasyēdamairaṇḍam | patraprāyam ||
            yathā |
prakrit_examples: iṭṭhōvalabhattāē uvalayabhaggā sahanti tujjha karē | uṇhōdayabhaṁḍā kamalammi va uttāṇapattasāmalayā || 104 || [ 120 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: churiaggamukkapupphaṁ ghēttua pāyaṅgulīhi uppayaṇē | taṁ uḍḍiāharaṇamucculaüliaṁ kōuatturiē || 121 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
kṣurikāgramuktaṁ puṣpaṁ pādāṅgulībhyāṁ gr̥hītvā yadutpatanaṁ taduḍḍiāharaṇaṁ |
            yadāha | ucculaüliaṁ kautūhalēna tvaritayātam ||
            yathā |
prakrit_examples: tuha churiaggaphurantārimōlikusumuḍḍiāharaṇaṁ | giddhā kuṇanti ucculaüliakaraṁ khēaravahūṇaṁ || 105 || [ 121 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: pāsaduēṇaṁ parivattaṇammi utthallapatthallā | uttiriviḍi uddhuddhē uttaraṇavaraṁḍiā uḍuvē || 122 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
utthallapatthallā pārśvadvayēna parivartanam |
            uta ōti ōtthallapatthallāity api | uttiriviḍī ūrdhvōrdhvam |
            bhāṇḍādēḥ sthāpanam |
            uttaraṇavaraṁḍiā uḍupaḥ |
            samuṁdranadyādau jalataraṇōpakaraṇaṁ pravahaṇādi ||
            yathā |
prakrit_examples: bhavaüttaraṇavaraṁḍiṁ saṁbhara savvaṇṇumaṇṇahā tujjha | ṇaragōttiriviḍimajjhē hōhī utthallapatthallā || 106 || [ 122 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: uddaṁ jalaṇarakaühēsu uḍḍaṇō dīhaüsahēsu | uvvuṇṇaṁ uvviggē ucchittē ubbhaḍē suṇṇē || 123 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
uddaṁ jalamānuṣaṁ kakudaṁ cēti dvyartham |
            uḍḍaṇō dīrghō vr̥ṣabhaśca |
            uvvuṇṇaṁ udvignamutsiktamudbhaṭaṁ śrūnyaṁ cēti caturartham || [ 123 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: visamōṇṇayappaēsē khiṇṇē ṇivahē a uddhāō | vikkhittōkkhittēsūcchittaṁ ummaṁḍamavi haḍhōvvattē || 124 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
uddhāō viṣamōnnatapradēśaḥ śrāntaḥ saṁghātaścēti tryarthaḥ |
            ucchittaṁ vikṣiptamutkṣi ptaṁ ca |
            ummaṁḍaṁ haṭha uddhr̥ttaṁ ca |
            haḍhōvvattē iti samāhāraḥ || [ 124 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: ukkhuṁḍō a alāē ṇiarē vatthēgadēsē a | ummacchamasaṁbaddhē bhaṅgībhaṇiammi kōhē a || 125 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
ukkhuṁḍō ulmukaṁ nikarō vastraikadēśaścēti tryarthaḥ |
            ummacchaṁ asaṁbaddhaṁ bhaṅgībha ṇitaṁ krōdhaścēti tryartham || [ 125 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: ukkhaṁḍō uppīlō ugghāō taha ya uddāmō | saṁghāyatthaüḍēsuṁ ubbūrō samahiatthē vi || 126 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
ukkhaṁḍō uppīlō ugghāō uddāmōity ētē catvārō ’pi śabdāḥ saṁghātārthā. sthapuṭārthāśca |
            ubbūrō adhikārthaḥ |
            apiśabdātsaṁghātasthapuṭārthaścēti tryarthaḥ | sthapuṭō viṣamōnnatapradēśaḥ || [ 126 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: khiṇṇē suṇṇē bhīē tahōbbhaḍakkantapayaḍavēsēsu | ubbiṁbaṁ uccullaṁ puṇa uvviggādhirūḍhabhīēsu || 127 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
ubbiṁbaṁ khinnaṁ śrūnyaṁ bhītamudbhaṭaṁ krāntaṁ prakaṭavēṣaṁ cēti ṣaḍartham |
            uccallaṁ tu udvignamadhirūḍhaṁ bhītaṁ cēti tryartham || [ 127 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: paḍisaddakuraraviṭṭhāgavviṭṭhamaṇōrahēsu uḍḍāṇō | ubbukkaṁ palaviaē saṁkaḍaē taha balakkārē || 128 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
uḍḍāṇō pratiśabdaḥ kurarō viṣṭā garviṣṭhō manōrathaścēti pañcārthaḥ |
            ubbukkaṁ prala pitaṁ saṁkaṭaṁ balātkāraścēti tryartham || [ 128 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: mañcaṇiarēsu uṁḍalamuppitthaṁ taṭṭhakuviavihurēsu | ṇīrāgē galiē uvvattaṁ uvvāḍhamurugayaduhēsu || 129 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
uṁḍalaṁ mañcō nikaraścēti dvyartham |
            uppitthaṁ trastaṁ kupitaṁ vidhuraṁ cēti tryartham | uvvattaṁ nīrāgaṁ galita cēti dvyartham |
            uvvaṭṭaṁ ṭāntamiti kēcit |
            uvvāḍhaṁ vistīrṇa gataduḥkhaṁ cēti dvyartham |
            kēcidvipūrvamēnaṁ paṭhanti viuvvāḍhaṁ iti || [ 129 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: ukkhiṇṇaṁ avakiṇṇē chaṇṇē pāsappasiḍhilē a | paṅkōcchēhasamūhēsu bahalaē taha ya uppaṁkō || 130 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
ukkhiṇṇaṁ avakīrṇa channaṁ pārśvapraśithilaṁ cēti tryartham |
            uta ōti ōkkhiṇṇaṁity api |
            uppaṁkō paṅka ucchrayaḥ samūhō bahalaṁ cēti caturarthaḥ || [ 130 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: uttappō gavviabahuguṇēsu ṇīvissamēsu uccōlō | aṇuvāyasamēsūcchullō ṇivaghaṇapīvarēsu ummallō || 131 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
uttappō garvitō ’dhikaguṇaśca |
            uccōlō nīvī khēdaśca |
            ucchullō anuvādaḥ khēdaśca | ummallō nr̥pō mēghaḥ pīvaraścēti tryarthaḥ |
            ummallō balātkāra iti kēcit || [ 131 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: uṇṇuiō huṁkārē gayaṇummuhasāṇasaddē a | ahiaavañchiaṇicchiatāvāgaṇiēsu uvvariaṁ || 132 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
uṇṇuiō huṁkārō gaganōnmukhasya śrunaḥ śabdaśra |
            uvvariaṁ adhikamanīpsitaṁ niścitaṁ tāpō ’gaṇitaṁ cēti pañcārtham || [ 132 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: kāṇacchidiṭṭhavikkhittakhittacattēsu ujjhariaṁ | uvvāḍuaṁ parammuhaṇimmajjāēsu suraēsu || 133 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
ujjhariaṁ kāṇākṣidr̥ṣṭaṁ vikṣiptaṁ kṣiptaṁ tyaktaṁ cēti caturartham |
            uta ōti ōjjhariaṁity api |
            uvvāḍuaṁ parāṅmukhasurataṁ nirmaryādasurataṁ ca || [ 133 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: gīārāmēsūvvāulamurupullō apūvakhiccēsu | ahiappamāṇavajjiamajjāēsuṁ ca uvviḍimō || 134 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
uvvāulaṁ gītamupavanaṁ ca |
            urupullō apūpō dhānyamiśrā ca |
            uvviḍimō adhikapramāṇō vimuktamaryādaścēti dvyarthaḥ || [ 134 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: ucchuṁḍiō sapattiahariēsūjjaṁgalaṁ haḍhē dīhē | uppiṁjalaṁ ca suraē dhūlīē taha akittīē || 135 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
ucchuṁḍiō sapatritaḥ |
            bāṇādinātivyathitaḥ |
            apahr̥taścēti dvyarthaḥ |
            ujjaṁgalaṁ balātkārō dīrgha ca |
            uppiṁjalaṁ surataṁ rajō ’kīrtiścēti tryartham || [ 135 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: raṇaraṇayāṇiṭṭhēsūvvāhulamuṇṇāliaṁ kisōṇamiē | uccēllaraṁ akhēḍiabhūmīē jahaṇarōmē a || 136 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
uvvāhulaṁ autsukyaṁ dvēṣyaṁ ca |
            uṇṇāliaṁ kr̥śamunnamitaṁ ca |
            kisōṇamiaṁ iti samāhāraḥ |
            uccēllaraṁ khilabhūmī jaghanarōmāṇi ca |
            uta ōti ōccillaraṁity api || [ 136 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: rusiākulēsu ummacchiamuḍuhiamūḍhakuviaücchiṭṭhē | uggāhiaṁ ca gahiē ukkhittapavaṭṭiēsuṁ ca || 137 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
ummacchiaṁ ruṣitamākulaṁ ca |
            uḍuhiaṁ ūḍhāyāḥ kupitamucchiṣṭaṁ ca |
            ūḍhakuviaücchiṭṭē iti dvipadaḥ samāhāraḥ |
            prākr̥tē dvitvamapi |
            tēna uḍḍuhiaṁity api | uggāhiaṁ gr̥hītamutkṣiptaṁ pravartitaṁ cēti tryartham || atra |
            ussikkaï muñcati utkṣipati ca |
            utthaṁghaï ruṇaddhi utkṣipati cēti dhātvādēśēṣuktāviti nōktau || [ 137 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: uvakasiō saṇṇihiē parisēviasajjiēsuṁ ca | uluphuṁṭiaṁ ca viṇivāḍiammi uvasantayammi tahā || 138 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
uvakasiō saṁnihitaḥ parisēvitaḥ sarjitaścēti tryarthaḥ |
            uluphaṁṭiaṁ vinipātitaṁ praśāntaṁ ca || [ 138 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: uccattavarattaṁ pāsatthūlammi aṇavatthabhamaṇē a | ūā jūā ūlō gaïbhaṅgē ūsaṇaṁ ca raṇaraṇaē || 139 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
uccattavarattaṁ pārśvayōḥ sthūlamasamañjasavivartanaṁ ca | ūā yūkā |
            ūlō gatibhaṅgaḥ |
            ūsaṇaṁ raṇaraṇakaḥ ||
            yathā |
prakrit_examples: ūāulavatthāṇaṁ riūṇa giribhamaṇajāyaūlāṇaṁ | piavirahaūsaṇēṇaṁ taï kuviē kaha suhaṁ kumaravāla || 107 || [ 139 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: ūsārō kūsārē ūsaamuvahāṇamūsalaṁ pīṇē | ūhaṭṭhaṁ ūhasiammi ūraṇī taha urabbhammi || 140 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
ūsārō gartaviśēṣaḥ |
            ūsaaṁ upadhānam |
            śayanē mastakōttambhanāya yannivēśyatē | ūsalaṁ pīnam |
            ūhaṭṭhaṁ upahasitam |
            ūhasiaṁ iti tu upahasitaśabdabhavaṁ rūpam | ūraṇī urabhraḥ ||
            yathā |
prakrit_examples: ūsalaūsayatūliṁ mōttuṁ sahi ṇaïtaḍē ahisarantī | hōhisi ūhaṭṭhapayaṁ pakhalantī ūraṇi vva ūsārē || 108 || [ 140 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: āṇandiammi ūṇaṁdiamūsaliaṁ sarōmañcē | vikkhittē ūsāiamūsāaṁtō a khēasiḍhilammi || 141 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
ūṇaṁdiaṁ ānanditam |
            ūsaliaṁ sarōmāñcam |
            ūsaliaṁ ullasitamiti tu ullasidhātvādēśasiddham |
            ūsāiaṁ vikṣiptam |
            ūsāiaṁ utkṣiptamiti dhanapālaḥ | ūsāaṁtō khēdē sati śithilaḥ ||
            yathā |
prakrit_examples: ūsāaṁtasarīraṁ ūsāiavalayaṇivaḍaṇabhaēṇa | uddhakaraṁ ūsaliaṁ ūṇaṁdaya muhaya virahataṇuiṁ taṁ || 109 || [ 141 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: ūsukkiaṁ vimukkē ūmuttiamavahapāsaghāyammi | ūsuṁbhiaūsurusuṁbhiā ya ruddhagalarūṇṇammi || 142 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
ūsukkiaṁ vimuktam |
            ūmuttiaṁ ubhayapārśvaghātaḥ |
            ūsuṁbhiaṁ tathā ūsurusuṁbhiaṁ ruddhagalaṁ rōdanam |
            ūsubhiaṁ ullasitamiti tu ullasidhātvādēśasiddham ||
            yathā |
prakrit_examples: ūsukkiahāsāē ūmuttiadutthiāi tuha virahē | ūsuṁbhiēṇa tīē kayamūsurusuṁbhiaṁ sahīṇaṁ pi || 110 || [ 142 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: gāmē saṅghē ūrō jimbhiapajjāulēsu ūsatthō | ūsaviaṁ ubbhantē tahēa uddhīkaē hōi || 143 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
ūrō grāmaḥ saṅghaśca |
            ūsatthō jr̥mbhitamākulaśca |
            ūsaviaṁ udbhāntamūrdhvīkr̥taṁ ca || [ 143 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: ēlō kusalē ēkkō ṇēhaparē candaṇammi ēkkaṁgaṁ | ēttōppaṁ ēappahudi a pavisantammi ēmāṇō || 144 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
ēlō kuśalaḥ |
            ēkkō snēhaparaḥ |
            ēkkaṁgaṁ candanam |
            ēttōppaṁ ētatprabhr̥tītyarthaḥ | yastu ēttōppaṁ ēddahamēttaṁ iti vyācaṣṭē sō ’bhimānacihnasūtraṁ vivr̥ṇvaṁstadabhiprāyaṁ nāvabudhyatē |
            yatō dēśyantarēṣvapi ēttōppaṁ ēappahudi ētāvadēva dr̥śyatē |
            udāhr̥taṁ cābhi mānacihnēnaiva svavr̥ttau |
            yathā | ēmāṇō praviśan ||
            yathā | atra ca |
            ēttāhē idānīm |
            ēddahaṁ iyam |
            ēkkārō ayaskāraḥ |
            ētē śabdānuśāsanē sādhitā iti nōktāḥ || [ 144 ]
prakrit_examples: diahaṁ thuḍuṁkiamuhī jūraï ahaē tumaṁ vahū diara | amhaṁ saha kāyaṁdiṁ ēttōppaṁ mā karijjāsu || 111 || iti |
ēmāṇamayaṇabāṇōṭṭhiē jarē tīi tujjha ēkkāē | ēttōppaṁēlāṇaṁ ēkkaṁgarasō vi ṇāhimaō || 112 ||

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: ēkkēkkamamaṇṇōṇṇē ēkkaṇaḍō taha ya kahayammi | sā ēmiṇiā jīē suttēṇa pamijjaē aṅgaṁ || 145 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
ēkkēkkamaṁ anyōnyam |
            ēkkaṇaḍō kathakaḥ |
            ēmiṇiā yasyāḥ striyāḥ sūtrēṇa śarīrapramāṇaṁ gr̥hītvā dikṣu prakṣipyatē kasmiṁściddēśa ācāraviśēṣē saivamucyatē ||
            yathā |
prakrit_examples: ēmiṇiāē tīē rūvaṁ dadr̥ṇa kāmasaraviddhā | ēkkēkkamaṁ kahantā taruṇā jāyanti ēkkaṇaḍā || 113 || atra ēkkavaī rathyētyēkapadīśabdabhavatvānnōktam || [145]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: ēkkagharillō diarē sahōsiē ēkkasāhillō | sā ēkkasiṁbalī jā siṁbalipupphēhi ṇavahaliā || 146 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
ēkkagharillō dēvaraḥ |
              ēkkasāhillō ēkasthānavāsī |
              ēkkasiṁbalī śālmalīpuppairnavaphalikā ||
              yathā |
prakrit_examples: ēkkagharilla ṇa lajjasi kimēkkasāhillamāṇusāṇaṁ pi | jaṁ ēkkasiṁbalimisā puṇō puṇō ṇiasi mālāriṁ || 114 || [ 146 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: ēkkallapuḍiṁgaṁ viralambukaṇē ēṇuvāsiō bhēkē | ērāṇī indāṇī puraṁdhiā tavvayatthā ya || 147 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
ēkkallapuḍiṁgaṁ viralabinduvarṣaḥ |
              ēṇuvāsiō bhēkaḥ ||
              yathā | atra ēkkasariaśabdaḥ śīghrārthē nipātēṣvasmābhirukta iti nōktaḥ || ērāṇī indrāṇī tadvratasthā ca strīti dvyarthā || [ 147 ]
prakrit_examples: sundara gōraṅgīē gōrī ajjēa tīi supasaṇṇā | ēkkallapuḍiṁga hu ēṇuvāsiē āgaō si jaṁ kālē || 115 ||

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: ēlavilō dhaṇiōsahā adhammarōrappiēsu ēkkamuhō | ōlī kulaparivāḍī ōjjhamacōkkhammi vimalaṇē ōppā || 148 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
ēlavilō ādyō vr̥ṣabhaśca |
              ēkkamuhō nirdharmō daridraḥ priyaścēti tryarthaḥ || || atha ōkārādayaḥ |
              aikārasya prākr̥tē ’bhāvāt |
              ōlī kutaparipāṭī | paṅktivācakastvālīśabdabhavaḥ |
              ōjjhaṁ acōkṣam |
              ōppā śāśādinā maṇyādērmārjanam ||
              yathā |
prakrit_examples: ṇivamaüḍōppiapayaṇaha kittī tujjha dhavalēi ōjjhaṁ pi | sasikulabhavāṇa ahavā ōlisahāvō ayaṁ kumaravāla || 11 6 || [ 148 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: ōaṁ vattā ōraṁ rucirē karibandhakhāyamōvaṁ ca | ōsārōsakkā gōvāḍōsariā himammi ōggīō || 149 |
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
ōaṁ vārtā |
              ōraṁ cāru |
              ōvaṁ gajādērbandhanārtha khātam |
              ōsārō gōvāṭaḥ ōsakkō apasr̥taḥ |
              ōggīō nīhāraḥ ||
              yathā |
prakrit_examples: caïājiōvaōaṁ riuṇō ōggīaōrajasa tujjha | bhīā ōsārēsuṁ vasanti samarāu ōsakkā || 117 || [ 149 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: kēsavivaraṇē ōcchiamōṁḍalamavi kēsagumphammi | ōsiamabalē ōṇīvī ṇivvē ōttharō vi ucchāhē || 150 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
ōcchiaṁ kēśavivaraṇam |
              ōṁḍalaṁ kēśagumphō dhammillaprāyaḥ |
              ōsiō abalaḥ |
              ōṇīvī nīvram |
              ōttharō utsāhaḥ ||
              yathā |
prakrit_examples: aṇaōttharōsiāṇaṁ jaraüḍaōṇīvisaṅgajaḍilēsu | tujjha riūṇaṁ raṇṇē kahamōcchiamōṁḍalaṁ ca kēsēsu || 118 || [ 150 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: ōggālō ōālō vahōlaē ōtthaō a avasaṇṇē | ōkkiamusiē rapphē ōṇivvō ṇīviāi ōvaḍḍhī || 151 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
ōggālō tathā ōālō alpaṁ srōtaḥ |
              ōtthaō avasannaḥ |
              ōtthayaṁ pihitamityanyē |
              ōkkiaṁ uṣitam |
              vāntamityanyē |
              ōṇivvō valmīkaḥ |
              pipīlikōtkhātō mr̥drāśirityarthaḥ |
              ōvaḍḍhī paridhānaikadēśaḥ ||
              yathā |
prakrit_examples: bāhōggālaghaṇōālapūriōṇivvaṇiggayāhibhayā | galiōvaḍḍhī tuha riuvahū vaṇē ōtthaōkkiā luḍhaï || 119 || [ 151 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: ōsāō pahararujā ōcchattaṁ dantadhāvaṇaē | ōsīsaṁ avavattē ōvaṭṭhō mēhavārisēammi || 152 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
ōsāō prahārapīḍā |
              ōcchattaṁ dantadhāvanam |
              ōsīsaṁ apavr̥ttam |
              ōvaṭṭhō mēghajalasēkaḥ ||
              yathā |
prakrit_examples: ō ōcchattamisēṇaṁ pahiō ōsīsiūṇa jantō vi | ṇavamayaṇasarōsāō mōḍaï ōvaṭṭaphullaṇīvalayaṁ || 120 || [ 152 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: ōhaṁkōhaṭṭhōlippā hāsē chaṇṇaramaṇamōluṁkī | ōliṁbhā uddēhī ōcullaṁ culliēgadēsammi || 153 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
ōhaṁkō ōhaṭṭhō ōlippaṁ hāsaḥ |
              ōluṁkī channaramaṇam |
              naṁṣṭvā yatra śiśavaḥ krīḍanti |
              cakṣuḥ sthaganakrīḍēti kēcit |
              ōliṁbhā upadēhikā |
              ōcullaṁ cullyēkadēśaḥ ||
              yathā |
prakrit_examples: ōhaṁkiri ōhaṭṭhaṁ ca ya ōluṁkiṁ ca sāravēsu gharaṁ | ōcullē ōliṁbhaṁ dadduṁ ōlippihī tuha ṇaṇandā || 121 || [ 153 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: baliē ōjjallō gajjiammi ōaṁkaōjjāyā | dīharamuharajhuṇīē ōrallī ōllaṇī sihariṇīē || 154 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
ōjjallō balavān |
              ōaṁkō tathā ōjjāō garjitam |
              ōrallī dīrghamadhuradhvaniḥ |
              ōllaṇī mārjitā ||
              yathā |
prakrit_examples: ōjjallabhaḍōjjāaṁ kariōaṁkaṁ ca suṇia saṁgāmē | ōllaṇimahurōrallīmuhalā jē hunti tē purisā || 122 || [ 154 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: ōsaṇamuvvēammi a ōrillō aïrakālammi | ōḍḍhaṇamuttariē ōittaṁ ōittaṇaṁ ca parihāṇē || 155 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
ōsaṇaṁ udvēgaḥ |
              ōrillō acirakālaḥ |
              ōḍḍhaṇaṁ uttarīyam |
              ōittaṁ tathā ōittaṇaṁ paridhānam ||
              yathā |
prakrit_examples: ōrillamayaṇavattōsaṇāi ōittaṇammi lhasiammi | parihiamōḍḍhaṇamōḍḍhiamōittaṁ tujjha daṁsaṇaturāē || 123 || [ 155 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: ōḍaḍḍhaṁ rattē ōlatthō daliē ṇayammi ōhattō | ōsaṇṇaṁ tuḍiē ōruṁjaṁ ṇatthi tti bhaṇiakīlāē || 156 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
ōḍaḍḍhaṁ raktam |
              ōlatthō vidāritaḥ |
              ōhattō avanataḥ |
              ōsaṇṇaṁ truṭitam | ōruṁjaṁ nāstīti bhaṇitagarbhā krīḍā ||
              yathā |
prakrit_examples: aṇṇōḍaḍḍhō daïō tuha ōhattō vi ṇavaṇahōlatthō | ōruṁjaṁ mukkaliō mā maha ōsaṇṇaṇēhiā hōsu || 124 || [ 156 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: vihalammi ōhuḍaṁ ōhuraṁ ca khiṇṇammi ōvarō ṇiarē | ōsuddhaṁ viṇivaḍiammi ōjjharī antaāvaraṇē || 157 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
ōhuḍaṁ viphalam |
              ōhuraṁ khinnam |
              ōhuraṁ avanataṁ srastaṁ cētyavantisundarī | yadudāharati sma | ōvarō nikaraḥ |
              kapratyayē ōvaraō |
              ōsuddhaṁ vinipatitam |
              ōjjharī antrāvaraṇam ||
              yathā |
prakrit_examples: khaṇamittakalusiāē luliālayavallarīsamōtthariaṁ | bhamarabharōhurayaṁ paṅkayaṁ va bharimō muhaṁ tīē || 125 ||
kiṁ taṁ pi hu vīsariaṁ ṇikkiva jaṁ guruaṇassa majjhammi | ahidhāviūṇa gahiō taṁ ōhuraüttarīāē || 126 ||
paharōsuddhahaōjjhariōvarakhalaṇōhurā raṇā riuṇō | tuha kumaravāla ōhuḍabhuadaṇḍā janti raṇṇēsu || 127 || [ 157 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: ōsittaṁ ōlittē ahihūē ōhuōggiōṇuṇayā | ōillaṁ ārūḍhē ōsīōhāiā ya hēṭṭhamuhē || 158 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
ōsittaṁ upaliptam |
              ōhuō ōggiō ōṇuṇaō ētē trayō ’py abhibhūtārthāḥ | ōillaṁ ārūḍham |
              ōsīō tathā ōhāiō adhōmukhaḥ ||
              yathā |
prakrit_examples: ōillē gayamōggiagiriṁ maōsittamuhamaṇōsīaṁ | taï ōhuaharicariē ōṇuṇaōhāiā huā riuṇō || 128 || [ 158 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: ōlittī ōlippaṁtī asidōsammi ōkkaṇī jūā | ōjjhāyaṁ ōhaṭṭiamaṇṇaṁ pēllia karēṇa jaṁ gahiaṁ || 159 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
ōlittī tathā ōlippaṁtī khaṅgādidōṣaḥ |
              ōkkaṇī yūkā |
              ōjjhāyaṁ tathā ōhaṭṭiaṁ anyaṁ prērya yatkarēṇa gr̥hītam ||
              yathā ||
prakrit_examples: churiōlittī asiōlippaṁtī ōkkaṇī a ṇavavatthē | kahaï riūṇa taē jasamōhaṭṭiayaṁ siriṁ ca ōjjhāyaṁ || 129 || [ 159 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: sēṇē ōlayaōlāvayā ya phalahaggalāi ōhaḍaṇī | ōlaaṇī ṇavavahuā ōlaïṇī daïabhūā ya || 160 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
ōlaō tathā ōlāvaō śyēnapakṣī |
              ōlaō apalāpaity anyē |
              atra | ōhaï avatarati |
              ayaṁ dhātvādēśēṣūktatvānnōktaḥ |
              ōmāla-ōjjhara-ōsattaśabdā nirmālya-nirjhara-avasaktaśabdabhavā iti nōktāḥ |
              ōhaḍaṇī phalahakārgalā | ōlaaṇī navavadhūḥ |
              ōlaïṇī dayitībhūtā ||
              yathā ||
prakrit_examples: ōlaïṇī ōlaaṇī riūṇa ōlayapiē raṇē khaggō | ōhaḍaṇidīhabhua tuha bhaḍacaḍaōlāvaō ruāvēi || 130 || [ 160 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: ōsuṁkhiaṁ ca uppēkkhiē alindammi ōsariā | ōāvalō a bālāyavammi ōhāḍaṇī pihāṇīē || 161 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
ōsuṁkhiaṁ utprēkṣitam |
              ōsariā alindaḥ |
              ōāvalō bālātapaḥ | ōhāḍaṇī pidhānī ||
              yathā |
prakrit_examples: ōsuṁkhia piamintaṁ ōāvalamōsariṁ sarantaṁ ca | ṇandīi khivia jāraṁ asari ōhāḍaṇiṁ dēi || 131 || [ 161 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: ōāavō vi atthakkhaṇammi ōvaṭṭiaṁ ca cāḍummi | ōagghiamōsiṁghiamaṅgapiṇaddhammi ōlaïaṁ || 162 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
ōāavō astasamayaḥ |
              ōvaṭṭiaṁ cāṭu |
              ōagghiaṁ ōsiṁghiaṁ |
              ghrātamityarthaḥ |
              ōsiṁghiaśabdō ’pi dēśya ēva |
              anayā tu bhaṅgayā nibaddhaḥ |
              ōlaïaṁ aṅgē pinaddham |
              yathā |
prakrit_examples: ṇa hu ōagghaï kamalaṁ ōlaïaṁ ṇa sahaē jaladdaṁ pi | ōvaṭṭiēhi ōāavē vi ōsiṁdhaē ṇa sā asaṇaṁ || 132 || [ 162 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: ōluṁpaō a taviāhatthē ōhīriaṁ ca uggīē | suttē ōllariō vihikayammi ōsāṇihāṇaṁ ca || 163 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
ōluṁpaō tāpikāhastaḥ |
              ōhīriaṁ udgītam |
              avasannamityanyē |
              yastu ōhīriaśabdō nidrārthaḥ sa dhātvādēśēṣūkta iti nōktaḥ |
              ōllariō sup‍taḥ | ōsāṇihāṇaṁ vidhivadanuṣṭhitam ||
              yathā | atra |
              ōrummāi udvāti |
              ōhāmaï tōlayati |
              ōluṁḍaï virēcayati | ōsukkaï tējayati |
              ōggālaï rōmanthayati |
              ōrasaï avatarati |
              ōaṁdaï ōddālaï ācchinatti |
              ōaggaï vyāpnōti |
              ōhāvaï ākrāmati |
              ōvāsaï avakāśatē | ōakkhaï paśyati |
              ōvāhaï avagāhatē |
              ētē dhātvādēśēṣvasmābhiruktā iti nōcyantē || [ 163 ]
prakrit_examples: ṇisi ōllaraṇē ōsāṇihāṇiaṁ kiṁ pi tīi jaṁ tumaē | taṁ cia ōhīraï sā ōluṁpayakammavāvaḍā vi diṇē || 133 ||

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: ṇisajalahimēsu ōsā sēvayaapahābalēsu ōluggō | ōālī asidōsōlī ōluṭṭamaghaḍantamicchāsu || 164 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
ōsā niśājalaṁ himaṁ cēti dvyarthā |
              ōluggō sēvakō niśchāyō niḥsthāmā cēti tryarthaḥ |
              ōālī khaṅgadōṣaḥ paṅkiścēti dvyarthā |
              ōluṭṭaṁ aghaṭamāṇaṁ mithyā ca || [ 164 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: ōallō palhatthappakampagōvāḍalambamāṇēsu | ōrattō vi vidāriagavviṭṭhakusumbharattēmu || 165 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
ōallō paryastaḥ kampō gōvāṭō lambamānaścēti caturarthaḥ |
              ōrattō vidāritō garviṣṭaḥ kusumbharaktaścēti tryarthaḥ || [165]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: ōhaṭṭō ōsariē avaguṇṭhaṇaṇīviāsuṁ ca | gāmēsahariaāṇābandhaṇakhāēsu ōāō || 166 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
ōhaṭṭō apasr̥tō ’vaguṇṭhanaṁ nīvī cēti tryarthaḥ |
              ōāō grāmādhīśō ’pahr̥ta ājñā hastyādīnāṁ bandhanārtha khātaṁ cēti caturarthaḥ || [ 166 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: ōhārō kacchavaē antaradīvammi bhāgē a | ōviamārōviaruṇṇacāḍumukkēsu hariē a || 167 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
ōhārō kacchapō nadyādīnāmantardvīpamaṁśaścēti tryarthaḥ |
              ōviaṁ ārōpitaṁ ruditaṁ cāṭu muktaṁ hr̥taṁ cēti pañcārtham || [ 167 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: ōhitthaṁ ca visāē rahasammi viāriē taha ya | candaṇasilāmu ōhaṁsō ōsavviamasōhasādēsu || 168 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
ōhitthaṁ viṣādō rabhasō vicāritaṁ cēti tryartham |
              ōhaṁsō candanaṁ candanagharṣaṇaśilā cēti dvyarthaḥ |
              ōsavviaṁ gataśōbhamavasādaśca || [ 168 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: ōsiṁghiammi candaṇaghasaṇasilāē a ōharisō | ōtthariō akkantē akkamamāṇē a ṇāyavvō || 169 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
ōharisō ghrātaścandanagharṣaṇaśilā ca |
              ōtthariō ākrānta ākramamāṇaśca || [ 169 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: ōsāaṁtō jimbhālasammi sīantasaviaṇēsuṁ ca | ōghasarō a aṇatthē gharāṇa vārippavāhē a || 170 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
ōsāaṁtō jr̥mbhālasaḥ sīdan savēdanaścēti tryarthaḥ |
              ōghasarō anarthō gr̥havāripravāhaśca |
              [ 170 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: hēṭṭhāmuhakāṇēkkhiaākiṇṇēsuṁ ca ōsariaṁ | ōddaṁpiaṁ ca ōraṁpiaṁ ca akkantaṇaṭṭhēsu || 171 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
ōsariaṁ adhōmukhamakṣinikōca ākīrṇa cēti tryartham |
              ōddaṁpiaṁ ākrāntaṁ naṣṭaṁ ca |
              ēvam ōraṁpiaṁ |
              cakārau dvayōrapi dvyarthatāsūcakau |
              yadāha |
              ōddaṁpiaōraṁpiaśabdau naṣṭē tathākrāntē || na cātra yathāsaṁkhyabhramaḥ |
              ōddaṁpiaṁ ōraṁpiaṁity anyōnyaparyāyatayā sarvairabhidhānāt |
              bhinnārthānāṁ hyanyōnyaparyāyatvaṁ na ghaṭata iti || [171]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: ōaggiamahihūē kēsāīpuñjakaraṇē a | aṇṇasattē taṇhāparē a ōlēhaḍō pavuḍḍhē a || 172 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
ōaggiaṁ abhibhūtaṁ kēśādīnāṁ puñcīkaraṇaṁ ca |
              ōlēhaḍō anyāsaktastr̥ṣṇāparaḥ pravr̥ddhaścēti tryarthaḥ || [172]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: candaṇaraïjōggē ōvasēramōhasiamaṁsuadhuēsu | ōsikkhiaṁ ca gamaṇavvāghāē araïṇihiē a || 173 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
ōvasēraṁ candanaṁ ratiyōgyaṁ cēti dvyartham |
              candaṇaraïjōggē iti samāhāradvandvaḥ | ōhasiaṁ vastraṁ dhūtaṁ cēti dvyartham |
              upahasitārthastu ōhasiaśabdaḥ saṁskr̥tabhava ēva | ōsikkhiaṁ gativyāghātō ’ratinihitaṁ ca || [ 173 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: ōharaṇaṁ viṇivāḍaṇamatthassārōvaṇaṁ cēa | paraō ṭhiasaṁjōē ukāraōkāraviṇimaō hōi || 174 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
ōharaṇaṁ vinipātanamasaṁbhavatō ’pyarthasya saṁbhāvanaṁ ca |
              atra ōṁbālaï chādayati plāvayati cēti dhātvādēśēṣūkta iti nōcyatē |
              iha ca kvacidukārasthāna ōkāraṁ paṭhanti ōkārasthānē ca ukāram |
              tatra viṣayavibhāgō darśyatē |
              parataḥ sthitē saṁyōga ukāraōkārayōrviparyayō bhavati |
              yathā |
              ukkaṁdī ōkkaṁdī |
              ukkhalī ōkkhalī |ity ādi |
              ētaccōpalakṣaṇamikāraēkārayōrapi |
              yathā |
              illō ēllō daridraḥ |
              ityādi | yadasmarāma |
              ōtsaṁyōgē |
              ita ēdvā |
              hūsvaḥ saṁyōgē |
              iti ca || [174]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: andhiakavaḍḍiāsuṁ kattāō mūlaē kaṁdī | kaṁtū kāmē kaṁcī musalāṇaṇalōhavalayammi || 1 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
saṁgr̥hītāḥ svarādayaḥ śabdāḥ |
              idānīṁ vyañcanādayaḥ saṁgr̥hyantē |
              tē ’pi vargakramēṇēti kavargādayō dvyakṣarādikramēṇa svarakramēṇa ca prastūyantē | kattā andhikādyūtakapardikā |
              kaṁdī mūlakaśākam |
              kaṁtū kāmaḥ |
              kaṁcī musalamukhē lōhavalayam ||
              yathā |
prakrit_examples: musalamuhaṁ kaṁcīē kacchapaēsō a kaṁdīhiṁ | kattāhi vaḍḍajūaṁ raīi kaṁtū a sōhanti || 1 || [1]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: kallā kavisaṁ majjē kalikallōlā vivakkhammi | kaccaṁ kōḍuṁbaṁ kajjē kassō kaccharō a paṅkammi || 2 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
kallā tathā kavisaṁ madyam |
              kallāśabdaḥ kalyāśabdabhavō ’py asti |
              sa tu kavīnāṁ nātiprasiddhaḥ |
              kalī tathā kallōlō śatruḥ |
              kaccaṁ tathā kōḍuṁbaṁ kāryam | kassō tathā kaccharō paṅkaḥ ||
              yathā |
prakrit_examples: pia kavisakacchara tumaṁ kallaṁ kassaṁ va muñca imiṇā hi | kallōlākalikaccākōḍuṁbāṇaṁ muṇijjaï ṇa bhēō || 2 || [2]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: kavayaṁ bhūmicchattē ṇāliavallīi a kalaṁbū | uvasappiammi kamiō kīḍībhēē karōḍī a || 3 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
kavayaṁ bhūmicchatram |
              yadvarṣāsu prarōhati |
              kalaṁbū nālikābhidhānā vallī |
              kamiō upasarpitaḥ |
              karōḍī kīṭikābhēdaḥ ||
              yathā |
prakrit_examples: kiṁ tē riddhiṁ pattā pisuṇā jē paṇaïṇō vi tāvinti | kavayakalaṁbūu varaṁ kamiakarōḍīṇa dinti jē chāhiṁ || 3 || [3]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: kayalaṁ aliñjarē kaṁdalaṁ kavālē churīi kaṭṭārī | kasarō ahamabaïllē kaṁṭālī riṁgaṇīē a || 4 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
kayalaṁ aliñjaraḥ |
              kaṁdalaṁ kapālam |
              kaṭṭārī kṣurikā |
              kasarō adhamabalīvardaḥ |
              kaṁṭālī kaṇṭakārikā ||
              yathā |
prakrit_examples: tuha siakaṭṭārīphuṭṭakaṁdalō babbarō kayalatundō | kasarō vva siddhaṇaravaï luḍhēi kaṁṭālisaṁkulaṇaīē || 4 || [ 4 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: kaühaṁ ṇiccē kaṇaī layāi kalahaṁ ca paḍiārē | kakkiṁḍammi karēḍū kavāsakavisā ya addhajaṁghāē || 5 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
kaühaṁ nityam |
              kaṇaī latā |
              kalahaṁ pratyākāraḥ |
              asiparivāra iti yāvat | karēḍū kr̥kalāsaḥ |
              kakkiṁḍaśabdō ’pi dēśyaḥ |
              paryāyabhaṅgayā tūpāttaḥ |
              kavāsō tathā kavisā ardhajaṅghā |
              mōcakamityarthaḥ ||
              yathā |
prakrit_examples: tuha jayasirikaṇaīduma kalahuggayakhagga kaühamariṇivahō | akavāsō kavisaṁ saṁbharaï karēḍu vva bōrivaṇamintō || 5 || [ 5 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: kiṁsāruammi kaṇisaṁ kasiā kasaī a raṇacāriphalē | kavilō sāṇē karamō jhīṇē kaḍasī masāṇammi || 6 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
kaṇisaṁ kiṁśāruḥ |
              dhānyaśīrṣavācī tu kaṇisaśabdaḥ saṁskr̥tabhavaḥ |
              kasiā tathā kasaī araṇyatārīphalam |
              kavilō śvā |
              karamō kṣīṇaḥ |
              kaḍasī śmaśānam ||
              yathā |
prakrit_examples: kasiākulammi gāmē kasaīkaṇisēsu baddhasaṁtōsō | alasa ṇa lajjasi kiṁ taṁ karamō kavilō vva kaḍasīē || 6 || [ 6 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: kaṁṭōlaṁ kaṁkōḍaṁ karaṇī rūvē karīsaē kaülaṁ | ayadavvīi kaḍacchū pahiaguhāsuṁ ca kaṁpaḍakaphāḍā || 7 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
kaṁṭōlaṁ kaṁkōḍaṁ |
              anyōnyavidhyanuvādabhāvō dvayōrapi dēśyatvāt |
              karaṇī rūpam |
              ākāraity arthaḥ |
              ēṣa yadi saṁskr̥tē na dr̥śyatē tadā dēśī |
              kaülaṁ karīṣam |
              tacca gōmayaṣaṇḍaṁ taccūrṇaca |
              kaḍacchū ayōdarvī |
              kaṁpaḍō pathikaḥ |
              kaphāḍō guhā ||
              yathā |
prakrit_examples: kaṁpaḍakaraṇīu tuhārivahūu karēṇa bhuggakaṁṭōlaṁ | kaḍḍhanti kaülajalaṇā kaō kaḍacchū kaphāḍammi || 7 || [ 7 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: kamaṇī ṇissēṇīē sukkatajāē karaṁjō a | kajjhālaṁ sēvālē māliavaṁsēsu kamhiakalaṁkā || 8 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
kamaṇī niḥśrēṇiḥ |
              karaṁjō śruṣkā tvak |
              kajjhālaṁ śēvālaḥ |
              kamhiō mālikaḥ |
              kalaṁkō vaṁśaḥ ||
              yathā |
prakrit_examples: kamaṇīkalaṁkakajjhāliō vi sakaraṁjaō vi dhaṇṇō si | uccatarukusumagahaṇē kamhia taruṇīi chippasi sayā jaṁ || 8 || [ 8 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: kaviḍaṁ ca pacchimaṅgaṇamuppalaē kalimakaṁdōṭṭā | kalhōḍō vacchayarē bagammi kaṁḍūrakāullā || 9 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
kaviḍaṁ gr̥hapaścimāṅgaṇam |
              kalimaṁ tathā kaṁdōṭṭaṁ nīlōtpalam |
              kalhōḍō vatsataraḥ |
              vatsatarī cētkalhōḍī |
              kaṁḍūrō tathā kāullō bakaḥ |
              akārāntakakārādiśabdaprastāva ākārāntakakārādērnivēśō ’rthānurōdhāt ||
              yathā |
prakrit_examples: kaṁdōṭṭacchī kaviḍē uḍḍiakaṁḍūrakalayalaṁ sōuṁ | kalhōḍapāyaṇamisā saraṁ sakāullakalimamahisaraï || 9 || [ 9 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: ṇāliarammi kaḍāraṁ vaṁsaṅkuraē karillaṁ ca | kavvāḍō dāhiṇaē hatthē cōrammi kalamakusumālā || 90 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
kaḍāraṁ nālikēram |
              karillaṁ vaṁśāṅkuraḥ |
              kavvāḍō dakṣiṇahastaḥ |
              kalamō tathā kusumālō cauraḥ |
              kalamaśabdaḥ saṁskr̥tasamō ’pi kavīnāṁ nātiprasiddha iti nibaddhaḥ ||
              yathā |
prakrit_examples: sēlammi karillakaḍāraēsu vāvāriūṇa kavvāḍaṁ | kucchiṁbharī hava tumaṁ muñcasu kusumāla kalamattaṁ || 10 || [ 10 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: puñjē kayārakajjavakatavārā kakkhaḍō pīṇē | taha ya kaliṁjakiliṁcā lahudāru kacchurī vi kavikacchū || 11 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
kayārō kajjavō tathā katavārō tr̥ṇādyutkaraḥ |
              kajjavō viṣṭhētyanyē |
              kakkhaḍō pīnaḥ |
              karkaśavācī tu saṁskr̥tabhava ēva |
              kaliṁjaṁ tathā kiliṁcaṁ laghudāru | kacchurī kapikacchūḥ ||
              yathā |
prakrit_examples: muṇaï maṇīu kayāraṁ kajjavaminduṁ visāi katavāraṁ | khalaï kiliṁcē kakkhaḍathaṇiā kacchurikaliṁjachitta vva || 11 || [ 11 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: kassayakōsaliā pāhuḍē karālī a dantavaṇē | kaṁkēllī a asōē tumbikaraṅkammi kalavukuuāō || 12 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
kassayaṁ tathā kōsaliaṁ prābhr̥tam |
              kōsaliāity ākārāntamityanyē | lakārasya dvirbhāvē kōsalliaṁity api |
              kōsaliaśabdasyātra pāṭhō ’rthānurōdhāt | ēvamanyatrāpi |
              karālī dantapavanakāṣṭham |
              kaṁkēllī aśōkavr̥kṣaḥ |
              kalavū tathā kuuā tumbīpātram ||
              yathā |
prakrit_examples: kaṁkēllilaṭṭhikōaṇḍakassayaṁ cūavāṇakōsaliaṁ | uvaṇēi vasantasirī jagajayakāmassa kāmassa || 12 ||
ajja vi kō vi karāliṁ ṇa karaï kalavūkarō tumaṁ bhamasi | bhikkhū kō tuha kuuaṁ pūrissaï piṇḍavāēṇa || 13 || [ 12 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: ṇiarē kaḍappakaï aṁkā kaïaṁkasaïkukkuruḍā | viṇṇāṇē kaṁvarakōttharā ya taruṇē kahēḍō a || 13 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
kaḍappō kaïaṁkō tathā kaïaṁkasaī tathā kukkuruḍō ētē catvāraḥ śabdā nikaravācakaḥ |
		kaḍappō kaṭapraśabdabhavō ’py asti |
		sa ca kavīnāṁ nātiprasiddha iti nibaddhaḥ |
		kaḍappō vastraikadēśa iti kēcit |
		kaṁbarō tathā kōttharaṁ vijñānam | udōtōrvyatyayē kuttharaṁity api |
		kahēḍō taruṇaḥ ||
		yathā |
prakrit_examples: avakaṁbaraya kahēḍaya kōttharakaïaṁkasēvaṇā lahasi | guṇakaïaṁkasaïṁ taha jasakukkuruḍaṁ sirīkaḍappaṁ ca || 14 || [ 13 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: majjaparīsaṇabhaṇḍē kariā taha kōttalaṁkā ya | kaṇṇāsō ’ntammi karambē kakkasakakkasārā vi || 14 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
kariā tathā kōttalaṁkā madyaparivēṣaṇabhāṇḍam |
		kaṇṇāsō paryantaḥ |
		kakkasaṁ tathā kakkasārō dadhyōdanaḥ ||
		yathā |
prakrit_examples: mayakōttalaṁka saüṇaṁ racchākaṇṇasayammi daṭṭhūṇa | maṇaruiakakkasāsava mayakariaṁ lahasi kakkasāraṁ ca || 15 || [ 14 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: dōvāriammi kaṁṭhiakaḍaïllā taha ya kaḍaallō | kaḍaallī kaṇṭhē kaddamiō mahisammi karamarī bandī || 15 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
kaṁṭhiō kaḍaïllō kaḍaallō ētē trayō dauvārikavācakāḥ |
		kaṁṭhiaity atra ṭakārayuktaṁ ṭhakāraṁ kēcitpaṭhanti |
		atra |
		kammaṇaṁ vaśyādi |
		kalāvō tūṇaḥ |
		kavvāō rākṣasaḥ |
		iti kārmaṇa-kalāpa-kravyādaśabdabhavatvānnōktāḥ |
		kaḍaallī kaṇṭhaḥ | kaddamiō mahiṣaḥ |
		karamarī haṭhahr̥tā strī ||
		yathā |
prakrit_examples: kaḍaïllāṇaṁ majjhē kaḍaallō kaṁṭhiēṇa tōraviō | kaddamiō vva sarōsō karamarikaḍayalliaṁ lēi || 16 || [ 15 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: thūlambarē karaarī kaḍaṁtaraṁ juṇṇasuppāī | kacchuriaṁ īsiaē kaṇōvaaṁ uṇhatōammi || 16 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
karaarī sthūlavastram |
		kēcidantyarēphasthānē ḍakāraṁ paṭhanti |
		kaḍaṁtaraṁ jīrṇaśrūrpādyupakaraṇam |
		kacchuriaṁ īrṣitam |
		kaṇōvaaṁ uṣṇōdakam |
		udakamupalakṣaṇam |
		tēna ghr̥tatailādyapyuṣṇaṁ kaṇōvaaṁ ||
		yathā |
prakrit_examples: karaarikaḍaṁtarapariṇṇahakahiasaïttaṇāi kacchuriē | sāvajalaṁ va vilōaṇakaṇōvaaṁ hōi dūsahaṁ mūḍha || 17 || [ 16 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: kajjaüḍō a aṇatthē kaṇṭayapōammi kaṁṭaüccī a | kaḍikhaṁbhō kaḍihatthē karaïllī sukkarukkhammi || 17 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
kajjaüḍō anarthaḥ |
		kaṁṭaüccī kaṇṭakaprōtaḥ |
		kaḍikhaṁbhō kaṭīnyastō hastaḥ | kadyāghāta iti kēcit |
		karaïllī śruṣkavr̥kṣaḥ ||
		yathā |
prakrit_examples: kajjaüḍasīla viraïakaḍikhaṁbhō hiṇḍa kaṁṭaüccipaō | karaïlli vva kaḍhōrā ṇa tumaṁ siviṇē vi sā mahaï || 18 || [ 17 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: kallaviakarāiṇikarayaṁdī timmiayasiṁbalīmallī | kaṇṭhē vatthāīṇaṁ ṇibaddhagaṇṭhimmi kaṁṭhakuṁcī a || 18 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
kallaviaṁ tīmitam |
		vistāritamityanyē |
		karāiṇī śālmalitaruḥ |
		kārāyaṇīti kaścit |
		karayaṁdī mallikā |
		kaṁṭhakuṁcī vastrādīnāṁ kaṇṭhē nibaddhō granthiḥ | kaṁṭhakuṁcī kaṇṭhē samuttuṅgō nāḍigranthirityanyē ||
		yathā |
prakrit_examples: aṇukarayaṁdikarāiṇitalammi iamaṁsukallaviaaṅgī | bandhēi kaṁṭhakuṁciṁ taṁ ṇa suhaṁ dharasu bāhummi || 19 || [ 18 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: sahiāi kakkhaḍaṁgī āuhabhēē kaḍatalā ya | kaṇṇachurī kuḍḍagilōiā ya gharagōhiāē a || 19 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
kakkhaḍaṁgī sakhī |
		kaḍatalā vakramēkadhāraṁ lōhāyudham |
		kaṇṇacchurī tathā kuḍḍagilōī gr̥hagōdhā ||
		yathā |
prakrit_examples: jāṇēi kakkhaḍaṁgī kaḍatalavaṁkāi tujjha cariāi | kaṇṇacchuriālāvaṁ kuḍḍagilōi ccia muṇēi || 20 || [ 19 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: kaṇṇōḍḍhiā ṇiraṁgī muavahaṇē kaṁṭhamallaṁ tu | kappariakaḍaṁtariā daliammi kaḍaṁbhuaṁ ca kuḍakaṇṭhē || 20 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
kaṇṇōḍḍhiā nīraṅgikā |
		kaṁṭhamallaṁ mr̥tapravahaṇam |
		yēna mr̥takamuhyatē |
		sāmānyēna yānapātramiti kēcit |
		kappariaṁ kaḍaṁtariaṁ ca dāritam |
		kaḍaṁbhuaṁ kuṭakaṇṭhaḥ | kuṭasyēva kaṇṭhō yasya sa kumbhagrīvākhyō bhāṇḍaviśēṣaity arthaḥ |
		kaḍaṁbhuaṁ ghaṭasyaiva kaṇṭha iti śīlāṅkaḥ ||
		yathā |
prakrit_examples: dantakaḍaṁtariāhara ṇahakappariaṅga muñca kaṇṇōḍḍhiṁ | taṁ cia kaḍaṁbhuathaṇiṁ vacca ṇa jā kaṁṭhamallajuggāsā || 21 || [ 20 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: kaṇaïllakīrakuṁtā sugammi kaïullakīlayā thōvē | guñjāē a kaṇōḍḍhiakāhēṇūkāiṇīō vi || 21 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
kaṇaïllō kīrō kuṁtō trayō ’pi śrukavācakāḥ |
		kaïullaṁ tathā kīlaṁ stōkam | kaṇēḍḍhiā kāhēṇū kāiṇī traya ētē guñjārthāḥ ||
		yathā |
prakrit_examples: aggikaṇakāiṇīṇaṁ āsamakaṇaïllapallikuṁtāṇaṁ | kaïullaṁ pi ṇa jāṇasi jamantaraṁ taṁ kaṇēḍḍhimittamaī || 22 ||
kīlayamaī kaī jaha kāhēṇuṁ sīahāriṇiṁ sisirē | taha kīrapāḍhagavvia avijjamavi maṇṇasē vijjaṁ || 23 || [ 21 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: thavaïmmi kaḍaïō kagghāyalakaraghāyalā kilāḍammi | kaṇṇōḍhattīkaṇṇōcchaḍiāō diṇṇakaṇṇāē || 22 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
kaḍaïō sthapatiḥ |
		kagghāyalō tathā karaghāyalō kilāṭākhyaḥ kṣīravikāraḥ | kaṇṇōḍhattī tathā kaṇṇōcchaḍiā dattakarṇā |
		yā bhāṣaṇārtha paravākyaṁ gr̥hṇāti ||
		yathā |
prakrit_examples: kagghāyalaṁ kaḍaïō paragharabhuttakaraghāyalō kahaï | kaṇṇōḍhattipiāē kaṇṇōcchaḍiā ṇa sā visaṁsēi || 24 || [22 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: kaṇṇāāsaṁ kaṇṇaṁbālaṁ kaṇṇassa āharaṇē | kaṇṇāiṁdhaṇamittha ya kasaṇasiō sīrapāṇimmi || 23 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
kaṇṇāāsaṁ kaṇṇaṁbālaṁ kaṇṇaïṁdhaṇaṁ trayō ’py ētē karṇasyābharaṇē kuṇḍalādau vartantē |
		atra karaṁjaï bhanakti |
		kammavaï upabhuṅktē |
		kamavasaï svapiti |
		ityādayō dhātvādēśēṣūktā iti nōcyantē |
		kasaṇasiō balabhadraḥ ||
		yathā |
prakrit_examples: bhaggaṁ kaṇṇaṁbālaṁ kaṇṇāiṁdhaṇapiē jaï tuhēkkaṁ | kasaṇasiassa vi kaṇṇākaṇṇāāsaṁ tuhaṁ dāhaṁ || 25 || [ 23 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: chiddammi kaṁṭhadīṇārakuḍiakuṇiākuḍīrakucchillā | kaṇiāriakaṇṇassaria kāṇacchī vaī kalaṁkavaī || 24 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
kaṁṭhadīṇārō kuḍiā kuṇiā kuḍīraṁ kucchillaṁ ētē pañca vr̥tivivarārthāḥ | kaṇiāriaṁ kaṇṇassariaṁ kāṇacchī trayō ’py ētē ’nyōnyaparyāyatayā kāṇākṣidr̥ṣṭavācakāḥ |
		kaṇṇōssariaṁ kāṇākṣidr̥ṣṭamityanyē |
		kalaṁkavaī vr̥tiḥ ||
		yathā |
prakrit_examples: āvanti kaṁṭhadīṇāraēṇa kuḍiabhamirā bhuaṅga tti | kucchillapūraṇē taṁ kaṇṇassariāi kiṁ kuṇasi || 26 ||
ajjēa kalaṁkavaī tuha païṇā ṇikkuḍīriā raïā | tuha kaṇiāriavittēhi tēhi kuṇiāsayaṁ kayaṁ tattha || 27 || [ 24 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: javaṇīi kaṁḍapaḍavā kaïlabaïllō a saïravasahammi | pāsajualāvavattē kaḍāhapalhatthiaṁ cēa || 25 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
kaṁḍapaḍavā yavanikā |
		kaïlabaïllō svacchandacārī vr̥ṣabhaḥ |
		kaḍāhapalhatthiaṁ pārśvadvayāpavr̥ttam ||
		yathā |
prakrit_examples: kaïlabaïllō vva tumaṁ gharā gharaṁ kiṁ bhamēsi ṇillajja | kaṁḍapaḍavāi majjhē kaḍāhapalhatthiaṁ ṇiasu tissā || 28 || [ 25 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: kāvī ṇīlā kāō lakkhē kālaṁ tamissammi | kārākōṇū lēhā kāraṁ kaḍuammi kāhalī taruṇī || 26 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
kāvī nīlavarṇā |
		kāō lakṣyam |
		vēdhyamityarthaḥ |
		anyē tu lakṣyaśabdēna yō yēna guṇēna lakṣyatē tamupamānabhūtaṁ padārthamāhuḥ |
		kālaṁ tamisram |
		kārā tathā kōṇū lēkhā |
		kāraṁ kaṭu |
		kāhalī taruṇī ||
		yathā |
prakrit_examples: hayakāvikālalaharīi virahikārāi candakārāē | mayaraddhayadhāṇukkō kāhalitaṇukōṇukāyamāhaṇaï || 29 || [ 26 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: kārimamavi kittimaē kāsāraṁ sīsapattammi | kāhārō parikhaṁdhē kāsijjaṁ kāgathaladēsē || 27 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
kārimaṁ kr̥trimam |
		kāsāraṁ sīsapatrakam |
		kāhārō parikhaṁdhō |
		jalādivāhī karmakaraity arthaḥ |
		kāsijjaṁ kākasthalābhidhānō dēśaḥ ||
		yathā |
prakrit_examples: kāsijjadēsaluṇṭhaṇakāhārāṇijjamāṇakaṇayāiṁ | kāsāraṁ ca buhāṇaṁ akārimaṁ dēsi cālukka || 30 || [ 27 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: kāyaṁdī kāṇaddhī parihāsē kāhilō a gōvālē | dhuttāsahaṇadhaṇūsuṁ kālayakāvaliakālavaṭṭhāiṁ || 28 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
kāyaṁdī tathā kāṇaddhī parihāsaḥ |
		kāhilō gōpālaḥ |
		kālaō dhūrtaḥ |
		ṭhakaity arthaḥ |
		kāvaliō asahanaḥ |
		kālavaṭṭaṁ dhanuḥ |
		kālapr̥ṣṭhaśabdō yadi dhanurmātravācī saṁskr̥tē rūḍhastadā saṁskr̥tabhava ēvāyam |
		anyathā tu dēśya ēva |
		asmābhistvanēkadēśīṣvavigānēna darśanādayaṁ nibaddhaḥ ||
		yathā |
prakrit_examples: caya hariaṁ majjha maṇaṁ kālaya kā kāhilāhi kāṇaddhī | kāyaṁdīi vi mayaṇō kāvaliō haṇaï kālavaṭṭhēṇa || 31 || [28]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: kāṇatthēvō viralambukaṇē kāliṁjaṇī a tāvicchē | kāyaṁdhuō a kāyaṁculō a kāmiṁjulavihaṅgē || 29 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
kāṇatthēvō viralāmbukaṇavr̥ṣṭiḥ |
		kāliṁjaṇī tāpicchalatā |
		kēcitkāliṁjaṇaṁ tāpicchamityāhuḥ |
		kālējjaṁ tāpicchakusumamityanyē |
		kāyaṁdhuō tathā kāyaṁculō kāmiṁjulākhyaḥ pakṣī |
		kāmiṁjulaśabdō ’pi dēśya ēva bhaṅgayā nibaddhaḥ |
		ētē trayō ’pi jalapakṣiviśēṣavācakāḥ ||
		yathā |
prakrit_examples: kāliṁjaṇisāmalaghaṇakāṇatthēvē ruanti virahijaṇā | rē kāyaṁdhua kāyaṁculīi sahiō si kūjasu tubhaṁ tā || 32 || [ 29 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: kāraṁkaḍō a pharusē kāyapiucchā ya kalakaṇṭhī | kāmakisōrō a kharē kiṇṇaṁ sōhantaē kirō kōlē || 30 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
kāraṁkaḍō |
		kapratyayē kāraṁkaḍaō paruṣaḥ |
		kāyapiucchā kōkilā |
		kāmakisōrō gardabhaḥ || kiṇṇaṁ śōbhamānam |
		kirō sūkaraḥ ||
		yathā |
prakrit_examples: sā kattha laliakiṇṇā kirō vva kāraṁkaḍaṅga kattha tumaṁ | kaha kalakāyapiucchā kāmakisōrō kaḍujjhuṇī kattha || 33 || [ 30 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: kiṁbōḍō khaliē kiṁkiaṁ ca dhavalammi kiṁpaō kivaṇē | kiṁjakkhō a sirīsē racchāē kilaṇikīlaṇiā || 31 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
atra kira kilārthē |
		kiṇō kīsa praśnē |
		kiḍī sūkaraḥ |
		ētē śabdānuśāsanē siddhā iti nōktāḥ |
		kiṁbōḍō skhalitaḥ |
		kiṁkiaṁ dhavalam |
		kiṁpaō kr̥paṇaḥ | kiṁjakkhō śirīṣaḥ |
		kilaṇī tathā kīlaṇiā rathyā ||
		yathā |
prakrit_examples: kīlaṇikiṁjakkhatalē vēsaṁ daṭṭhūṇa kiṁkiadugūlaṁ | kiṁpaya tumaṁ muha ccia kilaṇīē bhamasi kiṁbōḍō || 34 || [ 31 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: lahumacchē kiṁdharakuṁdharā ya sappammi kikkiṁḍī | kahiē kilimmiaṁ taha lakkhārattammi kimirāyaṁ || 32 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
kiṁdharō tathā kuṁdharō laghumatsyaḥ |
		kikkiṁḍī sarpaḥ |
		kilimmiaṁ kathitam | kimirāyaṁ lākṣāraktam |
		yastu rudhirōdbhavakīṭamukhōdvāntatantuniṣpannaṁ tadvācī kimirāyaśabdaḥ kr̥mirāgaśabdabhava ēva |
		atra ca |
		kilikiṁcaï ramatē |
		iti dhātvādēśēṣūkta iti nōcyatē ||
		yathā |
prakrit_examples: kikkiṁḍivēṇi kimirāyaṇivasaṇē kiṁdharacchi tuha virahē | tammaï thōvajalē kuṁdharō vva sō ia kilimmēmi || 35 || [ 32 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: kimiharavasaṇaṁ kōsēaē ṇavavahūi kīlakukulāō | vēṇumayaücchupīḍaṇakaṇḍē kuṁḍaṁ ca kuḍḍamacchariē || 33 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
kimiharavasaṇaṁ kauśēyaṁ vastram | atha īkārāntakakārādiśabda ēka ēva || kīlā navavadhūḥ | kukulā navavadhūrēva |
		kuṁḍaṁ vēṇumayaṁ jīrṇamikṣupīḍanakāṇḍam |
		yadāha |
		vēṇumayamikṣupīḍanakāṇḍaṁ jīrṇa viduḥ kuṁḍaṁ || kuḍḍaṁ āścaryam |
		kēcitkōḍḍaṁity āhuḥ |
		tacca paraō ṭhiasaṁjōēity ādinā (1,174) ukāraōkāravinimayē siddham ||
		yathā |
prakrit_examples: ua ṇāyarakīlāē kuṁḍaṁ pēcchantiāi parilhasaï | kimiharavasaṇaṁ kuḍḍā chippantaṁ haliakukulāhiṁ || 36 || [ 33 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: kukkhī kucchī kulhō a siālē pōṭṭalē kuṁṭī | kuṁbhī sīmantāī kuddaṁ bahu mañjarī kuṁtī || 34 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
kukkhī kukṣiḥ |
		kr̥kṣiśabdasya prākr̥tē ’kṣyādipāṭhācchatvē kucchīity ēva bhavatīti kukkhīśabdō dēśyaḥ |
		kulhō śrr̥gālaḥ |
		kuṁṭī pōṭṭalam |
		vastranibaddhaṁ dravyam | kuṁbhī sīmantālakādiḥ kēśaracanā |
		kuddaṁ prabhūtam |
		kuṁtī mañjarī ||
		yathā |
prakrit_examples: ghēttuṁ sambalakuṁṭiṁ caïa piākuṁbhikuṁtikammāiṁ | raṇṇammi kuddakulhē tuha riuṇō khāmakukkhiṇō janti || 37 || [ 34 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: kuṭṭākumārikuṭṭayarīkōsaṭṭaïriāu caṇḍīē | kuhiaṁ littammi kuhēḍō a gurēḍammi tīmaṇē kusaṇaṁ || 35 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
kuṭṭā kumārī kuṭṭayarī kōsaṭṭaïriā ētē catvāraścaṇḍīvācakāḥ |
		atra kuḍō ghaṭa iti saṁskr̥takuṭaśabdabhava ēvētyupēkṣitaḥ |
		kuhiaṁ lipram |
		kuhēḍō gurēṭakākhyō haritakaviśēṣaḥ |
		kusaṇaṁ tīmanam ||
		yathā |
prakrit_examples: kōsaṭṭaïrīpiuṇō kumārisiharē sakuṭṭamacca halā | kuṭṭayarivaïṁ sakusaṇabalīhi ghusiṇakuhiaṁ kuhēḍēhiṁ || 38 || [ 35 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: hālammi kuṁtalō kukkusō tusē kuppaḍhō gharāyārē | kuhaḍō khujjammi maṇōrahē kutattī a kuṁcalaṁ maülē || 36 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
kuṁtalō sātavāhanaḥ |
		kukkusō dhānyādituṣaḥ |
		kuppaḍhō gr̥hācāraḥ |
		samudācāraity anyē |
		kuhaḍō kubjaḥ |
		kutattī manōrathaḥ |
		kuṁcalaṁ mukulam |
		kuṁpalaṁ iti tu kuḍ‍malaśabdaprabhavamitīha nōktam ||
		yathā |
prakrit_examples: ahariakuṁtalakuppaḍha adōsakukkusa kumāravāla ṇiva | kuhaḍiasattukutattī disāsu jasakuṁcalaṁ viāsēsu || 39 || [ 36 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: mattammi kukkuḍō kuṁdaō kisē kuṁḍiō vi gāmēsē | kuṭṭāō cammayarē kuḍayakuḍaṁgā layāharaē || 37 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
kukkuḍō mattaḥ |
		kuṁdaō kr̥śaḥ |
		kuṁḍiō grāmādhipatiḥ |
		kuṭṭāō carmakāraḥ | kuḍayaṁ tathā kuḍaṁgaṁ latāgr̥ham ||
		yathā |
prakrit_examples: kuṁḍiaputtō kuḍayā kuḍaṁgaē bhamaï tujjha aṇurattō | kuṁdayakuṭṭāaṁ piva ṇēcchasi jaṁ kukkuḍā si taṁ putti || 40 || [ 37 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: gattāi kuṁbhiṇī kuṁtalī karōḍīi kuddaṇō rāsē | ṇīvīē a kuūlaṁ kutthuhavatthaṁ ca kōsalaṁ cēa || 38 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
kuṁbhiṇī jalagartaḥ |
		kuṁtalī karōṭikākhyaṁ parivēṣaṇōṣakaraṇam |
		kuddaṇō rāsakaḥ |
		kuūlaṁ kutthuhavatthaṁ kōsalaṁity ētē trayō ’pi nīvīvācakāḥ |
		kuūlaṁ parihitavastraprānta iti kēcit ||
		yathā |
prakrit_examples: varaṇāhī kuṁbhiṇikuṁtalikammaṁ caïa khēlla kuddaṇayaṁ | daḍhakōsalasahiāhiṁ kutthuhavatthaṁ daḍhēsu sukuūlē || 41 || [ 38 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: kuṁbhillaṁ khaṇṇē kuṁdīraṁ kōlhāhalaṁ ca bimbammi | aṇaïṭṭhammi kuruccaṁ kumulī kulasaṁtaī a cullīē || 39 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
kuṁbhillaṁ khananīyam |
		kuṁdīraṁ tathā kōlhāhalaṁ bimbyāḥ phalam |
		kuruccaṁ aniṣṭam |
		kumulī tathā kulasaṁtaī cullī ||
		yathā |
prakrit_examples: daṭṭhuṁ kuṁdīrōṭṭhiṁ pahiā kōlhāhalāi cuṇṭanti | kulasaṁtaïmavi khaṇirō kuruccakuṁbhillakumuliō havaï || 42 || [ 39 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: kurarī pasū milāṇē kummaṇakuṁṭārakurumāṇā | pisuṇē kusuṁbhilō kōḍillō a kuḍillayaṁ kuḍilē || 40 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
kurarī paśruḥ |
		kummaṇaṁ kuṁṭāraṁ kurumāṇaṁ trayamapi mlānārtham |
		atra kuppisō kañcuka iti kūrpāsaśabdabhavaḥ |
		kusuṁbhilō tathā kōḍillō piśrunaḥ |
		kuḍillayaṁ kuṭilam ||
		yathā |
prakrit_examples: akusuṁbhilā kuḍillayakēsī kōḍilla sā khu kurumāṇā | kuṁṭārēi sahīu vi akummaṇō puṇa tumaṁ kurarī || 43 || [ 40 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: kurucillaṁ gahaṇē kusumaṇṇaṁ ghusiṇē kuḍucciaṁ suraē | gabbhiṇikulīrakanduiā kucchimaïkurucillakullariā || 41 |
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
kurucillaṁ grahaṇam |
		kusumaṇṇaṁ kuṅkumam |
		kuḍucciaṁ suratam |
		kucchimaī garbhiṇī |
		kurucillō kulīraḥ |
		kullariō kāndavikaḥ ||
		yathā |
prakrit_examples: ō kurucillaï pahiō kurucillaṇihō kuḍucciassa kaē | chaṇakusumaṇṇavilittaṁ kullariaṁ kucchimaïaṁ pi || 44 || [ 41 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: kusumāliō a suṇṇamaṇē kurukuriaṁ ca raṇaraṇaē | kulaphaṁsaṇō kulakalaṅkammi chuhāē a kuḍḍalēvaṇiā || 42 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
kusumāliō śrūnyamanāḥ |
		kurukuriaṁ raṇaraṇakaḥ |
		kulaphaṁsaṇō kulakalaṅkaḥ | kuḍḍalēvaṇī sudhā ||
		yathā |
prakrit_examples: mā kuḍḍalēvaṇīdhavalakuṭṭimē paravahuṁ ṇiēūṇa | kusumālia kurukuriaṁ karēsu kulaphaṁsaṇō hōhī || 45 || [ 42 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: kuṁḍiapēsaṇakuṁtīpōṭṭalayā bambhaviṭṭicaükōṇā | kūlaṁ balapacchā kūḍō pāsē kūvalaṁ jaghaṇavasaṇē || 43 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
kuṁḍiapēsaṇaṁ brāhmaṇaviṣṭiḥ |
		kuṁtīpōṭṭalayaṁ catuṣkōṇam | kūlaṁ sainyasya paścādbhāgaḥ |
		kūḍō pāśaḥ |
		atra kūraṁ bhaktamiti saṁskr̥tasamatvānnōktam |
		kūvalaṁ jaghanavasanam ||
		yathā |
prakrit_examples: kuṁḍiapēsaṇakārīi kusumasarakūlakūvalavaīē | kuṁtīpōṭṭalabhavaṇē ua paḍaï diō kaḍakkhakūḍammi || 46 || [ 43 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: kūṇiamīsimaüliē gattākārammi kūsārō | kēā rajjū kēlī asaī kēū a kandammi || 44 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
kūṇiaṁ īṣanmukulitam |
		kūsārō gartākāraḥ | kēā rajjuḥ |
		kēlī asatī |
		kēū kandaḥ ||
		yathā | atra kēddahaṁ kiyaditi śabdabhavam |
		kēlāyaï samāracayatīti dhātvādēśa iti nōktau || [ 44 ]
prakrit_examples: kūsārakhalantapaō kēukaē pahia mā bhamasu kacchē | jaṁ kēlīē kūṇiapēcchiakēāṇa paḍasi pāsēsu || 47 ||

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: kēāravāṇakōṭṭā kiṁsuaṇayarēsu kasiṇaē kōṇō | kōlō gīvā kōppō avarāhē gēhakōṇaē kōṇṇō || 45 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
kēārabāṇō palāśaḥ | kōṭṭaṁ nagaram |
		kōṇō kr̥ṣṇavarṇaḥ |
		lakuṭaity anyē |
		kōlō grīvā |
		kōppō aparādhaḥ |
		kōṇṇō gr̥hakōṇaḥ ||
		yathā | atra kōō cakravāka iti kōkaśabdabhavatvānnōktaḥ || [ 45 ]
prakrit_examples: kēārabāṇaōḍayakōṇṇē kōṇāṇaṇā ṇamiakōlā | maṇṇanti hariakōṭṭā tuha riuṇō kōppamappaṇayaṁ || 48 ||

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: kōccappaṁ aliahiē itthirahassammi kōjjappaṁ | kōlīraṁ kuruvindē kōhallī tāviāē a || 46 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
kōccappaṁ alīkahitam |
		kōjjappaṁ strīrahasyam |
		kōlīraṁ kuruvindam | kōhallī tāpikā ||
		yathā |
prakrit_examples: daïammi sāvarāhē intē kōlīrarattaṇayaṇēaṁ | kōhallipūvarayaṇā kōccappaṁ kuṇaï ahaha kōjjappaṁ || 49 || [ 46 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: kōlaṁbakōllarā piḍharē kōsayakōḍiā lahusarāvē | kōṭṭiṁbō dōṇīē kōṭṭuṁbhaṁ karahaē tōē || 47 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
kōlaṁbō tathā kōllarō piṭharam |
		kōlaṁbō gr̥hamityanyē |
		kōsayaṁ tathā kōḍiaṁ laghuśarāvaḥ |
		kōṭṭiṁbō drōṇī |
		kōṭṭuṁbhaṁ karāhataṁ vāri ||
		yathā |
prakrit_examples: kōllarakōḍiavāṇia chaḍḍiakōlaṁbakōsaō kīsa | ṇivaḍasi kayakōṭṭuṁbhō ṇaīi kōṭṭiṁbaṭhiāmimaṁ ṇia vi || 50 || [ 47 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: kōṭṭhammi kōtthalō kōmuī tahā puṇṇamāsīē | bhēēṇa gāmabhōttā ya kōṁḍiō kōuā karīsaggī || 48 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
kōtthalō kuśrūlaḥ |
		kōmuī sarvā pūrṇimā |
		śaradyēva paurṇamāsī kaumudī rūḍhā | iha tu yā kācitpūrṇimā sā kōmuī |
		ata ēva ca dēśī |
		yadāha | || kōmuimāha ca śāmbō yā kācitpaurṇamāsī syāt || kōṁḍiō bhēdēna grāmabhōktā |
		aikamatyaṁ grāmīṇānāmapāsya yō māyayā grāmaṁ bhunakti |
		kōuā karīṣāgniḥ ||
		yathā |
prakrit_examples: kōtthalakammaṇiuttā kōṁḍiaputtassa diṇṇasaṁkēā | saṇṇaï gāmaṇivahuā kōmuijōṇha pi kōuasaricchaṁ || 51 || [ 48 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: kōṁḍhullū a ulūammi sivāē kōviā hōi | kōlittaṁ ca alāammi kōilā kaṭṭhaaṅgārā || 49 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
kōṁḍhullū ulūkaḥ |
		kōviā śrr̥gālī |
		kōlittaṁ ulmukam |
		kōilā kāṣṭhāṅgārāḥ ||
		yathā |
prakrit_examples: ṇisi ṇaïmintī kōviakōṁḍhullūṇaṁ ḍarēmi tassa kaha | kōlittakōilēhiṁ ia lihiaṁ dūiāi kahaï vahū || 52 || [ 49 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: kōlāhalō khagaruē sāvihajantummi kōṁḍaliā | kōkkāsiaṁ viasiē āpūriaammi kōjjhariaṁ || 50 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
kōlāhalō khagarutam |
		tumulamātravācī tvayaṁ saṁskr̥tasamaḥ |
		kōṁḍaliā śvāvitsaṁjñaḥ prāṇiviśēṣaḥ |
		kōṁḍaliā kīṭaity anyē |
		kōkkāsiaṁ vikasitam |
		kōjjhariaṁ āpūritam ||
		yathā | atra kōhaṇḍīkōhalīśabdau kūṣmāṇḍīśabdabhavau |
		kōkkaï vyāharati |
		kōāsaï vikasati |
		kōṭṭumaï ramatē |
		ētē dhātvādēśēṣūktā iti nōktāḥ || [ 50 ]
prakrit_examples: kōkkāsiacchi sāyaṁ jalamāṇintī ṇa kiṁ tumaṁ ḍarasi | kōlāhalakōṁḍaliākōjjhariē ēttha tūhammi || 53 ||

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: kaṁdō daḍhamattēsuṁ kaṁḍō dubbalavivaṇṇaphēṇēsu | kaṁṭhō sūarasīmāsu kaḍō jhīṇē uvaraē a || 51 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
kaṁdō dr̥ḍhō mattaśca |
		staraṇē 'pītyanyē |
		kaṁḍō durbalō vipannaḥ phēnaścēti tryarthaḥ | kaṁṭhō sūkarō maryādā ca |
		kaḍō kṣīṇō mr̥taśca || [ 51 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: ṇicchiddē kaḍivatthē dāratthavivakkhaāsīsu | gahaṇē vaṇē kaḍillaṁ kammantagharēsu kavvālaṁ || 52 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
kaḍillaṁ niśrchidraṁ kaṭīvastraṁ dauvārikaḥ śatrurāśīrgahanaṁ vanaṁ cēti saptārtham | kavvālaṁ karmasthānaṁ gr̥haṁ cēti dvyartham |
		[ 52 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: kaṅkālakarālēsu kalērō thēvōllavahalēsu | bapphē a kasavvaṁ kagghāḍō ’gghāḍē kilāḍē a || 53 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
kalērō kaṅkālaḥ karālaśca |
		kasavvaṁ stōkamārdraṁ pracuraṁ bāṣpaścēti caturartham kagghāḍō apāmārgaḥ kilāṭaśca || [ 53 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: śāliarakāgaüsahēsu karōḍō piḍharapaḍahēsu | muhahariṇēsu a kamalō kalaō jjuṇatarusuvaṇṇayārēsu || 54 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
karōḍō nālikēraṁ kākō vr̥ṣabhaścēti tryarthaḥ |
		kamalō piṭharaḥ paṭahō mukhaṁ hariṇaścēti caturarthaḥ |
		kalaō arjunavr̥kṣaḥ suvarṇakāraścēti dvyarthaḥ || [ 54 ]
