desinamaala.prakrit_verse: bhikkhāpattaasōēsu karaṁkaṁ vagghalaṁṭṭāsu | savalē vi a karaḍō kamaḍhō manthaṇipiḍharahaladharamuhēsu || 55 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
karaṁkaṁ bhikṣāpātramaśōkavr̥kṣaścēti dvyartham |
		karaḍō vyāghrō laṭvā karburaścēti tryarthaḥ |
		kākādivācī tu karaḍō karaṭaśabdabhava ēva |
		laṭbāyāṁ tu liṅgapariṇāmē karaḍā |
		kamaḍhō dadhikalaśī piṭharaṁ halabhr̥nmukhaṁ cēti caturarthaḥ |
		kacchapē bhikṣubhājanē daityē ca kamaṭhaśabdabhava ēva || [ 55 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: mūlayamusalēsu kaḍaṁtaṁ kusumuccayaïsūsu kaṇaō a | gavviaṇaülasahīsuṁ kaliō kaüaṁ pahāṇacinghēsu || 56 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
kaḍaṁtaṁ mūlakaśākaṁ musalaṁ ca |
		kaṇaō kusumāvacaya iṣuśca |
		kaliō garvitō nakulaḥ sakhī cēti tryarthaḥ |
		sakhyāṁ liṅgapariṇāmē kaliā |
		jñātārthastu kalitaśabdabhava ēva |
		kaüaṁ pradhānaṁ cihnaṁ ca |
		atra kammaï kṣuraṁ karōti bhuṅktē cēti dhātvādēśēṣūktamiti nōktam || [ 56 ] kaṇṇōllī cañcuravataṁsaśca |
		kaḍuālō ghaṇṭā laghumatsyaśca |
		jhaṣaśabdāddhrasvārthē kapratyayē jhaṣaka iti rūpam |
		kaṇaïaṁ ārdraṁ kr̥taṁ citritaṁ kaṇākīrṇa cēti caturartham || [ 57 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: pāḍalipasiddhaēsuṁ kalayaṁdī kāhalō miuṭhagēsu | kāyakalantaramēhēsu kāliā kāyalō piē kāē || 58 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
kalayaṁdī pāṭalā prasiddhaśca |
		kēcitpāṭalāyāṁ kaṇayaṁdītyāhuḥ |
		atra kāhīity atītē bhaviṣyati ca pratyayē kr̥gō rūpamiti nōktam |
		kāhalō mr̥duṣṭhakaśca |
		kātaravācī tu kātaraśabdabhava ēva |
		kāliā śarīraṁ kālāntaraṁ mēghaścēti tryarthā | kāyalō priyaḥ kākaśca |
		kēcitpriyē kāyarōity āhuḥ || [ 58 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: vayagaraṇatāviāsuṁ kāhallī taṇughaṇēsu kāliṁbō | kāsiakiṇhā saṇhē vatthē taha sēavaṇṇammi || 59 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
kāhallī vyayārtha dhānyādi tavaṇīti prasiddhamapūpādipacanabhāṇḍaṁ ca |
		kāliṁbō śarīraṁ mēghaśca |
		kāsiaṁ tathā kiṇhaṁ sūkṣmavastraṁ śvētavarṇaṁ cēti dvāvapi dvyarthau || [ 59 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: kiviḍī pāsaduvārē gharapacchimaaṅgaṇē cēa | kiviḍaṁ taha ṇiddiṭṭhaṁ dhaṇṇakhalē tattha jāē a || 60 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
kiviḍī pārśvadvāraṁ gr̥hapaścimāṅgaṇaṁ cēti dvyarthā |
		kiviḍaṁ dhānyakhalaṁ tatra dhānyakhalē yacca jātam || [ 60 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: kaṇṇōvagaṇṇiāē kōūhalaē a kiriiriā | kullō gīvāi tahā asamatthē chiṇṇapucchē a || 61 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
kiriiriā karṇōpakarṇikā kautūhalaṁ ca |
		kullō grīvā asamarthaśrchinnapucchaścēti tryarthaḥ || [ 61 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: hariāṇugamē hariacchaḍḍavaē taha ya kuḍhakūvā | kuhiṇī kuppararacchāsu kuṁbhilō cōrapisuṇēsu || 62 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
kuḍhō tathā kūvō hr̥tānugamanaṁ hr̥tatyājakaścēti dvāvapi dvyarthau |
		kuhiṇī kūrparō rathyā ca |
		kuṁbhilō cauraḥ piśrunaśca || [ 62 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: cullīē lahubhaṇḍē a kuṁḍhayaṁ kullaḍaṁ cēa | adayaṇiuṇēsu kuruḍō kurulō puṇa kuḍilakēsē vi || 63 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
kuṁḍhayaṁ tathā kullaḍaṁ cullī laghubhāṇḍaṁ cēti dvāvapi dvyarthau |
		kuruḍō nirdayō nipuṇaśca |
		kurulō punaradayanipuṇayōḥ kuṭilakēśē ’pīti tryarthaḥ || [ 63 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: kīlāghāē samuācārē ṇammē a kupparaṁ bhaṇiaṁ | chiddakuḍītuḍiēsu kuḍicchaṁ kōṭṭī du dōhakhalaṇāsu || 64 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
kupparaṁ kīlāghātaḥ samudācārō narma cēti tryartham |
		kīlā surata uraḥprahaṇanaviśēṣaḥ |
		kuḍicchaṁ vr̥tivivaraṁ kuṭī truṭitaṁ cēti tryartham |
		kōṭṭī dōhō viṣamāskhalanā ca || [ 64 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: kōsō kōsumbhajalahisu kōliō tantuvāyalūāsu | ucchuṇivīlaṇajantammi kōlhuō taha siālammi || 65 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
kōsō kusumbharaktavastraṁ jaladhiśca |
		kōliō tantuvāyō jālakārakr̥miśca | kōlhuō ikṣunipīḍanayantraṁ śrr̥gālaśca || [ 65 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: khaḍḍā khāṇī khallā cammē khaḍḍaṁ ca maṁsummi | khaṇaṁ khattaṁ khāē tilapiṇḍīē khalī cēa || 66 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
khaḍḍā khāniḥ |
		parvatakhātamityanyē |
		khallā carma |
		khaḍḍaṁ śmaśru |
		khaṇṇaṁ tathā khattaṁ khātam |
		khalī tilapiṇḍikā ||
		yathā | khaṭṭaṁ tīmanam |
		khaḍaṁ tr̥ṇam |
		khaddhaṁ tathā khariaṁ bhuktam |
		khaddhaṁ pracurārthē 'pi lakṣyēṣu dr̥śyatē |
		khavaō skandhaḥ |
		khaṁḍaī asatī |
		khaḍḍiō mattaḥ |
		khalagaṁḍiō mattaity anyē ||
		yathā |
prakrit_examples: khaṁḍaï taïā jantī ṇaccirakhavayā ṇa dēsi gharakiḍiaṁ | khariakhaḍakhaḍḍiavasahakhaddhaṁ khaṭṭaṁ ṇiēsi kiṁ iṇhiṁ || 55 || [ 67 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: khaḍuā muttā khaṇusā maṇadukkhē khaṁjarō vi sukkadumē | khaṭṭaṁgaṁ chāyā khavvullaṁ vayaṇammi khaṇṇuō kīlē || 68 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
khaḍuā mauktikāni |
		khaṇusā manōduḥkham |
		khaṁjarō śruṣkadrumaḥ |
		khaṭṭaṁgaṁ chāyā | khavvullaṁ mukham |
		khaṇṇuō kīlakaḥ ||
		yathā |
prakrit_examples: dukkhavvullē kā tuha khaṇusā khaḍuāvaliṁ ṇa jaṁ lahasi | khaṇṇuabhūē sahi khaṁjarammi kiṁ hōi khaṭṭaṁgaṁ || 56 || [ 68 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: khaccallō ricchē khapparō vi lukkhē uḍummi khajjōō | khaccōlakhaṁjaṇā vagghakaddamā khaggiō vi gāmēsē || 61 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
khaccallō acchabhallaḥ |
		khapparō rūkṣaḥ |
		khappurōity anyē |
		khajjōō nakṣatram | khaccōlō vyāghraḥ |
		khaṁjaṇō kardamaḥ |
		khañjarīṭavācī tu saṁskr̥tabhava ēva |
		khaggiō grāmēśaḥ ||
		yathā |
prakrit_examples: khaccallā khaccōlā khaṁjaṇavisamā mahī jahiṁ gāmē | khapparakhaggiadutthē mā vasa tassiṁ sukhajjōa || 57 || [ 69 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: khaṭṭikkō sūṇavaïmmi khallirī khullirī a saṁkēē | thūlēndhaṇaaggīē khaṁdhaggī khōḍapajjālī || 70 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
khaṭṭikkō saunikaḥ |
		khallirī tathā khullirī saṁkētaḥ |
		khaṁdhaggī tathā khōḍapajjālī sthūlēndhanāgniḥ ||
		yathā |
prakrit_examples: guṇakhallirī taē khulliriṁ aṇintēṇa kammakhaṭṭikka | sā visaï virahakhaṁdhaggipīḍiā khōḍapajjāliṁ || 58 || [ 70 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: lahubārammi khaḍakkī taha khavaḍiakhuṁḍayā khaliē | bāhummi khaṁdhayaṭṭhī a khaṁdhamaṁsō a khalaïaṁ rittē || 71 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
khaḍakkī laghudvāram |
		atra khasiō khacita iti khacitaśabdabhavaḥ |
		khaḍḍaï mr̥drātīti dhātvādēśēṣūktaity ētau nōktau |
		khavaḍiaṁ tathā khuṁḍayaṁ skhalitam | khuḍiaṁ khaṇḍitamiti tu khaṇḍitaśabdabhavam |
		khaṁdhayaṭṭhī tathā khaṁdhamaṁsō bāhuḥ | khalaïaṁ riktam ||
		yathā |
prakrit_examples: sā laliakhaṁdhayaṭṭhī tamākhuṁḍayalōakhalaïē maggē | sahidiṇṇakhaṁdhamaṁsā akhavaḍiamahisāriā khaḍakkīō || 59 || [ 71 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: tarumakkaḍē khaḍahaḍī khaṁdhīdhārō a uṇhajaladhārā | khaḍaïakhavaliakharahiasaddā saṁkuciakuviapōttēsu || 72 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
khaḍahaḍī tarumarkaṭaḥ |
		khaṁdhīdhārō atyuṣṇajaladhārā |
		khaḍaïō saṁkucitaḥ | khavaliō kupitaḥ |
		kharahiō pautraḥ ||
		yathā | atra khaüraï kṣubhyatīti dhātvādēśēṣūktamiti nōktam || [ 72 ]
prakrit_examples: ua vihi kharahiaṇandaṇaüjjāṇē khaḍahaḍī khaḍaïō vi | sīālōaṇakhaṁdhīdhāraṁ daṭṭūṇa khavaliō tujjha || 60 ||

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: khārayakhāiakhāraṁphiḍīu taha maülaparihagōhāsu | khāḍaïaṁ paḍiphaliammi khikkhirī ḍumbacindhalaṭṭhīē || 73 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
khārayaṁ mukulam |
		khāiā parikhā |
		khāraṁphiḍī gōdhā |
		khāḍaïaṁ pratiphalitam |
		khikkhirī ḍumbādīnāṁ sparśaparihārārthaṁ cihnayaṣṭiḥ ||
		yathā |
prakrit_examples: khāialaṅghaṇa khārayamuhiā khikkhirikarā tuhārivahū | khāḍaïaṇiaravēsu vi ḍariā khāraṁphiḍi vva lukkēi || 61 || [ 73 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: khijjiakhiṁkhiṇikhikkhiṁḍā ya uvālambhabhasuakikkiṁḍā | kuḍilahutuṭṭēsuṁ khullakhuḍḍakhuṭṭā cahuṭṭaē khuttaṁ || 74 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
khijjiaṁ upālambhaḥ |
		khiṁkhiṇī śrr̥gālī |
		khikkhiṁḍō kr̥kalāsaḥ |
		atra khiraï kṣaratīti dhātvādēśēṣūkta iti nōktaḥ |
		khullaṁ kuṭī |
		khuḍḍaṁ laghu |
		khuṭṭaṁ truṭitam |
		khuttaṁ nimagnam ||
		yathā |
prakrit_examples: khikkhiṁḍō vva tayā tumamuggīvō khiṁkhiṇīi va bhamēsi | kiṁ ajja khuḍḍakhullē khijjēsi vihiṁ akhuṭṭaduhakhuttō || 62 || [ 74 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: khuṇṇaṁ maḍhiē khuṁpā vuṭṭhittāṇammi khuḍḍiaṁ suraē | khuluhō gupphē khuvaō gaṇḍuasamakaṇṭakillatiṇē || 75 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
khuṇṇaṁ parivēṣṭitam |
		khuṁpā tr̥ṇādimayaṁ vr̥ṣṭinivāraṇam |
		khuḍḍiaṁ suratam | khuluhō gulphaḥ |
		khuvaō gaṇḍutsaṁjñatr̥ṇasadr̥śaṁ kaṇṭakitr̥ṇam ||
		yathā | atra |
		khuppaï majjati |
		khuṭṭaï khuḍaï tuḍati |
		ētē dhātvādēśēṣūktā iti nōktāḥ |
		[ 75 ]
prakrit_examples: khuṁpākhuṇṇataṇūō kharakhuvayapphāḍiantakhuluhāō | vāsārattē kulaḍāu khuḍḍiatthaṁ ahisaranti || 63 ||

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: khuṁkhuṇikhuṁkhuṇayakhuṇukkhuḍiāō racchaṇakkasiraghāṇā | paṇayapakōvē khuruḍukkhuḍī tahā khēlliaṁ hasiē || 76 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
khuṁkhuṇī rathyā |
		khuṁkhuṇaō ghrāṇasirā |
		khuṇukkhuḍiā ghrāṇam |
		khuruḍukkhuḍī praṇayakōpaḥ |
		khēlliaṁ hasitam ||
		yathā |
prakrit_examples: khuruḍukkhuḍiapaṇatthīpayaghāyacchuṭṭakhuṁkhuṇō bhaṭṭō | khuṁkhuṇiāi khuṇukkhuḍimua dhōantō jaṇēṇa khēlliaï || 64 || [ 76 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: khēālū asahē khōṭṭī dāsī danturammi khōsalaō | khallaṁ vaïvivararaīsu vāmakararāsahēsu khavvakhavā || 77 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
khēālū niḥsahaḥ |
		asahanaity anyē |
		atra khēḍḍaï ramatē dhātvādēśēṣūkta iti nōktaḥ |
		khōṭṭī dāsī |
		khōsalaō danturaḥ ||
		yathā |
prakrit_examples: rē khēālua khōsala imāṇa khōṭṭīṇa majjhamāvaḍiō | chuṭṭissasi kaha va tumaṁ akuṭṭiō ṭakkarāhi phuḍaṁ || 65 ||

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: raṇamaṇaduhēsu khammakkhamō kharaḍiaṁ ca lukkhabhaggēsu | khallaïaṁ saṁkuiamuiēsu khittayamaṇatthadittēsu || 79 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
khammakkhamō saṁgrāmō manōduḥkhaṁ ca |
		manōduḥkhaviśēṣō ’nuśayaniḥ śvasitamityanyē kharaḍiaṁ rūkṣaṁ bhagnaṁ ca |
		khallaïaṁ saṁkucitaṁ prahr̥ṣṭaṁ ca |
		khittayaṁ anarthō dīptaṁ ca | dīptaṁ prajvālanamityarthaḥ || [ 79 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: khōḍō sīmākaṭṭhē dhammiaē khañjaē cēa | khōlō lahugaddahaē vatthassa ya ēgadēsammi || 80 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
khōḍō sīmākāṣṭhaṁ dhārmikaḥ khañjaścēti tryarthaḥ |
		khōlō laghugardabhō vastraikadēśaśca || [ 80 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: gaṁjō gallē gaḍḍī sayaḍē gajjō javē gaḍhō duggē | gaḍḍhaṁ sayaṇē galiaṁ sumariamakkhavalaē gaṇēttī a || 81 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
gaṁjō gallaḥ |
		gaḍḍī gantrī |
		gajjō javaḥ |
		gaḍhō durgam |
		gaḍḍhaṁ śayyā |
		galiaṁ smr̥tam |
		gaṇēttī akṣamālā ||
		yathā |
prakrit_examples: mayaṇagaḍhaṁ gajjassa vi gaṁjaṁ gaḍḍhammi gaḍḍicakkakaḍiṁ | galiaṁ galiuṁ bhikkhū gaṇiagaṇēttī vi mucchēi || 66 || [ 81 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: gahaṇaṁ ajalaṭṭhāṇē gaṁḍīrī ucchukhaṇḍammi | gattāḍī taha gāṇī gavāyaṇī kaḍujhuṇimmi gaddabbhō || 82 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
gahaṇaṁ nirjalasthānam |
		gaṁḍīrī ikṣukhaṇḍam |
		gattāḍī tathā gāṇī gavādanī | mattāḍī gāyikēti gōpālaḥ |
		gaddabbhō kaṭughvaniḥ ||
		yathā |
prakrit_examples: gaddabbhasaddakarahōciammi gahaṇammi dhavala mā vacca | tattha ṇa duvvāgāṇī dūrē gaṁḍīrigattāḍī || 67 || [ 82 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: gaṁdhiagaddiagaddahasaddā duggandhadariakumuēsu | gaṁdīṇī cakkhuyagaṇakīlā gaṁjillagāḍiā vihurē || 83 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
gaṁdhiō durgandhaḥ |
		gaddiō garvitaḥ |
		gaddahaṁ kumudam |
		gaṁdīṇī cakṣuḥsthaganakrīḍā | gaṁjillō tathā gāḍiō vidhuraḥ ||
		yathā |
prakrit_examples: gaṁdhia gaddia uiē gaddahaṇāhammi kāmagaṁjillō | bhamia kimimāi gōsē karasi virahagāḍiāi gaṁdīṇiṁ || 68 || [ 83 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: gaḍḍurigāmēṇīō chagalīē gaṁchaō varuḍē | gahaṇī taha bandīē gaharō diddhē dhaṇummi gaṁḍīvaṁ || 84 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
gaḍḍarī tathā gāmēṇī chāgī |
		gaṁchaō varuḍaḥ |
		gahaṇī haṭhahr̥tā strī |
		gaharō gr̥dhraḥ |
		gaṁḍīvaṁ dhanuḥ ||
		yathā |
prakrit_examples: gaṁcha vva dalia vaṁsaṁ gahaṇiṁ gāmēṇiaṁ ca tāḍanti | dhī gaḍḍaribhōaṇayā pāvā gaṁḍīviṇō gaharaghōrā || 69 || [ 84 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: gahiagavattā vaṁkiaghāsā gahiā ya kammamāṇāē | ṇāsāē gaṁdhalayā ya gaḍayaḍī vajjaṇigghōsē || 85||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
gahiaṁ vakritam |
		gavattaṁ ghāsaḥ |
		gahiā kāmyamānā strī |
		atra gahilagaggaraśabdau grahilagadradaśabdabhavau |
		gañjiō kalyapāla iti gāñjikaśabdabhavaḥ |
		gañjā hi surāgr̥hamucyatē |
		iti nōktāḥ |
		gaṁdhalayā nāsā |
		gaḍayaḍī vajranirghōṣaḥ |
		yathā |
prakrit_examples: mēhammi gaḍayaḍantē agahiacittaṁ viṇā gahiajuvaïṁ | siṁghaï gaṁdhalayāē kō ṇu gavattaṁ va mālaīdāmaṁ || 70 || [ 85 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: gōṭṭhīraē gaṇasamō gallapphōḍō ḍamaruammi | gahakallōlō rāhū vivāhagaṇaē gaṇāyamahō || 86 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
gaṇasamō gōṣṭhīrataḥ |
		gallapphōḍō ḍamarukaḥ |
		atra |
		gandhuttamā surēti saṁskr̥tabhavaḥ |
		gaṇṭhicchēō granthicchēdaka iti granthicchēdaśabdabhava iti nōktau |
		gahakallōlō rāhuḥ |
		gaṇāyamahō vivāhagaṇakaḥ|| yathā |
prakrit_examples: gaṇasama gallapphōḍaṁ muhēṇa vāēsi kiṁ gaṇāyamaha | gahagaṇavivarīagaïṁ gahakallōlaṁ ṇayā ṇēsi|| 71 | [ 86 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: gaṇaṇāiā ya caṇḍii galalthaliaṁ galatthiaē | gayasāulō virattē gaṁdhāpisāō a gandhiaē|| 87||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
gaṇaṇāiā caṇḍā |
		galatthaliō kṣiptaḥ |
		galatthiaṁ iti tu dhātvādēśēṣu kṣipērdhātōḥ siddhamityanēnārthanirdēśaḥ kr̥taḥ |
		gayasāulō viraktaḥ |
		kēcit gayasāullō viraktaity āhuḥ |
		tatra sāullō anurāgō vakṣyatē |
		sa gatō yasya sa gayasāullaity ēva siddham |
		gaṁdhāpisāō gāndhikaḥ|| yathā |
prakrit_examples: gaṇaṇāiāi bhattōsavammi ṇa samāgaü tti vēsāē | gayasāulacittāē gaṁdhāpisāō galatthaliō|| 72|| [ 87 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: gayaṇaraī mēhē gajjaṇasaddō hariṇavarāṇaravammi | gāgējjaṁ gējjaṁ manthiammi ṇavapariṇiāi gāgējjā || 88 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
gayaṇaraī mēghaḥ |
		gajjaṇasaddō mr̥gavāraṇadhvaniḥ |
		gāgējjaṁ tathā gējjaṁ mathitam | gāgējjā navapariṇītā ||
		yathā |
prakrit_examples: gāgējjavāvaḍā gāgējjā gējjāravaṁ miuṁ kuṇaï | gayaṇaraïgajjigahiraṁ gajjaṇasaddaṁ suṇāntiā païṇō|| 73|| [ 88 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: gāhammi gāhulī gāyarigōā gaggarīē a | gāmapahāṇē gāmaṇigāmaüḍaggāmagōhagōhā ya || 89 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
gāhulī krūrajalacaraḥ |
		gāyarī tathā gōā gargarī |
		gaggarī śabdō ’pi kēṣāṁciddēśyaḥ | asmābhistu gargarīśabdabhavatvānnōktaḥ |
		yadi bhavati tadā paryāyabhaṅgayā darśitō 'sti | gāmaṇī gāmaüḍō gāmagōhō gōhō ētē catvārō ’pi grāmapradhānārthāḥ |
		gōhō bhaṭaity anyē |
		puruṣaity ēkē |
		gāmaṇisuaśabdō ’pi grāmapradhānavācītyanyē ||
		yathā |
prakrit_examples: gāmaṇisuēṇa kēṇa vi gōhasuā bhaggagāyarī kahaï | gāmaüḍagāmagōhaghariṇīṇa gāhulihayaṁ gōaṁ|| 74|| [ 89 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: gāmahaṇagāmarōḍā gāmaṭṭhāṇachalagāmabhōīsu | guṁphō kārā gummī icchā guṁṭhī a ṇīraṁgī || 90 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
gāmahaṇaṁ grāmasthānam |
		gāmarōḍō chalēna grāmabhōktā |
		antarbhēdaṁ kr̥tvā yō māyayā grāmaṁ bhunakti |
		guṁphō guptiḥ |
		gummī icchā |
		guṁṭhī nīraṅgī ||
		yathā |
prakrit_examples: taïā taṁ kayaguṁṭhiṁ gāmahaṇē suhaya gāmarōḍavahuṁ | uvabhuñjati gummīē iṇiṁha lajjēsi kiṁ guṁphē|| 75|| [ 90 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: guṁphī a sayavaīē gulaṁ guḍōladdhiā ya cumbiaē | mutthasamutthammi tiṇē guṁḍaṁ turayāhamē guṁṭhō || 91 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
guṁphī śatapadī |
		gulaṁ tathā guḍōladdhiā cumbanam |
		guṁḍaṁ mustōdbhavaṁ lacakākhyaṁ tr̥ṇam |
		guṁṭhō adhamahayaḥ ||
		yathā ||
prakrit_examples: guṁphisamāē jīē rattō guṁṭhu vva guṁḍiṇimahīē | tīē ccia kuṇasu gulaṁ majjha guḍōladdhiaṁ muñca || 76 || [ 91 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: mūlōcchasabhāmiabhāsēsuṁ gummiagulucchagutthaṁḍā | guṁjōlliaṁ ca guḍadāviaṁ ca piṇḍīkayatthammi || 92||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
gummiaṁ mūlōtsannam |
		gulucchaṁ bhramitam |
		gutthaṁḍō bhāsapakṣī |
		atra guluñchō guñcha iti saṁskr̥tasamaḥ |
		tathā guṁṭhaï uddhūlayati |
		gumaï bhramati |
		guṁjaï hasati | gummaï muhyati |
		ētē dhātvādēśēṣūktā iti nōktāḥ |
		guṁjēlliaṁ tathā guḍadāliaṁ piṇḍīkr̥tam ||
		yathā |
prakrit_examples: guṁjēlliaṇīsāsaṁ guḍadāliahaṇukaraṁ ca gutthaṁḍa | virahagulucchaṁ taha gummiaṁ ca uḍḍia kahēsu maṁ tassa || 77 || [ 92]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: guttaṇahāṇaṁ piujaladāṇē guluguṁchiō vayantariē | guphagumiō surahī gēṁḍagēṁṭhuā ya thaṇavatthagaṇṭhīē || 93 |
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
guttaṇahāṇaṁ pitr̥bhyō jalāñjalidānam |
		atra gujjhaharō rahasyabhēdīti guhyaharaśabdabhavaḥ |
		tathā |
		gulalaï cāṭu karōti |
		guṁjullaï ullasati |
		gummaḍaï muhyati | ētē dhātvādēśēṣūktā iti nōktāḥ |
		guluguṁchiaṁ vr̥tyantaritam |
		unnamitārthaṁ tu unnamērutkṣipērvādēśāsiddham |
		guphagumiaṁ sugandhi |
		gēṁḍaṁ tathā gēṁṭhuaṁ stanayōrupari vastragranthiḥ|| yathā |
prakrit_examples: guluguṁchia mayaguphagumiaṅgō mahasi kimagēṁḍamimaṁ | guttaṇhāṇakaē chuṭṭagēṁṭhuā jāi jaṁ sariamēsā|| 78|| [ 93]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: gēṁṭhullaṁ gōvillaṁ kuppāsē gēṇihaaṁ ca thaṇasuttē | kīlāi gēṁḍuī gējjalaṁ ca gēvējjaē vaṇē gōṁḍaṁ || 94 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
gēṁṭhullaṁ tathā gōvillaṁ kañcukaḥ |
		gēṇihaaṁ uraḥ sūtram |
		gēṁḍuī krīḍā |
		gējjalaṁ graivēyakam |
		gōṁḍaṁ kānanam ||
		yathā |
prakrit_examples: gēṁḍuigōṁḍē gōriṁ sagējjalaṁ pulayaphuṭṭagōvillaṁ | ua daṭṭhuṁ raïtisiōē gēṁṭhullaṁ gēṇihaaṁ ca avaharaï || 79 || [ 94 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: gōcchāgōṁṭhīgōṁḍīgōṁjīō mañjarīē a | gōlō sakkhī gōlhā bimbī gōlī a manthaṇiā || 95 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
gōcchā gōṁṭhī gōṁḍī gōṁjī ētē catvārō mañjarīvācakāḥ |
		gōlō sākṣī | gōlhā bimbī |
		gōlī manthanī ||
		yathā |
prakrit_examples: gōṁḍī gaṇḍē gōcchā bhālē gōṁṭhī urē thaṇē gōṁjī | gōlīsamajalaphusiāu ēttha gōlhōṭṭhi kō gōlō || 80|| [ 95 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: gōvī bālā gōsaṁ gōsaggaṁ gōvaraṁ karīsammi | gōbhaddā gōaggā racchāē gōhuraṁ ca gōviṭṭhā || 96||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
gōvī bālā |
		gōsaṁ prabhātam |
		gōsargaśabdō yadi saṁskr̥tē rūḍhastadā tadbhavō gōsaggaśabdaḥ |
		anyathā tu dēśī |
		paryāyabhaṅgayā tvihōpāttaḥ |
		gōvaraṁ karīṣam | gōmaddā tathā gōaggā rathyā |
		gōhuraṁ gōbiṣṭhā ||
		yathā |
prakrit_examples: gōvaraṇōhurakajjē gōaggaṁ gōvi mā bha/?/ gōsē | vippijjasi jaṁ tassiṁ kēṇa vi gōbhaddavasahēṇa || 81 || [ 96 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: gōṁdīṇaṁ sihipittē, gō/?/ gōsabhūhammi | ṇavayaṇajaḍēsu gōccayaṇōsalā gōviō ajaṁpiraē || 97 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
gōṁdīṇaṁ mayūrapittam |
		gōṇikkō gōsamūhaḥ |
		gōccaō prājanadaṇḍaḥ |
		gōsaṇṇō mūrkhaḥ |
		gōviō ajalpākaḥ ||
		yathā |
prakrit_examples: gōsasa gōviabhisaṁ gōṇikkaṁ gōccaēṇa kiṁ haṇasi | mōraṁ kaḍakkhamāṇiṁ gōṁdīṇapiaṁ ṇivārasu biḍāliṁ || 82 || [ 97 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: gōaṁṭā gōcaraṇēpu yōalā duddhabikaïṇī | gōāliāu pāusakīḍā yōraṁphiḍī gōhā || 98 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
gōaṁṭā gōvaraṇāḥ |
		gōaṁṭō syalaśrr̥ṅgaṭaity anyē |
		gōaṁṭagōkhurallaśabdau vr̥ddhatvavācakāviti tu /?/ |
		gōaṇā dugdhavikrayakartrā |
		ava gōillō gōmāniti matōrillādēśasiddham |
		tathā gō/?/ /?/ tvaśabdabhavatvānnōktam |
		yadāha || gōyukhamupannēpanē ’pi syāt|| iti ( ilāyudhaḥ 5, 11) gōāliā prāvr̥pi kīṭaviśēṣaḥ |
		gōdāṁphiḍī gōdhā ||
		yathā|
prakrit_examples: rēllia gōaṁṭapayaṁ gōālipiē ghaṇammi varisantē | gaṁttīsu gōalāsuṁ gōraṁphiḍi mā kuṇāsaṇiṇivāyaṁ|| 83|| [ 98 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: ghummiamuē gayaṁ vaṇatalārabālamigaṇhāviē gaṁḍō | gattaṁ īsāpaṅkēsu iccharayaṇīsu gaṁdhōllī || 99 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
gayaṁ ghūrṇitaṁ mr̥taṁ ca |
		gaṁḍō vanaṁ dāṇḍapāśikō laghumr̥gō nāpitaścēti caturarthaḥ | samāhāratvādēkavacanam |
		gattaṁ īṣā paṅkaśca |
		gaṁdhōllī icchā rajanī ca || [ 99 ] gaṁdhēllī chāyā madhumakṣikā ca |
		gahavaī grāmīṇaḥ śaśī ca |
		grahapatitvamāditya ēva rūḍhaṁ na śaśinīti nāyaṁ grahapatiśabdasamudbhavaḥ |
		gaṁjōlliaṁ rōmāñcitaṁ tathā hāsyasthānē ’ṅgasparśō yat giligilāviaṁ iti lōkē rūḍhamiti vdyartham || [ 100 ] guṁpā tathā guṁdā bindāvadhamē cēti pratyēkaṁ vdyarthā |
		guṁchā tu bindvadhamayōruttarōṣṭaśmaśruṇi cēti tryarthā |
		guttī bandhanamicchā vacanaṁ latā śirōmālyaṁ cēti pañ‍cārthā || [ 101 ] guppaṁtaṁ śayanīyaṁ saṁmūḍhaṁ gōpitaṁ cēti tryartham |
		gumilaṁ mūḍhaṁ gahanaṁ praskhalitamāpūrṇaṁ cēti caturartham || [ 102 ]
prakrit_examples: gaṁdhēllī chāyāsarahāsu gahavaī a gāmiasasīsu | gaṁjōlliamuddhusiaṁ hāsaṭṭhāṇē a aṅgamāliddhaṁ || 100 ||
binduahamēsu guṁpāguṁdāguṁchāu dāḍhiāē vi | guttī bandhaṇāicchāvayaṇalayāmaülimālāsu || 101 ||

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: busiāvilōḍa़iēsuṁ kaṇḍuathavaēsu taha guliā | saṁcaliakhaliavihāḍiapūriamūḍhēsu gummaïō || 103 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
guliā busikā vilōḍitaṁ kandukaḥ stabakaścēti caturarthā |
		gummaïō saṁcalitaḥ skhalitō vighaṭitaḥ pūritō mūḍhaścēti pañcārthaḥ || [ 103 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: paṅkajavēsuṁ gēḍḍaṁ gōgōdāṇaïsahīsu gōlā ya | sīakkhiggīvāsuṁ gōrā gōṇō a sakkhiusahēsu || 104||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
gēḍḍaṁ paṅkō yavaśca |
		gōlā gaurgōdāvarī sāmānyēna nadī sakhī cēti caturarthā | gōrā lāṅgalapaddhatiścatturgrīvā cēti tryarthā |
		gōṇō sākṣī vr̥ṣabhaśca |
		atra gōlāśabdaḥ saṁskr̥tasamō ’pi kavīnāṁ nātiprasiddhaity upāttaḥ |
		gōṇaśabdastu gavi śabdānuśāsanē sādhitō ’pi gōṇādiprapañcatvādasya prabandhasyēhōpāttaḥ|| [ 104 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: ghaṇṇō uratthalē ghallō aṇurattē gharē ghaṁghō | ghaḍighaḍiaghaḍā gōṭṭhī gharagōlīē gharōlī a || 105 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
ghaṇṇō uraḥ |
		ghaṇṇō raktaity anyē |
		ghallō anuraktaḥ |
		ghaṁghō gr̥ham |
		ghaḍī tathā ghaḍiaghaḍā gōṣṭī |
		gharōllī gr̥hagōlikā ||
		yathā |
prakrit_examples: ghallassa ghaṁghavaïṇō ghasē laggāi kaha ghaḍīruiṇō | ghaḍiaghaḍā ṇīsaṅkā bhamaï jamattā gharōli vva || 84 || [ 105 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: gharabhōaṇē gharōlaṁ sadhammiṇīē gharillī a | ghaṁghōrō hiṇḍaṇāē ghammōī gaṇḍuatiṇammi || 106 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
gharōlaṁ gr̥habhōjanabhēdaḥ |
		gharillī patnī |
		ghaṁghōrō bhramaṇaśīlaḥ |
		ghammōī gaṇḍutsaṁjñaṁ tr̥ṇam ||
		yathā |
prakrit_examples: saha tīē hiṇḍa tumaṁ ghammōīsaddalāi ghaṁghōra | bhuṁjihisi gharōlē puṇa surasē disē gharillīē || 85 || [ 106 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: jahaṇātthavatthabhēē ghaggharamājarirāyammi gharayaṁdō | ghaṇavāhī indē gharaghaṁṭō caḍaē a saüliā ghārī || 107 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
ghaggharaṁ javanasthavastrabhēdaḥ |
		gharayaṁdō ādarśaḥ |
		vaṇavāhī indraḥ |
		gharaghaṁṭō caṭakaḥ | ghārī śakunikākhyaḥ pakṣī ||
		yathā |
prakrit_examples: ghaṇavāhidhaṇumaṇaharē kālē gharaghaṁṭaghārisaṁgharaṇē | sayalakalāgharayaṁdō kō jaṁ siḍhilantaghaggharā sarasi || 86 || [ 107 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: pāyārammi a ghārō ghāraṁtō ghēvarē cēa | gāṇammi ghāyaṇō bhacchiē ghiaṁ khujjaē ghiṭṭō || 108 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
ghārō prākāraḥ |
		ghāraṁtō ghr̥tapūraḥ |
		ghāyaṇō gāyanaḥ |
		ghiaṁ bhartsitam |
		ghiṭṭō kubjaḥ |. yathā | atra |
		ghisaï grasatē |
		iti dhātvādēśēṣūkta iti nōktaḥ || [ 108 ]
prakrit_examples: ghāraṁtē bhikkhantō gēhaduvārē ghiō pariaṇēṇa | ō ghiṭṭaghāyaṇō dhiṭṭhayāi ghārammi āruhaï || 87 ||

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: bhēkē ghugghurighurughuriṇō ghuttiaghusiṇiā gaviṭṭāmmi | ghuṁghuruḍō ukkērē ghugghussusayaṁ sasaṅkabhaṇiammi || 109 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
ghugghurī tathā ghurughurī maṇḍūkaḥ |
		ghuttiaṁ tathā ghusiṇiaṁ gavēṣitam |
		ghuṁghuruḍō utkaraḥ |
		ghugghussusayaṁ sāśaṅkabhaṇitam ||
		yathā | atra ghusiṇaṁ kuṅkumamiti ghusr̥ṇaśabdabhavam |
		tathā |
		ghuṭṭaï pibati |
		ghulaï ghummaï ghūrṇatē |
		ghusalaï mathnāti |
		ētē dhātvādēśēṣūktā iti nōktāḥ|| [ 109 ]
prakrit_examples: pasariaghugghurighurughuriṇiravē sā ghuttiraha ghuṁghuruḍē | tā ghusiṇasu dūi tumaṁ ia ghugghussusaïō cavaï kō vi || 88 ||

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: kaṇṇōvaaṇiāē ghuṇaghuṇiā ghusirasāramavaṇhāṇē | ghuṭṭaghuṇiaṁ girigaḍē ghugghucchaṇayaṁ ca khēammi || 110||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
ghuṇaghuṇiā karṇōpakārṇikā |
		ghusirasāraṁ avasnānam |
		masūrādīnāṁ piṣṭam | ghuṭṭaghuṇiaṁ girērgaḍam |
		pr̥thuśilā |
		ghugghucchaṇayaṁ khēdaḥ |
		yathā | atra ghūō ulūka iti ghūkaśabdabhavaḥ || [ 110 ]
prakrit_examples: tuha āgamaghuṇadhuṇiaṁ sōuṁ caïūṇa ghusirasārāiṁ | ghuṭṭaghuṇiēsu ghugghucchaṇēṇa vaccanti riuvahuā || 89 ||

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: ghōrī salahavisēsē ghōsālī sarayavallibhēāmmi | ghaṭṭō kusumbharattē sariātūhammi vaṁsē a || 111 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
ghōrī śalabhaviśēṣaḥ |
		atra ghōḍō aśva iti ghōṭaśabdabhavaḥ |
		ghōsālī śaradudbhavō vallibhēdaḥ ||
		yathā | atra |
		ghōlaï ghūrṇatē |
		iti dhātvādēśēṣūkta iti nōktaḥ || ghaṭṭō kusumbharaktaṁ vastraṁ nadītīrthaṁ vēṇuścēti tryarthaḥ || [ 111 ]
prakrit_examples: sirikumaravāla ṇaravaï tuha turayā ghōriṇō vva agaṇijjā | kavalanti vēripatthivabalāi ghōsāliādalāiṁ va || 90 ||

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: ghammōḍī majjhaṇahē masaē gāmaṇitiṇē cēa | ghōrō ṇāsiagiddhēsu ghōliaṁ silayalē haḍhakaē a || 112 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
ghammōḍī madhyāhnō maśakhō grāmaṇīsaṁjñaṁ tr̥ṇaṁ cēti tryarthā |
		atra ghattaï kṣipati gavēṣayati cēti dhātvādēśēṣūktamiti nōktam |
		ghōrō nāśitō gr̥dhrapakṣī ca |
		ghōliaṁ śilātalaṁ haṭhakr̥taṁ ca || [ 112 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: cattō takkū caṁgaṁ cāruṁ caḍacōṭṭiāu sihā | caṭṭū a dāruhatthē caṁbhō cāsō a sīrasīmantē || 1 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
cattō tarkuḥ |
		caṁgaṁ cāru |
		caḍō tathā cōṭṭī śikhā |
		caṭṭū dāruhastaḥ |
		caṁbhō tathā cāsō halasphāṭitabhūmirēkhā ||
		yathā |
prakrit_examples: rē caṁgacōṭṭia caḍaṁ cōḍissaṁ caṭṭuēṇa ya haṇissaṁ | cāsakkhamaṁ ghaḍakusiṁ ṇa hu caṁbhaṁ karaï cattamittakusī || 1 || [ 1 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: cattharicahuṭṭacaṁḍikkā hāsaṇimaggarōsēsu | caṁdilacaükkacakkōḍā ṇāviacaccarāggibhēēsu || 2 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
cattharī hāsaḥ |
		cahuṭṭaṁ nimagnam |
		caṁḍikkō rōṣaḥ |
		caṁdilō nāpitaḥ |
		caṇḍila  iti tu saṁskr̥tasamam |
		caükkaṁ catvaram |
		cakkōḍā agnibhēdaḥ ||
		yathā | castaricatuṣkaśabdau yēṣāṁ saṁskr̥tē ’pi saṁmatau tanmatē cattharicaükkaśabdau na dēśyau || [ 2 ]
prakrit_examples: tīi virahacakkōḍājaliō sō caṁdilō sahi iāṇiṁ | hiayacaükkē catvaricahuṭṭaṇakkhō vi kuṇaï caṁḍikkaṁ || 2 ||

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: pīṇācchiṇṇavigāṇēsu caṁḍilacaṁḍiacavēṇā | juakarapuḍē cavēḍī tajā cakappā cuḍuppā ya || 3 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
caṁḍilō pīnaḥ |
		caṁḍiō kr̥ttaḥ |
		cavēṇaṁ vacanīyam |
		cavēḍī śliṣṭaṁ karasaṁpuṭam |
		cavēḍī saṁpuṭamityanyē |
		cakappā tathā cuḍuppā tvak |
		cuḍuppaṁ tvagvidalanamityanyē ||
		yathā |
prakrit_examples: caṁḍiacakappavasaṇā cuḍuppakandāsaṇāhuacavēṇā | riuṇō acaṁḍilā tuha kuṇanti bhillāṇa vi cavēḍiṁ || 3 || [ 3 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: caccikkacittalā maṇḍiammi kumuammi caṁdōjjaṁ | cakkhuḍḍaṇaṁ ca pēkkhaṇaē caṁcapparamasaccammi || 4 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
caccikkaṁ tathā cittalaṁ maṇḍitam |
		cittalaṁ ramaṇīyamityanyē |
		caṁdōjjaṁ kumudam |
		svārthē kē caṁdōjjayaṁ |
		atra candimā candrikā |
		cavalā vidyut |
		iti candrikācapalāśabdabhavau |
		cavaï kathayati |
		cayi śaknōti |
		cajjaï paśyati | cacchaï takṣṇōti |
		ityādayō dhātvādēśēṣūktā iti nōktāḥ |
		cakkhuḍḍaṇaṁ prēkṣaṇīyam |
		caṁcapparaṁ asatyam ||
		yathā |
prakrit_examples: caṁcapparaṁ ṇa bhaṇimō kuṇēsi cakkhuḍḍaṇō kaḍakkhēhiṁ | caṁdujjayacaccikkā disāu mayaṇāhicittalakavōlē || 4 || [ 4 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: mōrammi caṁdaïllō caükkarō kattikēammi | caḍiārō āḍōvē ahibhēē cakkulaṁḍā ya || 5 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
caṁdaïllō mayūraḥ |
		caükkarō kārttikēyaḥ |
		caḍiārō āṭōpaḥ |
		cakkulaṁḍā sarpaviśēṣaḥ ||
		yathā |
prakrit_examples: gaṇavaïgajjiaṇaccantacaükkaracaṁdaïllasaddēhiṁ | taṭṭhagalacakkulaṁḍō ṇaccaï ruddō sacaḍiāraṁ || 5 || [ 5 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: ṇāmammi carullēvaṁ cakkhaḍiaṁ jīviavvammi | caṁḍaṭṭhiā ya khavaē ummīē cakkaṇāhayaṁ cēa || 6 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
carullēvaṁ nāma |
		cakkhaḍiaṁ jīvitavyam |
		caṁdaṭṭhiā bhujaśikharam |
		stabakaity antē |
		yad āhuḥ || stabakaś caṁdaṭṭhiāsaṁjñaḥ || iti |
		atra |
		cañcarīō bhramaraḥ | caṁdasālā jālakr̥tā gr̥hōpari kuṭikā |
		iti cañcarīkacandraśālāśabdabhavau |
		caccuppaï arpayati |
		camaḍhaï bhuṅktē |
		cakkamaï bhramati |
		ityādayō dhātvādēśēṣūktā iti nōcyantē |
		cakkaṇāhayaṁ ūrmiḥ|| yathā |
prakrit_examples: ṇīsāsacakkaṇāhayatāviacaṁdaṭṭhiāi tuha virahē | kaṇṭhammi tīi vaṭṭaï cakkhaḍiaṁ tuha tahā carullēvaṁ || 6 || [ 6 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: hālammi caüraciṁdhō ṇāraṅgaphalammi cakkaṇabhayaṁ ca | caṁdavaḍāyā addhāvariaṅgī cakkhurakavaṇī lajjā || 7||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
caüraciṁdhō sātavāhanaḥ |
		cakkaṇabhayaṁ nāraṅgaphalam |
		caṁdavaḍāyā ardhaprāvr̥tadēhā | cakkhurakkhaṇī lajjā ||
		yathā | atra calaṇāuhō kukkuṭa iti caraṇāyudhaśabdabhavaḥ|| [ 7 ] caḍulātilayaṁ kāñcanaśrr̥ṅkhalālambiratnatilakam |
		caḍulā ratnatilakamityanyē | cāḍō māyāvī |
		cāulā taṇḍulāḥ |
		cālavāsō śirōbhūṣaṇabhēdaḥ ||
		yathā |
prakrit_examples: daṭṭhūṇa tumaṁ cakkaṇabhayatthaṇī avaracaüraciṁdhaṁ va | tammaï caṁdavaḍāyā muddhā vi hu mukkacakkhurakkhaṇiā || 7 ||
jīē tujjha ṇihittaṁ caḍulātilayaṁ ca cālavāsō a | taṁ cēa cāḍa aṇusara kiṁ cāulakhaṇḍalīi maē || 8 || [ 8 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: gaṇṭhicchēayagimhāṇilēsu cāraṇayacāravāyā vi | cillā saülīē civiḍaṇāsaē ciccaciccarayā || 9 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
cāraṇaō granthicchēdakaḥ |
		kapratyayābhāvē cāraṇō |
		cāravāō grīṣmānilaḥ | cillā śakunikākhyaḥ pakṣī |
		ciccō tathā ciccarō cipiṭanāsaḥ ||
		yathā |
prakrit_examples: ṇa hu mēllaï paharantō hī ciccaṁ ciccaraṁ ca cillaṁ ca | ua mayaṇō māṇiṇi māṇagaṇṭhicāraṇayacāravāyasahō || 9 || [ 9 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: bālammi cillacēḍā ciccaṁ ramaṇē huāsaṇē ciccī | ciṁciṇiciṁcā ambiliāē taha ciṁcaṇī gharaṭṭhīē || 10 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
cillō tathā cēḍō bālaḥ |
		ciccaṁ ramaṇam |
		ciccī hutāśanaḥ |
		ciṁciṇī tathā ciṁcā amlikā |
		kaiścit ciṁciṇiciṁcāśabdaḥ samasta ēva amlikāvācakatvēna prōktaḥ |
		ciṁcaṇī gharaṭṭikā|| yathā |
prakrit_examples: ciṁcavaṇē ciṁciṇiācaḍiē cēḍammi ciccaṭhiacillā | ua dhāvaï jaṇaṇī caïa ciṁcaṇīciccikammāiṁ || 10 || [ 10 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: masayammi cillirī rōmasammi cimiṇō kuḍīi cirayā ya | cikkhallō kaddamaē musalē cillūracēluṁpā || 11 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
cillirī maśakaḥ |
		cimiṇō rōmaśaḥ |
		cirayā kuṭī |
		cikkhallō kardamaḥ | cillūraṁ tathā cēluṁpaṁ musalaṁ ||
		yathā | atra ciṁcaï maṇḍayatīti dhātvādēśēṣūkta iti nōktaḥ|| [ 11 ]
prakrit_examples: cikkhalliacirayāē cilliriḍasiā tuhāriṇō cimiṇā | kaṇḍanti sayaṁ cillūraēṇa cēluṁpapāṇitupallabalā || 11 ||

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: ullē ciliccilaciliccīlā paritōsiammi cittaṭhiō | cirihiṭṭī a ciṇōṭṭhī mahupaḍalē cittadāū a || 12 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
ciliccilaṁ tathā ciliccīlaṁ ārdram |
		cittaṭhiō paritōṣitaḥ |
		cirihiṭṭī guñjā | ciṇōṭṭhīśabdō ’pi dēśyaḥ |
		paryāyabhaṅgayā tūpāttaḥ |
		cittadāū madhupaṭalam |
		kēcit | tiṇisammi cittadāū iti paṭhanti tiṇisaṁ ca vr̥ttaviśēṣamācakṣatē |
		asmābhistu sāratadēśīdarśanēna tiṇisaśabdō madhupaṭalārthō vyākhyātaḥ |
		tatra yuktāyuktatvē bahudr̥śvānaḥ pramāṇam ||
		yathā |
prakrit_examples: savarō sēaciliccilamaṁsuciliccīlamarivahuṁ tujjha | cirihiṭṭilōaṇō mahaï cittadāuṁ ca cittaṭhiacittō || 12 || [ 12 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: caṇḍātakammi ciṁphullaṇī ciricirāciriṁcirā dhārā | caliammi a ciṁcaïō ṇiṇṇāsiayammi ciddaviō || 13 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
ciṁphullaṇī strīṇāmarghōṁrukavastram |
		ciricirā tathā ciriṁcirā jaladhārā | ciṁcaïō calitaḥ |
		ciṁcaïō maṇḍita iti tu maṇḍidhātvādēśē siddhaḥ |
		ciddaviō nirnāśitaḥ ||
		yathā | atra ciṁcillaï maṇḍayatīti dhātvādēśēṣūkta iti nōktaḥ || [ 13 ]
prakrit_examples: ghaṇajalaciriṁcirāciddaviā pavasiavahūu ciṁcaïā | ṇayaṇaṁsuciricilōlliaciṁphullaṇiāu piahuttaṁ || 13||

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: dahiē ciriḍḍihillaṁ cīhī mutthāsamutthatiṇē | cīvaṭṭī bhallīē cukkō muṭṭhīi cujjamacchariē || 14 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
ciriḍḍihillaṁ dadhi |
		cīhī mustōdbhavaṁ tr̥ṇam |
		cīvaṭṭī bhallī |
		cukkō muṣṭiḥ | cujjaṁ āścaryam |
		ōtsaṁyōgē |
		iti cōjjaṁity api ||
		yathā |
prakrit_examples: sā hiṇḍirē taï ciriḍḍihillamatta ṇavacīhisamayammi | daḍhacukkakāmacīvaṭṭitāḍiā jaṁ jiēi taṁ cujjaṁ || 14 || [ 14 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: parisōsiammi cuṁchō sasiṇēhē cuppacōpphuccā | cullī silāi cuḍulī ukkā cuṇiō vidhāriaē || 15||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
cuṁchō pariśōṣitaḥ |
		cuppō tathā cōpphuccō sas‍nēhaḥ |
		cullī śilā |
		atra | cucchaṁ tuccham |
		iti tucchaśabdabhavatvānnōktam |
		cuḍulī ulkā |
		cuṇiō vidhāritaḥ ||
		yathā |
prakrit_examples: sundara taï cōpphuccā acuppavirahaggicuḍulicuṁchā vi | bāladharia vva cullī sā acchaï āsatantucuṇiappā || 15 || [ 15 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: cuṇṇāsī dāsī cuṁcuacuppalacuṁbhalā ya sēharaē | cuṇṇāā ya kalāē chāgammi a cukkuḍaculuppā || 16 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
cuṇṇāsī dāsī |
		cuṁcuō tathā cuppalō tathā cuṁbhalō śēkharaḥ |
		cuṇṇaā kalā |
		cukkuḍō tathā culuppō chāgaḥ ||
		yathā | atra cukkaï bhraśyatīti dhātvādēśēṣūktamiti nōcyatē || cuppālaō gavākṣaḥ |
		cuppaliaṁ navaraktaṁ vastram |
		cullōḍaō jyēṣṭhaḥ | cuṇṇaïō cūrṇāhataḥ |
		cuṇṇiō rēṇuvicchurita iti tu cūrṇitaśabdabhavaḥ ||
		yathā |
prakrit_examples: cuṇṇāsīē sacuṇṇaāē cuppalaculuppiduddhāiṁ | rē jaḍacuṁbhalacukkuḍa appasu kiṁ cuṁcuāiṇā majjha || 16 || [ 16 ]
cuppālayadārēṇaṁ ṇavacuppaliāi picchapaharantī | ō cullōḍayajāyā cusaïā dēarēṇa phagguchaṇē || 17 || [ 17 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: alasammi cuṁcumālī cuṁculipūrō a culuammi | valayāvalithaṇasihavāmaṇaēsuṁ cūḍacūacōlā ya || 18 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
caṁcamālī alasaḥ |
		cuṁculipūrō culukaḥ |
		atra culuculaï spandana iti dhātvādēśēṣūktamiti nōktam |
		cūḍō valayāvalī |
		cūō stanaśikhā |
		cōlō vāmanaḥ ||
		yathā |
prakrit_examples: tuha jalacuṁculipūrō vi dullahō cuṁcumāliṇō cōla | maṇicūḍamaṇḍiā cārucūaā kāmiṇīu kiṁ mahasi || 18 || [ 18 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: mālūratōttaṇahasiicōddasiā cōḍhacōttacōrāliā | caccā ya hatthabimbē talappahārē a ṇāyavvā || 19 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
cōḍhō bilvaḥ |
		cōttaṁ pratōdaḥ |
		cōralī śrāvaṇakr̥ṣṇacaturdaśī ||
		yathā | cōppaḍaï bhrakṣatīti dhātvādēśēṣūktamitīha nōktam | caccā sthāsakaḥ prasr̥tahastāghātaśca || [ 19 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: caṁḍijjō khalakōvēsu capphalaṁ sēharē asaccē a | kuṇḍalavaṭṭuladōlāphalayavisālēsu cakkalayaṁ || 20 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
caṁḍijjō piśrunaḥ kōpaśca |
		capphalaṁ śēkharaviśōṣō ' satyaṁ ca |
		sāmānyaśabdā api viśēṣē vartanta iti hi nyāyaḥ |
		cakkalaṁ kuṇḍalaṁ vartulaṁ dōlāphalakaṁ viśālaṁ cēti caturartham |
		atra caḍḍaï mr̥drāti bhuṅktē pinaṣṭi cēti dhātvādēśēṣūktamiti nōktam || [ 20 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: cārō piālaguttīcchāsuṁ cikkāppataṇuadhārāsu | cammamayavāribhaṇḍē taṇudhārādiṇamuhēsu a cirikkā || 21 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
cārō piyālavr̥kṣō bandhanasthānamicchā cēti tryarthaḥ |
		cikkā alpaṁ vastuṁ tanudhārā cēti dvyarthā |
		cirikkā carmamayajalabhāṇḍaṁ tanudhārā pratyūṣaścēti tryarthā || [ 21 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: ciṁdhālaṁ rammē uttamē a cullō sisummi dāsē a | pāṇappabālamukkacchandāruivaïarēsu cuṇaō vi || 22 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
ciṁdhālaṁ ramyaṁ mukhyaṁ ca |
		cullō śiśurdāsaśca |
		cuṇaō caṇḍālō ’lpō bālō muktaśrchandō ’rōcakō vyatikaraścēti saptārthaḥ |
		cuṇaō viaraō iti dhanapālaḥ | āghrātārthē ’pīti kēcit || [ 22 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: cañcuculuēsu cuṁculi avagamiasaïṁṇhayāsu cuṁculiaṁ | cuṁcuṇiā ciapaḍiravaramaṇambilimuṭṭhijūajūāsu || 23 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
cuṁculī cañcuśculukaśca |
		cuṁculi iti luptavibhaktyantō nirdēśaḥ |
		cuṁculiaṁ avadhāritaṁ satr̥ṣṇatā ca |
		cuṁcuṇiā cyutaṁ pratiravō ramaṇamamlikā muṣṭidyūtaṁ yūkā cēti ṣaḍarthā |
		pratirava iti sāmānyaśabdō ’pi viśēṣē gōṣṭhīpratiravē vartatē |
		yadāha | || cuṁcuṇiā pratiravō gōṣṭhayām || kēcit cuṁcuṇiaṁ calitē ’pyāhuḥ || [ 23 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: challī tajāi chaddī sējjāē vijjulāi chaḍā | kavikacchū chaṁkuichuṁchuīu chaliā chaïllachappaṇṇā || 24 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
challī tvak |
		chaddī śayyā |
		chaḍā vidyut |
		atra chaṇō utsava iti kṣaṇaśabdabhavō 'yamiti nōktaḥ |
		chaṁkuī tathā chuṁchuī kapikacchuḥ |
		chaliō chaïllō chappasōity ētē trayō ’pi vidagdhārthāḥ |
		anyōnyaparyāyabhaṅgayā tu nibaddhāḥ ||
		yathā |
prakrit_examples: kayalīchalliṁ chaṁkuimambujachaddiṁ pi chuṁchuiṁ muṇaï | chaliēṇa chaïllapiā tēṇa viṇā chaḍacalēṇa chappaṇṇā || 20 || [ 24 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: chavaḍī cammaṁ chappaṁtī ṇiamō jattha lihiaē paümaṁ | taṇuē chaüacchikkōliā chamalaō a sattachaē || 25 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
chavaḍī carma |
		chappaṁtī niyamaviśēṣō yatra padmaṁ likhyatē |
		chaüaṁ tathā chikkōliaṁ tanu |
		chamalaō saptacchadaḥ ||
		yathā | atra |
		chaḍḍaï muñcati |
		chajjaï rājati |
		iti dhātvādēśēṣūktāviti nōktau | chaḍakkharō skandaḥ |
		chāsī takram |
		chārō acchabhallaḥ |
		chāhī gaganam | chāyāvācakastu chāhīśabdaśrchāyāśabdabhava ēva |
		chāīō mātaraḥ |
		chiddō laghumatsyaḥ ||
		yathā |
prakrit_examples: jassa kaē chappaṁtiṁ karōsi chaüaṅgi sō vi tujjha kaē | chamalayatalammi chikkōliūṇa millēi migachavaḍiṁ || 29 ||
chāichaḍakkharachāhīmaṇi ṇa paṇamēsi kahasu kassa kaē | chāsīhāriṇi dhūē chārasirē chiddagandhillē || 22 || [ 26 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: chillī sihāi chittaṁ chiviē jārēsu chiṇṇachiṇṇālā | chivvaṁ kārimamucchudalē chiviaṁ vāhalīi chiṁchōlī || 27 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
chillī śikha |
		chittaṁ spr̥ṣṭam |
		chiṇṇō tathā chiṇṇālō jāraḥ |
		jārēṣvityēkaśēṣādbahuvacanāt chiṇṇā chiṇṇālī strītyapi |
		chivvaṁ kr̥trimam |
		chiviaṁ ikṣukhaṇḍam | chiṁchōlī vāhalī |
		vāhalīśabdaśca laghujalapravāhavācakō dēśya ēva vakṣyatē ||
		yathā |
prakrit_examples: chivvasiṇēhacchittacchilliṁ chiviēṇa bhōliūṇa sisuṁ | jaṁ calasi ghaḍakarā taṁ chiṇṇē chiṁchōliāi chiṇṇālō || 23 || [ 27 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: chippīraṁ ca palālē chippālō sassasattaüsahammi | chillaramavi pallalaē muhavikkōṇē a chivvōllō || 28 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
chippīraṁ palālam |
		chippālō sasyāsaktō gauḥ |
		chillaraṁ palvalam |
		chivvōllō nindārthaṁ mukhavikūṇanam |
		vikūṇitaṁ mukhamēvētyanyē ||
		yathā | atra |
		chivaï chihaï spr̥śati |
		ētau dhātvādēśēṣūktāviti nōktau |
		[ 28 ]
prakrit_examples: tujjha kaē bāhēhiṁ sā chillarayaṁ bharēi duṭṭha tumaṁ | chivvōllēṇa tamikkhasi chippīratiṇaṁ va chippālō || 24 ||

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: chippāluachikkōaṇachihaṁḍayā pucchaasahaṇadahisarā | chiṇṇōbbhavā ya duvvā taha chiṇṇacchōḍaṇaṁ sigghē || 29 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
chippāluaṁ puccham |
		chikkōaṇō asahanaḥ |
		chihaṁḍaō dadhisaraḥ |
		chiṇṇōbbhavā dūrvā |
		chiṇṇacchōḍaṇaṁ śīghram ||
		yathā |
prakrit_examples: varachippālua chiṇṇōbbhavāchihaṁḍēhi dhavala puṭṭhō si | chiṇṇacchōḍaṇagamaṇē hakkāchikkōaṇō havasu iṇhiṁ || 25 || [ 29 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: dahiē chihiṁḍibhillaṁ chiṁchaṭaramaṇaṁ ca miṁcaṇakkīlā | chuṁdaṁ bahuammi balāyāi chuī littaē chuhiaṁ || 30 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
chihiṁḍibhillaṁ dadhi |
		chiṁchaṭaramaṇaṁ cakṣuḥsthaganakrīḍā |
		chudaṁ bahu |
		chuī balākā |
		chuhiaṁ liptam ||
		yathā |
prakrit_examples: chuṁdaghaṇacchuhiaṁ ṇahamuḍḍīṇāchihiṁḍibhilladhavalachuiṁ | jāva huaṁ tā tīē chiṁchaṭaramaṇaṁ sahīhi kayaṁ || 29 || [ 30 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: churiachuramaḍḍichuṁchuṁmusayā maṭṭichurahatthaaraīsu | chēṁḍī lahuracchāē chēlī thōvappasūṇamālāē || 31 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
churiā mr̥ttiā |
		churamaḍḍī kṣurahastaḥ |
		nāpita iti yāvat |
		churahatthaśabdō ’pi dēśyaḥ |
		paryāyabhaṅgayā tūpāttaḥ |
		chuṁchuṁmusayaṁ raṇaraṇakaḥ |
		chēṁḍī laghurathyā | chēlī alpaprasūnā mālā ||
		yathā |
prakrit_examples: juttaṁ chuṁchuṁmusayaṁ karēsi churamaḍḍiāi churahattha | chēli ccia aṇurūvā churiāghaḍiassa chēṁḍijakkhassa || 27 || [ 31 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: chēttaramaṇavvasuppāi chēbhaō hatthabimbammi | chāgammi chēlaō khēttajāgarē chēttasōvaṇayaṁ || 32 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
chēttaraṁ jīrṇaṁ śrūrpādyupakaraṇam |
		chēbhaō sthāsakaḥ |
		chēlaō chāgaḥ |
		kapratyayābhāvē chēlōity api |
		chēttasōvaṇayaṁ kṣētrē jāgaraṇam ||
		yathā |
prakrit_examples: masichēbhaïllavasaṇaṁ parihariuṁ chēttaraṁ va maṁ bahiṇi | tīi kaē sō chēlō ṇisi vaccaï chēttasōvaṇamisēṇa || 28 || [ 32 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: chōbbhō pisuṇō dāsammi chōiō appiammi chōbbhatthaṁ | chaṁṭō jalacchaḍāsigghēsuṁ chāō a bhukkhiakisēsu || 33 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
chōbbhō piśrunaḥ |
		kēcit chōbbhō khala iti pūrvadēśīṣu pāṭhaṁ dr̥ṣṭvā khalaśabdavipralabdhāḥ khalaṁ piṇyākaṁ vyācakṣata udāharanti ca |
		asmābhistu sārataradēśīparyālōtanēna chōbbhō piśruna iti dr̥ṣṭamudāhr̥taṁ ca |
		tatra bahudr̥śvānaḥ pramāṇam |
		chōiō dāsaḥ |
		chōbbhatthaṁ apriyam |
		hrasvaḥ saṁyōgē |
		iti chubbhatthaṁity api ||
		yathā || chaṁṭō jalacchaṭā śīghraścēti vdyarthaḥ |
		chāō bubhukṣitaḥ kr̥śaśca |
		nanu |
		chātōdarī yuvadr̥śāṁ kṣaṇamutsavō ’bhūt ||ity ādau chātaśabdasya kr̥śārthasya darśanātkathamayaṁ dēśyaḥ |
		naivam |
		chēdanārthasyaiva chātaśabdasya sādhutvāt |
		na ca dhātvanēkārthatā | uttaramatra |
		anēkārthatā hi dhātūnāṁ lōkaprasidhdyā |
		lōkē ca chātaśabdasya chēdanārthaṁ muttkāsyaiva kavēḥ prayōgō nānyēṣāmityalaṁ bahunā || [ 33 ]
prakrit_examples: tīē kaḍillavatthaṁ uttariaṁ karia majjha daṁsantō | kiṁ kāhisi iha asaṁ rē chōia chōbbha chōbbhatthaṁ || 29 ||

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: dhaṇṇāīṇaṁ malaṇē gōmayavatthēsu taha chāṇaṁ | chāyā kittībhamarīsu chārayaṁ ucchusakkamaülēsu || 34 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
chāṇaṁ dhānyādimalanaṁ gōmayaṁ vastraṁ cēti tryartham |
		chāṇītyapi kēṣāṁcitpāṭhaḥ | chāyā kīrttirbhramarī ca |
		chārayaṁ ikṣuśalkaṁ mukulaṁ ca || [ 34 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: chāillō a paīvē sarisē ūṇē surūvē a | chiddakuḍīsuṁ chillaṁ chiṁḍaṁ sihachattadhūvajantēsu || 35 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
chāillō pradīpaḥ sadr̥śa ūnaḥ surūpaścēti caturarthaḥ |
		chillaṁ chidraṁ kuṭī ca |
		chillaṁ vr̥tyantaramapīti kēcit |
		chiṁḍaṁ cūḍā chatraṁ dhūpayantraṁ ca |
		saṁyōgē para idētōḥ kāmacāra iti chēḍaṁity api || [ 35]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: chippaṁ bhikkhāpucchēsu chittachīēsu chikkaṁ ca | chivaō samūhaṇīvīsu chiṁchaō dēhajārēsu || 36||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
chippaṁ bhikṣā pucchaṁ va |
		chikkaṁ spr̥ṣṭaṁ kṣutaṁ ca |
		chivaō samūhō nīvī ca | chiṁchaō dēhō jāraśca |
		kēcit chiṁchayaṁ śalāṭuphalamāhuḥ ||
		yathā |
prakrit_examples: dhūāi paḍhamagabbhaṁ va rakkhaē uaha āḍhiā ghariṇī | tumbīi paḍhamaṇiggayamābandhurabandhaṇaṁ chiṁchaṁ || 30 || [ 36 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: chippaṁtī vayaūsavabhēē piṭṭhē vi chippiṁḍī | chikkōṭṭalī a payaravapāmaddāchāṇakhaṇaḍēsu || 37 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
chippaṁtī vratabhēda utsavabhēdaścēti dvyarthā |
		chippiṁḍī vratōtsavabhēdau piṣṭaṁ cēti vyarthā |
		chikkōṭṭalī aṁhriravaḥ pādābhyāṁ dhānyamalanaṁ gōmayakhaṇḍaṁ cēti tryarthā || [ 37 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: chippaṁdūraṁ gōmayakhaṇḍammi tahēa visamammi | sisusasisu chuddahīrō chēō antammi diarē a || 38 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
chippaṁdūraṁ gōmayakhaṇḍaṁ viṣamaṁ cēti dvyartham |
		chuddahīrō śiśruḥ śaśī ca |
		chēō antō dēvaraśca || [ 38 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: chēdhō thāsayacōrēsu sihāṇōmāliāsu chēṁḍā vi | chōhō gaṇavikkhēvā chōbbhāittī achēppabēsāsu || 39 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
chēdhō sthāsakaścauraśca |
		chēṁḍā śikhā navamālikā ca |
		chōhō samūhō vikṣēpaï chōbbhāittī aspr̥śyā dvēṣyā va || [ 39 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: jaṁgā gōarabhūmī jaccō purisē tusē jaṁbhō | jayaṇaṁ hayakavacammi jaraṁḍō vuḍḍhammi jaṇahalī ṇīvī || 40
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
jaṁgā gōcarabhūmiḥ |
		jaccō puruṣaḥ |
		jaṁbhō tuṣaḥ |
		jayaṇaṁ hayasaṁnāhaḥ |
		jaraṁ br̥ddhaḥ |
		jaraḍōity anyē |
		jaṇhalī nīvī ||
		yathā |
prakrit_examples: jayaṇēhi hayā gāmā jaṁgāhi kaṇā a jaṁbhabhāvēṇa | mahilāō jaṇhalīhi sahanti gēhā jaraṁḍajaccēhiṁ || 31 || [ 40 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: jaḍiaṁ khaciē jagalaṁ paṅkasurē jaṁbulō a vāṇīrē | ṇāṅgalasihāi javaṇaṁ jaḍammi jaṁbhalajahājāyā || 41 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
jaḍiaṁ khacitam |
		jagalaṁ paṅkilā surā |
		paṅkilasarakō jagalaṁity anyē | jaṁbulō vānīraḥ |
		jaṁbulaṁ madyabhājanamiti sātavāhanaḥ |
		javaṇaṁ halaśikhā | jaṁbhalō tathā jahājāō jaḍaḥ ||
		yathā | atra jagarō saṁnāha iti saṁskr̥tasamaḥ |
		jaṁpaï kathayati |
		javaï yāpayati |
		iti dhātvādēśēṣūktāviti nōktau |
		[ 41 ] jahimā vidagdharacitā gāthā |
		javaō tathā javaraō yavāṅkuraḥ |
		jaṁghāmaō tathā jaṁghāluō dvāvapyētāvanyōnyaparyāyatayā jaṅghālavācakau |
		jaṁbālaṁ jalanīlī | śēvālamityarthaḥ |
		jalanīlīśabdō yadi saṁskr̥tē na rūḍhastadā dēśyaḥ ||
		yathā |
prakrit_examples: maṇijaḍiavāsabhavaṇē jagalaṁ jaṁbulagharōciaṁ ṇintō | jahajāya kīsa lajjasi javaṇōciahatthajaṁbhalattēṇa || 32 ||
jaṁghāluē ṇaïaḍaṁ gayā si jaṁ tuha taṇummi jaṁbālō | taha javarayagōvīō tuha jahimaṁ tattha gāyanti || 33||
taṁ javayagōraaṅgiṁ bhariuṁ jaṁghāmaō havia vacca | jalaṇīliduggamaggō ṇa viambhaï pāusō jāva || 34 || [ 42 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: jacchaṁdaō satantammi jakkharattī a dīvālī | jaṇṇōhaṇō ṇisiarē jaṁghāchēō a caccaraē || 43||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
jacchaṁdaō svacchandaḥ |
		kapratyayābhāvē jacchaṁdō |
		jakkharattī dīpālikā | jaṇṇōhaṇō rākṣasaḥ |
		jaṁghāchēō catvaram ||
		yathā |
prakrit_examples: maṇivalaēhi kuṇantī jaṁghāchēammi jakkharattiṁ va | jaṇṇōhaṇāṇa vi tumaṁ ṇisi jacchaṁdēṇa kiṁ ḍarasi || 35 || [ 43 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: viddaviammi jagaḍiō jaṁbhaṇaāī jahicchabhaṇirāī | jaraladdhiajaralaviā gāmīṇē ūruē jahaṇarōhō || 44 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
jagaḍiō vidrāvitaḥ |
		kadarthitaity arthaḥ |
		jaṁbhaṇaō yathēṣṭavaktā |
		jaṁbhaṇabhaṇō iti kēcit |
		ubhayatrādigrahaṇāt |
		jaṁpicchaō yathādr̥ṣṭamabhilaṣita |
		jaṁpōcchiramaggirō yō yadyadr̥ṣṭaṁ tadēva mr̥gayatē |
		ityādi |
		atra |
		jaaḍaï tvaratē |
		iti dhātvādēśēṣūktamiti nōktam |
		jaraladdhiō tathā jaralaviō grāmīṇaḥ |
		jahaṇarōhō ūruḥ ||
		yathā |
prakrit_examples: jaraladdhiāi daṭṭhuṁ pavaṇalhasantaṁsuaṁ jahaṇaṇēhaṁ | ō kāmasarajagaḍiā jaralaviā hunti jaṁbhaṇayā || 36 || [ 44 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: jahaṇūsavamaddhōrū jaṁkayasukaō 'ppasukayagijjhammi | jāḍī gummaṁ jāī surā kaviṭṭhammi jāūrō || 45||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
jahaṇūsavaṁ ardhōrukam |
		jaṁkayasukaō alpasukr̥tagrāhyaḥ |
		jāḍī gulmam |
		jāī surā |
		jāūrō kapitthaḥ ||
		yathā |
prakrit_examples: jāūrajāḍikaṇṭayaphaṭṭirajahaṇūsavā vi tēṇa samaṁ | jāīluddhā vaccasi jaṁkayasukayā si taṁ putti || 37 || [ 45 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: jālaghaḍiā siraharē jigghiamōsiṁghiatthammi | jiṇṇōbbhavā ya duvvāi jīvayamaī a vāhamaī || 46 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
jālaghaḍiā candraśālā |
		jigghiaṁ ghrātam |
		atra jimiaṁ bhuktamiti bhujidhātvādēśabhavam |
		jiṇṇōbbhavā dūrvā |
		jīvayamaī mr̥gākarṣaṇahēturvyādhamr̥gī ||
		yathā | atra jīhaï lajjatē |
		iti dhātvādēśēṣūktamiti nōktam |
prakrit_examples: jālaghaḍiāi jā taṁ ṇa ṇiasi jīvayamaïṁ va mayaṇassa | tā bhama hariṇō vva tumaṁ kulaḍājiṇṇōbbhavāu jigghantō || 38 || [ 46 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: juṇṇō chēgē jualō taruṇē apariggahammi juṁjuruḍō | jualiajurumillā duguṇiagahaṇā juaō a bappīhē || 47 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
juṇṇō vidagdhaḥ |
		jualō taruṇaḥ |
		juṁjuruḍō aparigrahaḥ |
		jualiaṁ dviguṇitam | jurumillaṁ gahanam |
		jūrummilayaṁ iti gōpālaḥ |
		juaō cātakaḥ ||
		yathā | atra |
		jūravaï vañcati |
		iti dhātvādēśēṣūktamiti nōktam || [ 47 ]
prakrit_examples: juṁjuruḍāē ghaṇaravajualiavisamasaravēaṇāi maha | duhajurumillāvatthaṁ kaha jūaa tassa juṇṇajualassa || 39 ||

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: jēmaṇayaṁ dāhiṇaē aṅgē jō raṁ ca jō kiratthammi | jōkkhamacōkkhē jōō candē jōggā ya cāḍummi || 48 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
jēmaṇayaṁ dakṣiṇamaṅgam |
		hastādi |
		jō raṁ yaḥ kirētyarthē |
		jōkkhaṁ malinam | jōō candraḥ |
		jōggā cāṭu ||
		yathā |
prakrit_examples: jayasiriṇivāsajēmaṇabhua tuha guṇavasaṇammi kā jōggā | jō raṁ jasēṇa cālukka jōkkhamavaharasi jōassa || 40 || [ 48 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: ṇakkhattē jōḍaṁ jōisaṁ ca jōī a vijjūē | khaliammi jōirō jōikkhō dīvammi jōḍiō vāhē || 49||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
jōḍaṁ tathā jōisaṁ nakṣatram |
		jōī vidyut |
		jōirō skhalitaḥ |
		jōikkhō dīpaḥ |
		jōḍiō vyādhaḥ ||
		yathā |
prakrit_examples: mēhammi pihiajōisavaïjōḍē ruirajōijōikkhē | hiṇḍanti ajōirayā vammahajōḍiasarāhayā kulaḍā || 41 || [ 49 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: ṇayaṇammi jōaṇaṁ taha khajjōē jōiaṁ jāṇa | jōiṁgaṇō a indōvē jōvārīi jōsaliā || 50||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
jōaṇaṁ lōcanam |
		jōiō khadyōtaḥ |
		jōiṁgaṇō indragōpaḥ |
		jōṇṇaliā jōvārī |
		dhānyam |
		jōvārīśabdō ' pi dēśya ēva ||
		yathā |
prakrit_examples: calajōiajōiṁgaṇamikkhia jōṇṇaliakāraṇaṁ kālaṁ | kāsayavahūu harisā upphullayajōaṇā hunti || 42 || [ 50 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: jōvvaṇaṇīraṁ taha jōvvaṇavēaṁ jōvvaṇōvayaṁ ca jarā | jaṇhaṁ lahupiḍharē kasiṇaē a jaṁpaṇamakittivayaṇēsu || 51||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
jōvvaṇaṇīraṁ tathā jōvvaṇavēṇaṁ tathā jōvvaṇōvayaṁ vayaḥ pariṇāmaḥ |
		jōvvaṇaṇīrō jōvvaṇōvaō r̥r̥kṣa iti catuṣpadavargē yatkēnaciduktaṁ tasya saṁmōha ēva ||
		yathā | jaṇhaṁ laghupiṭharaṁ kr̥ṣṇaṁ cēti dvyartham |
		jaṁpaṇaṁ akīrtirvaktraṁ ca || [ 51 ]
prakrit_examples: jōvvaṇaṇīraṁ taruṇakṣaṇē vi vijiēndiāṇa purisāṇa | jōvvaṇavēē vi ṇa jōvvaṇōvayaṁ hōi iarāṇa || 43 ||

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: vēḍisavaruṇēsuṁ jaṁbuō a gāmaṇiviḍēsu jaṇaüttō | jaccaṁdaṇamagarū kuṅkumaṁ ca jōvō a binduthōvēsu || 52 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
jaṁbuō vētasavr̥kṣaḥ paścimadikpālaśca |
		jaṇaüttō grāmapradhānapuruṣō viṭaśca | jaccaṁdaṇaṁ agaruḥ kuṅkumaṁ ca |
		jōvō binduḥ stōkaṁ ca |
		atra jūraï khidyatē krudhyati cēti dhātvādēśēṣūktamiti nōktam || [ 52 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: saṁtatavarisammi jhaḍī jhaṁkhō tuṭṭhē jhalā ya mayataṇhā | jhaṁṭī lahuddhakēsēsu pīlumāyāsu jhaṁḍuajhamālā || 53 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
jhaḍī nirantaravr̥ṣṭiḥ |
		jhaṁkhō tuṣṭaḥ |
		jhalā mr̥gatr̥ṣṇā |
		jhaṁṭī laghūrdhvakēśāḥ | jhaṁḍuō pīluvr̥kṣaḥ |
		jhamālaṁ indrajālam ||
		yathā |
prakrit_examples: ṇa jhaḍiṁ jhaṁkhō vi ravī kuṇaï jhalaṁ cēa ittha marudēsē | muñca jhamālāi lulantajhaṁṭiō jhaṁḍuāi cuṇṭēsu || 44 || [ 53 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: jhaṁḍalijhaṁkharajharayā asaīsukkatarusuṇṇaārēsu | jhajjharijharuā khikkhirimasaēsuṁ jhaṁpaṇī pamhē || 54||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
jhaṁḍalī asatī |
		jhaṁkharō śuṣkataruḥ |
		jharaō suvarṇakāraḥ |
		jhajjharī sparśaparihārārthaṁ caṇḍālādīnāṁ hastayaṣṭiḥ |
		khikkhirīti |
		jharuō maśakaḥ |
		maśakavācaka śabdāścīryāmapi vartantē |
		yadāha |
		maśakākhyāścīryāmapyucyantē kāvyatattvajñaiḥ | iti |
		jhaṁraṇī pakṣma ||
		yathā |
prakrit_examples: jharuāulammi mīliajhaṁpaṇiaṁ jhajjharīkaravirūvaṁ | jhaṁkharatalammi jharayāhamaṁ hahā jhaṁḍalī ramaï || 45 || [ 54 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: vayaṇijjē jhakkiajhiṁkhiā jharaṁkō a tiṇapurisē | jhaṁṭiajhaṁṭaliāō pahariacaṅkamaṇaatthēsu || 55 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
jhakkiaṁ tathā jhiṁkhiaṁ vacanīyam |
		ujjhiṁkhiaṁ vacanīyamiti tu utpūrvēṇa jhiṁkhiaśabdēna siddham |
		jharaṁkō tr̥ṇamayaḥ puruṣaḥ |
		jharaṁtō iti kēcit |
		jhaṁṭiaṁ prahr̥tam |
		jhaṁṭaliā caṅkamaṇam ||
		yathā | atra |
		jhaḍaï śīyatē |
		jhaṁpaï bhramatītyādayō dhātvādēśēṣūktā iti nōktāḥ |
		[ 55 ]
prakrit_examples: ṇa kuṇanti jhaṁṭiaṁ ṇa ya jhaṁṭaliaṁ jhakkiāi agaṇantā | tuha kumaravāla riuṇō ajhiṁkhia raṇājirē jharaṁka vva || 46 ||

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: daḍḍhammi jhalusiaṁ taha jhaluṁkiaṁ jhāmiaṁ cēa | jhaṁkāriajhaṁkhariā avacayaṇē jhōliāi jhalajhaliā || 56 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
jhalusiaṁ jhaluṁkiaṁ jhāmiaṁ trayamapi dagdhārtham |
		jhaṁkāriaṁ tathā jhaṁkhariaṁ avacayanam |
		jhalajhaliā jhōlikā |
		jhōlikāśabdō yadi saṁskr̥tē na rūjhastadāyamapi dēśyaḥ ||
		yathā |
prakrit_examples: tāvajhaluṁkiadavajhalusiō tuha payāvajhāmiō a riū | phalajhaṁkāriadalajhaṁkhariāiṁ kuṇaï jhalajhaliahatthō || 47 || [ 56 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: jhāḍaṁ layagahaṇē jhāmarō jarī jhāulaṁ ca vaüṇiphalē | jhāruajhiriṁḍajhīrā cīrījarakūvalajjāsu || 57 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
jhāḍaṁ latāgahanam |
		jhāmarō pravayāḥ |
		jhāulaṁ karpāsaphalam |
		jhāruā cīrī | jhiriṁḍaṁ jīrṇakūpaḥ |
		jhīrā lajjā ||
		yathā |
prakrit_examples: jhāulacuṇṭaṇakajjē ajhīra kaha jhāmaraṁ ṇiōēsi | jhāruajjhāḍacchasē jhiriṁḍaē ēsa jaṁ paḍihī || 48 || [ 57 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: jhuṁkhō vajjavisēsē jhuttī chēammi jhuṭṭhamaliammi | jhullurijhuṁṭaṇajhuṁjhuṁmusayā gummappavahamaṇaduhēsu || 58||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
jhuṁkhō tuṇayākhyō vādyaviśēṣaḥ |
		jhuttī chēdaḥ |
		jhuṭṭhaṁ alīkam |
		jhullurī gulmaḥ |
		 jhuṁṭaṇaṁ pravāhaḥ |
		atra jhuṇaï jugupsatē |
		iti dhātvādēśēṣuktamiti nōktam | jhuṁjhuṁmusayaṁ manōduḥkham |
		jhumujhumusayaṁity anyē ||
		yathā |
prakrit_examples: tuha ṇatthi jhuṭṭhajhuttī jhuṁṭaṇataḍajhullurīsu ṇāō si | jhuṁjhuṁmusayavaīē maha kahiaṁ tattha jhuṁkhavāēhiṁ || 49 || [ 58 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: jhūraṁ kuḍilē jhērō jagaghaṇṭē jhēṁḍuō vi kaṇḍuaē | addhamahisīi jhōṭṭī jhōḍappō caṇayadhalaṇṇammi || 59 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
jhūraṁ kuṭilam |
		atra jhūraï smaratīti dhātvādēśēṣūktamiti nōktam |
		jhērō jaraghaṇṭaḥ |
		jhēṁḍuō kandukaḥ |
		jhōṭṭī ardhamahiṣī |
		jhōḍappō caṇakadhānyam |
		śruṣkacaṇakaśākamityanyē ||
		yathā |
prakrit_examples: jhōḍappachēttakaṇṭhē jhōṭṭīō kaṇṭhabaddhajhērāō | ua cāraï gōvavahū khēllantī jhēṁḍuēṇa jhūragaī || 50 || [ 59 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: vāhammi jhōḍiō jhōṁḍaliā rāsayasaricchakīlāē | ṭaṅkacchiṇṇājasataḍataḍatthadīhagahirēsu jhasasaddō || 60 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
jhōḍiō vyādhaḥ |
		jhōṁḍaliā rāsakasadr̥śī krīḍā ||
		yathā | jhasō ṭaṅkacchinnamayaśastaṭastaṭasthō dīrghagambhīraścēti pañcārthaḥ || [ 60 ]
prakrit_examples: jhōṁḍaliāē khēllantu tāva bālāu hariṇiāu vva | ārōviūṇa cāvaṁ paharēi ṇa kāmajhōḍiō jāva || 59 ||

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: gayaṇaṭṭhēsuṁ jharthaṁ ca jhaṁpiaṁ tuṭṭhaghaṭṭiēsuṁ ca | jhasuraṁ tambōlatthēsū jhaṁḍulī asaïkīlāsu || 61 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
jhatthaṁ gataṁ naṣṭaṁ ca |
		jhaṁpiaṁ truṭitaṁ ghaṭṭitaṁ ca |
		jhasuraṁ tāmbūlamarthaśca |
		jhaṁḍulī asatī krīḍā ca || [ 61 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: palhatthākuṭṭhēsuṁ jhasiaṁ cīhimasaēsu jhilliriā | aṅgakiḍaēsu jhīṇaṁ accatthē acchaē a jhūsariaṁ || 62 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
jhasiaṁ paryastamākruṣṭaṁ ca |
		atra jhaṁkhaï saṁtapyatē vilapati upālabhatē niḥśvasiti ca |
		jharaï smarati kṣarati cēti dhātvādēśēṣūktamiti nōktam |
		jhilliriā cīhītr̥ṇaṁ maśakaśca |
		jhīṇaṁ aṅgaṁ kīṭaśca |
		jhūsariaṁ atyarthaṁ svacchaṁ ca || [ 62 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: ṭamarō kēsacaē caṁkiaṁ pasariē vimōḍaṇē ṭasaraṁ | ṭasarōṭṭaṁ sēharaē ṭaṭṭaïā javaṇiāē a || 1 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
ṭamarō kēśacayaḥ |
		ṭaṁkiaṁ prasr̥tam |
		ṭasaraṁ vimōṭanam |
		ṭasarōṭṭaṁ śēkharaḥ | ṭaṭṭaïā tiraskariṇī ||
		yathā |
prakrit_examples: mā saṁṭhavēsu ṭamarē ṭasariacūaṅkurāṇa ṭasōraṭṭaṁ | ṭaṁkiamayaṅkajuṇhāi antarē dēsu māmi ṭaṭṭaïaṁ || 1 || [ 1 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: ṭaṁbaraō bhāriaē karālakaṇṇammi ṭapparaō | araṇiakusumē ṭakkāriā ya ṭārō ahamaturaē || 2 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
ṭaṁbaraō bhārikaḥ |
		gururityarthaḥ |
		ṭapparaō karālakarṇaḥ |
		ṭakkārī araṇikusumam |
		ṭārō adhamaturaṅgaḥ ||
		yathā |
prakrit_examples: ṭārammi caḍiamittō ṭaṁbaraō ṭapparō a vāmaṇaō | jhatti paḍiō hasijjaï ṭakkarīcuṇṭaṇīhi vaṇē || 2 || [ 2 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: ṭippī ṭikkaṁ tilaē ṭiṁbaru tumburu ca ṭiggharō thērē | ṭuṁṭō chiṇṇakarē ṭēṁṭā jūapayammi ṭēkkaraṁ ca thalē || 3 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
ṭippī tathā ṭikkaṁ tilakam |
		ṭikkaṁ śirasi stabakaity anyē |
		ṭiṁbaru tumburu | ṭiggharō sthaviraḥ |
		atra |
		ṭiviḍikkaï maṇḍayati |
		ṭiriṭillaï bhrāmyati |
		ētau dhātvādēśēṣūktāviti nōktau |
		ṭuṁṭō chitrakaraḥ |
		ṭēṁṭā dyūtasthānam |
		ṭēkkaraṁ sthalam ||
		yathā |
prakrit_examples: candaṇaṭikkiaparavahumiha ṭēkkarēē ramantiaṁ dadda‌uṁ | ṭiṁbarujōggaya ṭiggharaṭuṁṭayaṭēṁṭia karēsi kiṁ ṭippiṁ || 3 || [ 3 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: ṭōlō salahē ṭōlaṁbaṭōkkaṇā mahuamajjabhaṇḍēsu | asichisakhāyajaṅghākhaṇittabhittītaḍēsu ṭaṁkō vi || 4 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
ṭōlō śalabhaḥ |
		ṭōlō piśācaity anyē |
		yadāha || ṭōlaṁ piśācamāhuḥ sarvē śalabhaṁ tu rāhulakaḥ || ṭōlaṁbō madhūkaḥ |
		ṭōkkaṇaṁ madyaparimāṇabhāmḍam |
		kēcit cōkkaṇakhaṁḍaṁ madyamānabhāṇḍamāhuḥ ||
		yathā | ṭakō khaṅgaśrchinnaṁ khātaṁ jaṅghā khanitraṁ bhittistaṭaṁ cēti saptārthaḥ || [ 4 ]
prakrit_examples: ṭōlō vva mā paḍa tumaṁ ujjāṇē vāṇiṇīu jaṁ puraō | ṭōlaṁbavaṇē ṭōkkaṇahatthā mayaṇaggijālāō || 4 ||

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: ṭhallayaṭhaïaṭṭhaviā ṇiddhaṇaükkhittapaḍimāsu | ṭhāṇō māṇē ṭhāṇijjō gōraviammi siṇhaē ṭhikkaṁ || 5 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
ṭhallō nirdhanaḥ |
		ṭhaïō utkṣiptaḥ |
		ṭhaïō avakāśaity anyē |
		ṭhaviā pratimā | ṭhāṇō mānaḥ |
		ṭhāṇijjō gauravitaḥ |
		ayaṁ dantyādirapītyēkē |
		thāṇijjō |
		ṭhikkaṁ śiśnam ||
		yathā |
prakrit_examples: ṭhāṇē ṇa ṭhallayāṇaṁ ṭhāṇijjattaṁ ṇa yāvi ṭhaïāṇaṁ | ṇa ya ṭhikkaṁ saṇḍhāṇaṁ aṭhaviaüvalāṇa ṇa ya pūā || 5 || [ 5 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: gōraviuddhēsuṁ ṭhariaṁ ṭhiviaṁ uddhaṇiaḍahikkāsu | dantaggahiē ḍakkaṁ ḍavvō ḍāvō a vāmakarē || 6 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
ṭhariaṁ gauravitamūrdhvasthitaṁ ca |
		ṭhiviaṁ ūrdhvaṁ nikaṭaṁ hikkā cēti tryartham ūrdhvārthē ṭhiaaṁity anyē || ḍakkaṁ dantagr̥hītam |
		daṣṭārthaṁ tu daṣṭaśabdabhavam |
		ḍavbō tathā ḍāvō vāmakaraḥ | yathā |
prakrit_examples: ḍavvē pharayamaḍāvē khaggaṁ gahiūṇa tuha paī samarē | pahupaccakkhaṁ pasaraï amarisaḍakkāharō ēsō || 6 || [ 6 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: ḍaṁḍaṁ ḍiṁḍī sīviakappaḍakhaṇḍēsu taha ḍalō lōṭṭhē | ḍapphaṁ sēllē ḍallaṁ piḍiāi aliñjarē ḍaharī || 7 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
ḍaṁḍaṁ tathā ḍiṁḍī sūcyā saṁghaṭitāni vastrakhaṇḍāni |
		ḍaṁḍītyapyanyē |
		ḍalō lōṣṭaḥ |
		ḍapphaṁ sēllākhyamāyudham |
		ḍallaṁ piṭikā |
		ḍaharī aliñjaram ||
		yathā |
prakrit_examples: ḍaṁḍaparihāṇaḍiṁḍīpāuraṇā caïa ḍapphayā tujjha | riuṇō pallivaṇiharē ḍaharīḍallē vahanti ḍalakhalirā || 7 || [ 7 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: ḍaharō sisū siraharammi ḍaggalō davapahammi ḍaḍḍhāḍī | racchāi ḍaṁḍaō ḍaṁbhiō a kitavammi ḍaṁbarō ghammē || 8||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
ḍaharō śiśruḥ |
		ḍaggalō bhavanōpari bhūmitalam |
		ḍaḍḍhāḍī davamārgaḥ |
		ḍaṁḍaō rathyā |
		ḍaṁbhiō dyūtakāraḥ |
		ḍaṁbarō dharmaḥ ||
		yathā | atra |
		ḍallaï pibati |
		ḍaraï trasyati |
		ētau dhātvādēśēṣūktāviti nōktau || [ 8 ]
prakrit_examples: giṇhia ḍaharē uttaria ḍaggalā ḍaṁḍaēṇa tuha riuṇō | ḍaḍḍhāḍiḍaṁbarillē janti vaṇē ḍaṁbhia vva jaravasaṇā || 8 ||

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: ḍālī sāhāē ṇāyaṇē ḍāalaḍōlaḍōaṇayā | ḍialī thūṇā bhēgammi ḍiḍḍarō ḍiṁphiaṁ ca jalapaḍiē || 9 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
ḍālī śākhā |
		ḍāalaṁ ḍōlō ḍōaṇaṁ trayō ’pi lōcanārthāḥ |
		ḍialī sthūṇā | ḍiḍḍarō bhēkaḥ |
		ḍiṁphiaṁ jalapatitam ||
		yathā | atra |
		ḍiṁbhaï sraṁsatē |
		iti dhātvādēśēṣūktamiti nōktam || [ 9 ]
prakrit_examples: gayaḍōla ḍōaṇēhiṁ ṇa ṇiasi ḍāliṁ luṇēsi ḍialikaē | tā taraliaḍāalaō guttidrahē ḍiḍḍarō vva ḍiṁphēsu || 9 ||

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: ḍiṁḍilliaṁ ca khaliē vatthē ḍīraṁ ca kandalaē | ōiṇṇammi a ḍīṇaṁ tahēa ḍīṇōvayaṁ uvari || 10||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
ḍiṁḍilliaṁ khalikhacitaṁ vastram |
		ḍiṁḍilliaṁ skhalitē hastē iti kēcit | yadāha || ḍiṁphiaḍiṁḍilliayā patitē ca skhalitahastē ca || ḍīraṁ kandalaḥ |
		ḍīṇaṁ avatīrṇam |
		uḍḍīnavācakastu saṁskr̥tabhava ēva |
		ḍīṇōvayaṁ upari ||
		yathā |
prakrit_examples: viṇhū ḍīṇō si tumaṁ baliṇivaḍīṇōvayaṁ payaṁ dēsi | ḍīraṁ lihanti ḍiṁḍilliaṁ ca parihanti tēṇa tuha riuṇō || 10 || [ 10 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: ḍuṁbō savacē ḍuṁghō uañcaṇē ḍuṁgarō sēlē | ghaṇṭammi ḍuṁḍuō ḍōlā siviā dāruhatthaē ḍōō || 11||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
ḍuṁbō śvapacaḥ |
		ḍuṁghō udañcanaviśēṣō nālikēranayaḥ |
		ḍuṁgarō śailaḥ |
		ḍuṁḍuō jīrṇaghaṇṭaḥ |
		ḍōlā śibikā |
		andōlanavācakakastu dōlāśabdabhavaḥ |
		ḍōō dāruhastaḥ ||
		yathā |
prakrit_examples: ḍuṁgaraāṇiaḍōlāḍōē vikkintayassa tuha riuṇō | ḍuṁḍuasarassa ḍuṁbō tti chivia ḍuṁghayajalēṇa lēi jaṇō || 11 || [ 11 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: tambōlabhāyaṇē ḍōṁgilī tahā ḍōliō kasiṇāsārē | ḍāū phalihaṁsadugē gaṇavaïpaḍimāvisēsē a || 12 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
ḍōṁgilī tāmbūlabhājanaviśēṣaḥ |
		ḍōṁgilī tāmbūlinītyēkē |
		ḍiliō kr̥ṣṇasāraḥ ||
		yathā | ḍāū phalihaṁsakavr̥kṣō gaṇapatipratimāviśēṣaśca || [ 12 ]
prakrit_examples: daïammi sāvarāhē ēntē ḍōliavisālaṇayaṇāē | ḍōṁgiliṇihittavīḍayakaḍaḍḍhaṇamisaōḥ paraṁmuhīi ṭhiaṁ || 12 ||

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: ḍōṁgī a hatthabimbē tambōlaṭṭhāṇabhēē a | ḍhaḍḍhō bhērī ḍhaṁkō a vāyasē ḍhaṁḍhaṇī a kavikacchū || 13 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
ḍōṁgī sthāsakastāmbūlabhājanaviśēṣaśca | ḍhaḍḍhō bhērī |
		ḍhaṁkō vāyasaḥ |
		ḍhaṁḍhaṇī kapikacchūḥ ||
		yathā |
prakrit_examples: gōsuṭṭhiaḍhaṁkaülē dēulavāijjamāṇaḍhaḍḍhē a | uṭṭhaviō vēsāē ḍhaṁḍhaṇichittō vva tammaï bhuaṅgō || 13 || [ 13 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: maṁkuṇaē ḍhaṁkuṇaḍhēṁkuṇā tahā ḍhaṁkaṇī pihāṇīē | ḍhaṁsayamajasē vīṇāi ḍhaṁkharī ḍhakkayaṁ tilaē || 14 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
ḍhaṁkuṇō tathā ḍhēṁkuṇō matkuṇaḥ |
		ḍhaṁkaṇī pidhānikā |
		ḍhaṁsayaṁ ayaśaḥ |
		ḍhaṁkharī vīṇābhēdaḥ |
		ḍhakkayaṁ tilakam ||
		yathā | atra ḍhakkaï chādayati |
		ḍhaṁsaï vivartatē |
		iti dhātvādēśēṣūktāviti nōktau || [ 14 ]
prakrit_examples: ḍhaṁkharia ḍhaṁkuṇaharē imāi mā vacca ḍhakkayaṁ daṭṭhuṁ | ḍhēṁkuṇakhaddhō ḍhaṁkaṇihaṇiō ṇīharasi ḍhaṁsayaṁ lahia || 14||

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: cikkhallē ḍhaṁḍhariō ḍhaṁḍhasiō gāmajakkhammi | ṇiccammi ḍhikkayaṁ ḍhiṁḍhayaṁ jalagaē balāiā ḍhēṁkī || 15 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
ḍhaṁḍhariō kardamaḥ |
		ḍhaṁḍhasiō grāmayakṣaḥ |
		kēcit grāmavr̥kṣaity ācakṣatē | yadāhu || ḍhaṁḍhasiō ḍhaṁḍhariō grāmatarau kardamē cākhyē || atra |
		ḍhaṁḍhallaï bhramati | ḍhaṁḍhōlaï gavēṣayati |
		iti dhātvādēśēṣūktāviti nōktau |
		ḍhikkayaṁ nityam |
		ḍhiṁḍhayaṁ jalamadhyapatitam |
		ḍhēṁkī balākā ||
		yathā | atra |
		ḍhikkaï vr̥ṣabhō garjati |
		ḍhumaï ḍhusaï bhramati |
		iti dhātvādēśēṣūktā iti nōktāḥ || [ 15 ]
prakrit_examples: ḍhaṁḍhasiapūaṇaparā ḍhēṁkīō bhaṇaï ḍhikkayaṁ kā vi | ḍhiṭṭhō kaha vi maha paī ḍhiṁḍhō ḍhaṁḍhariakhuttō vā || 15 ||

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: adhaṇē ḍhēllō ḍhēṁḍhiaḍhōṁgharayā dhūviabbhamiraēsu | ḍhaṁḍhō paṅkaṇiratthē ḍhaṁḍharaḍhayarā pisāyaīsāsu || 16 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
ḍhēllō nirdhanaḥ |
		ḍhēṁḍhiō dhūṣitaḥ |
		ḍhōṁgharō bhramaṇaśīlaḥ ||
		yathā | ḍhaṁḍhō paṅkō nirarthakaścēti samāhāraḥ |
		ḍhaṁḍharō tathā ḍhayarō piśāca īrṣyāyāṁ cēti dvāvapi vdyarthau || [ 16 ]
prakrit_examples: sirikumaravāla riuṇō tuha davaḍajjhantapīludhūmahayā | ṇavaagaruḍhēṁḍhiāṇaṁ sumarantē ḍhēllaḍhōṁgharā raṇṇē || 16 ||

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: piḍharōṇhajalēsuṁ ḍhamaraṁ ḍhēṁkā harisakūvayatulāsu | ṇatthā ṇāsārajjū āuttē ṇavvaṇōvvā ya || 17 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
ḍhamaraṁ piṭharamuṣṇajalaṁ cēti dvyartham |
		atra ḍhuṁḍhullaï bhramati gavēṣayati cēti dhātvādēśēṣūkta iti nōktaḥ | ḍhēṁkā harṣaḥ kūpatulā cēti vdyarthā || ṇatthā nāsārajjuḥ |
		ṇavvō tathā ṇōvvō āyuktaḥ ||
		yathā |
prakrit_examples: bhakkhantēṇaṁ gāmaṁ ṇatthārahiōsahēṇa va samaggaṁ | ṇavva taē ṇōvvāṇaṁ asāṇa vi bhañjiō maggō || 17 || [ 17 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: ṇaddhō ārūḍhē ṇaṁdāṇaṁdīṇaṁdiṇīu gāīē | parivañciammi ṇāḍiō a ṇaccira ramaṇasīlammi || 18 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
ṇaddhō ārūḍhaḥ |
		ṇaṁdā ṇaṁdī ṇaṁdiṇī trayō ’py ētē gōvācakāḥ |
		atra ṇakkhā nakhāḥ |
		ṇavi vaiparītyē |
		ṇaï avadhāraṇē |
		ētē śabdānuśāsanē sādhitā iti nōktāḥ | ṇaḍiō vañcitaḥ |
		khēditaity anyē |
		ṇaccirō ramaṇaśīlaḥ ||
		yathā |
prakrit_examples: ambaraṇaddhē mēhē ṇaṁdāvālīṇa ṇaṁdiṇīgōṭṭhē | ṇa suṇēsi ṇaccirāṇaṁ jaï gīaṁ ṇaṁdiputta ṇaḍiō si || 18 || [ 18 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: maliṇammi ṇajjarō ṇaṁdaṇō a bhiccammi ṇajjharō vimalē | ṇalayamusīrē sīhē ṇaṁdikkhō ṇaṁdiaṁ ca sīharuē || 19 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
ṇajjarō malinaḥ |
		ṇaṁdaṇō bhr̥tyaḥ |
		ṇajjharō vimalaḥ |
		ṇalayaṁ uśīram | ṇaṁdikkhō siṁhaḥ |
		ṇaṁdiaṁ siṁharutam ||
		yathā |
prakrit_examples: ṇajjharajasa tuha riuṇō ṇaravaïṇaṁdikkha ṇaṁdiaṁ sōuṁ | ṇajjaravatthā ṇalayakarā māliaṇaṁdaṇā havia janti || 19 || [ 19 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: duhiammi ṇaddiō ṇaḍḍarī a bhēgammi mandirē ṇaliaṁ | ṇaharī churīi ṇaḍulī kacchavaē ṇahamuhō ghuē || 20 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
ṇaddiō duḥkhitaḥ |
		ṇaḍḍarī bhēkaḥ |
		ṇaliaṁ gr̥ham |
		ṇaharī kṣurikā |
		ṇaḍulī kacchapaḥ |
		dvitvē ṇaḍḍulīity api |
		ṇahamuhō ghūkaḥ ||
		yathā | atra |
		ṇavara kēvalē |
		ṇavari ānantaryē |
		ētāvavyayau |
		ṇavvaï ṇajjaï jñāyatē |
		ṇaḍaï gupyati |
		ētē dhātvādēśēṣūktā iti nōktāḥ || [ 20 ]
prakrit_examples: ṇahamuhaṇaliē rasē rusaṁ sōūṇa tuha riuvahūṇaṁ | ṇaharīhaya vva ṇaḍḍariṇaḍulīu vi ṇaddiā hunti || 20 ||

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: jattha palāsalayāē jaṇēhi païṇāma pucchiā juvaī | akahantī ṇihaṇijjaï ṇiamavisēsō ṇavat‍nayā sā || 21 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
yadāha || niyamaviśēṣaśca ṇavalayā jñēyā |
		ādāya palāśalatāṁ bhrāmyati lōkō ’khilō yasyām |
		pr̥ṣṭā patināma strī nihanyatē cāpyakathayantī ||
		yathā |
prakrit_examples: dōlāvilāsasamaē pucchantīhiṁ sahīhi païṇāmaṁ | laṭṭhīhi haṇijjantī vahuā ṇavalayavayaṁ bharaï || 21 || [ 21 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: ṇavaria sahasā ōāiē ṇamasiaṁ taḍammi ṇahavallī | ṇāvvāuttō bhōgī kaṇhē ṇakkhattaṇēmī a || 22 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
ṇavaria sahasā |
		ṇamasiaṁ upayācitakam |
		ṇavasiaṁity anyē |
		ṇahavallī vidyut |
		ṇavvāuttō īśvaraḥ |
		niyōgitutaity anyē |
		ṇakkhattaṇēmī viṣṇuḥ ||
		yathā |
prakrit_examples: ṇamasiasaēhi pāviasirīi ṇakkhattaṇōmisamamappaṁ | ṇavaria ṇavvāuttaya mā muṇa ṇahavallicañcalā ēsā || 22 || [ 22 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: jalabhavaphalabhēē ṇaïmāsayamucciṭṭhaē ṇavōddharaṇaṁ | ṇāō gavviṭṭhē ṇāullō gōmī bilammi ṇārōṭṭō || 23 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
ṇāimāsayaṁ jalōdbhavaḥ phalabhēdaḥ |
		ṇavōddharaṇaṁ ucchiṣṭam |
		ṇāō garviṣṭhaḥ | ṇāullō gōmān |
		ṇārōṭṭō bilam |
		kūsāraity anyē ||
		yathā |
prakrit_examples: ṇāulla ṇavōddharaṇēṇa tūsa mā visasu ṇāyaüḍḍaṇayaṁ | dulahaṇaïmāsayakaē sayā vi gōhā ṇa hōi ṇārōṭṭhē || 23 || [ 23 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: ṇālaṁbī jūḍē ṇāhidāmamullōamajjhadāmammi | ṇālaṁpiamakkandē jahaṇammi a ṇāhivicchēō || 24||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
ṇālaṁbī kuntalaḥ |
		ṇāhidāmaṁ ullōcamadhyadāma |
		ṇālaṁpiaṁ ākranditam | ṇāhivicchēō jaghanam |
		ṇāhīē vicchēō iti vākyamapi jaghanavācakam | yadāha || ṇāhīē vicchēō jaghanaṁ kaiścittu ṇāhivicchēō ||
		yathā |
prakrit_examples: puṇajammē kusumāiṁ gayāi ṇālaṁbiṇāhidāmēsu | ia ṇālaṁpantē tuha riūṇa pihuṇāhivicchēā || 24 || [ 24 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: ṇāmōkkasiaṁ kajjē ṇijjaṇuvaṇṇā ya suttammi | bhūē ṇiḍō haliddā ṇiggā ṇihasō a vammīē || 25 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
ṇāmōkkasiaṁ kāryam |
		ṇijjō tathā ṇuvaṇṇō suptaḥ |
		ṇiḍō piśācaḥ |
		ṇiggā haridrā |
		ṇihasō valmīkaḥ ||
		yathā |
prakrit_examples: ṇāmōkkasiaṁ tumaē kiṁ rē ṇiḍa ṇiggarāga ṇihasamuha | tīē ccia jaṁ ṇāmaṁ lavasi ṇuvaṇṇō aṇijjō a || 25 || [ 25 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: ṇihuṇaṁ vāvārē kāmiāi ṇihuā ya ṇijjharaṁ jusē | ṇivahō sāmiddhīē ṇiaḍī ḍambhē ṇihūamavi suraē || 26 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
ṇihuṇaṁ vyāpāraḥ |
		ṇihuā kābhitā |
		ṇijjharaṁ jīrṇam |
		ṇijjhūraṁity anyē | ṇivahō samr̥ddhiḥ |
		ṇiaḍī dambhaḥ |
		yadi nikr̥tiśabdasya pratyādau [ siddhahēma° 1, 206 ] pāṭha iṣyatē tadā na dēśyaḥ |
		ṇihūaṁ suratam ||
		yathā |
prakrit_examples: ṇihuāṇihūayāṇaṁ mā saṁbhara muñca ṇiaḍiṇihuṇāiṁ | jaṁ ṇijjharō si iṇhiṁ kuṇasu maṇaṁ puṇṇaṇivahammi || 26 || [ 26 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: tuṇhikkammi ṇiukkō ṇirulī mayarākiiggāhē | ṇihaṇaṁ kūlē ṇigaḍhō dhammē ṇisuaṁ ṇisāmiaṁ ca suē || 27 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
ṇiukkō tūṣṇīkaḥ |
		ṇirulī makarākr̥tigrāhaḥ |
		ṇihaṇaṁ kūlaṇ |
		ṇigaḍhō gharmaḥ |
		ṇisuaṁ tathā ṇisāmiaṁ śrutam ||
		yathā |
prakrit_examples: ṇisuē ṇirulīrāvē ṇisāmiē saüṇikalayalē a vahū | ṇaïṇihaṇāgayajāraṁ muṇia ṇiukkāhisaraï ṇigaḍhē vi || 27 || [ 27 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: ṇiurammi ṇialamavisēsiammi ṇiriaṁ ca ṇikkhuḍamakampē | ṇivvēḍhaṇivvaḍhā ṇaggē ṇijjūhō a ṇivvammi || 28 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
ṇialaṁ nūpuram |
		ṇiriaṁ aviśēṣitam |
		ṇikkhuḍaṁ akampam |
		ṇivvēḍhō tathā ṇivvaḍhō nagnaḥ |
		ṇijjūhō nīvram ||
		yathā |
prakrit_examples: ṇiriaṭṭhāṇāṭhāṇaya kiṁ ṇialē ṇiasi ṇikkhuḍō cōra | jaraṇijjūhammi gharē ṇivvēḍhō ṇivvaḍhēṇa pēlliaï || 28 || [ 28 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: aribhavaṇammi ṇiāraṁ ṇivvūḍhaṁ pacchimaṅgaṇaē | kaḍhiṇammi ṇikkaḍaṁ taha ṇipphēsō saddaṇiggamaṇē || 29||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
ṇiāraṁ ripugr̥ham |
		ṇivvūḍhaṁ gr̥hapaścimāṅganam |
		ṇikkaḍaṁ kaṭhinam |
		ṇipphēsō śabdanirgamaḥ ||
		yathā |
prakrit_examples: dhaṇukaḍḍhaṇaṇikkaḍabhua cālukka tuhaṁ ṇiāraṇivvūḍhē | ṇīsaṅkavilasirāṇaṁ sivāṇa ullasaï ṇipphēsō || 29 || [ 29 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: ṇaṭṭhammi ṇirādō ṇicchiē ṇiruttaṁ ṇaē ṇiriṁkō a | saṁtuṭṭhammi ṇisattō vi ṇimēlaṁ dantamaṁsammi || 30||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
ṇirādō naṣṭaḥ |
		ṇiruttaṁ niścitam |
		ṇiriṁkō nataḥ |
		ṇisattō saṁtuṣṭaḥ |
		ṇimēlaṁ dantamāṁsam |
		ṇimēlā iti dhanapālaḥ ||
		yathā |
prakrit_examples: tuha ghāyaṇimēlucchuḍḍadantayā riugayā ṇiriṁkamuhā | janti ṇirādā taha vi hu jaē ṇiruttaṁ tumaṁ si ṇa ṇisattō || 30 || [ 30 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: ṇillaṁkaṇilaṁkā paḍigahammi ṇijjōbhiṇōmiṇō rassī | aṁguṭṭhīi ṇiraṁgīṇīraṁgīu ahiammi ṇippaṭṭhō || 31 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
ṇillaṁkō tathā ṇilaṁkō patadrahaḥ |
		ṇijjōmī tathā ṇōmī raś‍miḥ |
		rajjurityarthaḥ |
		ṇiraṁgī tathā ṇīraṁgī śirō 'vaguṇṭhanam |
		ṇippaṭṭhō adhikaḥ ||
		yathā |
prakrit_examples: ṇijjōmikhaṁciōsaharahaōiṇṇē piammi lēi vahū | ṇippaṭṭhapēmmaviraïaṇiraṁgiā karayaṇillaṁkē || 31 ||
kiṁ māmi rōasi tumaṁ ṇīraṁgiṁ caïa ācama ṇilaṁkē | pēkkhasi ṇa cirā daïaṁ ṇōmībaddhaṁ purō baïllaṁ va || 32 || [ 31 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: ṇimmaṁsū taruṇē ṇibbhuggō bhaggammi ṇikkhayaṁ ṇihaē | suttōṭṭhiammi ṇivvittō ṇissaṁkō a ṇibbharaē || 32 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
ṇimmaṁsū taruṇaḥ |
		ṇibbhuggō bhagnaḥ |
		ṇikkhayaṁ nihatam |
		ṇivvittō sup‍tōtthitaḥ |
		ṇissaṁkō nirbharaḥ ||
		yathā |
prakrit_examples: ṇissaṁkakāmasaraṇikkhayā imā siviṇaē tumaṁ daṭṭhuṁ | ṇimmaṁsua ṇivvittā ṇibbhuggamaṇōrahā hōi || 33 || [ 32 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: ṇijjōō payarē parihiē ṇiatthaṁ calammi ṇikkajjō | ṇivvāṇaṁ duhakahaṇē thaḍḍhē ṇiṭṭhūhaṇivvūḍhā || 33 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
ṇijjōō prakaraḥ |
		puṣpāvakaraity anyē |
		ṇiatthaṁ parihitam |
		ṇikkajjō anavasthitaḥ |
		ṇivvāṇaṁ duḥkhakathanam |
		ṇiṭṭhūhō tathā ṇivvūḍhō stabdhaḥ ||
		yathā |
prakrit_examples: ṇikkajjē jaṁ maṇṇasi ṇiatthahāraṁ phuliṅgaṇijjōaṁ | ṇiṭṭhūhē ṇivvāṇaṁ kuṇasu aṇivvūḍhayāṇaṁ ta amha || 34 || [ 33 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: gayakusalōvakiīsuṁ ṇimmayaṇigghaṭṭhaṇijjāyā | sēdōciaüjjāṇā ṇivāyaṇivviṭṭhaṇibbhaggā || 34 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
ṇimmaō gataḥ |
		ṇigghaṭṭhō kuśalaḥ |
		ṇijjāō upakāraḥ |
		ṇivāō svēdaḥ |
		 ṇivviṭṭhaṁ ucitam |
		upabhuktārthaṁ tu nirviṣṭaśabdabhavam |
		ṇibbhaggaṁ udyānam ||
		yathā |
prakrit_examples: ṇibbhaggaṇimmayaṁ taṁ daṭṭhuṁ payaḍiāṇivāyasiḍhilaṅgī | tammaï tujjha kaē ṇivviṭṭhaṇijjāyaṇigghaṭṭhaय़ || 35 || [ 34 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: suttapasuttammi ṇisāyaṁ cāmuṇḍāi ṇimmaṁsā | ṇiddhammō ēgamuhammi ṇiṁdiṇiṇiāṇiā kutiṇaharaṇē || 35 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
ṇisāyaṁ suptaprasuptam |
		caṇḍālavācakastu ṇisāyaśabdō niṣādaśabdabhavaḥ |
		ṇimmaṁsā cāmuṇḍā |
		ṇiddhammō ēkamukhayāyī |
		ṇiṁdiṇī tathā ṇiāṇiā kutr̥ṇōddharaṇam ||
		yathā |
prakrit_examples: kēāraṇiṁdiṇikaē ṇiāṇiāmullajaṁpaṇamisēṇa | ṇimmaṁsadēulaṁ ṇiddhamma piā vaccaï ṇisāē || 36 || [ 35 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: ṇiṇṇālā ṇōlacchā ṇōlaïā cēa cañcubhmi | ṇiggiṇṇaṁ ṇillasiaṁ ca ṇiggaē pāḍiē ṇisuddhaṁ ca || 36 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
ṇiṇṇālā tathā ṇōlacchā tathā ṇōlaïā cañcuḥ |
		ṇiggiṇṇaṁ tathā ṇillasiaṁ nirgatam |
		ṇisuddhaṁ pātitam ||
		yathā |
prakrit_examples: ṇōlaïāi haṇantō ṇōlacchivarō visālaṇisālō | ṇiggiṇṇajiō hūō āsamaṇillasiarāvaṇaṇisuddhō || 37 || [ 36 ]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: ṇijjhāō ṇicchuṁḍō ṇirāhaṇigghōraṇippharisā | ṇiddhaṁdhasō a ṇivvērisō a adaē ṇimēṇamavi ṭhāṇē || 37 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
ṇijjhāyādayaḥ sapta śabdā nirdayavācakāḥ |
		ṇivvērisaśabdō ’tyarthē ’pi dr̥śyatē | ṇimēṇaṁ sthānam ||
		yathā |
prakrit_examples: ṇigghōrē ṇicchuṁḍō aṇirāhē kō vva ṇa hu aṇippharisō | ṇiddhaṁdhasē aṇivvērisō aṇijjhāya kattha vi ṇimēṇē || 38 || [37]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: avibhiṇṇagēhaē ṇiddhamaṇiddhayaṇiddhamāyā vi | ṇiaraṭṭhiē ṇiariaṁ ṇiaṁdhaṇaṇiaṁsaṇā vatthē || 38 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
ṇiddhamō tathā ṇiddhaō tathā ṇiddhamāō avibhinnagr̥haḥ |
		atra |
		ṇiaï paśya ti |
		ṇivvāi viśrāmyati |
		ṇimaï nyasyati |
		ētē dhātvādēśēṣūktā iti nōktāḥ | ṇiariaṁ nikarēṇa sthitam |
		ṇiaṁdhaṇaṁ tathā ṇiaṁsaṇaṁ vastram ||
		yathā |
prakrit_examples: ṇiariaguṇa suṇiaṁsaṇa ṇiaṁdhaṇaṁ kaḍḍha ṇiddhamō havia | ṇiddhaa vayammi ramimō kiṁ pēmmamaṇiddhamāyāṇa || 39 || [38]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: ṇiddhamaṇaṁ ōghasarē ṇiakkalaṁ vaṭṭulē cēa | ṇivvamiaṁ parihuttē pāṇiggahaṇāmmi ṇivvahaṇaṁ || 39 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
ṇiddhamaṇaṁ gr̥hajalapravāhaḥ |
		ṇiakkalaṁ vartulam |
		ṇivvamiaṁ paribhuktam | ṇivvahaṇaṁ vivāhaḥ ||
		yathā |
prakrit_examples: gandhavvē ṇivvahaṇē tuha ṇivvamiaṁ ṇiakkalathaṇīē | virahē sumarantīē bāhēhiṁ vahaï ṇiddhamaṇaṁ || 40 || [39]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: adaḍhammi a ṇikkhuriaṁ ṇirantarē cēa ṇittiraḍī | ōāraṇē ṇivacchaṇaṇēvacchaṇayā cuammi ṇissariaṁ || 40 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
ṇikkhuriaṁ adr̥ḍham |
		ṇittiraḍī nirantaram |
		ṇivacchaṇaṁ tathā ṇēvacchaṇaṁ avatāraṇam |
		ṇissariaṁ srastam ||
		yathā | atra |
		ṇiacchaï paśyati |
		ṇirappaï tiṣṭhati |
		ṇimmāṇaï ṇimmavaï nirmimītē |
		ṇijjharaï kṣīyatē |
		ṇihuvaï kāmayatē |
		ṇiāraï kāṇēkṣitaṁ karōti | ṇirigghaï nilīyatē |
		ṇivvaḍaï pr̥thak spaṣṭō vā bhavati |
		ṇiṭṭhuhaï niṣṭambhaṁ karōti | ṇivvōlaï manyunōṣṭhaṁ malinaṁ karōti |
		ṇilluṁchaï muñcati |
		ṇiuḍḍaï majjati | ṇicchallaï ṇijjhōḍaï ṇillūraï chinatti |
		ṇisuḍhaï bhārākrāntō namati |
		ṇiḍḍuaï kṣarati |
		ṇiṭṭuhaï vigalati |
		ṇimmahaï gacchati |
		ṇillasaï ullasati |
		ētē dhātvādēśēṣūktā iti nōktāḥ || [40]
prakrit_examples: ṇittiraḍivirahaṇikkhuriataṇū ṇissaria aṁsu pattapiē | ṇēvacchaṇagahakhaliā sayamēva ṇivacchaṇīhuā vahuā || 41 ||

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: ṇiṭṭhuhiaṇikkhasariaṇiruvakkayā thukkamusiaakaēsu | ṇittiraḍiaṁ ca tuṭṭē ṇīsārō maṇḍavē cēa || 41 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
ṇiṭṭhuhiaṁ thūtkr̥tam |
		niṣṭhyūtamityarthaḥ |
		ṇikkhasariō muṣitaḥ |
		apahr̥tasāra iti yāvat |
		ṇiruvakkayaṁ akr̥tam |
		ṇittiraḍiaṁ truṭitam |
		atra |
		ṇiruvāraï gr̥hṇāti |
		ṇiriṇajjaï pinaṣṭi |
		ityētau dhātvādēśēṣūktāviti nōktau |
		ṇīsārō maṇḍapaḥ ||
		yathā |
prakrit_examples: tuha ṇittiraḍiathāmā riuṇō ṇikkhasariā vasanti vaṇē | ṇiruvakkayaṇīsārē taṇhāi susantaṇiṭṭhuhiā || 42 || [41]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: ṇīsaṁpāyaṁ parisantajaṇavaē taha jhuṇimmi ṇīhariaṁ | ṇīsīmiō a ṇivvāsiammi bāṇammi ṇīlakaṁṭhī a || 42 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
ṇīsaṁpāyaṁ pariśrāntajanapadam |
		ṇīhariaṁ śabdaḥ |
		ṇīsīmiō nirvāsitaḥ | ṇīlakaṁṭhī bāṇavr̥kṣaḥ ||
		yathā |
prakrit_examples: vōliavahū ṇisamuhaṁ ṇīsaṁpāē aṇīhariakañcī | ahisaraï ṇīlakaṁṭhīvaṇammi ṇīsīmiassa tassa kaē || 43 || [42]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: ṇīsaṇiā ṇissēṇī ṇīāraṇamavi balighaḍīē | ṇūlā sāhāē paṭṭavāsiāē a ṇēḍālī || 43 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
ṇīsaṇiā niḥśrēṇī |
		kapratyayābhāvē ṇīsaṇītyapi |
		ṇīāraṇaṁ balighaṭī | atra |
		ṇīi ṇīṇaï ṇīlukkaï gacchati |
		ṇīraṁjaï bhanakti |
		ṇuvvaï prakāśayati | ētē dhātvādēśēṣūktā iti nōktāḥ |
		ṇīhammiaṁ nirgatamiti tu nirpūrvasya hammidhātōḥ siddham |
		ṇūlā śākhā |
		atra ṇūmaï chādayatīti dhātvādēśēṣūktamiti nōktam |
		ṇēḍālī paṭṭavāsitā |
		śirōbhūṣaṇabhēdaḥ ||
		yathā |
prakrit_examples: ṇēḍālisundara tumaṁ puttaya mā caḍasu uccataruṇūlaṁ | jaṁ ṇīsaṇipaḍiēsu vi ṇīāraṇavallahā ṇa hōi chalaṁ || 44 || [43]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: ṇēuḍḍō sabbhāvē kūvatulāē a ṇēlicchī | ravivaṇiasacivasaṇḍhā ṇēsaraṇēsatthiṇēlacchā || 44 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
ṇēuḍḍō sadbhāvaḥ |
		ṇēlicchī kūpatulā |
		ṇēsarō raviḥ |
		ṇēsatthī vaṇiksacivaḥ |
		ṇēlacchō ṣaṇḍhaḥ |
		vr̥ṣabhaity anyē ||
		yathā | atra ṇēḍḍaṁ nīḍamiti tu nīḍaśabdabhavamiti nōktam || [44]
prakrit_examples: ṇēsatthi aṇēlacchō taṁ ṇēuḍḍēṇa ṇēsaratthamaṇē | ṇēlicchiravaṁ sōuṁ vaccaï jaṁ jalamisēṇa tuha jāyā || 45 ||

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: bhaddavaōjjaladasamīūsavabhēammi ṇēḍḍariā | ucchuṇivīḍaṇakaṇḍē tahēa kuṇḍammi ṇaṁdaṁ ca || 45 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
ṇēḍḍariā bhādrapadōjjvaladaśamyāṁ kaścidutsavaviśēṣaḥ ||
		yathā | atra ṇōllaï kṣipatīti dhātvādēśēṣūktamiti nōktam | ṇaṁdaṁ ikṣunipīḍanakāṇḍaṁ kuṇḍākhyō bhāṇḍaviśēṣaścēti dvyartham |
		kēcittu |
		ikṣunipīḍanakāṇḍavācakāvēva ṇaṁdakuṁḍaśabdaudēśyāvityāhuḥ |
		yadāha |
		|| ikṣunipīḍanakāṇḍaṁ ṇaṁdaṁ kuṁḍaṁ ca gō ṇaṁdī || na tu kuṇḍākhyabhāṇḍavācī ṇaṁdaśabdō dēśyaḥ |
		asmābhistūbhayamapi dr̥ṣṭamityanēkārthēṣūpanibaddham || [45]
prakrit_examples: saṁkēamāgaē uvavaïmmi dūīi jhatti saṁlaviā | ahisaraï ṇāyaravahū ṇēḍḍariādaṁsaṇamisēṇa || 46 ||

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: ghāṇē mūkē ṇakkō ṇaṇṇō kūvē khalaggajēsuṁ ca | kaddamiē vaïvivarē paōaṇē ṇallayaṁ ṇimittē a || 46 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
ṇakkō ghrāṇaṁ mūkaśca |
		grāhē tu ṇakkaśabdō nakraśabdabhava ēva |
		ṇaṇṇō kūpō durjanō jyēṣṭhō bhrātā cēti tryarthaḥ |
		ṇallayaṁ kardamitaṁ vr̥tivivaraṁ prayōjanaṁ nimittaṁ cēti caturartham || [46]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: rayaduddiṇēsu ṇaḍḍalamaha ṇaddhaṁbavayamaghiṇaṇindāsu | sabbhāvē ’bhippāē ṇāuḍḍō cōrakañcaṇē ṇikkhō || 47 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
ṇaḍḍalaṁ rataṁ durdinaṁ ca |
		ṇaddhaṁbavayaṁ aghr̥ṇā nindā cēti dvyartham |
		ṇāuḍḍō sadbhāvō ’bhiprāyaśca |
		manōrathaity anyē |
		ṇikkhō cōraḥ kāñcanaṁ ca || [47]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: kaühachaümēsu ṇivvaṁ ṇiayaṁ rayasayaṇasāsayaghaḍēsu | suttōṭṭhiē ṇirāsē ubbhaḍaakivēsu a ṇividdhō || 48 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
ṇivvaṁ kakudaṁ vyājaśca |
		paṭalāntē tu ṇivvaśabdō nīvraśabdabhava ēva |
		ṇiayaṁ rataṁ śayanīyaṁ śāśvataṁ ghaṭaścēti caturartham |
		ṇividdhō suptōtthitō nirāśa udbhaṭō nr̥śaṁsaścēti caturarthaḥ || [48]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: sēagaṇēsu ṇihāō puṭṭhē uvvēḍhiē ṇirappō a | cōraṭṭhiapuṭṭhēsuṁ ṇirakkamujjuadaḍhēsu ṇippicchaṁ || 49 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
ṇihāō svēdaḥ samūhaśca |
		ṇirappō pr̥ṣṭhamudvēṣṭitaṁ ca |
		ṇirakkō cōraḥ sthitaḥ pr̥ṣṭhaṁ cēti tryarthaḥ |
		ṇippicchaṁ r̥ju dr̥ḍhaṁ ca || [49]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: payaḍōjjuriūsu ṇirāō ṇiṭṭaṁkaṁ ca ṭaṅkiē visamē | ṇihuaṁ ṇivvāvārē tuṇhikkē taha ya surayammi || 50 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
ṇirāō prakaṭa r̥jū ripuścēti tryarthaḥ |
		ṇiṭṭaṁkaṁ ṭaṅkicchinnaṁ viṣamaṁ ca |
		ṇihuaṁ nirvyāpāraṁ tūṣṇīkaṁ surataṁ cēti tryartham |
		[50]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: ṇivvaliaṁ jaladhōē pavigaṇiē vihaḍiē cēa | vāyasamūkēsu ṇiukkaṇō ṇihēlaṇamagārajaghaṇēsu || 51 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
ṇivvaliaṁ jaladhautaṁ pravigaṇitaṁ vighaṭitaṁ cēti tryartham |
		ṇivvalēi duḥkhaṁ muñcati niṣpadyatē kṣarati cēti dhātvādēśē siddham |
		ṇiukkaṇō vāyasō mūkaśca | ṇihēlaṇaṁ gr̥haṁ jaghanaṁ ca |
		atra |
		ṇivvaraï duḥkhaṁ kathayati chinatti ca |
		ṇihōḍaï nivārayati pātayati ca |
		ṇilukkaï tuḍati nilīyatē ca |
		ṇivahaï ṇiriṇāsaï gacchati pinaṣṭi naśyati ca |
		ṇīluṁchaï niṣpatati ācchōṭayati ca |
		ṇīravaï bubhukṣatē ākṣipati ca |
		ṇīharaï niḥsarati ākrandati ca |
		ṇumaï nyasyati chādayati cēti dhātvādēśēṣūktā iti nōktāḥ || [51]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: taṁbā gāī taṁṭaṁ puṭṭhaṁ suttōppalēsu taggataṇā | taṭṭī vaīi sōgammi tamō tavaṇī a bhakkhammi || 1 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
taṁbā gauḥ |
		taṁṭaṁ pr̥ṣṭham |
		taggaṁ sūtram |
		sūtramiti sāmānyābhidhānē ’pi sūtrakaṅkaṇamucyatē |
		yadāha |
		|| taggaṁ ca sūtrakaṅkaṇakam || taṇaṁ utpalam |
		taṭṭī  vr̥tiḥ |
		tamō śōkaḥ |
		tavaṇī bhakṣaṇayōgyam |
		kaṇādi ||
		yathā |
prakrit_examples: taṁṭavahaṇataṭṭivihīhi taṁbacāraṇaya taggavalaṇahi | taṇalōaṇā ṇa tavaṇiṁ kuṇanti virahē tamaṁ jaḍā janti || 1 || [1]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: tamaṇaṁ cullī taharī bahalasurā vāvaḍē tavaō | tasiaṁ sukkē sayaṇē tallaḍamōllammi taṇṇāyaṁ || 2 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
tamaṇaṁ culliḥ |
		taharī paṅkilā surā |
		tavaō vyāpr̥taḥ |
		tasiaṁ śuṣkam | tallaḍaṁ śayyā |
		taṇṇāyaṁ ārdram |
		yathā |
prakrit_examples: virahammi tujjha sūhava tasiē taṇṇāyakamalatallaḍaē | tamaṇaṁ va tappaï sahī taharītavaō ṇa jāṇasi tumaṁ tu || 2 || [2]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: tacchiṁḍaṁ ca karālē ṇayarārakkhē talārō a | tattillō tallicchō a tapparē taṇacaē taṇēsī a || 3 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
tacchiṁḍaṁ karālam |
		talārō nagarārakṣakaḥ |
		tattillō tathā tallicchō tatparaḥ |
