		taṇēsī tr̥ṇaprakaraḥ ||
		yathā |
prakrit_examples: dōsagavēsaṇatattilla talārabhayā taṇēsiantariā | ua taï tallicchā sā tamatacchiṁḍē paḍicchaï kuḍaṅgē || 3 || [3]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: tarasaṁ maṁsē taṁbēhitaṁbaṭakkāriāu sēhālī | icchāi takkaṇā taṁtaḍitōṁtaḍiā karambammi || 4 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
tarasaṁ māṁsam |
		taṁbēhī tathā taṁbaṭakkārī śēphālikā |
		takkaṇā icchā |
		taṁtaḍī tathā tōṁtaḍī karambaḥ ||
		yathā |
prakrit_examples: caya taṁbēhikuḍaṅgaṁ ṇa taṁbaṭakkārirattavasaṇō ’aṁ | ṇa hu tarasatakkaṇaṁ kaṅgutaṁtaḍī kalamatōṁtaḍī a harē || 4 || [4]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: gōhumakuṅkumiāē a taṁbirā taṁbarattī a | taravaṭṭō paümāḍammi taḍavaḍā āulitarummi || 5 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
taṁbirā tathā taṁbarattī gōdhūmēṣu kuṅkumacchāyā |
		taravaṭṭō prapunāṭaḥ |
		taḍavaḍā āulivr̥kṣaḥ ||
		yathā | atra |
		taliṇaṁ sūkṣmamiti talinaśabdabhavam |
		taraï śaknōti |
		tacchaï takṣṇōti |
		taḍaï taḍḍaï taḍḍavaï tanōti |
		ētē dhātvādēśēṣūktā iti nōktāḥ || [5]
prakrit_examples: sahi taṁbarattirammē chēttē suttammi taṁbiracchi piē | taravaṭṭataḍavaḍāulakuḍaṅgaē kīsa caliā si || 5 ||

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: sālimmi talapphalatālahalā khuhiē taḍamaḍō a | taṁtukkhōḍī a turī uḍuvē tariavvataṇavaraṁḍīō || 7 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
talapphalō tathā tālahalō śāliḥ |
		taḍamaḍō kṣubhitaḥ |
		taṁtukkhōḍī vāyakatantrōpakaraṇam |
		tariavvaṁ tathā taṇavaraṁḍī uḍupaḥ ||
		yathā |
prakrit_examples: kīsa talapphalagōvītaḍamaḍiō jāsi tālahalachēttaṁ | taṁtukkhōḍia vaccasu tariavvaṇiutta taṇavaraṁḍīē || 7 || [7]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: taddiasaṁ aṇudiasē tahalliā cēa gōvāḍē | taddiacayaṁ ca ṇaccē talaāgattī a kūvammi || 8 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
taddiasaṁ |
		adūraviprakarṣāt taddiasiaṁ |
		taddiahaṁity api |
		anudivasam | tahalliā gōvāṭaḥ |
		taddiacayaṁ nr̥tyam |
		talaāgattī kūpaḥ ||
		yathā |
prakrit_examples: taruṇatahalliarakkhaya bhumayātaddiacaēṇa taddiasaṁ | talaāgattiṁ vaccaï ṇisi vahuā pāṇiamisēṇa || 8 || [8]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: taḍaphaḍiaṁ paricaliammi kuravaē taṁbakusumō a | gāliaaṅguliēsuṁ talasāriataṇayamuddiāō a || 9 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
taḍaphaḍiaṁ paritaścalitam |
		taṁbakusumō kuravakaḥ |
		talasāriaṁ gālitam | anyē tu talasāriō nālika iti paṭhantastalasāriaṁ mugdhamācakṣatē |
		taṇayamuddiā aṅgulīyakam ||
		yathā | atra |
		talaaṁṭaï bhramati |
		iti dhātvādēśēṣūktamiti nōktam |
		[9]
prakrit_examples: aï talasāriapēmmaya tuha virahē tīi ittha taḍaphaḍiaṁ | taṁbakusumassa mūlē ōpaḍiā taṇayamuddiā kahaï || 9 || [9]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: tālā lājā rammammi tāmarō rōaṇammi tāḍiayaṁ | tārattarō muhuttē jalabhavaphullammi tāmarasaṁ || 10 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
tālā lājāḥ |
		tāmaraṁ ramyam |
		tāḍiayaṁ rōdanam |
		tārattarō muhūrtaḥ |
		tāmarasaṁ jalōdbhavapuṣpam |
		padmavācakastu tāmarasaśabdaḥ saṁskr̥tasama ēva ||
		yathā |
prakrit_examples: tāḍiayaparaṁ bālaṁ kulaḍā tālāhi bhōlavia jāi | tārattarēṇa tāmaratāmarasē sariatūhammi || 10 || [10]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: uṇhapavaṇē tiriḍḍī tiṁgicchī tiṁgiā ya kamalaraē | tiviḍī puḍiā guru tittuaṁ ca ṇhāṇōlliammi tittiriaṁ || 12 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
tiriḍḍī uṣṇavātaḥ |
		tiṁgicchī tathā tiṁgiā kamalarajaḥ |
		tiviḍī puṭikā | tiviḍā sūcīti kēcit |
		tittuaṁ guru |
		tittiriaṁ snānārdram ||
		yathā |
prakrit_examples: tiṁgicchisurahijasabharaṇiva kalusiatiṁgiē tiriḍḍammi | tittuaduhā tuha riū ṇaïtittiriā jimanti tiviḍīē || 12 || [12]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: timiricchatimicchāhā karañjapahiā timiṁgilō mīṇē | tiṇhīkayammi tikkhāliaṁ taha tirōvaī vayantariē || 13 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
timiricchō karañjadrumaḥ |
		timicchāhō pathikaḥ |
		timicchaō iti kaścit | timiṁgilō mīnaḥ |
		matsyaviśēṣavācakastu saṁskr̥tasamaḥ |
		tikkhāliaṁ tīkṣṇīkr̥tam |
		tirōvaī vr̥tyantaritaḥ ||
		yathā |
prakrit_examples: haṇiō timiṁgiladhaēṇa ēsa tikkhāliēṇa va sarēṇa | mucchaï timiricchatalē tirōvaïpiō timicchāhō || 13 || [13]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: tuṁgī rayaṇī tuṇhī a sūarē tucchamōsukkē | tulasī surasalayāē tuṁḍīraṁ mahurabimbammi || 14 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
tuṁgī rātriḥ |
		tuṇhī sūkaraḥ |
		tucchaṁ avaśuṣkam |
		atra tuṁdaṁ udaram |
		tuṁḍaṁ āsyam |
		tuṁbī alābūḥ |
		ētē saṁskr̥tasamatvānnōktāḥ |
		tulasī surasalatā | tuṁḍīraṁ madhurabimbam ||
		yathā |
prakrit_examples: tuṁḍīraüṭṭhi tumaē atucchatulasīhi acciā caṇḍī | tuṁgīvaïpuṇṇakalaṁ jamāituṇhībalaṁ varaṁ lahasi || 14 || [14]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: tuṇhikkō miuacalammi tulaggaṁ kāgatālīē | tucchayatucchaïā rañjiē jaraghaḍammi tuṁḍūō || 15 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
tuṇhīkō mr̥duniścalaḥ |
		tulaggaṁ kākatālīyam |
		tucchayaṁ tathā tucchaïaṁ rañjitam |
		tuṁḍūō jīrṇaghaṭaḥ ||
		yathā |
prakrit_examples: assiṁ tulaggadiṭṭhē tucchaïā mēlliūṇa tuṁḍūaṁ | kiṁ ahisarasi sahi tumaṁ ṇa tucchaō ēsa hōhi tuṇhikkā || 15 || [15]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: tuṇaō tūravisēsē tuṁtukkhuḍiō turājuttē | dārū tusēajaṁbhaṁ tūō taha ucchukammayarē || 16 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
tuṇaō jhuṁkhākhyastūryaviśēṣaḥ |
		atra tuvarō rasaviśēṣa iti saṁskr̥tasamatvānnōktaḥ |
		tuṁtukkhuḍiō tvarāyuktaḥ |
		tusēajaṁbhaṁ dāru |
		tūō ikṣukarmakaraḥ ||
		yathā | atra tūhō saridavatāra iti tīrthaśabdabhavatvānnōktaḥ || [16]
prakrit_examples: tūō vāyaï tuṇayaṁ ucchuṇivīḍaṇatusēajaṁbhaṭhiō | taṁ suṇia gōvavahuā tuṁtukkhuḍiā ahisarēi || 16 ||

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: purisammi tūhaṇō tōlaṇō a siṁbalitarummi tūliṇiā | tēṁḍuamavi tumburuē tōsaṁ davvammi tōmarī vallī || 17 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
tūhaṇō tathā tōlaṇō puruṣaḥ |
		tūliṇī śālmaliḥ |
		tōṁḍuaṁ tumburu |
		atra tēavaï pradīpyata iti dhātvādēśēṣūkta iti nōktaḥ |
		tōsaṁ dhanam |
		tōmarī vallī ||
		yathā |
prakrit_examples: tūhaṇa tūliṇitēṁḍuatōmarigahaṇē girimmi kiṁ bhamasi | muttūṇa tōlaṇavayaṁ ṇa hu tōsaṁ labbhaē kaha vi || 17 || [17]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: aṇimittatapparē tōkkaō tahā tōḍaṇō asahaṇammi | tōayatōmariā bappīhayasatthappamajjaēsuṁ ca || 18 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
tōkkaō animittatatparaḥ |
		tōḍaṇō asahanaḥ |
		tōaō cātakaḥ |
		tōmariō śastrapramārjakaḥ ||
		yathā |
prakrit_examples: vammahasaratōmariē māṇaṁsiṇimāṇatōḍaṇē kālē | tōaa majjha avatthākahaṇē daïasa tōkkaō hōhi || 18 || [18]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: taṁḍaṁ khalīṇalālayasirahīṇasarāhiēsuṁ ca | gāmaṇisējjāsu talaṁ tallaṁ pallalayabaruasējjāsu || 19 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
taṁḍaṁ kavikālālakaṁ śirōvihīnaṁ svarādhikaṁ cēti tryartham |
		talaṁ grāmēśaḥ śayyā ca |
		tallaṁ palvalaṁ barukākhyatr̥ṇaṁ śayyā cēti tryartham || [19]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: tapparaāēsēsuṁ tattī tamaṇī a bāhubhujjēsu | talimō kuṭṭimasējjāgharōddhabhūvāsabhavaṇabhaṭṭhēsu || 20 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
tattī tatparatā ādēśaśca |
		tamaṇī bhujō bhūrjaṁ ca |
		talimō kuṭṭimaṁ śayyā gr̥hōrdhvabhūmirvāsabhavanaṁ bhrāṣṭraścēti pañcārthaḥ || [20]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: kaṇṇāharaṇavisēsē varaṅgaē cēa talavattō | tālūrō phēṇakaviṭṭhēsu tiriḍiaṁ satimiraviciēsu || 21 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
talavattō karṇābharaṇaviśēṣō varāṅgaṁ ca |
		tālūrō phēnaḥ kapitthataruśca |
		tālūrō āvartaścēti kēcit |
		tiriḍiaṁ timirayutaṁ vicitaṁ ca || [21]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: kōuavivāhasarisavahaviasiṇiddhakutuvēsu tuppō vi | pīṇammi turīsaddō uvagaraṇē tūliāṇaṁ ca || 22 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
tuppō kautukaṁ vivāhaḥ sarṣapō mrakṣitaḥ snigdhaḥ kutupaścēti ṣaḍarthaḥ |
		turī pīnaṁ tūlikānāmupakaraṇaṁ cēti dvyarthā || [22]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: ṇāyavvā tuṁbillī mahupaḍalē ukkhalē cēa | tēḍḍō salahapisallā taüvaṭṭhiakaṇṇiāsu tōvaṭṭō || 23 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
tuṁbillī madhupaṭalamuḍhūkhalaṁ cēti dvyarthā |
		tēḍḍō śalabhaḥ piśācaśca |
		tōvaṭṭō trapupaṭṭikākhyaḥ karṇābharaṇabhēdaḥ kamalakarṇikā cēti dvyarthaḥ || [23]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: thagghō gādhē ṇilaē thahō tharō dahisarē tharū charuē | thaṁbaṁ visamē thakkō ’vasarammi pasummi thaṭṭithavā || 24 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
thagghō gādhaḥ |
		thahō nilayaḥ |
		tharō dadhisaraḥ |
		tharū tsaruḥ |
		thaṁbaṁ viṣamam | thakkō avasaraḥ |
		thaṭṭī tathā thavō paśuḥ ||
		yathā |
prakrit_examples: dahiaṁ tharēṇa khaggā tharūhi kūvā a thagghasalilēhiṁ | sōhanti thaṁbathakkā bhaḍēhi thaṭṭīthavēhi gāmathahā || 19 || [24]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: vitthiṇṇammi thasathasalathāmā thaviā pasēviāē a | thaṁḍillathamiathalayā maṇḍalavimhariamaṇḍavēsuṁ ca || 25 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
thasō thasalō thāmō ētē trayō ' pi vistīrṇārthāḥ |
		thavī prasēvikā |
		thaṁḍillaṁ maṇḍalam |
		thamiaṁ vismr̥tam |
		thalaō maṇḍapaḥ ||
		yathā |
prakrit_examples: thāmatthaṇathaṁḍillē thasakaḍi tuha thaviasuṇṇahiayāē | thalayāgaō vi daïō thamiō kiṁ thasaladōsō vva || 20 || [25]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: bhallāaē thaüḍḍaṁ vīsāmē thattiaṁ cēa | cañcūi thaggayā thavaïllō dīhōrujualaüvaviṭṭhō || 26 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
thaüḍḍaṁ bhallātakam |
		thattiaṁ viśrāmaḥ |
		thaggayā cañcuḥ |
		thavaïllō prasāritōrudvayōpaviṣṭaḥ ||
		yathā |
prakrit_examples: ṇiva tuha bhaēṇa ṇaṭṭhā bhuñjia suathaggaaddhakhaddhaphalā | riuṇō kuṇanti khiṇṇā thavaïllā thattiaṁ thaüḍḍatalē || 21 || [26]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: tharahariaṁ kampiaē ghaṇammi thārō thirē thimiaṁ | thiraṇāmō calacittē dariē thuṇṇō a vaṭṭiē thullō || 27 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
tharahariaṁ kampitam |
		thārō ghanaḥ |
		thāṇayaṁ ālavāla iti sthānakaśabdabhavaḥ | thimiaṁ sthiram |
		thiraṇāmō calacittaḥ |
		yaḥ kvacidapi dhr̥tiṁ na badhnāti |
		thuṇṇō dr̥ptaḥ |
		thullō parivartitaḥ ||
		yathā |
prakrit_examples: thuṇṇattaṇathullamuhō māṇiṇilōō piammi thiraṇāmō | thāratthaṇiaṁ sōuṁ tharahariataṇū havēi thimiamaṇō || 22 || [27]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: thulamō dūsē thukkiamuṇṇayaē thuḍḍahīramavi camarē | thurūṇullaṇayaṁ sējjā vāayabhaṇḍammi thūrī a || 28 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
thulamō paṭakuṭī |
		thukkiaṁ unnatam |
		ambūkr̥tē tu thukkiaṁ thūtkr̥taśabdabhavamēva |
		thuḍḍahīraṁ cāmaram |
		thuruṇullaṇayaṁ śayyā |
		thūrī tantuvāyōpakaraṇam ||
		yathā |
prakrit_examples: tuha thukkiaṁsariuṇō thuruṇullaṇathuḍḍahīrathulamāiṁ | ōmuttūṇa paṇaṭṭhā thūrikarā tantuvāyavēsēṇa || 23 || [28]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: thūṇō turaē kōlammi thūlaghōṇō a binduē thēvō | thērō kē thērāsaṇathēvariā paümajammatūrēsu || 29 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
thūṇō aśvaḥ |
		thūlaghōṇō sūkaraḥ |
		thēvō binduḥ |
		stōkavācakastu thēvaśabdaḥ stōkaśabdabhava ēva |
		thērō brahmā |
		thūṇō thēṇō cōra iti stēnaśabdabhavau |
		thērāsaṇaṁ padmam |
		thēvariaṁ janmani tūryam ||
		yathā |
prakrit_examples: ukkaṇṇia ravithūṇāi thūlaghōṇaṁ aṇajjhayaṇathēraṁ | thērāsaṇaṅkajiṇa tuha thēvariaṁ jaṇaï harisajalathēvē || 24 || [29]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: kamapihuvaṭṭē thōrō balammi thōhaṁ ca khōlaē thōlō | ṭhāṇōṇḍapihusu thāhō ṇiṇṇēhadayadariēsu thiṇṇō vi || 30 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
thōrō kramapr̥thuparivartulaḥ |
		sthūlārthastu sthūlaśabdabhava ēva |
		thōhaṁ balam | thōlō vastraikadēśaḥ ||
		yathā | tatra thakkaï tiṣṭhati phakkati cēti dhātvādēśēṣūktamiti nōktam |
		ṭhāṇaṁ sthānam | uṇḍaṁ gambhīrajalam |
		pr̥thu vistīrṇam |
		tatra trayē ’pi thāhaśabdaḥ |
		thāhō dīrghaity anyē |
		thiṇṇō niḥsnēhadayō dr̥ptaścēti dvyarthaḥ |
		thippaï vigalati tr̥pyati cēti dhātvādēśēṣūktamitīha nōktam |
		[30]
prakrit_examples: thōrabhuathambha iṇhiṁ tuha thōhēṇaṁ raṇē hayavaīō | suabhikkhaṇimittaṁ riusuddhantavahūu thōlamuḍḍanti || 35 ||

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: bhayarahiaṇibbharēsuṁ baddhasirakkē a thirasīsō | darakuviavayaṇasaṁkōaṇamōṇēsuṁ thuḍuṁkiaṁ cēa || 31 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
thirasīsō nirbhīkō nirbharō baddhaśirastrāṇaścēti tryarthaḥ |
		thuḍuṁkiaṁ darakupitavadanasaṁkōcanaṁ maunaṁ cēti dvyartham || [31]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: pāsāyasiharabappīhaēsu rapphē tahā thūhō | thēṇilliaṁ hariabhīēsu rajagamūlaēsu thōō vi || 32 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
thūhō prāsādaśikharaṁ cātakō valmīkaṁ cēti tryarthaḥ |
		thēṇilliaṁ hr̥taṁ bhītaṁ ca | thōō rajakō mūlakaśca || [32]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: daramaddhē dayamambū daṁtō kaḍaē davō a gaggaraē | dacchaṁ tikkhē suttakaṇayammi daṁḍī dasērō a || 33 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
daraṁ ardham |
		dayaṁ jalam |
		dayaṁ śōkaity anyē |
		daṁtō parvataikadēśaḥ |
		davō gadgadaḥ |
		parihāsavācakastu davō dravaśabdabhavaḥ |
		vanavahnivācī tu saṁskr̥tasamaḥ | dacchaṁ tīkṣṇam |
		daṁḍī tathā dasērō sūtrakanakam |
		daṁḍī ḍaṁḍīvatsūcīsaṁghaṭitavastrayugalamapītyanyē ||
		yathā |
prakrit_examples: dacchatavaṁ kēṇa kayaṁ daṁtē sahi daradayammi kō paḍiō | jō daṁḍimaṇḍiaürō sadasēraṁ davasaraṁ tumaṁ ramaï || 26 || [33]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: sōammi dasū daarī surāi damaō dariddammi | dattharadakkhajjā karasāḍayagiddhēsu daṁtiō sasaē || 34 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
dasū śōkaḥ |
		daarī surā |
		damaō daridraḥ |
		dattharō hastaśāṭakaḥ | dakkhajjō gr̥dhraḥ |
		daṁtiō śaśakaḥ ||
		yathā |
prakrit_examples: dakkhajjēṇa jhaḍappiadattharasaṁchaṇṇadaṁtiayamaṁsē | kuṇaï dasumāraḍantī daarīpāṇāulā damayavēsā || 27 || [34]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: davaradahiṭṭhā tantukaviṭṭhēsu daïadayāiā aviē | daḍavaḍadahiupphadayāvaṇā ya dhāḍiṇavaṇīadīṇēsu || 35 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
davarō tantuḥ |
		dahiṭṭhō kapitthaḥ |
		atra |
		dariō dr̥pta iti dr̥ptaśabdabhavaḥ | daṁsaï darśayatīti dhātvādēśēṣūkta iti nōktau |
		daïaṁ tathā dayāiaṁ rakṣitam |
		daḍavaḍō dhāṭī |
		dahiupphaṁ navanītam |
		dayāvaṇō dīnaḥ ||
		yathā |
prakrit_examples: daïa dayāvaṇaya tumaṁ davarāhataṇū dahiṭṭhavaṭṭathaṇī | dahiupphakōmalaṅgī virahadaḍavaḍā dayāiüṁ jōggā || 28 || [35]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: davahuttaṁ gimhamuhammi dahitthārō dahisarammi | dahabōllī thālīē daravalladaaccharā ya gāmēsē || 36 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
davahuttaṁ grīṣmamukham |
		dahitthārō dadhisaraḥ |
		dahittharōity anyē |
		dahabōllī sthālī |
		daravallō tathā daaccharō grāmasvāmī ||
		yathā |
prakrit_examples: sadahitthāradahiṇā ṇavadahabōllīi viraïakaramba | davahuttē alahantō daravalla daaccharō si kahaṁ || 29 || [36]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: ṇiviḍammi darummillaṁ daramattadaraṁdarā haḍhōllāsā | daravallahō a daïē daravallaṇihēlaṇaṁ ca suṇṇagharē || 37 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
darummillaṁ ghanam |
		daramattā balātkāraḥ |
		daraṁdarō ullāsaḥ |
		daravallahō dayitaḥ | daravallaṇihēlaṇaṁ śūnyagr̥ham ||
		yathā | atra |
		davvīarō sarpa iti darvīkaraśabdabhavaḥ |
		dakkhavaï darśayatīti dhātvādēśēṣūkta iti nōktau || [37]
prakrit_examples: daravallahāi tuha taï ṇa siṇēhadaraṁdarō darummillō | tā jaï daramattāē daravallaṇihēlaṇammi taṁ ramasi || 30 ||

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: dāō paḍihū kañcīi dāradōrā ya dāliaṁ ṇayaṇē | dāriadāraddhaṁtādādaliā vēsapēḍaaṅguliā || 38 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
dāō pratibhūḥ |
		dārō tathā dōrō kaṭisūtram |
		dāliaṁ cakṣuḥ |
		dāriā vēśyā |
		atra dāvaï darśayatīti dhātvādēśēṣūktamiti nōktam |
		dāraddhaṁtā pēṭā | dādaliā aṅguliḥ ||
		yathā |
prakrit_examples: caladāliadādaliāṇa raṇiradārāṇa dāriajaṇāṇa | dōraravō dāraddhaṁtāē jaṇaatthaghallaṇayadāō || 31 || [38]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: diahammi diō suṇṇārāṇatthēsuṁ diajjhadippaṁtā | divvāsā cāmuṇḍā jaḍē dialiō diāhamō bhāsē || 39 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
diō divasaḥ |
		diajjhō suvarṇakāraḥ |
		dippaṁtō anarthaḥ |
		divvāsā cāmuṇḍā | dialiō mūrkhaḥ |
		diāhamō bhāsapakṣī ||
		yathā |
prakrit_examples: purisadiāhama dialiadiajjha dikkhasi ṇa tīi dippaṁtaṁ | jaṁ divvāsābhavaṇē diantasamayammi ṇāgaō si tumaṁ || 32 || [39]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: saïbhōaṇē diasiaṁ puvvaṇhayabhōaṇē a diahutaṁ | bālē dilliṁdiliō a duddhagaṁdhiamuhō cēa || 40 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
diasiaṁ sadābhōjanam |
		diasiaṁ anudinamityanyē |
		diahuttaṁ pūrvāhṇabhōjanam |
		dilliṁdiliō tathā duddhagaṁdhiamuhō bālaḥ ||
		yathā |
prakrit_examples: maha duddhagaṁdhiamuhā dilliṁdiliassa tassa sēvāē | dūrē diasiavattā diahuttakaē vi tammanti || 33 || [40]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: diadhuttaō a kāgē kakkiṁḍē dīvaō cēa | saṅkhammi dīhajīhō dullaṁ vatthammi dutti sigghammi || 41 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
diadhuttō kākaḥ |
		atra divāittī cāṇḍāla iti divākīrtiśabdabhavatvānnōktaḥ | dīvaō kr̥kalāsaḥ |
		dīhajīhō śaṅkhaḥ |
		dullaṁ vastram |
		dutti śīghram ||
		yathā |
prakrit_examples: ō dīhajīhaüjjaladullō gāmaṇijuāṇaō dutti | diadhuttamukkamalakalusamatthaō dīvaō vva ummuhaï || 34 || [41]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: dutthaṁ dukkhaṁ jahaṇē dulī a kummammi duddhaō ṇivahē | māghaṇhāṇē dukkaramavi dubbōllō uvālambhē || 42 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
dutthaṁ tathā dukkhaṁ jaghanam |
		dulī kūrmaḥ |
		atra duhaṁ asukhamiti duḥkhaśabdabhavatvānnōktam |
		duddhaō samūhaḥ |
		dukkaraṁ māghē rātrau caturyāmasnānam |
		dubbōllō upālambhaḥ ||
		yathā |
prakrit_examples: dukkaravēvirataṇuē pihudutthē ṇiayadukkhabhārēṇa | jaï duliduddhayakhuddhā paḍasi tumaṁ tā ṇu kassa dubbōllō || 35 || [42]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: duddōlī a dumālī dullaggaṁ aghaḍamāṇammi | dūhavajaṇammi dutthōhadūsalā dūhalō cēa || 43 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
duddōlī vr̥kṣapaṅktiḥ |
		dullaggaṁ aghaṭamānam |
		dutthōhō dūsalō dūhalō trayō ’py ētē durbhagavācakāḥ |
		dūhabaśabdastu durbhagaśabdabhava iti nōpāttaḥ ||
		yathā |
prakrit_examples: dūsala adūhalāṇaṁ pēmmaṁ dutthōhaē sudullaggaṁ | kiṁ kaha vi kayā vi marutthalammi pallavaï duddōlī || 36 || [43]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: dummuhadumaṇīō kavichuhāsu dugghuṭṭadūṇayā hatthī | dujjāyaṁ vasaṇē dukkuhō asahaṇammi duddamō diarē || 44 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
dummuhō markaṭaḥ |
		dahimuhaśabdō ’pi dēśyaḥ kapivācī kaiściduktaḥ |
		dumaṇī sudhā |
		dugghuṭṭō tathā dūṇē hastī |
		dujjāyaṁ vyasanam |
		dukkuhō asahanaḥ |
		arōcakinyapi lakṣyēṣu dr̥śyatē |
		duddamō dēvaraḥ ||
		yathā | atra dumaï dhavalayatīti dhātvādēśēṣūktamiti nōktam || [44]
prakrit_examples: dugghuṭṭadūṇataṭṭhā dumaṇisiagharē tuha ppiā ṇaṭṭhā | tā dummuhabaladuddama visēsu mā dukkuhattadujjāyaṁ || 37 ||

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: duhaō khuṇṇē duṇṇikkaduṇṇikhittā ya duccariā | duṁdumiṇī rūvavaī galagajjiayammi duṁdumiaṁ || 45 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
duhaō cūrṇitaḥ |
		duṇṇikkō tathā duṇṇikhittō duścaritaḥ |
		duṇṇikhittō durdarśaity anyē |
		duṁdumiṇī rūpavatī |
		duṁdumiaṁ galagarjitam ||
		yathā |
prakrit_examples: duṇṇikka duṇṇikhittaṁ bhaja taṁ cia mayaṇabāṇaduhayaṅgō | sukulubbhavaduṁdumiṇiṁ daṭṭhuṁ kiṁ karasi duṁdumiaṁ || 38 || [45]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: dullasiā dāsīē duraṁdaraṁ dukkhaüttiṇṇē | duddhōlaṇī duhiadujjhāē timirē durālōō || 46 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
dullasiā dāsī |
		duraṁdaraṁ duḥkhōttīrṇam |
		duddhōlaṇī yā dugdhāpi duhyatē |
		durālōō timiram ||
		yathā |
prakrit_examples: rakkhasu duddhōlaṇiaṁ dullasiāputta ghaṇadurālōē | jīi pasāēṇa sayā dāliddaduraṁdarā amhē || 39 || [46]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: saṇḍhē duakkharō taha dumaṁtaō kēsabandhammi | dummaïṇīdutthuruhaṁḍāō taha kalahasīlāē || 47 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
duakkharō ṣaṇḍhaḥ |
		dumaṁtaō kēśabandhaḥ |
		dummaïṇī tathā dutthuruhaṁḍā kalahaśīlā strī |
		dutthuruhaṁḍō puruṣō ’pi |
		yathā || atra |
		dugucchaï duguṁcchaï jugupsatē |
		duhāvaï chinatti |
		ētē dhātvādēśēṣūktā iti nōktāḥ || [47]
prakrit_examples: dutthuruhaṁḍaduakkhara dummaïṇīē dumaṁtaē tīē | bandhasu kusumāmēlaṁ amhē ṇa hu tujjha jōggāō || 40 ||

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: sariāi duṁbavattī dukkukkaṇiā paḍiggahaē | lajjadumaṇammi dūhaṭṭhō dēhaṇidōhaṇīu paṅkammi || 48 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
duṁbavattī sarit |
		dukkukkaṇiā patadgrahaḥ |
		dūhaṭṭhō lajjādurmanāḥ |
		atra dūmaï paritāpayatīti dhātvādēśēṣūktamiti nōktam |
		dēhaṇī tathā dōhaṇī paṅkaḥ ||
		yathā | atra dēkkhaï paśyatīti dhātvādēśēṣūktamiti nōktam || [48]
prakrit_examples: mā lajja duṁbavattīdōhaṇikhuttā cirēṇa āvinti | dhōēmi dēhaṇiṁ tuha payāṇa dukkukkaṇīi dūhaṭṭha || 41 ||

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: pikkammi dēvaüpphaṁ pupphē dōggaṁ ca jualammi | kūvayasavaüsahēsuṁ dōddhiadōhūadōālā || 49 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
dēvaüpphaṁ pakvapuṣpam |
		dōggaṁ yugmam |
		dōddhiō carmakūpaḥ |
		dōhūō śavaḥ | dōālō vr̥ṣabhaḥ ||
		yathā |
prakrit_examples: dōhūamuhā dōālavāhaṇā galiabāhudōggabalā | jīanti dōddhiavahā tuha riuṇō mahuadēvaüpphēhiṁ || 42 || [49]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: dōvēlī sāyaṁbhōaṇammi taha dōṇaō a āuttē | juṇhāi dōsiṇī kaḍiaḍammi dōhāsalaṁ cēa || 50 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
dōvēlī sāyaṁbhōjanam |
		dōṇaō āyuktaḥ |
		hālikaity anyē |
		dōsiṇī jyōtsnā |
		dōhāsalaṁ kaṭītaṭam ||
		yathā |
prakrit_examples: tuha dōhāsaladaṁsaṇaparavvasō gāmadōṇaō bahiṇi | tā ēhi maha gharē dōvēlimisā dōsiṇī ṇa jā phuraï || 43 || [50]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: dōsāṇiaṁ ca vimalīkayammi dōṇakkiā sarahā | dōsākaraṇaṁ kōvē dōsaṇijaṁtō a candammi || 51 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
dōsāṇiaṁ nirmalīkr̥tam |
		dōṇakkā saraghā |
		dōsākaraṇaṁ kōpaḥ |
		dōsaṇijaṁtō candraḥ ||
		yathā |
prakrit_examples: dōsaṇijaṁtayadōsāṇiasīlāē imāi aharadalaṁ | dōṇakkāē daṭṭhaṁ dōsākaraṇaṁ karēsi kiṁ ittha || 44 || [51]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: daliaṁ ṇikūṇiacchē dārummi a aṅgulīē a | dīhaviralēsu daraviṁdaraṁ ca pasavaṇayaṇēsu dāmaṇiā || 52 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
daliaṁ nikūṇitākṣaṁ dāru aṅgulī cēti tryartham |
		daraviṁdaraṁ dīrghaṁ viralaṁ ca | dāmaṇī prasavō nayanaṁ ca || [52]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: uddēhivāhahariṇīsu dīviā duhakaḍīsu duggaṁ ca | jahaṇaṭṭhiammi vatthē jahaṇē vi a duṇṇiatthaṁ ca || 53 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
dīviā upadēhikā mr̥gākarṣaṇī vyādhamr̥gī cēti dvyarthā |
		duggaṁ duḥkhaṁ kaṭī ca | duṇṇiatthaṁ jaghanasthitavastraṁ jaghanaṁ ca || [53]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: duccaṁbālō kalahī duccariō pharusavayaṇō a | ṇēhaṭṭhāvaṇabhaṇḍē tumbīē taha ya duddhiṇiā || 54 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
duccaṁbālō kalahaniratō duścaritaḥ paruṣavacanaścēti tryarthaḥ |
		duddhiṇiā kapratyayābhāvē duddhiṇī snēhasthāpanabhāṇḍaṁ tumbī cēti dvyarthā || [54]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: duccaṁḍiō a dullaliammi tahā duvviaḍḍhammi | duppariallamasakkē duuṇammi tahā aṇabbhasiē || 55 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
duccaṁḍiō durlalitō durvidagdhaśca |
		duppariallaṁ aśakyaṁ dviguṇamanabhyastaṁ cēti tryartham || [55]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: dūṇāvēḍhamasakkē sarē a dōsō ’ddhukōvēsu | dōhaṇahārī pāṇiahārīē pārihāriṇīē a || 56 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
dūṇāvēḍhaṁ aśakyaṁ taḍāgaśca |
		dōsō ardhaṁ kōpaśca |
		dōhaṇahārī jalahāriṇī pārihāriṇī ca || [56]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: dharadhavvā tūlarayā bhamarē dhaṁgadhuagāyadhūmaṁgā | dhayadhaṁdhā ṇaralajjā dhavalō jaccōttamē gharē dhayaṇaṁ || 57 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
dharaṁ tūlam |
		dhavvō vēgaḥ |
		dhaṁgō dhuagāō dhūmaṁgō ētē trayō ’pi bhramarārthāḥ | dhaō puruṣaḥ |
		dhaṁdhā lajjā |
		dhavalō yō yasyāṁ jātāvuttamaḥ |
		dhayaṇaṁ gr̥ham ||
		yathā |
prakrit_examples: dhayaṇadharasayaṇadhaṁdhā dhayadhavalē caïa kattha caliā si | ṇisi dhaṁgakēsidhavvā parimalabhamiradhuagāyadhūmaṁgi || 45 || [57]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: dhaṇiadharaggā daḍhakappāsēsu pihummi dhasaladhuttā ya | dhaṇiā piāi dhaṇṇāusō kahijjantaāsīsē || 58 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
dhaṇiaṁ gāḍham |
		gharaggō kārpāsaḥ |
		dhasalō tathā dhuttō vistīrṇaḥ |
		dhaṇiā priyā |
		dhaṇṇāusō kathyamānāśīrvādaḥ |
		dhaṇṇāusō āśīrēvēti kēcit ||
		yathā |
prakrit_examples: dhaṇiadhasalathaṇakalasaṁ dhuttaṇiambaṁ dharaggasiahasiaṁ | dhaṇiaṁ lahia juāṇō maṇṇaï dhaṇṇāusattaṇaṁ sahalaṁ || 46 || [58]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: dhaṁsāḍiō vavagaē haṁsē dhavalasaüṇō lahuṁ dhāraṁ | dhārājimuhē dhāḍī a ṇirasiē dhāḍiō a ārāmē || 59 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
dhaṁsāḍiō vyapagataḥ |
		muktārthaṁstu mucidhātvādēśasiddhaḥ |
		dhavalasaüṇō haṁsaḥ | dhāraṁ laghu |
		dhārā raṇamukham |
		dhāḍī nirastam |
		dhāḍiō ārāmaḥ |
		atra dhāḍai niḥsaratīti dhātvādēśēṣūktamiti nōktam ||
		yathā |
prakrit_examples: dhārāi dhāḍiaṅgā adhāraṇivadhavalasaüṇa tuha riuṇō | dhaṁsāḍiasayaladuhā ramanti suradhāḍiē suravahūhiṁ || 47 || [59]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: phalabhēē dhāṇūriamindāṇī dhuṁdhumārā ya | dhukkuddhuadhukkuddhugiā ullasiē gajē dhūṇō || 60 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
dhāṇūriaṁ phalabhēdaḥ |
		dhuṁdhumārā indrāṇī |
		dhukkuddhuaṁ tathā dhukkuddhugiaṁ ullasitam |
		dhūṇō gajaḥ |
		atra dhūā duhitēti duhitr̥śabdabhavatvānnōktam ||
		yathā |
prakrit_examples: dhūṇagaya dhuṁdhumārāpaïsamavikkama tuhāriṇārīō | dhukkuddhuadhāṇūriamaḍanti dhukkuddhugiamayā aḍaviṁ || 48 || [60]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: ṇīhārē dhūmaridhūmiāu dhūmasihadhūmamahisīō | dhūlīvaṭṭō turaē dhūmaddāraṁ gavakkhammi || 61 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
dhūmarī dhūmiā dhūmasihā dhūmamahisī ētē catvārō nīhārārthāḥ |
		dhūlīvaṭṭō aśvaḥ |
		dhūriavaṭṭōity anyē |
		dhūmaddāraṁ gavākṣaḥ ||
		yathā |
prakrit_examples: dhūmamahisīi dhūmariajalē kō caḍaï dhūmiākālē | dhūmasihāō bhīō dhūlīvaṭṭē a dhūmadārē a || 49 || [61]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: dhūriaaṁ dīhē dhūmaddhayamahisīu bahulāsu | bhajjāpajjattīsuṁ baddhayaṇīsaṅkaē a dhaṇī || 62 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
dhūriaṁ dīrgham |
		dhūmaddhayamahisīō kr̥ttikāḥ ||
		yathā | dhaṇī bhāryā paryāptirbaddhō ’pi niḥśaṅkaścēti tryarthō dhaṇīśabdaḥ |
prakrit_examples: dhūmaddhayamahisīsuṁ gaē diṇēsē adhūriāō vi | piavirahavihuriāṇaṁ rayaṇīō jugasamā hunti || 50 || [62]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: caüra ṅgulahatthavaṇē caṇḍiṇarabalimmi dhammaō taha ya | dhārāvāsō ghaṇabhēgēsuṁ dhūmaddhaō sarē mahisē || 63 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
dhammaō caturaṅgulō hastavraṇaścaṇḍīpuruṣōpahāraśca ||
		yadāha | dhārāvāsō mēghō bhēkaśca |
		dhūmaddhaō taṭākō mahiṣaśca || nakārādayastu dēśyāmasaṁbhavina ēvēti na nibaddhāḥ |
		yacca vādāviti sūtritamasmābhistatsaṁskr̥tabhavaprākr̥taśabdāpēkṣayā na dēśyapēkṣayēti sarvamavadātam || [63]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: paḍḍī paḍhamapasūā | pacchī piḍiā palaṁ pasēammi | gāmaṭṭhāṇē paddaṁ dhavalē paḍḍamahirōhiṇī pajjā || 1 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
paḍḍī prathamaprasūtā |
		pacchī piṭikā |
		palaṁ svēdaḥ |
		paddaṁ grāmasthānam |
		paḍḍaṁ dhavalam |
		pajjā adhirōhiṇī |
		adhikāravācakastu pajjāśabdaḥ prabandhabhēdavācakaparyāyaśabdabhava ēva |
		mārgavācakastu padyāśabdabhavaḥ ||
		yathā |
prakrit_examples: paḍḍīpayapaḍḍajasō paddavaī ēsa juvaïpalajaṇaṇō | guṇapacchī jassaṁsē bhujapajjāē caḍēi jayalacchī || 1 || [1]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: pattipasāiapattapasāiasaddā pulindasirapaṇṇē | pattapisālasamittha ya paṁtī vēṇī guhāi paḍḍaṁsō || 2 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
pattī tathā pasāiā tathā pattapasāiā tathā pattapisālasaṁity ētē catvāraḥ śabdāḥ pulindaśirasi yatparṇapuṭaṁ tadvācakāḥ |
		paṁtī vēṇī |
		kēśaracanā |
		paḍḍaṁsō giriguhā || yathā |
prakrit_examples: paḍḍaṁsē pattikarō pattapasāiasirō riū tujjha | pattapisālasahatthaṁ sapasāiapaṁtiaṁ ramaï savariṁ || 2 || [2]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: palasū sēvā paṇiā karōḍiā paṇhaō a thaṇadhārā | paḍivēsiē paēsō pamhārō pamharō a avamaccū || 3 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
palasū sēvā |
		paṇiā karōṭikā |
		paṇhaō stanadhārā |
		paēsō prātivēśmikaḥ | pamhārō tathā pamharō apamr̥tyuḥ ||
		yathā |
prakrit_examples: jaha paṇhaō tahēhī pamharabhīē suō apamhārō | kijjaü ajja paēsiṇi surapalasū caïa paṇiakammāiṁ || 3 || [3]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: kappāsammi a palahī paviā khagapāṇapattammi | paüḍhapaūḍhā gēhammi migavisēsammi pasaō a || 4 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
palahī karpāsaḥ |
		paviā pakṣiṇaṁ pānabhājanam |
		paüḍhaṁ tathā paṁūḍhaṁ gr̥ham | paüḍhō gr̥hasya paścimapradēśa iti kēcit |
		pasaō mr̥gaviśēṣaḥ ||
		yathā |
prakrit_examples: kattha ya guṇamaṇipaüḍhaṁ lāyaṇṇaṇihī kalāpaūḍhaṁ sā | pasayasamapalahidasaṇō paviāpāṇō a kattha tumaṁ || 4 || [4]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: paraḍā sappavisēsē paḍalaṁ ṇivvē ravimmi paccūhō | pahaṇaṁ kulē diṇē paüō pahaṇī saṁmuhāgayaṇirōhē || 5 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
paraḍā sarpaviśēṣaḥ |
		paḍalaṁ nīvram |
		paccūhō raviḥ |
		pahaṇaṁ kulam | paüō dinam |
		pahaṇī saṁmukhāgatanirōdhaḥ ||
		yathā |
prakrit_examples: taï pahaṇiariuvahuā paraḍāulajuṇṇapaḍalaüḍaēsu | paüammi lianti sayā ḍariā cālukkapahaṇapaccūha || 5 || [5]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: payalā ṇiddā payayaṁ aṇisaṁ paḍavā paḍakuḍīē | pahiaṁ mahiē pasiaṁ pūgaphalē paḍḍasaṁ susaṁjamiē || 6 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
payalā nidrā |
		payayaṁ aniśam |
		paḍavā paṭakuṭī |
		pahiaṁ mathitam |
		pasiaṁ pūgaphalam |
		paḍḍasaṁ susaṁyamitam ||
		yathā |
prakrit_examples: paḍavantarē dhaṇivahū payalaṁ muttūṇa paḍḍasiaṇīviṁ | dahipahiaṁ virayantī payayaṁ pasiēṇa kāgamuḍḍavaï || 6 || [6]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: paṇiaṁ payaḍē parihō rōsē paṇaō a paṅkammi | payalō ṇīḍē vipulē païṇṇapēḍhālapējjālā || 7 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
paṇiaṁ prakaṭam |
		vikrētavyē tu saṁskr̥tamavamēva |
		parihō rōṣaḥ |
		paṇaō paṅkaḥ | payalō nīḍam |
		païṇṇō pēḍhālō pējjālō ētē trayō ’pi vipulārthāḥ |
		pēḍhālaṁ vartulamiti drōṇaḥ ||
		yathā |
prakrit_examples: pēḍhālakhandha pējjālavaccha cālukka taï paṇiaparihē | riuṇō païṇṇapaṇaē vasanti payalāulē samuddataḍē || 7 || [7]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: cōraṇivahē paḍīrō pattavahōlēsu paṁkhuḍiparakkā | cōrammi palāō pattharapaḍḍalapaḍḍuā caraṇaghāē || 8 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
paḍīrō cōrasamūhaḥ |
		lipibhraṣṭāstu bōraṇivahē paḍīraṁ iti taruvargē paṭhanti | paṁkhuḍī patram |
		parakkaṁ alpaṁ srōtaḥ |
		palāō cōraḥ |
		pattharā paḍḍalā paḍḍuā trayō ’py amī caraṇaghātavācakāḥ ||
		yathā |
prakrit_examples: ēsa parakkapaḍīrō pattharakusalēṇa paḍḍuaṁ dintō | paṁkhuḍia vva vikiṇṇō palāyarakkhēṇa paḍḍalāhiṁ pi || 8 || [8]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: dariammi pahaṭṭhō bālammi paḍōō payāmamaṇupuvvē | kusumē pasūamōlijalaṇabhēēsuṁ paḍālipapphāḍā || 9 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
pahaṭṭhō dr̥ptaḥ |
		paḍōō bālaḥ |
		payāmaṁ anupūrvam |
		pasūaṁ kusumam |
		paḍālī paṅktiḥ |
		papphāḍō agnibhēdaḥ ||
		yathā |
prakrit_examples: jiṇaï pasūasarō vi hu bhuvaṇapaḍāliṁ payāmathōrōru | ēsa pahaṭṭhō mayaṇō apaḍō apayāvapapphāḍō || 9 ||

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: patthiapasaṁḍipabbhōā sigghasuvaṇṇabhōēsu | paddharamujjū saïdiṭṭhē pahadaṁ pakkharā turayakavacē || 10 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
patthiō śīghraḥ |
		pasaṁḍi kanakam |
		pabbhōō bhōgaḥ |
		paddharaṁ r̥ju |
		pahadaṁ sadādr̥ṣṭam |
		pakkharā turagasaṁnāhaḥ ||
		yathā |
prakrit_examples: pakkhariapatthiahaō pasaṁḍigōrō raṇē jayasirīē | pabbhōakaē pahadō si paddharaṁ kumaravāla tumaṁ || 10 ||

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: surakhāyammi pahammaṁ patthīṇaṁ thūlavatthammi | pavviddhaṁ pēriaē ghaṇē pavaddhō a pajjaṇaṁ pāṇē || 11 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
pahammaṁ surakhātam |
		patthīṇaṁ sthūlavastram |
		sāmānyēna patthīṇaṁ sthūlamityēkē | pavviddhaṁ prēritam |
		pavaddhō ghanaḥ |
		lōhakuṭṭanōpakaraṇamityarthaḥ |
		pajjaṇaṁ pānam |
		yathā |
prakrit_examples: ēsō pavaddhahatthō patthīṇī taha ya tēṇa pavviddhā | hayakāmiṇi kiṁ vaccasi pahammajalapajjaṇamisēṇa || 11 || [11]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: paḍiaparēā vihaḍiapisallaēsuṁ ca paṁpuaṁ dīhē | pappīō bappīhē paccūḍhō parialī a thālammi || 12 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
paḍiaṁ vighaṭitam |
		parēō piśācaḥ |
		paṁpuaṁ dīrgham |
		pappīō cātakaḥ | paccūḍhō tathā parialī sthālam |
		bhōjanabhāṇḍamiti yāvat ||
		yathā |
prakrit_examples: apaḍiapaṁpuapimmaṁ jīi samaṁ bhuttamēkkapaccūḍhē | taṁ kiṁ parēa ṇēcchasi parialipaḍiaṁ jalaṁ va pappīō || 12 || [12]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: paccutthaṁ paḍivaviē paddhārō chiṇṇaṇaṅgūlē | pamhalapasarēhā kēsarē pavasiammi pariutthō || 13 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
paccutthaṁ pratyuptam |
		paddhārō chinnalāṅgūlaḥ |
		pamhalō tathā pasarēhō kiñjalkaḥ | pariutthō prōṣitaḥ ||
		yathā |
prakrit_examples: pariuttha calasu kālē kēaïpasarēhaṇīmapamhaliē | paccutthaduhā marihī tuha daïā camaria vva paddhārā || 13 || [13]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: jīvāi paḍaṁcapaḍaṁsuā ya bhallī palāsipāsālā | pattalapaḍuvaïā pattisamiddhaṁ cēa tikkhammi || 14 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
paḍaṁcā tathā paḍaṁsuā jyā |
		pratiśrutivācakastu paḍaṁsuāśabdaḥ pratiśrutśabdabhava ēva |
		palāsī tathā pāsālā bhallī |
		pattalaṁ paḍuvaïaṁ pattisamiddhaṁ ētē trayō ’pi tīkṣṇārthāḥ |
		pattalaṁ kr̥śamityanyē |
		pattalaṁ patrabahulamiti tu patralaśabdabhavam ||
		yathā | atra |
		pavittō darbhaḥ |
		payarō śaraḥ |
		iti pavitrapradaraśabdabhavau |
		pallatthō pallaṭṭō paryasta iti paryastaśabdabhavau |
		tathā paṭṭaï pibati |
		paṁgaï gr̥hṇāti |
		paraï bhramati | iti dhātvādēśēṣūktā iti nōktāḥ || [14]
prakrit_examples: mahumāsē bhamarōlī vammahavīrassa dhaṇupaḍaṁca cca | sahayāramañjarī uṇa pattisamiddhā palāsi cca || 14 ||
taṭṭhā raṇāu riuṇō paḍaṁsuapphālaṇē vi cālukka | pattalakōvō paḍuvaïpāsālāhiṁ karēsi kiṁ tumayaṁ || 15 ||

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: paccēḍaṁ paccavaraṁ musalē paggējjapahayarā ṇiarē | palahiapurōhaḍā visamē pariaṭṭō a rajagammi || 15 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
paccēḍaṁ tathā paccavaraṁ musalam |
		paggējjō tathā pahayarō nikaraḥ |
		palahiaṁ tathā purōhaḍaṁ viṣamam |
		yadāha || palahiaṁ viṣamamasamaṁ ca purōhaḍaṁ gaditam || iti | atra caturakṣarapakārādiśabdaprastāvē ukārasahitapakārādipurōhaḍaśabdapāṭhō ’rthānurōdhāt |
		anyē tu palahiaṁ purōhaḍaṁity anyōnyaparyāyatayā āvr̥tamahīvāstuvācakāvityāhuḥ |
		yadāha || āvariamahīvatthū purōhaḍō palahiō taha ya || purōhaḍaṁ pacchōkaḍamiti tu sātavāhanaḥ |
		pariaṭṭō rajakaḥ ||
		yathā |
prakrit_examples: pariaṭṭa silāpahayarapurōhaḍāō jalaṁ ṇaītūhā | savilambaṁ āṇijjaï sundara mā kuppasu imāi || 16 ||
tuha gayavisāṇapaccēḍakhaṇḍiā palahiā vi riuvappā | hayabhaḍapaggējjā hunti paccavarapāṇitulla cālukka || 17 || [15]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: paḍisārapāḍisārā paḍuāi paḍicchaō samaē | palihassaṁ palihāō a uddhadārummi payavaī sēṇā || 16 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
paḍisārō tathā pāḍisārō paṭutā |
		paḍisārō paṭurityanyē |
		paḍicchaō samayaḥ | palihassaṁ tathā palihāō ūrdhvadāru |
		payavaī sēnā ||
		yathā |
prakrit_examples: palihāyatthamiāē apāḍisārāi kaha vi tuha virahē | tīi ṇisā vōlīṇā kaha gōsapaḍicchaē hōhī || 18 ||
tuha kumaravāla payavaïdaṁsaṇamittēṇa thammia vva raṇē | riuṇō gayapaḍisārā jāyā palihassasaṁṭhāṇā || 19 || [16]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: ēraṇḍadumē paṁcaṁgulī a ghaggharagalammi paḍisāō | paṁphulliaṁ gaviṭṭhammi paḍiarō cullimūlammi || 17 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
paṁcaṁgulī ēraṇḍavr̥kṣaḥ |
		paḍisāō ghargharakaṇṭhaḥ |
		paṁphulliaṁ gavēṣitam |
		paḍiarō cullīmūlam ||
		yathā |
prakrit_examples: paḍisāillē paṁcaṁgulīsu kiṁ kañcuaṁ gavēsēsi | paḍiarakammayari taē vi kīsa paṁphulliō ṇalēsu imō || 20 || [17]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: paḍisuttī paḍisūrō paḍisaṁtaṁ cēa paḍikūlē | pāyavaḍaṇē parēvayapāḍavaṇā pūalammi pahaēllō || 18 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
paḍisuttī paḍisūrō paḍisaṁtaṁ ētē trayō ’pi pratikūlārthāḥ |
		paḍisaṁtaṁ astamitamiti tu sātavāhanaḥ |
		parēvayaṁ tathā pāḍavaṇaṁ pādapatanam |
		pahaēllō pūpaḥ ||
		yathā |
prakrit_examples: paḍisuttī paḍisūrē parēvayaparammi jō apaḍisaṁtō | pāḍavaṇaṁ pahaēllā ya tassa dijjantu gāmajakkhassa || 21 || [21]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: indasuē païhaṁtō lakkhārattammi pallaviaṁ | paḍihatthī vuḍḍhīē paḍihatthapaḍikkayā paḍikidīē || 19 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
païhaṁtō jayantaḥ |
		pallaviaṁ lākṣāraktam |
		pallaviaṁ pallavākāramiti tu pallava ivācaratīti kvibantasiddhatvānnōktam |
		paḍihatthī vr̥ddhiḥ |
		paḍihatthō tathā paḍikvaō pratikriyā |
		paḍihatthō vacanamiti tu sātavāhanaḥ ||
		yathā |
prakrit_examples: tumaï paḍikkayakusalē païhaṁtasaricchapattapaḍihatthi | pallaviullaṇivasaṇā ṇamanti paḍihatthaakkhamā riuṇō || 22 || [19]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: paṁḍaviaṁ pāṁḍaviaṁ jalaüllē pallavammi patthariō | pakkhaḍiaṁ papphuriē jaḍē palihaō paḍitthirō sarisē || 20 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
paṁḍaviaṁ tathā pāṁḍaviaṁ jalārdram |
		patthariō pallavaḥ |
		pakkhaḍiaṁ prasphuritam |
		palihaō mūrkhaḥ |
		paḍitthirō sadr̥śaḥ ||
		yathā |
prakrit_examples: patthariasattharē vi hu paṁḍaviē aṁsupāṁḍaviasihiṇā | sā tappaï tuha palihaya pakkhaḍiē sihipaḍitthirē virahē || 23 || [20]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: paḍivēsō vikkhēvē pacattaraṁ cāḍu parihaṇaṁ vasaṇē | parihaṭṭī āyaḍḍhī paḍihārīē paḍicchiā cēa || 21 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
paḍivēsō vikṣēpaḥ |
		pacattaraṁ cāṭu |
		parihaṇaṁ paridhānam |
		parihaṭṭī ākr̥ṣṭiḥ | paḍicchiā pratīhārī |
		paḍicchiā ciraprasūtā mahiṣītyanyē ||
		yathā |
prakrit_examples: kiṁ parihaṇaṁ jalōllasi sayaṇē kiṁ karasi kamalapaḍivēsaṁ | kuṇasu pacattaraṇiuṇē paḍicchiē hiayasallaparihaṭṭiṁ || 24 || [21]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: papphiḍiaṁ paḍiphaliē paḍōharaṁ pacchimaṅgaṇaē | paḍuvattī paḍisārī javaṇīi pasēvō bambhē || 22 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
papphiḍiaṁ pratiphalitam |
		paḍōharaṁ gr̥hapaścimāṅgaṇam |
		paḍuvattī tathā paḍisārī javanikā |
		pasēvaō brahmā ||
		yathā |
prakrit_examples: bāhapaḍisāriduuṇaṁ paḍōharē candimāi paḍuvattiṁ | kuṇaï maṇōpapphiḍiē taï muṇaï diṇaṁ pasēvaadiṇaṁ sā || 25 || [22]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: parivāhō duvviṇayammi paṭṭhisaṁgaṁ ca kaühammi | ruddammi paṁḍaraṁgō pakkaggāhō a mayarammi || 23 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
parivāhō durvinayaḥ |
		paṭṭisaṁgaṁ kakudam |
		paṁḍaraṁgō rudraḥ |
		pakkaggāhō makaraḥ || yathā |
prakrit_examples: taï paṁḍaraṁgavisapaṭṭhisaṁgasamakhandha kumaravāla ṇiva | sāsiajaē jaï paraṁ pakkaggāhaddhayassa parivāhō || 26 || [23]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: pariliapaḍichaṁdā līṇamuhā pacchēṇayaṁ ca pāhējjaṁ | samuhāgamaṇē paccuddhārō paccōvaṇī cēa || 24 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
pariliō līnaḥ |
		pariarō līnaity anyē |
		paḍichaṁdō mukham |
		pacchēṇayaṁ pāhējjaṁ |
		pāthēyamityarthaḥ |
		dvāvapi dēśyāvanyōnyaparyāyatayā nibaddhau |
		paccuddhārō tathā paccōvaṇī saṁmukhāgamanam |
		kriyāśabdāvētau |
		tēna saṁmukhāgatē paccuddhariō paccōvaṇiōity ādyapi bhavati ||
		yathā |
prakrit_examples: lōaṇacaōrapacchēṇaantapaḍichaṁdacandimā kuṇasu | hiapariliā vi paccuddhāraṁ paccōvaṇīparē daïē || 27 || [24]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: paccuhiaṁ paṇhaviē paḍaccarō sālasarisammi | parihāyaparicchūḍhā jhīṇōkkhittā paḍikkharō kūrē || 25 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
paccuhiaṁ prasnutam |
		paccuaṁ prasnutamityanyē |
		paḍaccarō śyālaprāyō vidūṣakādiḥ | parihāō kṣīṇaḥ |
		paricchūḍhō utkṣiptaḥ |
		paḍikkharō krūraḥ ||
		yathā |
prakrit_examples: kiṁ taṁ chuhaparihāō parichūḍhakarō paḍaccara raḍēsi | apaḍikkharapaccuhiāi gaddahīē thaṇaṁdhaō hōhi || 28 || [25]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: khēttasaē parivāsō payaṭṭiō taha pavaṭṭiaē | pajjattammi pahōiamaha khēttē pallavāyapōrayayā || 26 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
parivāsō kṣētraśayaḥ |
		payaṭṭiō pravartitaḥ |
		pahōiaṁ paryāptam |
		prabhutvamityanyē |
		pallavāyaṁ tathā pōrayaṁ kṣētram |
		vallavāyaṁ iti dantyōṣṭhyādirapyayam iti gōpālaḥ ||
		yathā |
prakrit_examples: parivāsa sālipōrayagōvīdaṁsaṇapayaṭṭiamaṇō jaṁ | ṇa ṇiēsi divā vi migē pahōiaṁ pallavāyarakkhāē || 29 || [26]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: pañcāhiapaṇṇāsāē paṁcāvaṇṇapaṇavaṇṇā | papphōḍiaṁ ca pakkhōḍiammi surayammi parabhāō || 27 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
paṁcāvaṇṇā tathā paṇavaṇṇā pañcādhikapañcāśat |
		papphōḍiaṁ pakkhōḍiaṁ nirjhāṭitamityarthaḥ |
		parabhāō suratam ||
		yathā |
prakrit_examples: raïpapphōḍia parabhāyaluddha vēsāi dēsu dīṇārē | pañca vi paṇavaṇṇasamē paṁcāvaṇṇaṁ pi mā khu pañcasamaṁ || 30 || [27]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: paḍialipaviraïā turiē puṇṇammi paḍihatthapōṇiayā | paḍikhaṁdhaṁ paḍikhaṁdhī jalavahaṇē matthayammi pavaraṁgaṁ || 28 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
paḍialī tathā paviraïō tvaritaḥ |
		paḍihatthō tathā pōṇiō pūrṇaḥ |
		paḍikhaṁdhaṁ paḍikhaṁdhī jalavahanam |
		jalamuhyatē ’nēnēti jalavahanam |
		dr̥tyādi |
		anyē jalavāhamāhuḥ |
		pavaraṁgaṁ śiraḥ |
		uttamāṅgavat śirōvācakatvēna nāyaṁ kavīnāṁ rūḍha iti dēśyēṣu nibaddhaḥ ||
		yathā |
prakrit_examples: aṇapaḍiali paviraïaṁ apōṇiē kuṇa jalēṇa paḍihatthē | paḍikhaṁdhē paḍikhaṁdhīṇiutta kiṁ kaṇḍuēsi pavaraṁgaṁ || 31 || [28]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: ṇagarammi païṭṭhāṇaṁ rukkhē pasuhattaparasuhattā ya | pāṇiaṇiggamaṇammi a parihālō parihalāviō cēa || 29 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
païṭṭhāṇaṁ nagaram |
		pasuhattō tathā parasuhattō vr̥kṣaḥ |
		parihālō tathā parihalāviō jalanirgamaḥ ||
		yathā | atra paṁguraṇaṁ prāvaraṇamiti prāvaraṇaśabdabhavatvānnōktam |
		tathā |
		pajjaraï kathayati |
		pavvāyaï mlāyati |
		palhatthaï virēcayati |
		palāvaï nāśayati |
		paṇāmaï arpayati |
		payaraï pamhuhaï smarati |
		payallaï prasarati |
		pahallaï ghūrṇatē |
		paṇṇāḍaï mr̥dgāti |
		paḍḍuhaï kṣubhyati |
		paccāraï upālabhatē |
		paccaḍḍaï pacchaṁdaï padaaï gacchati | pallaṭṭaï palhatthaï paryasyati |
		paülaï pacati |
		pajjharaï paccaḍaï kṣarati |
		ityētē dhātvādēśēṣūktā iti nōktāḥ || [29]
prakrit_examples: mahikappaparasuhattaya gurubhuapasuhatta tuha païṭṭhāṇē | gharaparihalāviā karimadaparihālēhi hunti apphuṇṇā || 32 ||

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: paṇaattiaṁ payaḍiē itthīpaṇaē paṇāmaṇiā | parivāriō a ghaḍiē pulōaṇē pasavaḍakkaṁ ca || 30 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
paṇaattiaṁ prakaṭitam |
		paṇāmaṇiā strīṣu praṇayaḥ |
		parivāriō ghaṭitaḥ | pasavaḍakkaṁ vilōkanam ||
		yathā |
prakrit_examples: tīē raïsavvassaṁ paṇaattiapasavaḍakkalīlāē | kaha lahasi ṇiddurakkhara aṇaparivāriapaṇāmaṇiō || 33 || [30]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: pavvaïsēllaṁ vālamayakaṇḍaē taruṇiāi paḍujuvaī | cirasuamahisī parihāriṇī a paḍiajjhaō uvajjhāē || 31 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
pavvaïsēlaṁ vālamayakaṇḍakam |
		paḍujuvaī taruṇī |
		parihāriṇī ciraprasūtā mahiṣī |
		paḍiajjhaō upādhyāyaḥ ||
		yathā |
prakrit_examples: paḍiajjhaya tuha sīsō parihāriṇiduddhapāṇadullaliō | paḍujuvaīṇa ṇimittaṁ pavvaïsēllāi gumphēi || 34 || [31]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: paḍiēlliō kayatthē bhaggē paḍiraṁjiaṁ cēa | pajjuṇasaramucchusarisatiṇammi paḍiaṁtaō a kammayarē || 32 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
paḍiēlliō kr̥tārthaḥ |
		paḍiraṁjiaṁ bhagnam |
		pajjuṇasaraṁ ikṣusadr̥śaṁ tr̥ṇam | paḍiaṁtaō karmakaraḥ ||
		yathā |
prakrit_examples: paḍiraṁjiapaḍimāē kiṁ rē paḍiēlliāi hōi phalaṁ | paḍiaṁtaya kiṁ diṭṭhō pīḍiapajjuṇasarāu ucchurasō || 35 || [32]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: paḍisāriaṁ sumariē parillavāsō a amuṇiagaïmmi | vammīayammi paḍilaggalaṁ vasantammi paümalaō || 33 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
paḍisāriaṁ smr̥tam |
		parillavāsō ajñātagatiḥ |
		paḍilaggalaṁ valmīkam | paümalaō vasantaḥ ||
		yathā |
prakrit_examples: hiṇḍasi parillavāsō paümalaē suhaya kattha jaṁ tīē | paḍilaggalaṁ va araī paḍisāriatagguṇāi vaḍḍhēi || 36 || [33]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: pavahāiaṁ payaṭṭē paḍipiṁḍiamavi pavuḍḍhammi | paccabalōkkō pāḍaccarō a āsattacittammi || 34 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
pavahāiaṁ pravr̥ttam |
		paḍipiṁḍiaṁ pravr̥ddham |
		paccabalōkkō tathā pāḍaccarō āsaktacittaḥ |
		cōravācī tu pāṭaccaraśabdabhavaḥ ||
		yathā |
prakrit_examples: pāḍaccarā taē sā paccabalōkkō tumaṁ suhaya tīē | aṇṇōṇṇaṁ pavahāiarasāṇa paḍipiṁḍiō ccia siṇēhō || 37 || [34]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: paṁthucchuhaṇī jā sāsurāu āṇijjaē vahū paḍhamaṁ | paccucchuhaṇī paḍhamasurā gujjhaharē palōṭṭajīhō a || 35 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
paṁthucchuhaṇī śvaśurakulātprathamamānītā vadhūḥ |
		paccucchuhaṇī navasurā |
		palōṭṭajīhō rahasyabhēdī ||
		yathā | atra paḍiammiaṁ maṇḍitamiti pratikarmitaśabdabhavamiti nōktam |
		parivāḍaï ghaṭayati parivālaï vēṣṭayati |
		parihaṭṭaï mr̥dnā/?/ti |
		pariallaï parialaï gacchati | pariaṁti śliṣyati |
		parisāmaï śāmyati |
		iti dhātvādēśēṣūktā iti nōktāḥ || [35] payalāyabhattō mayūraḥ |
		pariaṭṭaliaṁ paricchinnam |
		pattharabhalliaṁ kōlāhalakaraṇam |
		paḍiṇiaṁsaṇaṁ rātrau paridhēyavastram ||
		yathā |
prakrit_examples: ṇa hu mahupaccucchuhaṇī pijjaï tā kaha palōṭṭajīhāhaṁ | ia kulapaṁthucchuhaṇī sāsuagaïpucchirāṇa kuppēi || 38 ||
payalāyabhattasaṇhaya tīi paḍiṇiaṁsaṇaṁ ihāṇēsi | pattharabhalliamacchaü pariaṭṭaliō si cittēṇa || 39 || [36]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: parihāraïttiā riumaīi cūlāi pāsipicchīō | pārī dōhaṇabhaṇḍē pāō cakkē disāi pālī a || 37 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
parihāraïttiā r̥tumatī |
		pāsī tathā picchī cūḍā |
		pārī dōhanabhāṇḍam | pāō rathacakram |
		pālī dik ||
		yathā |
prakrit_examples: pārīhatthō pāantariō pālīu kiṁ ṇiasi gōva | calapāsia tuha picchiṁ luṇēmi parihāraïttiaṁ mahasi || 40 || [37]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: pāvō sappē savacē pāṇō pāṇāaō a puṇaī a | ṇayaṇammi pāyalaṁ pāuaṁ himē pārayaṁ surābhaṇḍē || 38 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
pāvō sarpaḥ |
		pāṇō pāṇāaō puṇaīity ētē trayaḥ śvapacārthāḥ |
		pāyalaṁ cakṣuḥ | pāuaṁ himam |
		pārayaṁ surābhāṇḍam ||
		yathā |
prakrit_examples: pārayahatthō pāṇō pāṇāayavāḍayammi puṇaïjuō | pāuapāvayabhīō rattīē rattapāyalō gāi || 41 || [38]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: pāḍuṁkī vaṇisiviāi pāiaṁ tuṇḍavitthārē | pāṇaddhī racchāē pāḍuccī turayamaṇḍaṇaē || 39 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
pāḍuṁkī vraṇiśibikā |
		pāiaṁ vadanavistāraḥ |
		pāṇaddhī rathyā |
		pāḍuccī turagamaṇḍanam ||
		yathā |
prakrit_examples: tuha virahē pāḍuṁkījōggā sā pāiaṁ ṇa pāvēi | malhasi pāṇaddhīsuṁ tumaṁ tu pāḍucciahaēhiṁ || 42 || [39]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: pāyaḍamaṅgaṇaē taha pāmaddā pāyadhaṇṇamalaṇammi | hatthajualappahārē pāṇālī pāhuṇaṁ ca vikkējjē || 40 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
pāyaḍaṁ aṅganam |
		pāmaddā pādābhyāṁ dhānyamardanam |
		pāṇālī hastadvayaprahāraḥ | pāhuṇaṁ vikrēyam ||
		yathā |
prakrit_examples: khalapāyaḍapāmaddaṁ mōttuṁ pāhuṇaraïtthimālavirō | pāṇālīi haṇijjaï haliō piṭṭhāgayāi jāyāē || 43 || [40]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: pāraṁkaṁ suramāṇayabhaṇḍē maggīkayammi pāukkaṁ | pāuggō sabbhē pāsaṇiō pāsāṇiō a sakkhimmi || 41 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
pāraṁkaṁ surāmānabhāṇḍam |
		pāukkaṁ mārgīkr̥tam |
		pāuggō sabhyaḥ |
		pāsaṇiō tathā pāsāṇiō sākṣī ||
		yathā | atra pāmarō kuṭumbīti saṁskr̥tasamaḥ |
		pāhuḍaṁ prābhr̥tamiti prābhr̥taśabdabhavam | tathā pāḍikkaṁ pāḍiēkkaṁ pratyēkamiti śabdabhavau |
		pāraï śaknōti |
		pāsaï paśyati | ētau dhātvādēśēṣūktāviti nōktau || [41]
prakrit_examples: pāsaṇiā khu pamāṇaṁ bhajjaï pāsāṇiēhi divvaṁ pi | pāraṁkayasaṅkhabhamē ia pāuggēhi pāukkaṁ || 44 ||

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: pāuggiō a sahiē khalīṇajuttāi pāḍisirā | pāḍuhuō paḍihūē mālāē pārihacchī a || 42 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
pāuggiō sabhikaḥ |
		dyūtakārayitā |
		anyē tu sahiaṁ sōḍhamācakṣatē |
		yadāha | pāuggiō ’pi sōḍhaḥ || pāḍisirā khalīnayuktā |
		pāḍuhuō pratibhūḥ pārihacchī mālā |
		pāḍihacchī śirōmālyamityanyē ||
		yathā |
prakrit_examples: pāuggia sāraviuṁ pāḍisirāmaṇiapārihacchīō | pāḍuhuaṁ puṇa maggasi kimēsa paḍihāi tuha ṇāō || 45 || [42]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: pāuraṇī kavacē pāsāvayapārāvarā gavakkhammi | jō piuharā païharaṁ ṇēi vahuṁ pāḍiajjhō sō || 43 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
pāuraṇī kavacam |
		pāsāvaō tathā pārāvarō gavākṣaḥ |
		pāḍiajjhō yaḥ pitr̥gr̥hātpatigr̥haṁ vadhūṁ nayati ||
		yathā |
prakrit_examples: pāsāvayappaïṭṭhō vahūi pārāvarōvaviṭṭhāē | rōmōggamapāuraṇīi pāḍiajjhō huō malayapavaṇō || 46 || [43]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: ṇāyavvā vīsāmammi pāḍiaggō a pāruaggō a | pāraṁparō ṇisiarammi pāruallō pahuṁkammi || 44 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
pāḍiaggō tathā pāruaggō viśrāmaḥ |
		pāraṁparō rākṣasaḥ |
		pāruallō pr̥thukaḥ || yathā |
prakrit_examples: rē halia pāḍiaggaṁ kuṇa iṇhimapāruaggadāḍha tumaṁ | pāraṁparō vva tittiṁ ṇa maṇṇasē pāruallaasaṇammi || 47 || [44]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: pālīhammaṁ ca vaī mālīkayamāhu pāruhallaṁ ca | pālībaṁdhō a sarē pāyappahaṇō a kukkuḍaē || 45 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
pālīhammaṁ vr̥tiḥ |
		pāruhallaṁ mālīkr̥tam |
		pālībaṁdhō taṭākaḥ |
		pāyappahaṇō kukkuṭaḥ ||
		yathā |
prakrit_examples: laṅghaï jalahiṁ garuḍō pālībaṁdhaṁ ca pāruhallōmmiṁ | pāyappahaṇa tumaṁ puṇa pālīhammaṁ pi phuḍasi dukkhēṇa || 48 || [45]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: pāḍalasaüṇō haṁsē piṇhī khāmā jalē pibbaṁ | piṁcū pikkakarīrē pilhaṁ lahupakkhirūammi || 46 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
pāḍalasaüṇō haṁsaḥ |
		piṇhī kṣāmā |
		pibbaṁ jalam |
		piṁcū pakvakarīram | pilhaṁ laghupakṣirūpam ||
		yathā |
prakrit_examples: pāḍalasaüṇayapilhaya tumayaṁ marumaṇḍalammi mā vacca | tattha apibbē piṁcuamittaphalē hōsi piṇhitaṇū || 49 || [46]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: piṁḍī a mañjarīē piriḍī saülīi picchilī lajjā | pihulaṁ piṁsulipiṁchōlīō muhapavaṇabhariatiṇavajjē || 47 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
piṁḍī mañjarī |
		piriḍī śakunikā |
		picchilī lajjā |
		pihulaṁ piṁsulī piṁchōlī trayō ’py ētē mukhamārutāpūritatr̥ṇavādyavācakāḥ ||
		yathā |
prakrit_examples: ramiraṁ pihulēṇa samaṁ piṁchōlimuhīhi piṁsulikarāhiṁ | piṁḍīhi palōhantō apicchilīpiriḍilōla kiṁ mahasi || 50 || [47]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: piaṇaṁ duddhē āṇāi piṇāī dāḍimammi piṁḍīraṁ | uṇṇāpipīliāē a pippaḍā makkaḍammi piṁgaṁgō || 48 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
piaṇaṁ dugdham |
		piṇāī ājñā |
		piṁḍīraṁ dāḍimam |
		piṁḍarayaṁity anyē |
		pippaḍā ūrṇāpipīlikā |
		piṁgaṁgō markaṭaḥ ||
		yathā |
prakrit_examples: liha piṁḍīraṁ piaṇaṁ piēsu mā kuṇasu pippaḍāsaṅkaṁ | jāva piṇāiṁ dintō piṁgaṁgamuhō ṇa ēi dhaṇibhaṭṭō || 51 || [48]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: balakārammi piṇāō piamā phaliṇīi piṁjiaṁ vihuē | pilaṇaṁ picchiladēsē sahī piḍacchā gudammi piṭṭhaṁtaṁ || 49 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
piṇāō balātkāraḥ |
		piamā phalinī piṁjiaṁ vidhutaṁ |
		piṁjiayaṁity api | pilaṇaṁ picchilō dēśaḥ |
		piḍacchā sakhī |
		piṭṭhaṁtaṁ gudaḥ ||
		yathā | atra pihaḍō piṭharaḥ |
		piucchā pitr̥ṣvasā |
		iti śabdabhavau |
		tathā pijjaï pibatīti dhātvādēśēṣūkta iti nōktaḥ |
		[49]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: piṁjaruḍō bhēruṇḍē jaṁkiṁcippaḍhiayammi pippaḍiaṁ | taṇuē pihōarō paṅkasurē piṭṭhakhaürā ya pēṁḍhā ya || 50 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
piṁjaruḍō bhēruṇḍaḥ |
		vadanadvayōpētō bhāruṇḍākhyaḥ pakṣī |
		pippaḍiaṁ yatkiṁcitpaṭhitam |
		pihōarō tanuḥ |
		atra pihurōmō mīna iti pr̥thurōmaśabdabhavaḥ |
		pisuṇaï kathayatīti dhātvādēśēṣūkta iti nōktaḥ |
		piṭṭhakhaürā tathā pēṁḍhā kaluṣā surā ||
		yathā |
prakrit_examples: piṁjaruḍō vva duvayaṇō pēṁḍhāmattō si piṭṭhakhaürapiā | sā tuha virahummattā pihōarā pippaḍaï ṇiccaṁ || 53 || [50]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: piamāhavipīṇā pikicaüraṁsā pīḍhamucchujantammi | pīī turaē pīluṭṭhapīḍaraïā ya ḍaḍḍhacōravahū || 51 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
piamāhavī kōkilā |
		pīṇaṁ caturasram |
		pīḍhaṁ ikṣunipīḍanayantram |
		pīī turaṁgamaḥ | pīluṭṭhaṁ pluṣṭam |
		pīvalaṁ pītamiti tu pītaśabdabhavam |
		pīḍaraī cōrabhāryā ||
		yathā |
prakrit_examples: pīṇaürapīirōhē pīḍhaṭhiā pikkhiūṇa pīḍaraī | piamāhavikālamuhī pīluṭṭhaṁ maṇṇaē palliṁ || 54 || [51]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: puṁḍē vaccatthē puṁḍhō gattē piusiāi pupphā ya | putthaṁ miu mēlē puṁpuaṁ ca puvvāḍapuppuā pīṇē || 52 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
puṁḍē iti śabdō vrajētyasminnarthē |
		puṁḍhō gartaḥ |
		pupphā pitr̥ṣvasā |
		putthaṁ mr̥du | puṁpuaṁ saṁgamaḥ |
		puvvāḍaṁ tathā puppuaṁ pīnam ||
		yathā |
prakrit_examples: puvvāḍakhandha puppuabhua putthālāva aṇṇaō puṁḍē | ṇa sahaï puṁpuamamhaṁ païpupphā puṁḍhasamagallā || 55 || [52]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: taruṇammi puaṁḍō pēṁḍaō a pavarē purillō a | asaīē puṇṇālī a puṇṇavattaṁ pamōahiavatthē || 53 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
puaṁḍō tathā pēṁḍaō taruṇaḥ |
		pēṁḍaō ṣaṇḍhaity anyē |
		purillō pravaraḥ |
		puṇṇālī asatī |
		puṇṇavattaṁ pramōdahr̥tavastram ||
		yathā | atra pukkharō sārasa iti puṣkaraśabdabhavaḥ |
		puṁchaï puṁsaï pusaï mārṣṭi |
		pulōi paśyati |
		iti dhātvādēśēṣūktā iti nōktāḥ || [53]
prakrit_examples: puṇṇālipuṇṇavattaṁ purillapēṁḍaya tumaṁ parihiūṇa | malhasu puaṁḍamajjhē suhayattaṇagavviō kimamhēhiṁ || 56 ||

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: puḍaïapuṁḍaïā taha pērullīpēṁḍabālapēṁḍaliā | piṇḍīkaē puāiṇipūāō puṇa pisāyagahiāē || 54 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
puḍaïaṁ puṁḍaïaṁ pērullī pēṁḍabālaṁ pēṁḍaliaṁ ētē pañca piṇḍīkr̥tārthāḥ | piṁḍalaïaṁity api |
		puāiṇī tathā pūā piśācagr̥hītā |
		puāiṇī unmattā duḥśīlā cētyanyē ||
		yathā |
prakrit_examples: puṁḍaïā pērullīsaddā puḍaïaapēṁḍabālakacā | apuāiṇī vi pūa vva tuhārivahū ruanti pēṁḍaliaṁ || 57 || [54]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: puruhūō ghūē puḍaïṇī a ṇaliṇī pulāsiō ’ggikaṇē | asurē purilladēvō ukkaṇṭhāē a purupuriā || 55 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
puruhūō ghūkaḥ |
		puḍaïṇī nalinī |
		saṁskr̥tē tu puṭakinīśabdaṁ kēcidēva nibadhnanti |
		pulāsiō agnikaṇaḥ |
		purilladēvō asuraḥ |
		purupuriā utkaṇṭhā ||
		yathā | atra pulaaï paśyatīti dhātvādēśēṣūktamiti nōktam || [55]
prakrit_examples: puruhūapiē kālē purilladēvārivirahiā rāhī | mavaṇapulāsiatattā puḍaïṇisayaṇē karēi purupuriaṁ || 58 ||

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: āsīi purillapahāṇā pūṇī piculayā karī pūṇō | pūrī vāyagabhaṇḍē pūaṁ dahiammi pūraṇaṁ suppē || 56 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
purillapahāṇā ahidaṁṣṭrā |
		pūṇī tūlalatā |
		yanmadhyātsūtratanturniḥsarati |
		pūṇō hastī |
		pūrī tantuvāyōpakaraṇam |
		pūaṁ dadhi |
		pūraṇaṁ śūrpam ||
		yathā |
prakrit_examples: pūaapūrīpūraṇapūṇīhiṁ jē jianti tē vi varaṁ | khuttapurillapahāṇō marasi alaṁ gāruḍēṇa ṇarapūṇa || 59 || [56]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: pūrōṭṭī kajjavaē pūṁḍariaṁ pēsaṇaṁ ca kajjammi | pēlliamavi pīḍiaē pēālaṁ pējjalaṁ pamāṇammi || 57 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
pūrōṭṭī avakaraḥ |
		pūṁḍariaṁ tathā pēsaṇaṁ kāryam |
		pēlliaṁ pīḍitam |
		pēālaṁ tathā pējjalaṁ pramāṇam ||
		yathā |
prakrit_examples: pūrōṭṭimapēālaṁ pēsaṇaaṇahijja ghallasu sakhēttē | dāriddapēllia apējjalakaṇisēhi jaï atthi pūṁḍariaṁ || 60 || [57]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: pērijjaṁ sāhijjammi pēcchaō diṭṭhamittaahilasirē | picchammi pēhuṇaṁ pēṁḍalō rasē gōvayammi pēṁḍārō || 58 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
pērijjaṁ sāhāyyam |
		pēcchaō dr̥ṣṭamātrābhilāṣī |
		pēhuṇaṁ piccham |
		pēṁḍalō rasaḥ |
		yad āha gōpālaḥ ||
		
		  
		    pēhuṇapēṁḍalaśabdau picchē ca rasē ca bōddhavyau ||
		  
		
		pēṁḍalō arasa iti tu akārapraślēṣō mūḍhānām |
		pēṁḍārō gōpaḥ |
		pēṁḍārō mahiṣīpāla iti dēvarājaḥ ||
		yathā |
prakrit_examples: sihipēhuṇāvayaṁsō pīṇō payapēṁḍalēṇa pēṁḍārō | vammahakayapērijjō bhattayahārīṇa pēcchaō jāō || 61 || [58]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: pēṁḍōlīpēraṇapēṁḍadhavā kīlōddhaṭhāṇakhaggēsu | pēḍaïō kaṇavaṇiē pēsaṇaārī a dūīē || 59 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
pēṁḍōlī krīḍā |
		pēraṇaṁ ūrdhvasthānam |
		atra |
		pēcchaï paśyati |
		pēllaï kṣipati |
		ētau dhātvādēśēṣūktāviti nōktau |
		pēṁḍadhavō khaḍgaḥ |
		atra |
		pēṁḍavaï prasthāpayati |
		ayaṁ dhātvādēśēṣūkta iti nōktaḥ |
		pēḍaïō kaṇādivikrētā vaṇik | pēsaṇaārī dūtī ||
		yathā |
prakrit_examples: pēḍaïadhūapēṁḍōlilampaḍō pēraṇaṁ kuṇasi kīsa | ṇa viṇā pēsaṇaāriṁ havanti kajjāi pēṁḍadhavahattha || 62 || [56]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: pōṭṭaṁ uarē pōccaṁ sukumārē jūhaṇāyagē pōṁḍō | kācammi hōi pōttī gāmapahāṇammi pōāō || 60 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
pōṭṭaṁ udaram |
		pōccaṁ sukumāram |
		pōṁḍō yūthādhipatiḥ |
		pōttī kācaḥ | pōāō grāmapradhānaḥ ||
		yathā |
prakrit_examples: taṁ pōccaṁ taṇupōṭṭiṁ mēllia pōāapōṁḍa ṇiaghariṇiṁ | hāliamahilaṁ ēaṁ ramasi ṇa taṁ muṇasi pōttimaṇibhēaṁ || 63 || [60]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: dutthammi pōsiō pōṇiā ya suttabhariammi takkummi | pōaṁḍō mukkabhayammi pōuā karisaaggimmi || 61 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
pōsiō duḥsthaḥ |
		pōṇiā sūtrabhr̥ttarkuḥ |
		pōaṁḍō muktabhayaḥ |
		ṣaṇḍhaity anyē | pōuā karīṣāgniḥ ||
		yathā |
prakrit_examples: hāliajāliapōuadhūmaṁ daṭṭhūṇa pōṇiaṁ caïa | pōsiaghariṇī chēttaṁ ua pōaṁḍā ṇisāi ahisaraï || 64 || [61]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: pōālō vasahē pōaṁtō savahammi pōttaō visaṇē | pōliapōhaṇapōracchā sōṇialahuamacchapisuṇēsu || 62 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
pōālō vr̥ṣabhaḥ |
		pōaṁtō śapathaḥ |
		pōttaō vr̥ṣaṇaḥ |
		pōliō saunikaḥ | pōhaṇō laghumatsyaḥ |
		pōracchō durjanaḥ ||
		yathā |
prakrit_examples: taṁ rē pōhaṇagandhiṁ sapōttapōālaü vva ramiūṇa | pōracchakamma pōlia iṇhiṁ puṇa kuṇasi pōaṁtē || 65 || [62]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: pōiapōaïā ṇiddayarilayā pōiō a kanduiē | pōlaccā khēḍiabhū kusumbharattammi pōmarayaṁ || 63 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
pōiā tathā pōaïā nidrākarī latā |
		pōiō kāndavikaḥ |
		khadyōtaity anyē |
		pōlaccā khēṭitabhūmiḥ |
		pōmaraṁ kusumbharaktaṁ vastram |
		atra pōkkaï vyāharatīti dhātvādēśēṣūktamiti nōktam ||
		yathā |
prakrit_examples: pōiacuṇṭaṇamisaō pōaïavaṇammi pōiagharillī | pōlaccachēttakaṇṭhē supōmarā pēccha ahisaraï || 66 || [63]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: dariakkhamēsu pakkō pattaṇamisuphalayapuṅkhēśu | païaṁ bhacchiacakkēsu papphuaṁ dīhaüḍḍiantēsu || 64 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
pakkō dr̥ptaḥ samarthaśca |
		pattaṇaṁ bāṇasya phalaṁ puṅkhaścēti dvyartham |
		païaṁ bhartsitaṁ rathacakraṁ ca |
		papphuaṁ dīrghamuḍḍīyamānaṁ ca || [64]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: vaïjavaṇīsu paḍillī paüṇō vaṇarōhaṇiamabhēēsu | aïsōhantē bhaggē piaṁvara pakkaṇī cēa || 65 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
paḍillī vr̥tistiraskariṇī ca |
		paüṇō vraṇaprarōhō niyamabhēdaścēti dvyarthaḥ |
		pakkaṇī atiśayaśōbhamānō bhagnaḥ priyaṁvadaścēti tryarthaḥ || [65] païṭṭhō jñātarasō viralaṁ mārgaścēti tryarthaḥ |
		pabbhārō saṁghātō giriguhā ca |
		paṁsulō kōkilō jāraśca |
		paütthaṁ gr̥haṁ prōṣitaṁ ca || [66]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: vaïvivarē taha maggē dussīlē kaṇṭhadīṇārē | kaṇṭhacchiddammi tahā ya dīṇaṇāē paērō a || 67 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary: paērō vr̥tivivaraṁ mārgō duḥśīlaḥ kaṇṭhadīnārākhyabhūṣaṇabhēdaḥ kaṇṭhē vivaraṁ dīnanādaścēti ṣaḍarthaḥ || [67]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: lahupiḍharammi paḍulaṁ taha cirakālappasūammi | pattaṭṭhō ṇāyavvō bahusikkhiasundarēsuṁ ca || 68 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
paḍullaṁ laghupiṭharaṁ ciraprasūtaṁ ca |
		pattaṭṭhō bahuśikṣitaḥ sundaraśca || [68]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: asahaṇasamatthaēsuṁ ca paccalō pakkaṇō cēa | pavvajjō ṇahasarasisumiēsu gaṇasattharēsu patthārī || 69 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
paccalō tathā pakkaṇō asahanaḥ samarthaścēti dvāvapi dvyarthau || pavvajjō nakhaḥ śarō bālamr̥gaścēti tryarthaḥ |
		patthārī nikaraḥ prastaraśca || [69]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: kappāsē sēē palasaṁ pīḍiapaḍiabhīrusu paraddhaṁ | paḍḍatthī bahududdhāē pārīhāriṇīē a || 70 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
palasaṁ karpāsaphalaṁ svēdaśca |
		paraddhaṁ pīḍitaṁ patitaṁ bhīru cēti tryartham |
		paḍḍatthī bahudugdhā dōhanahāriṇī cēti dvyarthā |
		atra parīi bhramati kṣipati cēti dhātvādēśēṣūktamiti nōktam |
		[70]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: païrikkaṁ ca visālē ēgantē taha ya suṇṇammi | parihacchaṁ paḍumaṇṇūsu bhīabhaggēsu paḍisiddhaṁ || 71 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
païrikkaṁ viśālamēkāntaṁ śūnyaṁ cēti tryartham |
		parihacchaṁ paṭurmanyuśca |
		paḍisiddhaṁ bhītaṁ bhagnaṁ ca || [71]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: payalāō harasappēsu paribbhaṁtō ṇisiddhabhīrūsu | dāthāyaḍḍhīmahisīsu payaḍḍhaṇipārihaṭṭīō || 72 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
payalāō haraḥ sarpaśca |
		paribbhaṁtō niṣiddhō bhīruśca |
		dvāḥsthā pratīhārī | ākr̥ṣṭirākarṣaṇam |
		mahiṣī sāmānyōktāpi ciraprasūtēha gr̥hyatē |
		ēṣu dvāḥsthādiṣu triṣvarthēṣu payaḍḍhaṇipārihaṭṭiśabdau |
		yad āha gōpālaḥ |
		|| payaḍḍhaṇī syātpratīhārī | ākr̥ṣṭiḥ parihaṭṭī payaḍḍhaṇī cēti vijñēyā || || dvāḥsthā ca pārihaṭṭī ākr̥ṣṭīḥ pārihaṭṭī syāt || iti ca |
		gōkulaprakaraṇē dēvarājastvāha |
		parihāriṇīpayaḍḍhaṇipaḍicchiā pārihaṭṭīē || [72]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: vaïmukkhēsu pariaḍī pahēṇayaṁ lāhaṇōsavēsuṁ ca | paḍuāliaṁ paḍūkayaparitāḍiadhāriēsuṁ ca || 73 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
pariaḍī vr̥tirmūrkhaśca |
		pahēṇayaṁ bhōjanōpāyanamutsavaśca |
		atra |
		pabbālaï plāvayati chādayati ca |
		payallaï śithilībhavati lambatē ca |
		pamhusaï vismarati pramr̥śati pramuṣṇāti ca |
		pakkhōḍaï vikōśayati śīyatē ca |
		palōṭṭaï pratyāgacchati paryasyati ca |
		paḍisāi śāmyati naśyati ca |
		ētē dhātvādēśēṣūktā iti nōktāḥ | paḍuāliaṁ paṭūkr̥taṁ tāḍitaṁ dhāritaṁ cēti tryartham || [73]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: parihuttavaḍḍhaviapāliēsu paḍiaggiaṁ cēa | paviraṁjiō a bhaṇiō siṇiddhaē kayaṇisēhē a || 74 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
paḍiaggiaṁ paribhuktaṁ varvā/?/pitaṁ pālitaṁ cēti tryartham |
		paḍiaggiaṁ anutrajitamiti tu anuvrajidhātvādēśasiddham |
		paviraṁjiō snigdhaḥ kr̥taniṣēdhaśca |
		paviraṁjiō bhagna iti tu bhañjidhātvādēśasiddhaḥ || [74]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: sarahē vagghammi a pakkasāvaō pāsamacchiviruvēsu | pālō suṇḍika juṇṇēsu bhattaücchūsu pāū a || 75 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
pakkasāvaō śarabhō vyāghraśca |
		pāsaṁ akṣi viśōbhaṁ ca |
		dantakuntayōrapi pāsaṁ icchantyanyē |
		pālō śauṇḍikō jīrṇaśca |
		pāū bhaktamikṣuśca |
		svārthē kē pāuaṁity api || [75] pāḍukkō samālambhanaṁ paṭuśca |
		pālappō viplutaḥ pratisāraśca |
		pāḍalō haṁsō vr̥ṣabhaḥ kamalaṁ cēti tryarthaḥ |
		pāsallaṁ dvāraṁ tiryak ca || [76]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: puvvakayakammapariṇaïāhēḍaapīḍiēsu pāraddhaṁ | tullaṇisēhē sarisē samuācārē a pāḍisiddhī a || 77 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
pāraddhaṁ pūrvakr̥takarmapariṇāma ākhēṭakaḥ pīḍitaścēti tryartham |
		pāḍisiddhī spardhā sadr̥śaḥ samudācāraścēti tryarthaḥ || [77]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: pāḍuṁgōrī viuṇē majjāsattammi daḍhavaīē a | masaümmattēsuṁ pippaō a picupūṇiāsu piulī a || 78 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
pāḍuṁgōrī viguṇō madyāsaktō dr̥ḍhakr̥tāvēṣṭanā ca vr̥tiriti tryarthaḥ |
		yadāha || pāḍuṁgōrī ca vr̥tirdīrghaṁ yasyā vivēṣṭanaṁ paritaḥ || pippaō maśaka unmattaśca |
		piulī karpāsastūlalatikā ca || [78]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: gaṇḍutiṇacīrighammēsu pillirī pipparō visē haṁsē | vajjavisēsavivaṇṇēsu pihaṁḍō vagghasīhayā pullī || 79 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
pillirī gaṇḍutsaṁjñaṁ tr̥ṇaṁ cīrī gharmaścēti tryarthā |
		pipparō vr̥ṣabhō haṁsaśca |
		pihaṁḍō vādyaviśēṣō vivarṇaścēti dvyarthaḥ |
		pullī vyāghraḥ siṁhaśca || [79] puāī taruṇa unmattaḥ piśācaścēti tryarthaḥ |
		puḍiṁgaṁ vadanaṁ binduśca |
		pūsō sātavāhanaḥ śukaśca |
		pēḍḍā bhittirdvāraṁ mahiṣī cēti tryarthā |
		kēcitpēḍḍaśabdēna mahiṣamāhuḥ || [80]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: khaṇḍavalaēsu pēṁḍaṁ pōō dhavarukkhalahuasappēsu | assiṇamāsōsavaē apūaē taha ya pōalaō || 81 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
pēṁḍaṁ khaṇḍaṁ valayaśca |
		pōō dhavavr̥kṣō laghusarpaścēti dvyarthaḥ |
		pōō bāla iti tu pōtaśabdabhavaḥ |
		pōalaō āśvinamāsōtsavō ’pūpaśca |
		yadāha |
		bhartā bhuṅktē ’pūpaṁ yatra gr̥hiṇyāḥ karātsamādāya |
		āśvayujē pōalaō sa utsavō ’pūpabhēdaśca || pōalaō bālavasantaity anyē || [81]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: phaggū mahucchaṇē phalahī vavaṇī phasulaphaṁsulā mukkē | pharaō phalayammi a phaṁsulī a ṇōmāliāē a || 82 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
phaggū vasantōtsavaḥ |
		phalahī karpāsaḥ |
		phasulō tathā phaṁsulō muktaḥ |
		pharaō phalakaḥ |
		phaṁsulī navamālikā ||
		yathā |
prakrit_examples: kiṁ rē pharōsi pharayaṁ phalahīlayahattha phaṁsulahirī a | phaggummi phaṁsulighaṇē khalanti kāmaphasulā sarā ṇēttha || 67 || [82]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: phaliārī duvvāē phasaliaphasalāṇiā kayavihūsē | phaṁphasaō layabhēē phikkī harisammi kārimē phippaṁ || 83 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
phaliārī dūrvā |
		phasaliō tathā phasalāṇiō kr̥tavibhūṣaḥ |
		phaṁphasaō latābhēdaḥ |
		phikkī harṣaḥ |
		phippaṁ kr̥trimam ||
		yathā |
prakrit_examples: phaṁphasayamālaphasalāṇiō a phaliāriāphasaliō a | phippagahilō jaṇāṇaṁ viraïa hāsaṁ jaṇaï phikkiṁ || 68 || [83]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: phiḍḍō vāmaṇaē phukkā micchā kēsabandhaṇē phuṁṭā | phukkī rajaī phuriaṁ ca ṇindiē phuṁphuā karīsaggī || 84 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
phiḍḍō vāmanaḥ |
		atra |
		phiḍaï phiṭṭaï bhraśyati |
		ētau dhātvādēśēṣūktāviti nōktau |
		phukkā mithyā |
		phuṁṭā kēśabandhaḥ |
		phukkī rajakī |
		phuriaṁ ninditam | calitadīptayōstu sphuritaśabdabhavamēva |
		phuṁphuā karīṣāgniḥ ||
		yathā | atra phuḍaï phuṭṭaï bhraśyatīti dhātvādēśēṣūktāviti nōktau || [84]
prakrit_examples: saṁkēaphukkiaharē phukkāphiḍḍaṁ piamaphuriaphuṁṭaṁ | daṭṭhuṁ viōaphuṁphuatattā taruṇī suhāi va ṇibuḍḍā || 69 ||

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: phullaṁdhuō alī phūō lōhārē daliddaē phēllō | māulavahūi phēlāyā varuṇē phēṇabaṁdhaphēṇavaḍā || 85 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
phullaṁdhuō bhramaraḥ |
		phūō lōhakāraḥ |
		phēllō daridraḥ |
		phēlāyā mātulānī | phēṇabaṁdhō tathā phēṇavaḍō varuṇaḥ ||
		yathā |
prakrit_examples: ua phēlāyāi muhaṁ phēṇavaḍadisāi phēllaphūaharē | phullaṁdhuō vva cumbaï ēsa gaē phēṇabaṁdhadisamakkē || 70 || [85]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: phēllusaṇaṁ pilaṇē uggamammi phōsō bhayadaravē phōṁphā | phaḍamahibhōgaphaṇēsuṁ phalī a liṅgammi usahē a || 86 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
phēllusaṇaṁ picchilō dēśaḥ |
		phēllusa iti patanārthaḥ |
		kriyāśabdō ’yam |
		sa yadā adhikaraṇasādhanastadā phēllusaṇaṁ picchilō dēśaḥ |
		yadā tu bhāvasādhanastadā phēllusaṇaṁ patanamucyatē |
		ēvaṁ ca |
		phēllusaï |
		phēllusiūṇa |
		ityādayō draṣṭavyāḥ | phōsō udgamaḥ |
		phōōity anyē |
		phōṁphā bhīṣayituṁ śabdaḥ ||
		yathā | phaḍaṁ sarpasya sarvaśarīraṁ phaṇaśca |
		phalī liṅgaṁ vr̥ṣabhaśca || [86]
prakrit_examples: bhūchattaphōsakālē taruṇiṁ daṭṭhūṇa karaï taha phōṁphaṁ | jaha phēllusaṇē khaliaṁ dharēi dhuttō ṇiambammi || 71 ||

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: juttamaliṇēsu phaṁsaṇamaha sārē thāsaē a phasalaṁ ca | phēsō ḍarasabbhāvēsu mukkavitthāriēsu phōiayaṁ || 87 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
phaṁsaṇaṁ yuktaṁ malinaṁ ca |
		phasalaṁ sāraṁ sthāsakaśca |
		atra |
		phaṁsaï visaṁvadati spr̥śati ca |
		phusaï mārṣṭi bhramati cēti dhātvādēśēṣūktāviti nōktau |
		phēsō trāsaḥ sadbhāvaśca |
		phōiayaṁ muktaṁ vistāritaṁ ca || [87]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: phōḍiayaṁ rāī dhūmiaṁ ca sīhāirakkhaṇavihī a | baṁdhō bhiccē babbhō vaddhē bappabaliā suhaḍapīṇā || 88 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
phōḍiayaṁ rājikā dhūmitaṁ |
		śākādi |
		rātrāvaṭavyāṁ siṁhādirakṣāprakāraśca || baṁdhō bhr̥tyaḥ |
		babbhō vardhraḥ |
		bappō subhaṭaḥ |
		pitētyanyē |
		baliō pīnaḥ ||
		yathā |
prakrit_examples: kāsaṇiabaṁdhaya tumaṁ gaḍḍīē caïa babbhakammāiṁ | rē baliabappaghariṇiṁ jaṁpantō lahasi jhatti phalaṁ || 72 || [88]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: baṁdhōllō mēlayaē bavvāḍō dāhiṇakarammi | bahalaṁ paṅkē hāsammi bakkaraṁ baddhaō a taüvaṭṭē || 89 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
baṁdhōllō mēlakaḥ |
		bavvāḍō dakṣiṇahastaḥ |
		bahalaṁ paṅkaḥ |
		bakkaraṁ parihāsaḥ || baddhaō trapupaṭṭākhyaḥ karṇābharaṇaviśēṣaḥ ||
		yathā |
prakrit_examples: bavvāḍaggahaṇachaṇē bandhurabaṁdhōllayammi tujjha piē | calabaddhayāṇa mayamayabahaliaālīṇa bakkaraṁ bharimō || 73 || [89]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: bappīhabaṁbhaṇīō cāayahālāhalēsuṁ ca | tumulē bamālabōlā ya babbarī kēsarayaṇāē || 90 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
bappīhō cātakaḥ |
		baṁbhaṇī |
		svārthē kē baṁbhaṇiā |
		hālāhalaḥ |
		bamālō tathā bōlō kalakalaḥ |
		babbarī kēśaracanā |
		atra bappīhabamālabōlā dantyōṣṭhyādayaḥ kaiścidiṣyantē ||
		yathā |
prakrit_examples: sā baṁbhaṇi vva tappaï tuha virahōmhāi luliababbariā | bappīhabōlaghaṇaghaṇabamālakālē vi ṇēa ṇivvāi || 74 || [90]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: ucchusamatiṇē baruaṁ gōkamalēsuṁ baïllabaṁbhaharā | balavaṭṭīvabahurāṇā sahiasidhārā sivāi bahurāvā || 91 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
baruaṁ ikṣusadr̥śatr̥ṇam |
		baïllō balīvardaḥ |
		baṁbhaharaṁ kamalam |
		balavaṭṭī sakhī | vyāyāmasahētyanyē |
		bahurāṇā khaḍgadhārā |
		bahurāvā śivā |
		atra baruabalavaṭṭiśabdau dantyōṣṭhyādī kaiścinnibaddhau ||
		yathā |
prakrit_examples: katthucchu kattha baruaṁ baṁbhaharaṁ kattha kattha bahurāṇā | balavaṭṭī katthamhaṁ baïllabahurāvasadda kattha tumaṁ || 75 || [91]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: bapphāulamaïuṇhē haḍhē balāmōḍibalamaḍḍā | bahumuhabālayabāullī khalavaṇiuttaputtiāsuṁ ca || 92 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
bapphāulaṁ atiśayōṣṇam |
		abāṣpākulē ’pi vr̥ttērnāyaṁ bāṣpākulaśabdabhavaḥ | balāmōḍī tathā balamaḍḍā balātkāraḥ |
		bahumuhō durjanaḥ |
		atra |
		bajjaraï kathayati |
		baḍabaḍaï vilapati |
		ētau dhātvādēśēṣūktāviti nōktau |
		tathā bāhiṁ bahiriti śabdabhavatvānnōktam |
		bālaō vaṇikputraḥ |
		bāullī pañcālikā |
		atra bapphāulabāullīśabdau kēṣāṁciddantyōṣṭhyādī ||
		yathā |
prakrit_examples: amarisabapphāuliā bahumuha bāullia vva tuṇhikkā | ṇa balāmōḍījōggā bālaya pēmmaṁ khu haṇha balamaḍḍā || 76 || [92]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: biggāibiāyā juadō kīḍā bīlaō a tāḍaṅkē | asaṇammi bīaō bījamalaṇakhalayammi bīajamaṇaṁ tu || 93 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
biggāī |
		svārthē kē biggāiā |
		tathā biāyā yutau kīṭau |
		yadāha | yau kīṭau saṁlagnau bhramatō biggāiā khyātau ||
		yastu |
		biggāiā biāyā |
		ityabhimānacihnasūtrē sati biggāiā calacittatēti vyācaṣṭa udāharati ca |
		yathā || iti |
		sa mahāsāhasikaḥ |
		yadabhimānacihnēnaiva svavr̥ttāvudāhr̥tam ||
		yathā || atra bisakaṇṭhī balākēti saṁskr̥tasamatvānnōktaḥ |
		bīlaō tāḍaṅkaḥ |
		bīaō asanavr̥kṣaḥ |
		bīaṇōity anyē |
		atra bīhaï bibhētīti dhātvādēśēṣūktamiti nōktam | bīajamaṇaṁ bījamalanakhalam |
		atrāpi bīlayabīajamaṇaśabdau dantyōṣṭhyādī kēṣāṁcit ||
		yathā ||
prakrit_examples: jahimaṁ tirō vaīē guluguṁchia gōviā pulōēsi | biggāiāi kāhisi kāyaṁ taha kāmabāṇāṇa || 77 ||
sabbhāvasaṁdiāō ṇiccaṁ cia saṁgayāu hōjjāi | ṇa muanti ēkkamēkkaṁ puttaya biggāiāō vi || 78 ||
biggāiā vi hu varaṁ viṇā piaṁ bīlaēhi kiṁ ittha | ia bīajamaṇabīayatalammi salahaï biāiaṁ bālā || 79 || [93]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: buttī pupphavaīē bukkā muṭṭhīi bukkaṇō kāgē | bindammi buṁbuaṁ buṁdiṇī kumārīsamūhammi || 94 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
buttī r̥tumatī |
		bukkā muṣṭiḥ |
		vrīhimuṣṭirityanyē |
		bukkaṇō kākaḥ |
		buṁbuaṁ br̥ndam |
		buṁdiṇī kumārīsamūhaḥ ||
		yathā || atra |
		bukkaï garjati |
		buḍḍaï majjati |
		ētau dhātvādēśēṣūktāviti nōktau |
		[94]
prakrit_examples: ajja vi ṇa hu buttī sā buṁdiṇimajjhammi khēllaē muddhā | dāsībuṁbuabukkō via bukkaṇa mā khu hōhi uttālō || 80 ||

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: bukkāsārō bhīrū bulaṁbulā bubbuē cēa | bēlī thūṇā bēḍō tarīi maṁsummi bēḍḍabōḍḍarayā || 95 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
bukkāsārō bhīruḥ |
		bulaṁbulā budbudaḥ |
		bēlī sthūṇā |
		bēḍō nauḥ |
		dantyōṣṭhyādirayaṁ kēṣāṁcit |
		bēḍḍā tathā bōḍḍaraṁ śmaśru ||
		yathā |
prakrit_examples: rē bēḍiasua bōkkaḍabōḍḍara kiṁ tujjha uggayā bēḍḍā | ṇaïjalabulaṁbulāō bukkāsārō si bēlibiḍiō vi || 81 || [95]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: dhammiṭṭayammi bōḍō bōvvaṁ khēttammi cūcuē bōṁḍaṁ | chāgammi bōkkaḍō bōdaraṁ pihū pavahaṇammi bōhitthō || 96 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
bōḍō dhārmikaḥ |
		taruṇaity anyē |
		bōvvaṁ kṣētram |
		bōṁḍaṁ cūcukam |
		bōṁṭaṇaṁ iti śīlāṅkaḥ |
		bōkkaḍō chāgaḥ |
		bōdaraṁ pr̥thu |
		bōhitthō pravahaṇam ||
		yathā |
prakrit_examples: bōḍāṇa puṇṇabōvvē bōdarasaṁsārasindhubōhitthaṁ | avalambantāṇa samaṁ varabōṁḍā bōkkaḍi vva paḍihāi || 82 || [96]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: saṁmajjaṇīi bōhārī bōhaharō a māgahaē | bahuṇō cōrē dhuttē a suhayapaṇasēsu bāṇō a || 97 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
bōhārī saṁmārjanī |
		baühārīity anyē |
		atra |
		bōllaï kathayati |
		iti dhātvādēśēṣūktamiti nōktam |
		bōhaharō māgadhaḥ ||
		yathā | bahuṇō cōrō dhūrtaśca |
		bāṇō subhagaḥ panasaśca || [97]
prakrit_examples: bōhaharamaṅgalajhuṇīi jhatti mihuṇāṇa uṭṭhamāṇāṇa | rayatuṭṭahāramuttā ua bōhārīharīu gēṇhanti || 83 ||

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: biṁbōvaṇayaṁ khōhē vikāraūsīsaēsuṁ ca | cumbiakiḍīsu buṁdī buṁdīrō mahisagaruēsu || 98 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
biṁbōvaṇayaṁ kṣōbhō vikāra ucchīrṣakaṁ cēti tryartham |
		buṁdī cumbanaṁ sūkaraśca | buṁdīrō mahiṣō mahāṁśca || [98]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: rūvamuhataṇusu bōṁdī bhūsiaāḍōvaēsu bōṁgillō | bhallū ricchē bhaggaṁ littē bhaṁbhī a asaīē || [99]
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
bōṁdī rūpaṁ mukhaṁ śarīraṁ cēti tryarthā |
		bōṁdaṁ mukhamityanyē |
		bōṁgillō bhūṣita āṭōpaśca || bhallū r̥kṣaḥ |
		bhaggaṁ liptam |
		bhaṁbhī asatī ||
		yathā |
prakrit_examples: bhallūsaricchakēsē païmmi alasē sayāluē bhaṁbhī | candaṇarasabhaggataṇū uvavaïmahisaraï juṇhīē || 84 || [99]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: bhaṁbhā bhērī bhavvō bahiṇītaṇaē vaïṅgaṇē bhaṁḍaṁ | bhaṁḍuṁ muṇḍaṇaē bhaddaṁ āmalayammi bhaṭṭiō kaṇhē || 100 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
bhaṁbhā tūryaviśēṣaḥ |
		bhavvō bhāginēyaḥ |
		bhaṁḍaṁ vr̥ntākam |
		bhaṁḍuṁ muṇḍanam |
		bhaddaṁ āmalakam |
		bhaṭṭiō viṣṇuḥ ||
		yathā |
prakrit_examples: kayabhaṁḍusirō bhaṁbhāsaddō rē bhavva lihaï tuha jaṇaō | bhaṭṭiabhattiviuttō bhaddayaēgārasīi bhaṁḍāiṁ || 85 || [100]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: baruammi bhamāsō bhalluṁkī bhasuā bhuruṁḍiā ya sivā | pakhalantammi bhalaṁtaṁ kalahāvattēsu bhaṁḍaṇabhamamuhā || 101 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
bhamāsō ikṣusadr̥śatr̥ṇam |
		bhamasō iti dhanapālaḥ |
		bhalluṁkī bhasuā bhuruṁḍiāity ētē trayō ’pi śivāvācakāḥ |
		atra bhuruṁḍiāśabdō bhukārādirarthānurōdhātpaṭhitaḥ | bhalaṁtaṁ praskhalat |
		bhaṁḍaṇaṁ kalahaḥ |
		atra bhasalō bhramara iti bhramaraśabdabhavaḥ | bharaï bhalaï smaratīti dhātvādēśēṣūktāviti nōktau |
		bhamamuhō āvartaḥ ||
		yathā |
prakrit_examples: bhaṁḍaṇabhamamuhapaḍiaṁ pēkkhia bhalluṁkiāi saha bhasuaṁ | ṇēi bhamāsabhalaṁtaṁ tuha hayavēriṁ bhuruṁḍiā aṇṇā || 86 || [101]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: bhaddākaribhaddasirī dīhamalayajā bharōcchayaṁ tālaṁ | bhayavaggāmō mōḍhērayammi jēṭṭhabahiṇīvaī bhāō || 102 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
bhaddākarī pralambaḥ |
		bhaddasirī śrīkhaṇḍam |
		bharōcchayaṁ tālaphalam |
		atra bhammaḍaï bhamāḍaï bhamaḍaï bhramatīti dhātvādēśēṣūktā iti nōktāḥ |
		bhayavaggāmō mōḍhērakam |
		bhāō jyēṣṭhabhaginīpatiḥ ||
		yathā | atra bhāi bibhētīti dhātvādēśēṣūktamiti nōktam |
		[102]
prakrit_examples: bhaddākaribhuadaṇḍaṁ bhayavaggāmammi bhaddasirihatthō | vīrajiṇamacca bhāua bharōcchayaphalaṁ cayaṇṇasurasēvaṁ || 87 ||

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: bhāsalabhāviabhāujjā dittagahiayabhāujāyāsu | bhāsuṁḍī ṇīsaraṇē bhāuamāsāḍhagōriūsavaē || 103 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
bhāsalaṁ dīptam |
		bhāviaṁ gr̥hītam |
		bhāujjā bhrātr̥jāyā |
		bhāsuṁḍī niḥsaraṇam |
		bhāuaṁ āṣāḍhē gauryā utsavaviśēṣaḥ ||
		yathā |
prakrit_examples: ō piccha jārabhāviasaṁkēā mayaṇaaggibhāsaliā | bhāuamisēṇa bhavaṇā bhāsuṁḍaï tujjha bhāujjā || 88 || [103]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: bhāyalabhāsiabhāillā jaccaturaṁgadiṇṇahaliēsu | bhāvaïā dhammigēhiṇīi bhiṁgaṁ ca kasiṇammi || 104 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
bhāyalō jātyaturaṁgamaḥ |
		bhāsiaṁ dattam |
		bhāillō hālikaḥ |
		atra bhāirō bhīruriti bibhētērbhādēśē tr̥na irē siddhamiti nōktam |
		bhāvaïā dhārmikagr̥hiṇī | bhiṁgaṁ kr̥ṣṇam ||
		yathā |
prakrit_examples: indiabhāyalavivasō bhāvaïāṇa ṇiaḍē bhama tumaṁ mā | bhāilla tāhi bhāsiasāvō kaha hōsi pāva bhiṁgamuhō || 89 || [104]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: bhisiā bisī bhisaṁtamaṇatthē cīrīi bhiṁgārī | bārammi bhittaraṁ ṭaṅkacchiṇṇē bhittirūvaṁ ca || 105 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
bhisiā br̥sī |
		bhisaṁtaṁ anarthaḥ |
		dīptārthastu bhāsērbhisa iti dhātvādēśē siddhaḥ | bhiṁgārī cīrī |
		maśakaity anyē |
		bhittaraṁ dvāram |
		bhittirūvaṁ ṭaṅkacchinnam ||
		yathā |
prakrit_examples: bhiṁgārisaṁkulābhittirūvaguhabhittarē vasantāṇaṁ | bhisiāpariggahāṇaṁ muṇīṇa kattō bhisaṁtāiṁ || 90 || [105]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: bhujjē bhuaṁ chuhāē bhukkhā kōlammi bhuṁḍabhuṁḍīrā | bhuttūṇō bhiccē bhuruhuṁḍiamuddhūliē cēa || 106 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
bhuaṁ bhūrjam |
		bhukkhā kṣut |
		bhuṁḍō tathā bhuṁḍīrō sūkaraḥ |
		bhuttūṇō |
		ōtsaṁyōgē iti bhōttūṇōity api |
		bhr̥tyaḥ |
		atra |
		bhumaï bhramati |
		bhullaï bhraśyati |
		bhukkaï bhaṣati |
		ētē dhātvādēśēṣūktā iti nōktāḥ |
		bhuruhuṁḍiaṁ uddhūlitam |
		bhurukuṁḍiaṁity anyē ||
		yathā |
prakrit_examples: dhūlibhuruhuṁḍiā jē bhukkhāē bhuakisā ya bhuttūṇa | kiṁ jāēhi bahūhi vi bhuṁḍīrēhiṁ ca tēhi bhuṁḍīē || 91 || [106]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: bhūō a jantavāhē bhūaṇō kiṭṭhakhalajaṇṇē | bhūmipisāō tālē bhayāluē bhēḍabhējjalayā || 107 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
bhūō yantravāhaḥ |
		bhūaṇṇō kr̥ṣṭē khalē yajñaḥ |
		bhūmipisāō tālaḥ |
		bhēḍō bhējjō bhējjalaō trayō ’py ētē bhīruvācakāḥ |
		bhēḍaśabdō bhēraśabdabhavō ’py asti ||
		yathā |
prakrit_examples: bhūmipisāē bhūaṁ caḍiamabhēḍaṁ vahū ṇiēūṇa | bhūaṇṇapikkhaṇamisā abhējjalā jāi bhējja vva || 92 || [107]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: bhēruṁḍō dīvī bhōabhōiā bhāḍigāmapavarēsu | ahiārisambalē bhōllayaṁ ca bhāruṇḍayammi bhōruḍaō || 108 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
bhēruṁḍō citrakaḥ |
		bhōō bhāṭiḥ |
		bhōiō grāpradhānam |
		bhōllayaṁ prabandhapravr̥ttaṁ pāthēyam |
		bhōruḍō bhāruṇḍapakṣī ||
		yathā |
prakrit_examples: aṇutitthaṁ kayabhōā ēkkamuhīhavia bhōllayaṁ lēha | bhōiabhēruṁḍā dōmuhabhōruḍayāṇa pēcchaï avāyaṁ || 93 || [108]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: chiṇṇasirabandibhūsāsahidōhittēsu bhaṁḍō a | bhaṁḍī sirīsarukkhō aḍaī asaī a gaḍḍī a || 109 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
bhaṁḍō chinnamūrdhā māgadhō maṇḍanaṁ sakhā dauhitraścēti pañcārthaḥ |
		bhaṁḍī śirīṣavr̥kṣō ’ṭavī asatī gantrī cēti caturarthā || [109] bhaṁbhalaṁ apriyam |
		bhaṁbhalō mūrkhō bhittaṁ dvāraṁ gr̥haṁ ca |
		bhukkaṇō śvā madyādimānaṁ ca |
		bhēlī ājñā bēḍā cēṭī cēti tryarthā |
		bēḍāyāṁ bhēlaōity api kēcit || [110]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: maṁtī vivāhagaṇaē maṁṭhō saṇṭhē pihāṇiā maṁḍī | maṁcō bandhē maggō pacchā maccaṁ malē malō sēē || 111 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
maṁtī vivāhagaṇakaḥ |
		maṁṭhō śaṭhaḥ |
		maṁḍī pidhānikā |
		maṁcō bandhaḥ |
		maṁṭhō bandha iti kēcitpaṭhanti |
		maggō paścāt |
		maccaṁ malaḥ |
		malō svēdaḥ ||
		yathā |
prakrit_examples: maṁḍīi haṇēmi siraṁ jaṁ muṇḍēūṇa ghammajāyamalō | rē maṁcajōggamaccia maṁtiṁ pucchēsi maggaō maṁṭha || 94 || [111]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: siṅgavihīṇē maṭṭō maṭṭhamarālā ya alasammi | maṁkhō ’ṇḍē mammī mallāṇī māmā ya māmīē || 112 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
maṭṭō śr̥ṅgavihīnaḥ |
		maṭṭhō tathā marālō alasaḥ |
		marālō haṁsa iti sātavāhanaḥ |
		maṁkhō aṇḍaḥ |
		mammī mallāṇī māmā trayō ’py amī mātulānīvācakāḥ | māmīśabdō ’pi dēśyaḥ |
		paryāyabhaṅgyā tūpāttaḥ ||
		yathā |
prakrit_examples: rēhasi marāla ṇa gharē maṁkhillō maṭṭhamaṭṭaüsahō vva | ia ēsa mammimajjhē māmāhasiō haṇēi mallāṇiṁ || 95 || [112]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: maïrāi maī maïmōhaṇī a sīmāi majjamērāō | sēlē maū haḍhē mattallimiṇāyāi akkhamē maharō || 113 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
maī tathā maïmōhaṇī surā |
		majjā tathā mērā maryādā |
		maū parvataḥ |
		mattallī tathā miṇāyaṁ balātkāraḥ |
		maharō asamarthaḥ ||
		yathā |
prakrit_examples: mattallimukkamajjō maümērāghōsadaṁsiamiṇāō | piaï maï gaïmaharō musalī maïmōhaṇīkuḍayahatthō || 96 || [113]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: maḍiā samāhayāē maüaṁ dīṇammi piuharē mahaṇaṁ | marulō bhūē maïaṁ ca bhacchiē maṁḍalō sāṇē || 114 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
maḍiā samāhatā |
		maüaṁ dīnam |
		mahaṇaṁ piturgr̥ham |
		marulō bhūtam |
		piśācādi |
		maïaṁ bhartsitam |
		maṁḍalō śvā ||
		yathā |
prakrit_examples: kāmamarulamaḍiā sā maüā mahaṇammi vasaï maïasahī | taṁ maṁḍalō vva kattha vi bhamēsi jāṇasi ṇa vēaṇaṁ tīē || 97 || [114]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: maḍayamayaḍā uvavaṇē caṇḍilaē majjhaō cēa | siramālāi maāī maülī a hiayarasōcchalaṇē || 115 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
maḍaō tathā mayaḍō ārāmaḥ |
		majjhaō nāpitaḥ |
		maāī śirōmālā |
		maülī hr̥dayarasōcchalanam ||
		yathā |
prakrit_examples: majjhaya macchayagandhia havēi maülī tumaṁ ṇiantāṇa | mahasi suandhimaāiṁ maḍayaṭhiaṁ taṁ kahaṁ mayaḍavāliṁ || 98 || [115]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: maṁjīraṁ hiñjīrē vallivisēsē mayālī a | jārammi mahālō maṁjuā ya tulasīi maṁtuā lajjā || 116 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
maṁjīraṁ śr̥ṅkhalakam |
		mayālī nidrākarī latā |
		mahālō jāraḥ |
		maṁjuā tulasī |
		maṁjiāity anyē |
		maṁtuā lajjā ||
		yathā |
prakrit_examples: taïā mayāligahaṇē maṁjuadalacuṇṭiriṁ ramasi suṇhaṁ | virayasi maṁtuamiṇhiṁ mahāla maṁjīraghalliō kīsa || 99 || [116]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: karahammi mahaṁgō maṁḍillō pūvē lahummi maḍahaṁ ca | maüḍī mukkuṁḍī murumuṁḍō mōḍō a jūḍammi || 117 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
mahaṁgō uṣṭraḥ |
		maṁḍillō apūpaḥ |
		maḍaha laghu |
		maüḍī mukkuṁḍī murumuṁḍō mōḍōity ētē catvārō jūṭavācakāḥ ||
		yathā ||
prakrit_examples: tīi sumukkuṁḍīē murumuṁḍaṁ ṇia vi kiṁ sumōḍakaē | maṁḍillamatta mōḍasi maḍahaṁ ṇiakumaüḍiṁ mahaṁgōṭṭha || 100 || [117]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: majjōkkamahiṇavē maṁgusamuggusumuggasā ṇaülē | maṁgalamasiṇā samarammā agghāḍammi maüramaüraṁdā || 118 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
majjōkkaṁ pratyagram |
		maṁgusō muggusū muggasō trayō ’py ētē nakulavācakāḥ |
		maṁgalaṁ sadr̥śam |
		masiṇaṁ ramyam |
		maürō tathā maüraṁdō apāmārgaḥ ||
		yathā |
prakrit_examples: maṁgusamuappamaṁgala muggusumuggasijuaṁ masiṇapucchaṁ | maüraṁdavaṇē majjōkkamaürakaṇṭayaṇahaṁ haṇantamahiṁ || 101 || [118]

desinamaala.prakrit_verse: maṁtēllīmayaṇasalāyā sālahiāi malhaṇaṁ līlā | maṁdhāyamahāattā aḍḍhē paṅkē mahēḍḍō a || 199 ||
desinamaala.sanskrit_commentary:
maṁtēllī tathā mayaṇasalāyā sārikā |
		malhaṇaṁ līlā |
		maṁdhāō tathā mahāatō ādyaḥ |
		mahēḍḍō paṅkaḥ ||
		yathā | atra |
		makkaḍō jālakārakr̥miḥ |
